GuruConnect Mobile App — Software Requirements Specification

Implementation-ready SRS for the GuruConnect mobile app (Parents, Students, Teachers, Institutes), split into 55 modules (M0 platform foundation + the 54 requested modules) in build order. Stack: React Native (Expo dev build) + TypeScript, Node.js 20 + Express 4 (same API codebase as the admin portal), PostgreSQL 16 (same database), Firebase Cloud Messaging, Cloudflare R2, Razorpay.

This pack is a companion to the GuruConnect Admin Web Portal SRS (guruconnect-admin-srs.zip / its viewer) — they share one database and one backend codebase. Read 00-conventions.md here first; it only states what's different for the mobile app and refers back to the admin conventions for anything already established there.
Modules 55
Screens 216
New PostgreSQL tables 27 (+ 3 columns added to app_users)
App API endpoints (/api/v1/app) 240
Roles Parent, Student, Teacher, Institute staff
Estimated build effort 180–220 developer-days (one React Native + one backend developer, in parallel where phases allow)

Phase dependency graph

Ordering notes.

  • M10/M13 (subscriptions) and M15/M22 (registration fees) need M43's payment API and PaymentSheet component. Build M43 first, or ship M10/M13/M15/M22 in a "browse only" mode until it lands.
  • M08/M12 dashboards ship with simple rule-based ranking (v0), replaced by M30's scored engine behind the same response shape — no screen changes needed when M30 lands.
  • Push delivery infrastructure (device registration, notification inbox, NotificationService) is built once in M00; M20 adds the preference screen; M47 is the full event catalogue; M48 is the inbox screen.
  • user_consents is owned by M52 but written at every registration flow (M05/M06/M11/M14/M21) and by M11's parental-consent flow — its migration (152) runs with all the others at the start, so there is no runtime ordering issue, only a documentation one.
  • Every admin-portal dependency (e.g. M16 needs Admin M16's verification queue to review into, M43 needs Admin M40's webhook processing) means the admin backend for that area should exist before the mobile module is tested end-to-end; the mobile module's own screens can still be built in parallel against a mock.

Running the database

This app shares its database with the admin portal. If you already applied the admin schema, apply only the mobile addition:

psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d guruconnect -f sql/mobile_only.sql
for f in sql/seed/004_mobile.sql; do psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d guruconnect -f "$f"; done

Fresh database (both apps together):

createdb guruconnect
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d guruconnect -f sql/schema.sql
for f in sql/seed/*.sql; do psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d guruconnect -f "$f"; done

The full schema (admin + mobile, 98 tables) and all seeds (twice) were run on a clean PostgreSQL 16 database while building this pack with no errors.

Confirm before go-live

  • Firebase project: create it, add google-services.json / GoogleService-Info.plist, generate the FCM server key for the API.
  • Cloudflare R2: create gc-public (CDN-fronted) and gc-private buckets, generate S3-compatible API tokens for presigned URLs.
  • SMS/OTP provider (MSG91, Gupshup or similar) and WhatsApp Business API if channel: whatsapp is used for OTP.
  • Google Sign-In OAuth client ids (Android SHA-1, iOS bundle id, Web client id for server-side verification).
  • Razorpay Standard Checkout keys (shared with the admin portal's payment gateway).
  • App Store / Play Store listings — app.store_url_ios is a placeholder until the App Store listing exists (see the admin pack's confirm list for prices and the grievance officer name, which the app also displays).
  • Play Integrity / App Attest, and TLS certificate pinning are noted as v1.1 hardening in 00-conventions.md §13 and each module's §17 — decide the timeline before launch if the threat model needs them at launch.

00 · Mobile Engineering Conventions (read first)

These rules apply to every module in this pack. Module files only describe what is specific to that module; anything not repeated there follows this document. The mobile app shares one PostgreSQL database and one Express API codebase with the admin portal (see the Admin SRS pack). Admin tables are reused as they are; the app adds 27 tables and 3 columns in migrations 100–154.

1. Architecture

Diagram loads when this page is online…

  • The app never talks to PostgreSQL, R2 credentials or FCM server keys directly. It only calls the API, uploads to presigned R2 URLs, and receives pushes.
  • One Express app mounts /api/v1/admin (admin JWT audience gc-admin) and /api/v1/app (app JWT audience gc-app). A token for one audience is rejected by the other.
  • Workers run the same code with a different entrypoint (npm run worker).

4. Navigation map

Diagram loads when this page is online…

  • Route names are PascalCase screen names, e.g. TeacherProfile, typed in navigation/types.ts. Modules list their screens in section 4.
  • Deep links: custom scheme gc:// and universal/app links on https://guruconnect.in. Canonical paths: /t/<teacherPublicCode>, /i/<instituteSlug>, /s/<shareShortCode>, /r/<referralCode>, /leads/<id>, /demos/<id>, /notifications, /plans. Links that need a signed-in user are stored and replayed after login.
  • The role tab navigator is chosen from the role claim of the access token. A user has exactly one role in v1.

5. API conventions for the app

  • Base URL https://api.guruconnect.in/api/v1/app. All paths in module files are relative to it.
  • Headers sent by every request: Authorization: Bearer <access> (when signed in), X-Install-Id (uuid from secure store), X-App-Version (semver), X-App-Build, X-Platform (android/ios), Accept-Language (en-IN), X-Request-Id (uuid per request, echoed back). Idempotency-Key (uuid) on create actions marked in module files.
  • Envelope (same as admin): success { "data": …, "meta": {…} }; error { "error": { "code", "message", "details", "requestId" } }. message is safe to show to users; the app maps known codes to its own translated copy.
  • IDs are UUIDs. Human codes (GC-T10241, LD-100231) are for display and support only.
  • Money in paise (integer). The app formats with formatINR(paise) → ₹1,999.
  • Time: API sends ISO 8601 UTC; the app displays Asia/Kolkata. Dates without time (2026-09-29) are IST calendar dates.
  • Pagination: feeds and lists use cursor pagination: ?limit=20&cursor=<opaque> → meta.nextCursor (null at the end). Search results use ?page= only where totals matter (section 17 of each module says which).
  • Version gate: every response carries X-Min-App-Version. If the app is below it, the API returns 426 APP_UPDATE_REQUIRED for all calls except /bootstrap; the app routes to the Force Update screen.
  • Maintenance: when app.maintenance_mode is true, all calls except /bootstrap return 503 MAINTENANCE.
  • Rate limits: default 120 requests/minute per user and 300/minute per IP; tighter limits are listed per endpoint.

Standard error codes (app)

Code HTTP Meaning App behaviour
AUTH_REQUIRED 401 No/invalid token Go to Login, keep intended deep link
AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED 401 Access token expired Refresh once, retry the request
AUTH_REFRESH_INVALID 401 Refresh token revoked/expired/reused Clear session, go to Login with message "Please sign in again."
ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED 403 account_status suspended/banned Blocking screen with support contact and reason
FORBIDDEN 403 Wrong role or not the owner Toast "You can't do that."
ROLE_MISMATCH 409 Signing in with a role different from the account's Explain and offer to continue as the existing role
REGISTRATION_REQUIRED 409 Verified phone/email has no account yet Route to registration with registrationToken
OTP_INVALID / OTP_EXPIRED / OTP_LOCKED 422 / 410 / 429 OTP checks Inline error under the code field
VALIDATION_FAILED 422 Zod failed; details[] = { path, message } Map to form fields
NOT_FOUND 404 Missing or soft-deleted "This is no longer available." with back button
CONFLICT_STATE 409 Action not allowed in current status Show message, refetch
CONFLICT_DUPLICATE 409 Unique rule Inline message
VERSION_CONFLICT 409 If-Match mismatch on profile edits "Updated on another device. Review and save again."
SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED 402 Feature needs an active plan Open plans sheet (M10/M13)
LIMIT_REACHED 429 Business limit (leads/day, children) Show limit copy from details.limit
BLOCKED 403 One side blocked the other "You can't contact this user."
RATE_LIMITED 429 Too many requests; Retry-After Disable button until retry time
APP_UPDATE_REQUIRED 426 Below minimum version Force Update screen
MAINTENANCE 503 Maintenance mode Maintenance screen
PAYMENT_FAILED 402 Gateway declined / signature mismatch Payment result screen with retry
GATEWAY_ERROR 502 SMS, R2, FCM or Razorpay down Retry button; never lose form input
FILE_TOO_LARGE / FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED 413 / 415 Upload rules Inline under the picker
INTERNAL_ERROR 500 Anything else Generic error state with request id (long-press to copy)

6. Authentication and sessions

  • Access token: JWT RS256, 15 minutes, audience gc-app. Claims: sub (app_users.id), role (parent|student|teacher|institute_staff), pid (id in the role table: parents.id, students.id, teachers.id or institute_managers.id), iid (institute id for staff), sid (app_sessions.id). Kept in memory only.
  • Refresh token: 256-bit random, 30-day sliding / 60-day absolute, stored in expo-secure-store (Keychain / Android Keystore). Stored server-side as SHA-256 in app_sessions. Rotates on every refresh; presenting an old token revokes the whole token_family (theft detection).
  • Registration token: after a new phone/email is verified, the API returns a 30-minute JWT (aud gc-register, sub = verified contact, role) that is the only credential accepted by the registration endpoints. The account (app_users + role row) is created only when registration is submitted, so there are no half-created accounts.
  • Refresh flow in the app: lib/api.ts catches AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED, runs one shared refresh promise, retries queued requests; on AUTH_REFRESH_INVALID it signs out.
  • Server middleware order: requestId → versionGate → maintenanceGate → rateLimit → authenticateApp → loadAccount (status check, cached 60 s in Redis) → requireRole(...) → validate(zod) → handler.
  • Ownership: every handler scopes queries by the token (WHERE parent_id = :pid), never by ids sent in the body.

7. State management rules

Kind of state Where Example
Server data TanStack Query cache (persisted to MMKV) profile, dashboard rails, search results, leads
Session Zustand useSession (memory) + secure store (refresh token) access token, role, pid
App flags Zustand + MMKV onboardingSeenVersion, lastRole, pushPromptShownAt
Form drafts Zustand + encrypted MMKV, keyed per form teacher registration steps, review draft
Filters Zustand per search type, persisted selected subject/class/city
Ephemeral UI component state open bottom sheet, selected tab
  • Query keys come from one factory per feature, e.g. teacherKeys.detail(id), searchKeys.teachers(filters). Mutations invalidate by key prefix.
  • Optimistic updates only for reversible, idempotent actions (favourite, mark read, availability toggle). Roll back on error with a toast.
  • Sign-out clears: query cache, all Zustand stores, encrypted MMKV, secure store refresh token; keeps install_id and onboarding flag.

8. Offline handling (global)

  • NetInfo drives an offline banner ("You're offline. Showing saved results.").
  • Read: persisted queries render instantly from cache (max age 24 h; cache busted on app version change). Screens show the cached time ("Updated 2 h ago") when offline.
  • Write: three classes, stated per module:
    1. Queue offline — idempotent actions with a client-generated id (favourites, lead messages, notification read, availability edits). Stored in a persisted mutation queue, replayed in order on reconnect, deduplicated server-side by client_message_id / unique indexes.
    2. Save draft, submit online — forms (registration, reviews, complaints, child setup). The draft survives app restarts; the submit button is disabled offline with a hint.
    3. Online only — OTP, payments, uploads start, account deletion, anything with money or security. Button disabled offline.
  • Uploads resume: if the app is killed mid-upload, the file is re-uploaded on next launch (presigned URLs are re-requested; files rows in pending are cleaned by a job after 24 h).

9. Push notifications (global)

  • Token lifecycle: after sign-in the app calls PUT /devices/me with install id, FCM token and permission state; again on onTokenRefresh and on app foreground if the token changed. Sign-out calls DELETE /devices/me.
  • Permission timing: never on first launch. Ask after a meaningful moment (parent: after first lead or saving a favourite; teacher: at the end of registration "Get notified when you're verified"; institute: after registration). Android 13+ uses the POST_NOTIFICATIONS runtime prompt; iOS uses provisional authorisation first where suitable. A pre-permission explainer sheet is shown before the OS prompt.
  • Android channels: leads (high importance, sound), account (default), payments (default), reviews (default), general (low). Channel per category is set in the payload.
  • Payload (FCM HTTP v1): notification { title, body, image } + data { eventType, notificationId, deepLink, category, entityId }; Android collapse_key per entity for updates; iOS thread-id per category; badge = unread count.
  • Server pipeline: domain event → NotificationService.notify(userId, template, data) → insert user_notifications (dedupe key) → check preferences + quiet hours (21:30–08:00 IST unless urgent) → BullMQ push queue → FCM send to all active devices → update push_status; UNREGISTERED tokens revoke the device row.
  • Tap handling: cold start (getInitialNotification), background (onNotificationOpenedApp), foreground (onMessage → notifee banner). All route through deeplinks.open(deepLink) and mark the notification read.
  • Each module lists its events in section 16 as: event · recipient · title/body template · deep link · category · urgent?

10. File uploads (Cloudflare R2)

  1. App picks a file; images are resized to max 2000 px long edge, JPEG quality 0.8, EXIF GPS stripped; PDFs ≤ 10 MB.
  2. POST /uploads/presign { purpose, mimeType, sizeBytes, fileName } → { fileId, uploadUrl, headers, expiresAt } (URL valid 10 min; R2 S3-compatible presigned PUT with Content-Type and Content-Length fixed).
  3. App PUTs the bytes directly to R2 with progress.
  4. POST /uploads/:fileId/confirm → API checks object size/type via HEAD, marks files.status = 'active'.
  5. The module's own endpoint links the fileId (e.g. POST /teacher/documents { fileId, docType }).
Purpose Bucket Allowed Max
avatar, teacher_photo, institute_logo, institute_cover, institute_gallery gc-public (served via cdn.guruconnect.in) jpeg, png, webp 5 MB
teacher_document, institute_document gc-private jpeg, png, pdf 10 MB
complaint_evidence, support_attachment gc-private jpeg, png, pdf 10 MB

Private files are read through GET /files/:id/url (owner only, 60-second presigned GET). Identity documents are never shown back in full after upload: the app shows a thumbnail with the masked number.

11. Audit logs

App actions that change important data write audit_logs rows in the same transaction, with actor_type = 'app_user', actor_id = sub, module = 'app.<feature>', IP, user agent (GuruConnect/1.2.0 (Android 14; SM-A546E)) and request id. Logged: sign-in/out, session revocation, contact changes, registration, profile and fee changes, document uploads, children changes, reviews and replies, leads and demo actions, payments started, reports and blocks, privacy/consent changes, account deletion. Reads and searches are not audit-logged (they go to analytics). Sensitive values (OTP, tokens, document numbers, passwords) are never written to audit logs. Each module lists its events in section 20.

12. Data conventions

  • UUID primary keys everywhere (gen_random_uuid()); join tables use composite keys.
  • Soft delete: user-facing deletes set deleted_at; queries filter deleted_at IS NULL; unique indexes are partial on live rows. Hard deletes only in the account-erasure job (M54) and for expired OTPs/sessions (cleanup jobs).
  • updated_at (trigger) is the version for optimistic locking: edits send If-Match: <updatedAt>.
  • Children are minors: first name only, class, board, subjects, school name optional — no photo, no date of birth.

13. Security baseline

  • TLS only; HSTS on the API. Certificate pinning for api.guruconnect.in is planned after launch (section 21 of M00).
  • Tokens only in secure store/memory. Encrypted MMKV for cached personal data. No PII in logs, Sentry breadcrumbs or analytics (scrub phone, email, names).
  • FLAG_SECURE (Android) and a privacy overlay on iOS app switcher for document upload/view, payment and OTP screens.
  • Root/jailbreak detection is informational only (sent as a header, used in fraud scoring) — the app still works.
  • Server: Zod validation on every input, parameterised SQL (Kysely), per-endpoint rate limits, ownership checks, output DTOs that never include other users' phone/email unless the contact is unlocked.
  • Contact info in free text (bios, messages, reviews) is detected and masked until contact is unlocked, to keep payments on-platform and users safe.
  • DPDP Act 2023: consent captured and stored (user_consents), purpose-limited analytics, user can download and delete data (M52, M54); users under 18 need verifiable parental consent (M11).

14. UI conventions

  • Touch targets ≥ 48 dp; body text 16 sp; supports system font scaling up to 130% without clipping.
  • Every data screen has four states: loading (skeleton), empty (illustration + one action), error (message + Retry), content. Pull-to-refresh on lists.
  • Colour is never the only signal (status pills have text; trust score has a number).
  • Primary actions sit in a sticky bottom bar on forms. Destructive actions ask for confirmation in a bottom sheet.
  • Currency ₹1,999; large numbers in Indian grouping (1,23,456); dates Tue, 29 Sep · 6:00 PM.
  • Accessibility: accessibilityLabel on icon buttons, logical focus order, screen reader announcements for toasts and OTP errors.

15. Error handling pattern

  • AppErrorBoundary at the navigator root (fallback screen with "Restart" and request id).
  • toAppError(e) maps API codes to translated copy and to a UI action (toast | inline | screen | signOut | upgrade).
  • Forms: VALIDATION_FAILED.details[].path → setError(path); unknown paths → toast.
  • Network: requests time out after 15 s (uploads 120 s); GET retried twice with backoff; mutations are not retried automatically unless idempotent.
  • Every error screen shows a Retry and keeps user input.

16. Testing

  • Unit/component: Jest + React Native Testing Library, MSW handlers generated from shared schemas. Every screen: renders each of the four states.
  • API: Supertest against a disposable PostgreSQL (the schema in sql/schema.sql), seeded with sql/seed/*.
  • E2E: Maestro flows for each module's happy path plus the listed edge cases, run on an Android emulator (API 34) and an iOS simulator in CI. OTP uses a test-mode provider where +91 90000 0000x numbers accept 123456 (disabled in production builds).
  • Devices: manual pass on a 2 GB RAM Android 9/10 phone, a mid-range Android 14, and an iPhone SE-size screen.
  • Each module's section 19 lists the scenarios; IDs are T<module>.<n>.

17. Performance budgets

Cold start to interactive ≤ 2.5 s on a mid-range Android; dashboard first content ≤ 1.5 s from cache; search results ≤ 800 ms API p95; JS bundle ≤ 6 MB; images from CDN with width parameters; lists virtualised with FlashList.

18. Definition of done (per module)

Screens match section 6; all four UI states; validation shared with the API; endpoints return the documented payloads and errors; ownership and role checks; audit events written; push events wired; offline behaviour as specified; analytics events named <module>_<action>; unit + API tests and the module's Maestro flow pass; strings in en.json; accessibility labels present.

01 · Data Model (mobile additions)

The mobile app adds 27 new tables and 3 columns on app_users to the shared database described in the Admin SRS's 01-data-model.md. Every new table uses a uuid primary key (gen_random_uuid()) except join/rollup tables, which use composite keys or a natural key (user_notification_preferences (user_id, category), institute_daily_stats (institute_id, stat_date)). All tables use timestamptz, snake_case names, and the same soft-delete convention (deleted_at, partial unique indexes WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) as the admin schema.

Conventions recap

  • Money: bigint paise everywhere money appears (wallet_ledger.amount_paise), same as the admin schema — never a JS float.
  • OTP and session secrets: otp_challenges.code_hash and app_sessions.refresh_token_hash store only HMAC/SHA-256 hashes, never plaintext codes or tokens.
  • Idempotency: client-generated ids double as unique indexes so offline-queued writes are safe to replay — lead_messages.client_message_id, wallet_ledger.idempotency_key, user_notifications.dedupe_key, support_ticket_messages.client_message_id.
  • One-per-user uniqueness: partial unique indexes enforce "one live X per user" without a service-layer race — uq_user_devices_token, uq_user_favorites_teacher/_institute, uq_account_deletion_live.
  • Append-only: otp_challenges, user_search_history, recommendation_impressions, wallet_ledger, profile_shares are never updated in place by the app; only inserted (and soft-deleted where the user can clear history).

03 · Push Notification Catalogue

Every push / in-app notification event across the mobile app, drawn from each module's §16. Delivery mechanics (device registration, quiet hours, Android channels, tap handling) are defined once in M00 and restated as a contract in M47; this page is the full list used to build NotificationService templates. 208 distinct events listed below.

M00 Mobile Platform Foundation

This module provides the delivery infrastructure; it sends no events of its own. Android channels are created at first launch: leads (high), account, payments, reviews (default), general (low). The app handles notification taps in the three states described in conventions §9 and marks the item read via M48.

M04 Login

Event Recipient Title / Body Deep link Category Urgent
Password changed Account owner "Your password was changed" / "If this wasn't you, contact support immediately." gc://account/security account yes
Signed out everywhere (reuse detected) Account owner "We signed you out for your security" / "A sign-in token was reused from another device. Please sign in again." gc://login account yes
New device signed in (optional, only when > 1 active session already existed) Account owner "New sign-in to your account" / "{deviceLabel} · {city}" gc://account/security account no

M07 Parent Child Setup

Event Recipient Title / Body Deep link Category Urgent
New match appears later for a child with zero matches at save time Parent "A teacher for {childName} just joined" / "{teacherName} teaches {subject} near you." gc://t/{teacherPublicCode} recommendations no
No push at save time itself — the in-app preview sheet (BR-7.6) already shows the result synchronously; the push above only fires later, from the same recommendation-recompute job triggered elsewhere (a newly approved teacher), for a child that previously had none.

04 · React Native App Structure

Expo SDK 52 development build, React Native 0.76+ (New Architecture), TypeScript strict, React Navigation 7, TanStack Query v5, Zustand, React Hook Form + Zod. Full library list in 00-conventions.md §2.

Folder layout

apps/mobile/
  app.config.ts
  src/
    app/                App.tsx, providers, navigation/ (RootNavigator, linking.ts, types.ts)
    features/<module>/  screens/, components/, hooks/, api.ts, store.ts, __tests__/
    components/ui/      Button, TextField, PhoneField, OtpInput, Select, Chip, Card, Avatar, Badge, StatusPill, Skeleton, EmptyState, ErrorState, BottomSheet, Toast, StickyActionBar, ConfirmSheet, ImagePickerField, DocumentPickerField
    components/domain/  TeacherCard, InstituteCard, VerifiedBadge, TrustScoreRing, RatingStars, PriceTag, ChildChip, LocationPill
    lib/                api.ts, queryClient.ts, storage.ts, push.ts, upload.ts, format.ts, analytics.ts, errors.ts, deeplinks.ts
    theme/              tokens.ts
    i18n/               en.json, hi.json
  packages/shared/      Zod schemas, enums, error codes, fee codes (imported by both the app and the API)

App shell & tab navigators

  • Root sequence: Splash (M01) → Onboarding/Auth (M02–M05) or role tabs, chosen from GET /me (M00).
  • Parent tabs: Home (M08) · Search (M27/M28) · Saved (M40/M41) · Requests (M37/M38) · Profile (M09).
  • Student tabs: Home (M12) · Search · Saved · Requests · Profile.
  • Teacher tabs: Dashboard (M18) · Leads (M37) · Reviews (M36) · Profile (M17).
  • Institute tabs: Dashboard (M23) · Enquiries (M39) · Teachers (M25) · Profile (M24).
  • Settings, notifications, help, trust score and complaint screens are pushed from Profile on every role.
  • Deep linking: custom scheme gc:// and universal links on https://guruconnect.in (paths in 00-conventions.md §4); a link needing auth is replayed after login (M00 BR-0.11).

Component Purpose

useMe, useMasters, useAreas(cityId), useUpload(purpose), useChildrenQuery, useSearchTeachers(filters), useRecommendations(childId), useLead(id), useDemoSlots(teacherId), useFavorites, useTrustScore(teacherId), usePlans(role), useSubscription, useWallet, useNotifications, useNotificationPreferences.

05 · Roadmap and Future Enhancements

Delivery plan by phase

Phase Modules Estimate (dev-days) Outcome when done
Phase 0 · Mobile Platform M00 5–6 Shell, API client, sessions, push/upload/masters plumbing — everything else builds on this
Phase 1 · App Foundation M01, M02, M03, M04, M05 11–15 App opens, gates on version/maintenance, routes to onboarding, login or home
Phase 2 · Parent M06, M07, M08, M09, M10 15–17 Parents sign up, add children and see a dashboard with recommendations and a subscription
Phase 3 · Student M11, M12, M13 8–9 Students sign up (with parental consent under 18) and see their own dashboard/subscription
Phase 4 · Teacher M14, M15, M16, M17, M18, M19, M20 23–28 Teachers register, upload documents, get verified, build a profile and see leads
Phase 5 · Institute M21, M22, M23, M24, M25, M26 20–26 Institutes register, get verified, manage staff and teachers, show ratings
Phase 6 · Search & Discovery M27, M28, M29, M30 19–23 Learners can search, filter, save searches and get personalised recommendations
Phase 7 · Profiles M31, M32, M33 12–15 Full teacher/institute profile pages and shareable links
Phase 8 · Reviews M34, M35, M36 8–9 Reviews with replies and moderation-aware display
Phase 9 · Leads M37, M38, M39 13–16 Leads, messaging and demo bookings end to end
Phase 10 · Favourites M40, M41 3–4 Favourites and comparison
Phase 11 · Trust Score M42 3–3 Trust score explained to every learner and teacher
Phase 12 · Payments M43, M44, M45 11–14 Payments, subscriptions and payment history live
Phase 13 · Referrals M46 4–5 Referral program and wallet
Phase 14 · Notifications M47, M48 5–6 Full push + in-app notification experience
Phase 15 · Complaints M49, M50 6–8 Reporting, blocking and complaint tracking
Phase 16 · Settings M51, M52, M53, M54 14–16 Account, privacy, help and account deletion

Suggested milestones: Alpha (Phases 0–5: foundation, parent, student, teacher, institute onboarding) → Beta (Phases 6–11: discovery, profiles, reviews, leads, favourites, trust) → Launch (Phases 12–16: payments, referrals, notifications, safety, settings).

Future enhancements by module

M00 Mobile Platform Foundation

  • Certificate pinning (TrustKit / react-native-ssl-public-key-pinning) with a backup pin once the API domain is stable.
  • Play Integrity API and Apple App Attest tokens on sensitive calls (OTP request, payments) to block emulators and scripted abuse.
  • Move analytics to a dedicated pipeline (e.g. PostHog / BigQuery) when event volume passes ~5M/day.
  • Partition user_notifications by month and archive items older than 12 months.
  • Offline-first local database (WatermelonDB) only if a future feature needs heavy offline editing; the query cache is enough for v1.

M01 Splash Screen

  • app_releases table (platform, version, notes, rollout %, min OS) for staged rollouts and "What's new" screens.
  • Server-driven feature flags per user segment (e.g. GrowthBook) delivered in bootstrap.
  • Remote-config onboarding content and seasonal splash artwork.
  • Per-city maintenance (e.g. payments down only) using feature flags instead of a global switch.

M02 Onboarding Screens

  • Personalise slide order or copy by acquisition channel (e.g. a teacher-focused variant for institute referral links) using the same onboardingVersion mechanism, versioned per audience segment.
  • A/B test slide copy through a remote-config layer once one exists (see M00 scalability).
  • Video or Lottie illustrations instead of static images once bundle size budget (conventions §17, 6 MB) allows it.
  • Track onboarding_slide_viewed / onboarding_skipped analytics events (M00 POST /events) to see where users drop off, once the analytics pipeline can slice by slide index.

M03 Authentication Selection

  • Apple Sign-In alongside Google once the iOS App Store guideline requirement is confirmed to apply (mandatory when any third-party social login is offered).
  • WhatsApp OTP as a channel alongside SMS (schema already supports channel = 'whatsapp' on otp_challenges) if SMS delivery cost or reliability becomes an issue.
  • Remember the last successful method per install (useAppFlags.lastAuthMethod) and visually promote it to the top on return visits.
  • Single Tap / One Tap Google prompt (no button press) for returning Google users, once product wants a more aggressive default.

M04 Login

  • Move JWT signing to a KMS-backed key with kid rotation and a JWKS endpoint, matching Admin M01's future notes.
  • WhatsApp as a third OTP channel (schema-ready, otp_challenges.channel = 'whatsapp') where SMS deliverability is poor.
  • Device attestation (Play Integrity / App Attest) gating /auth/otp/request and /auth/google to cut scripted OTP abuse further than rate limits alone.
  • Step-up re-authentication (short-lived "sensitive action" token) before payment method changes or account deletion, instead of relying solely on the 15-minute access token's age.
  • Passkeys (WebAuthn) as a fourth identity provider once React Native support is mature enough for a 2 GB RAM Android baseline.

M05 Registration

  • A fifth "I'm not sure" tile that asks two quick questions (age, "do you teach or do you want a teacher?") and recommends a role, for users confused by the four-way choice.
  • Server-driven role tile ordering/copy (A/B test "Teacher" vs "Institute" phrasing) once remote config exists.
  • Multi-role accounts (e.g. a parent who is also a part-time tutor) — out of scope for v1 ("a user has exactly one role", conventions §4); would need a role-switch flow and a rethink of app_users.user_type as the sole role source.
  • Save-and-resume by email link ("finish signing up later") for the longer Teacher/Institute forms, instead of relying solely on the on-device encrypted draft.

M06 Parent Registration

  • Optional profile photo at registration once product wants richer parent profiles (currently deferred to M09 Parent Profile, post-registration).
  • Auto-detect city from expo-location (foreground only) to pre-select the state/city pickers, falling back to the manual pickers exactly as today.
  • Multi-language registration form once Hindi strings ship (conventions §2 i18n), reusing the same fields.
  • Bulk/import registration for schools onboarding many parents at once (an admin-portal feature, not this app screen) — noted for Admin portal additions if requested later.

M07 Parent Child Setup

  • Learning-to-rank recommendations using actual lead/demo outcomes per child, replacing the fixed BR-7.6 weights once M30 has enough signal (module map build-order note: M30 replaces the v0 formula behind the same rec:<childId> cache contract, no app change needed).
  • A "similar to {childName}" quick-copy when adding a second child with the same class/subjects (common for twins or close-in-age siblings).
  • Push the moment a class transition is likely (e.g. April board-year rollover) prompting parents to review each child's class before the new academic year's search results shift under them.
  • Per-child content recommendations (blog posts filtered by class, Admin M45) surfaced on the child's card once that module exists.

M08 Parent Dashboard

  • Replace the v0 formulas with Module 30's learned scorer without any app change (BR-8.12).
  • Precompute rail caches in a nightly/streaming job instead of on first request, to remove the cold-cache latency spike after a child edit.
  • A "For You" mixed rail blending teachers and institutes once click-through data exists.
  • Per-rail A/B testing of card layout and copy, keyed by algo_version (reusing Module 30's column).
  • Server-driven layout (rail order and count configurable by admin/segment) once more rail types exist.

M09 Parent Profile

  • Multiple guardians per family (co-parent access) once the product needs it — today one app_users row = one parent.
  • Address book (multiple saved addresses for different children/schools) if home-tuition logistics need it.
  • Profile completeness meter (mirroring the teacher one, Module 17) to nudge photo/area completion, which improves Nearby/Recommended relevance.

M10 Parent Subscription

  • Family/multi-child plan tiers (e.g. a higher tier unlocking simultaneous demo scheduling for 3+ children).
  • In-app plan comparison with usage stats ("You contacted 6 teachers this month").
  • Win-back offer screen for expired/cancelled parents (Admin M30's future coupon codes, Admin M05 §21).
  • Re-enable auto-renew from the app once a stored-mandate re-authorisation flow exists (Razorpay recurring token refresh).

M11 Student Registration

  • Schema request: a student_subjects table (mirroring parent_child_subjects) to make subject interest durable and editable, replacing the 30-day Redis cold-start hint (BR-11.5).
  • Schema request / v1.1 feature: a parent-side confirm/decline endpoint and push for a pending account link, removing the current admin-mediated step (BR-11.9).
  • A short in-app explainer video for "Why does my parent need to approve?" to raise consent completion rate.
  • Email as a fallback parental-consent channel for households where the parent's number can't receive SMS reliably.
  • Re-verification of consent if the student's class crosses back below the threshold is not applicable (class only increases), but a periodic re-confirmation (e.g. yearly) could be added if regulation requires it.

M12 Student Dashboard

  • Fold the cold-start/search-affinity/favourite-category signals into Module 30's proper feature set once it ships, rather than three ad-hoc terms.
  • A durable student_subjects table (Module 11's schema request) would remove the 30-day cold-start expiry edge case entirely.
  • Exam-goal-based rails (e.g. "For JEE Main" curated by admins) once Module 45's blog/content tagging by class extends to subjects.
  • Per-rail impression/click analytics feeding Module 30's training data, as Module 8.

M13 Student Subscription

  • Exam-season short plans (e.g. 90-day JEE crash plan) as additional fee codes, per Admin M32 §21.
  • A visible "why no trial" state for device-reuse cases if support tickets show it's confusing (currently silent by design, BR-13.3).
  • Institutional/school bulk licences that would set many students to free_access at once (Admin M32 §21).
  • Merge trial-contacts tracking into Module 30's engine so "contacts remaining" also informs recommendation urgency messaging (e.g. nudge to contact a strong match before contacts run out).

M14 Teacher Registration

  • Server-side draft validation shared with Admin M16's manual-creation form (FR-16.10) so both entry points enforce identical rules.
  • A "resume by SMS link" flow (deep link straight to nextStep) for teachers who abandon the wizard, driven by a reminder job reading teachers.verification_status = 'draft' and created_at age.
  • Bulk-import qualifications from a resume/CV photo via OCR as an optional shortcut before manual entry.
  • Category-specific step sets (e.g. institute-affiliated teachers skip Locations) once Module 25 institute-linked teachers are common.

M15 Teacher Document Upload

  • DigiLocker / UIDAI e-KYC integration to skip manual number entry and photo upload entirely (Admin M16 §21 already anticipates this).
  • Client-side document-quality pre-check (blur/glare detection) before upload to cut reupload-requested rates.
  • Allow a teacher to start verification with only Aadhaar + PAN and add certificates later, once Admin policy supports partial submission.
  • Move the OCR/face-match vendor calls (today triggered on submit) to run per-upload for faster feedback, once vendor cost allows it.

M16 Teacher Verification Status

  • Estimated review time shown from a rolling p50 of Admin M16's actual decision times instead of the fixed "24 hours" copy.
  • In-app chat with the verification team for edge cases, reusing Module 53's support-ticket infrastructure instead of "Contact support" as a bare link.
  • Push-driven live timeline updates via a lightweight WebSocket/SSE channel once polling load becomes noticeable at scale.
  • Self-service re-application flow that resets a rejected teacher to draft directly from the app (today requires Admin support), once the 30-day rule is stable enough to automate safely.

M17 Teacher Profile Builder

  • Fee plan templates by category (pre-filled suggestions for "Home Tutor" vs "Coaching Faculty") to speed up setup.
  • A/B testing bio prompts or structured bio fields (a short "teaching philosophy" prompt) to lift profile-view-to-lead conversion.
  • Multi-photo galleries (classroom photos) once Module 32-style galleries prove valuable for institutes and are extended to teachers.
  • Inline "profile score vs. similar teachers in your city" benchmark once Module 21 analytics support percentile comparisons.

M18 Teacher Dashboard

  • City/subject percentile benchmarks ("Top 15% for JEE Physics in Bengaluru") once Admin M21's leaderboard data is safe to expose per-teacher without revealing competitors' identities.
  • Push-driven live tile updates for high-value events (a lead just arrived) instead of a 60-second staleTime, via a lightweight event channel.
  • Exportable monthly summary (PDF) for a teacher's own records, reusing Module 45's payment-history export patterns.
  • A goals feature ("Get to 10 reviews this month") once enough usage data exists to make goals meaningful rather than arbitrary.

M19 Teacher Availability

  • Per-slot granularity (15/30-minute bookable slots with capacity) instead of open windows, once Module 38 needs finer-grained scheduling than "somewhere in this window."
  • Google/Outlook calendar two-way sync so a teacher's external calendar drives availability automatically (Admin M39 §21 already anticipates this on the demo side).
  • Recurring time off (e.g. "every Sunday") as a lighter-weight alternative to one-off ranges, if teachers ask for it often enough to justify the added complexity.
  • Per-window capacity (a coaching-institute teacher accepting multiple students in the same online slot) once group classes are modelled.

M20 Teacher Notifications

  • WhatsApp Business API as a channel for leads/demos categories once the platform supports it (per Admin M46 §21), reusing the same category/preference model.
  • Per-device preferences (mute this specific phone but not a tablet) once multi-device usage is common enough to justify it.
  • Smarter default nudging ("Teachers who enable lead push reply 3× faster") shown once during onboarding rather than left to discovery.
  • A monthly digest email per category as a lower-frequency alternative to per-event email, once email volume needs it.

M21 Institute Registration

  • GST portal (GSTN public API) lookup during registration to prefill the legal name and address and warn on mismatch.
  • Google Places autocomplete for the address with automatic pin placement.
  • Branches: a parent_institute_id so chains register several centres under one owner account.
  • Owner identity through DigiLocker e-KYC instead of an uploaded Aadhaar image.
  • Allow one person to belong to several institutes (institute switcher in the app) by moving iid from the token into a selected-institute header.
  • Admin portal additions: none; registrations appear in Admin M22's queue once submitted, and drafts are visible in the Admin M24 directory with status draft.

M22 Institute Verification

  • In-app document scanner with edge detection and automatic crop (ML Kit document scanner on Android, VisionKit on iOS).
  • DigiLocker pull for the owner's Aadhaar and PAN instead of images.
  • Self-service visit rescheduling with slots published by evaluators.
  • Video walkthrough upload (for video_walkthrough evaluations) with resumable multipart uploads to R2.
  • Admin portal additions: publishing the gallery (Admin M24 FR-24.7) must copy approved campus_photo files from gc-private to gc-public as institute_gallery files.

M23 Institute Dashboard

  • Partition institute_profile_views by month once it passes ~20M rows; move the job to incremental aggregation from an event stream.
  • Funnel view (impression → view → enquiry → visit → enrolled) using demo_requests.outcome.
  • Benchmarks: "Institutes like yours in Koramangala get 22 enquiries a month" from anonymised city/type medians.
  • Per-counsellor response metrics once enquiries record which staff member responded.
  • CSV export of daily stats for owners.
  • Admin portal additions: none; Admin M50 institute reports read institute_daily_stats.

M24 Institute Manager

  • Granular per-staff permissions (e.g. a counsellor who can also manage batches) instead of the fixed two roles.
  • Staff activity log visible to the manager (last enquiry handled, last sign-in).
  • A "meet our team" section on the public profile (photo, designation) sourced from this staff list.
  • Branches/chains sharing one staff directory across several institute records (tracked in M21's scalability notes too).
  • Bulk facilities/photos import when onboarding a chain of centres.
  • Admin portal additions: none; Admin M24 and M25 already cover the same data for support.

M25 Institute Teacher Management

  • An in-app identity check for directly-added (unlinked) institute teachers, instead of relying on the external lightweight flow (Admin M26 FR-26.4) to move them out of id_pending.
  • Per-batch teacher assignment (which teacher teaches which institute_batches row) once batches carry a teacher reference.
  • Bulk import (CSV) of a faculty list for onboarding a large institute.
  • Teacher-visible history of which institutes have listed them, with an option to unlink themselves.
  • Public faculty change history on the profile ("3 new teachers this term").
  • Admin portal additions: none; Admin M26 already covers support overrides and the cross-institute phone/teacher search.

M26 Institute Rating Display

  • A public "rating history" timeline on the profile (currently staff-only) once ratings are frequent enough to be a positive signal rather than noise.
  • Featured/leaderboard rails ("Top-rated JEE coaching in Bengaluru") built on Admin M27's leaderboard endpoint.
  • Push a comparison ("your rating vs. similar institutes in your city") using anonymised medians.
  • Cache the summary in the CDN edge for the public endpoint once traffic justifies it (currently Redis only).
  • Admin portal additions: none; Admin M27 already owns rating creation, submission and the leaderboard.

M27 Teacher Search

  • Move ranking to OpenSearch/Elasticsearch once teachers passes ~200k rows and pg_trgm scan cost rises; keep the same scoring formula as the relevance function.
  • Personalise relevance weights per user from click-through (feeds into M30's model rather than duplicating logic here).
  • Location-aware suggestions using device GPS instead of area-name text once permission UX is validated.
  • Add subjectIds multi-select synonyms (e.g. "Maths" ↔ "Mathematics") as a small curated table instead of relying on aliases alone.
  • Schema requests: GIN trigram indexes on teachers.full_name and subjects.name (BR-27.2) — no new columns, index-only migration.

M28 Institute Search

  • Personalised institute ranking blended with M30's model once enough click-through data exists.
  • Distance-based ranking (haversine, like M27) once institute density per city justifies it — today a city-level list is small enough that rating order reads better than distance order.
  • Batch-level search ("show only institutes with an open Class 10 CBSE batch starting this month") as a dedicated filter once institute_batches volume supports it.

M29 Advanced Filters

  • Move facet counting to a search index (same migration point as M27's scalability note) so seven grouped counts become sub-100 ms even at high teacher volumes.
  • Weekly digest option (in addition to daily) once alert volume data shows daily is too frequent for low-density cities.
  • Filter presets ("Budget-friendly", "Highly rated") as one-tap combinations built from the same facet data.
  • Cross-target saved searches (one alert covering both teachers and institutes) if usage shows parents want a single combined feed.

M30 Recommendation Engine

  • Feed dismissal reasons back into that user's own live scoring (a lightweight per-user category penalty) once enough dismissal volume exists to do so without overfitting on 1–2 data points.
  • Replace the in-process candidate SQL with a vector/embedding-based similarity service once subject/category taxonomies grow past what a hand-tuned weighted sum models well.
  • A/B testing harness for recommendations.weights versions (parallel to Admin M36's trust-weight simulate/activate pattern) rather than a single live version.
  • Background pre-warm of the Redis cache for active users overnight, so the first dashboard open of the day never pays the compute-on-miss cost.
  • Cross-child household signals (what similar households with a Class 8 CBSE child in the same city responded to) once privacy and volume both support it.

M31 Teacher Profile View

  • Server-rendered, cacheable HTML preview pages per teacher for search-engine indexing beyond the Open Graph share preview (SEO growth channel).
  • "Compare teachers" (2–3 side by side) reusing this module's field set once M40/M41 favourites data shows people shortlisting before contacting.
  • Video introduction clips on the profile (a new files purpose) once upload/transcoding infrastructure exists.
  • Personalised "why this teacher" reasons (reused from M30) surfaced directly on the profile hero, not only in rails.

M32 Institute Profile View

  • Server-rendered, indexable HTML preview pages per institute for SEO, matching M31's equivalent note.
  • "Compare institutes" side by side once favourites/shortlisting data (M41) shows demand.
  • Virtual campus tour (360° photos or short video) on the gallery once upload infrastructure supports larger media.
  • Batch waitlist ("Notify me when a seat opens") tied into M39's enquiry flow instead of only a generic enquiry message.

M33 Profile Sharing

  • Deferred deep linking (e.g. Branch.io-style) so a store install truly resumes into the exact shared profile even without a referral code round trip, rather than relying on BR-33.4's registration-time join.
  • Per-share analytics (which channel converts best) once volume justifies a breakdown beyond the two counters.
  • QR codes for offline sharing (a teacher's visiting card, an institute's front-desk poster) generated from the same short codes.
  • Expiring or one-time share links for time-limited promotions, as a expires_at column addition if ever needed.

M34 Teacher Reviews

  • Aspect ratings for teachers (clarity, punctuality, patience) using a new teacher_reviews.aspect_ratings jsonb, mirroring institute reviews.
  • "Helpful" votes and sort by helpfulness (needs a review_votes table).
  • Photo attachments on reviews (homework improvement, report cards with names blurred) through M00 uploads and moderation.
  • Hindi and regional-language reviews with on-device translation toggle.
  • Report outcome notifications to reporters once Admin M35 records a user-facing outcome message.
  • Admin portal additions: none — Admin M33/M35 cover reviews, reports and moderation.

M35 Institute Reviews

  • Batch-level reviews (review a specific institute_batches row) once institutes run many batches.
  • Verified-result badges ("Student cleared JEE Main 2026") with document proof.
  • Reply templates saved per institute.
  • Response-time metric for replies shown on the institute profile.
  • Admin portal additions: none — Admin M34/M35 cover institute reviews and reply moderation.

M36 Teacher Reply To Review

  • AI-assisted reply suggestions (tone check before posting) running server-side with the same moderation rules.
  • Private message to the reviewer from a review (needs a lead/message link for reviews without a lead).
  • Reply-rate badge on the public profile ("Replies to 90 % of reviews").
  • Admin portal additions: none — reply moderation is in Admin M35.

M37 Contact Teacher

  • Real-time delivery over WebSockets or SSE (/leads/stream) to replace 5-second polling when active threads exceed ~20k.
  • Image and PDF attachments in messages (syllabus, fee receipts) through M00 uploads with contact-info OCR.
  • Call recording and call-outcome logging from the masked-calling provider (needs a lead_calls table).
  • Smart replies for teachers ("Share fee details", "Propose demo time").
  • Partition lead_messages by month after ~50M rows.
  • Admin portal additions: a read-only "Messages" tab on the Admin M38 lead detail (with users.pii masking and flagged messages highlighted), a queue of flagged messages and contact-info detections, and settings UI for calls.masked_enabled and the telephony provider.

M38 Demo Class Request

  • Teacher-side bulk slot templates ("copy this week to the next 4 weeks") — already served by M19, referenced here for context.
  • In-app video for the demo itself, replacing external meeting links (needs a demo_sessions table and a WebRTC/SFU provider).
  • Institute per-counsellor calendars with real slot picking, once campus-visit volume justifies it.
  • Automatic rebooking suggestion when a demo expires or is cancelled (reuse the M30 recommendation engine).
  • Waitlist for a fully booked teacher's next opening.
  • Admin portal additions: none — Admin M39 already covers demo scheduling, cancellation, rescheduling and outcome for support.

M39 Contact Institute

  • Round-robin or load-based auto-assignment across active counsellors once enquiry volume per institute justifies it.
  • A dedicated "team" view showing every staff member's open count and response time, feeding a lightweight institute-side leaderboard.
  • SMS fallback for institute staff exactly as M37's teacher SMS nudge, once institute response rates lag behind teachers'.
  • Admin portal additions: none — Admin M38 already shows institute leads and their assignment in the lead detail's target card.

M40 Favorite Teachers

  • Shareable favourite lists ("Teachers I'm considering for Aarav") a parent can send to a co-parent or grandparent, read-only.
  • Price-drop or new-fee-plan alerts specifically for favourited teachers, beyond the generic update notification.
  • A "Compare my favourites" shortcut straight into M29's advanced filters/compare view once favourites exceed 5.
  • Admin portal additions: none — favourites are private, personal data with no admin-facing use in v1.

M41 Favorite Institutes

  • A saved "Shortlist" note per compare session, so a parent can pick up a comparison later without reselecting.
  • Comparison across teachers and institutes together once a family is deciding between a private tutor and a coaching centre for the same subject.
  • Share a comparison (read-only link) with a co-parent, reusing M33's profile-sharing short codes.
  • Admin portal additions: none — favourites and comparisons are private, personal data with no admin-facing use in v1.

M42 Trust Score Display

  • A "what changed since last week" push summarising the biggest single mover, once teachers ask for more proactive updates than the raw history screen gives.
  • Per-category weight visibility for parents (e.g. showing that Reviews outweighs Profile completion) if user research shows it builds more trust than the current four-line summary.
  • Comparable trust-score context on CompareInstitutes-style teacher comparison, once teacher-to-teacher compare ships.
  • Localised (Hindi) plain-language sentences alongside the rest of the app's i18n rollout.
  • Admin portal additions: none — Admin M36/M37 already own every write and every admin-facing view of trust scores and their history.

M43 Payment Gateway

  • Razorpay Turbo UPI (in-app UPI without app switch) once available for the account, cutting drop-off on UPI intent.
  • Second gateway (Cashfree / PhonePe PG) behind the PaymentGateway interface with automatic failover when Razorpay's order API errors.
  • Promo codes as a second discount line in PriceBreakdownCard (Admin M05 future coupons), stored in discount_paise with metadata.promoCode.
  • Play Integrity / App Attest token on POST /payments/orders to block scripted order creation.
  • Saved UPI IDs / tokenised cards via Razorpay Customer and Tokens APIs for one-tap renewals.

M44 Subscriptions

  • Plan upgrades with pro-rated credit (monthly → yearly immediately) instead of queuing.
  • AutoPay for teacher registration and boosts once UPI Autopay limits and demand justify it.
  • City-level featured slot waitlist with automatic purchase offer when a slot opens.
  • Family membership shared between two guardians (Admin M41 future note).
  • Schema request: payment_configurations.gateway_plan_id to replace the Redis plan-id cache (BR-44.4).
  • Admin portal additions: a "Mandates" tab in the Admin M41 subscription drawer showing Razorpay subscription status, charge attempts and a cancel-mandate button.

M45 Payment History

  • Partial-amount refund requests (currently full refundable amount only) once support needs finer control from the app side.
  • Bulk export (CSV/PDF) of a date range for a teacher's or institute's annual tax filing.
  • In-app support chat pre-filled from a payment instead of a plain ticket link.
  • Push the refund decision the moment Admin M40's webhook lands, instead of relying on the next GET /payments/:id (already covered by BR-45's push table; today the app also refetches on foreground).
  • A combined annual GST statement (all invoices for a financial year in one PDF) once teachers ask for it at tax time.

M46 Referral System

  • Wallet credit expiry after a configurable number of days (no expiry at launch; wallet_ledger.expires_at is already in the schema for this).
  • Tiered rewards (a bigger reward after 5 successful referrals) once Admin M42 ships tiered rules.
  • A referral leaderboard visible to users themselves (today GET /referrals/top-referrers is admin-only), as a light gamification layer.
  • Share-link attribution with per-channel tracking (WhatsApp vs SMS vs copy-link conversion) beyond the existing profile_shares table (M33).
  • reward_type = discount programs applying the referee's reward automatically at their first PaymentSheet checkout instead of (or in addition to) a wallet credit.

M47 Push Notifications

  • Rich push (images, action buttons — "Reply" inline for lead_message) once FCM's data payload size and Notifee's action-button support are worth the added complexity.
  • Per-user send-time optimisation (send within quiet hours' end at the time historically most opened) instead of a fixed 08:00 for delayed non-urgent pushes.
  • Consolidate near-duplicate events into one send when several fire within a short window for the same user (e.g. two leads within a minute), to reduce notification fatigue.
  • A dedicated events service (outside the shared Express/BullMQ stack) once push volume passes a few million sends/day.
  • SMS/WhatsApp fallback for urgent categories when a user has no active device and push has failed twice running.
  • Retire the pre-convention event names (BR-47.3) in a single migration once all clients on old dedupe-key formats have aged out (30-day user_notifications lookback is enough to confirm).

M48 Notification Center

  • Inline notification grouping ("3 new leads" collapsing several lead_new rows from the same day) once volume makes a flat list noisy.
  • A quick "Mute this category" action right from a row's swipe menu, deep-linking into M20's preference switches instead of a separate settings trip.
  • Search within notifications once the list is long enough to need it (title/body full-text).
  • Rich campaign layouts (carousel, video) for announcements rows, matching whatever Admin M46 adds to campaign composition.
  • Move user_notifications to a partitioned table (by month) once the 12-month retention job is deleting a meaningful fraction of total rows nightly (M00's existing scalability note).

M49 Report User

  • In-app two-way messaging on an open case (currently only via the resolve/dismiss message and info requests) — tracked as an Admin M43 scalability item too.
  • Automatic detection of payment-outside-app language in lead messages to pre-fill a report (shared with M37's contact-info detector).
  • A short "why block" taxonomy (harassment, spam, inappropriate) instead of free text, to feed abuse analytics.
  • Rate-limit reports per (reporter, reported) pair specifically, not just per reporter, once report volume grows.
  • Bulk "block and report" from a single sheet for institute counsellors handling many enquiries.

M50 Complaint History

  • Push a small "days since last update" indicator on long-open cases so users don't feel forgotten (paired with Admin M43's SLA breach view).
  • Read receipts on info requests so support knows the user has seen the question before the 7-day auto-transition.
  • A "was this outcome fair?" one-tap feedback on resolved cases, separate from the app-store rating prompt.

M51 Account Settings

  • Apple Sign-In as a second social provider once iOS volume justifies it.
  • Passkeys (WebAuthn) as a phishing-resistant alternative to password.
  • Step-up re-authentication (fresh OTP) before especially sensitive actions like unlinking the only backup identity.
  • Session naming ("iPhone 14 · Bengaluru") using IP geolocation, shown next to the device model.
  • Email change confirmation on both old and new addresses (currently only the new one is OTP-verified) once email deliverability is proven reliable.

M52 Privacy Settings

  • A dedicated data_export_requests table once export volume needs a status/history UI beyond "one request every 30 days".
  • Granular per-teacher visibility (hide my activity from a specific teacher) beyond the global search-visibility toggle.
  • Consent captured per-language document version, so re-consent prompts show the policy in the user's own language.
  • Automated DPDP grievance-officer routing for data-principal requests beyond export (correction, erasure — erasure already lives in M54).

M53 Help & Support

  • In-app live chat for technical/account categories during support hours, falling back to async tickets outside them.
  • Suggested FAQs ranked by the user's own recent activity (e.g. a failed payment surfaces the refund FAQ first).
  • CSAT trend dashboard from support_tickets.rating (Admin side).
  • Canned replies and macros for support agents (Admin side).
  • Admin portal additions: a Support Tickets queue (list, filters by category/priority/status, assignment, SLA-style first-response tracking, reply composer with saved macros, rating dashboard) — support_tickets/support_ticket_messages have no admin screens in the Admin SRS pack today; this module's data model is ready for them.

M54 Delete Account

  • A shorter, opt-in immediate-erasure path once legal confirms it's safe for accounts with zero financial/safety history.
  • Self-serve "why was I blocked" deep links directly into resolving each blocker (e.g. one-tap to view the exact referral reward, not just its date).
  • Bulk/GDPR-style data processor notifications if GuruConnect adds EU users, alongside the DPDP-only flow today.
  • A support-side "deletion audit" screen reading erasure_report for compliance responses, without exposing any personal data that was already scrubbed.

Platform-wide

  • Certificate pinning and Play Integrity / App Attest on sensitive calls (OTP, payments).
  • Offline-first local database (WatermelonDB) if a future feature needs heavy offline editing beyond the query cache.
  • Hindi and regional-language UI (strings are already externalised in i18n/).
  • In-app video/voice calling for demos and lead conversations.
  • Partition high-volume tables by month (user_notifications, user_search_history, notification_recipients, recommendation_impressions).

Module 0 · Mobile Platform Foundation

Phase 0 · Mobile Platform · Used by: All app users (infrastructure used by every module) · Depends on: Admin M00 (audit_logs, files, app_users), Admin M04 (system_settings), Admin M07–M15 (masters) · New tables: user_devices, user_notifications, user_notification_preferences · Uses: app_users, files, audit_logs, system_settings, classes, subjects, boards, teaching_modes, teacher_categories, states, cities, areas · Build estimate: 5–6 days

1. Module Purpose

The shared plumbing every other module relies on, built once before any feature screen: the app shell and providers, the API client (headers, envelope, token refresh, error mapping), secure session storage, the persisted query cache and offline mutation queue, device registration for push (FCM token per install), the notification inbox table and NotificationService on the server, presigned uploads to Cloudflare R2, cached master data (classes, subjects, boards, modes, categories, locations), analytics event batching, deep-link routing and the reusable UI kit. It also adds three columns to app_users.

2. User Stories

  • As a developer, I want one API client that adds auth and device headers, refreshes tokens and maps errors so that feature modules only call typed hooks.
  • As a parent on a slow network, I want screens to open instantly from saved data so that the app feels fast even on 3G.
  • As a teacher, I want notifications to reach every phone I'm signed in on so that I never miss a lead.
  • As a user, I want uploads to continue if I switch apps so that I don't have to redo a document photo.
  • As product, I want consistent analytics events (screen views, taps, impressions) without collecting personal data.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-0.1 App shell. App.tsx mounts, in order: SafeAreaProvider → GestureHandlerRootView → ThemeProvider (light/dark tokens, follows system) → I18nProvider → QueryClientProvider (persisted) → AppErrorBoundary → NavigationContainer (linking config) → RootNavigator. Toast host and bottom-sheet host sit above the navigator.

BR-0.2 API client (lib/api.ts).

  • Adds the standard headers from conventions §5; X-Install-Id is a uuid created on first launch and kept in secure store (survives sign-out, reset only on reinstall).
  • Unwraps { data, meta }; throws AppError { code, message, details, status, requestId } for error envelopes and network failures (NETWORK_OFFLINE, NETWORK_TIMEOUT are client-only codes).
  • On AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED runs a single-flight refresh (M04 POST /auth/refresh) and retries the original request once. Concurrent 401s wait for the same promise.
  • On APP_UPDATE_REQUIRED / MAINTENANCE emits a global event that the root navigator handles (M01 screens).
  • Timeouts: 15 s default, 120 s for uploads. GETs retry twice (exponential backoff 1 s, 3 s) on network errors and 502/503/504; mutations never auto-retry unless the call passes idempotent: true.

BR-0.3 Session storage. Access token in memory (useSession Zustand store). Refresh token, install id and the encryption key for the encrypted MMKV instance in expo-secure-store (keychainAccessible: AFTER_FIRST_UNLOCK). Sign-out wipes query cache, stores, encrypted MMKV and the refresh token.

BR-0.4 Query cache persistence. TanStack Query persister on encrypted MMKV, maxAge 24 h, buster = app version, throttled writes (1 s). Queries opt out with meta: { persist: false } (OTP, payment status, presigned URLs, anything containing full phone numbers).

BR-0.5 Offline mutation queue. Mutations declared with offline: 'queue' are stored (key, variables, client id, created time) in MMKV when offline or when the request fails with a network error, and replayed FIFO on reconnect (NetInfo isInternetReachable). Items older than 7 days are dropped with a toast. The server makes each queued action idempotent (unique client id or natural unique index).

BR-0.6 Device registration. After sign-in and on each foreground: if FCM token, permission state or app version changed since the last successful call → PUT /devices/me. The server upserts on (user_id, install_id); if the same FCM token is active on another user's row (shared phone), that row is revoked first (unique index uq_user_devices_token). Sign-out → DELETE /devices/me (revokes; best effort, also done server-side when the session is revoked).

BR-0.7 NotificationService (server). notify(userId, { category, eventType, title, body, deepLink, data, dedupeKey, urgent }): inserts user_notifications (ON CONFLICT on dedupe key does nothing → no duplicate push), reads preferences (missing row = push on), applies quiet hours from notifications.quiet_hours unless urgent, enqueues push:send with the notification id. The worker loads active devices and sends one FCM v1 request per token (batched, 500 per call), sets push_status, revokes devices whose token returns UNREGISTERED/INVALID_ARGUMENT. Quiet-hour pushes are delayed to the end of quiet hours, not dropped. Unread count for the app icon badge = count of unread, non-deleted rows (cached in Redis unread:<userId>, invalidated on insert/read).

BR-0.8 Uploads to R2. POST /uploads/presign validates purpose, MIME type and size against conventions §10, creates a files row (status = 'pending', storage_provider = 'r2', uploaded_by_type = 'app_user'), and returns a presigned PUT URL (10 min). POST /uploads/:fileId/confirm does a HEAD on the object, checks size and content type match, sets status = 'active', and for gc-public purposes returns the CDN URL. Pending files older than 24 h are deleted by a job (object + row). A user may have at most 20 pending uploads.

BR-0.9 Masters cache. GET /masters returns all active classes, subjects (with class ranges), boards, teaching modes, teacher categories, states and cities in one payload with an ETag (hash of the masters' max updated_at). The app stores it in MMKV and sends If-None-Match; 304 keeps the cache. Areas are fetched per city (GET /masters/areas?cityId=), cached 7 days. GET /bootstrap (M01) includes mastersVersion so the app knows when to refresh.

BR-0.10 Analytics events. POST /events accepts batches of up to 50 events { name, ts, props, clientEventId }, flushed every 30 s or on background. Names are <module>_<action> (e.g. search_result_click). Props must not contain names, phones, emails or free text. Events for impressions and profile views feed teacher_profile_views, institute_profile_views, recommendation_impressions server-side. If allow_analytics is false (M52), only operational events (app_open, crash) are sent.

BR-0.11 Deep links. lib/deeplinks.ts maps paths (conventions §4) to screens. Links needing auth are stored in pendingDeepLink and replayed after login/registration. Unknown links open Home with a toast "That link isn't available."

BR-0.12 GET /me. Returns the account summary used on every launch after bootstrap: user id, role, profile id, name, photo, language, account status, registration/verification state per role (e.g. teacher verificationStatus), unread notification count, subscription summary, feature flags. The app uses it to choose the tab navigator and to show blocking states (suspended, pending verification).

BR-0.13 New app_users columns. preferred_language (drives push/email language), profile_photo_file_id (parents, students, institute staff), signup_source (set at registration: referral when a code was used, deep_link when the install came from a share link, otherwise organic).

4. Screen List

Screen Route name Purpose
Root navigator Root Chooses Splash → Maintenance/ForceUpdate → Onboarding/Auth → role tabs
Global offline banner (overlay) Shows when offline; tap for details
Toast host (overlay) Success/error/info toasts
Error fallback ErrorFallback Crash fallback with Restart and request id
Account blocked AccountBlocked Shown when /me or any call returns ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED
Upload progress sheet (bottom sheet) Progress, retry and cancel for uploads

5. Screen Flow & Navigation

Diagram loads when this page is online…

Offline launch with a valid cached session: skip network calls, open role tabs from the cached /me, show the offline banner, refresh when online.

6. Screen Wireframe Description

Offline banner — 32 dp strip under the status bar, neutral dark background, cloud-off icon, text "You're offline. Showing saved data." Tapping expands to "Some actions will be sent when you're back online (2 waiting)." Disappears 2 s after reconnecting with "Back online".

Error fallback — centred illustration, heading "Something went wrong", body "Restart the app to continue. If this keeps happening, contact support.", primary button "Restart", small text "Error ID 3f2a…" (long-press copies).

Account blocked — lock icon, heading "Your account is on hold", reason from the server (e.g. "Suspended while we review a report"), "Until 12 Oct 2026" if temporary, buttons "Contact support" (opens M53) and "Sign out".

Upload progress sheet — file name, thumbnail, progress bar with percentage, "Uploading 2 of 3", buttons "Cancel" and, on failure, "Retry".

App
├─ Providers (SafeArea, Gesture, Theme, I18n, QueryClient+Persister, ErrorBoundary)
├─ NavigationContainer (linking)
│  └─ RootNavigator

│     └─ ParentTabs | StudentTabs | TeacherTabs | InstituteTabs
├─ OfflineBanner

Shared UI kit (components/ui): Button (primary/secondary/ghost/destructive, loading), TextField (label, helper, error, counter), PhoneField (+91 prefix, 10 digits), OtpInput (6 cells, autofill), Select / MultiSelect (bottom-sheet list with search), Chip / ChipGroup, Card, Avatar (initials fallback), Badge, StatusPill, Skeleton, EmptyState, ErrorState (message + Retry + request id), ListFooterLoader, StickyActionBar, ConfirmSheet, ImagePickerField, DocumentPickerField, ProgressBar, SectionHeader, KeyValueRow.

Domain components (components/domain), built here as shells and completed by their modules: TeacherCard, InstituteCard, VerifiedBadge, TrustScoreRing, RatingStars, PriceTag, ChildChip, LocationPill.

Hooks: useApi, useMe, useMasters, useAreas(cityId), useUpload(purpose), useNetwork, useOfflineQueue, useDeepLink, useTrack(eventName).

8. Validation Rules

Input Rule
PUT /devices/me installId uuid v4
platform android or ios
appVersion semver ^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$
fcmToken 20–4,096 chars or null
pushPermission granted, denied, not_determined, provisional
timezone IANA name; default Asia/Kolkata
presign purpose one of the purposes in conventions §10
presign mimeType / sizeBytes allowed for the purpose; size 1 byte – purpose max
fileName 1–120 chars, no path separators
events batch 1–50 events; name ^[a-z0-9_]{3,60}$; props object ≤ 2 KB, no keys named phone, email, name, message

9. API Endpoints

Method Path Auth Description
GET /me Any user Account summary, role, profile id, flags, unread count
PUT /devices/me Any user Register or update this install's device and FCM token
DELETE /devices/me Any user Revoke this install's device (sign-out)
POST /uploads/presign Any user (and Registration token for registration uploads) Create a pending file and presigned R2 PUT URL
POST /uploads/:fileId/confirm Any user Verify the uploaded object and activate the file
GET /files/:id/url Any user (owner only) 60-second presigned GET for a private file
GET /masters Public Classes, subjects, boards, modes, categories, states, cities (ETag)
GET /masters/areas Public Areas of a city (?cityId=)
POST /events Public (install) / Any user Batched analytics and impression events

12. PostgreSQL Tables & Columns

New tables owned by this module (migration sql/migrations/100_app_m00_mobile_app_foundation_devices_notification_inbox_notification_preferences.sql)

user_devices

Every app install a user has signed in on, with its FCM token. One row per (user, install).

Column Type Null Default Constraints / References Description
id uuid no gen_random_uuid() PK Primary key
user_id uuid no — FK → app_users.id (on delete cascade) Owner
install_id uuid no — — Random id generated on first launch and kept in secure storage
platform text no — CHECK platform IN ('android','ios') OS
os_version text yes — — e.g. 14
app_version text no — — Semver of the build, e.g. 1.2.0
build_number integer yes — — Store build number
device_model text yes — — e.g. SM-A546E
fcm_token text yes — — Firebase Cloud Messaging token; NULL when push permission denied
push_permission text no 'not_determined' CHECK push_permission IN ('granted','denied','not_determined','provisional') OS permission state
locale text yes — — e.g. en-IN
timezone text no 'Asia/Kolkata' — IANA timezone
last_seen_at timestamptz no now() — Last API call from this install
token_updated_at timestamptz yes — — When fcm_token last changed
revoked_at timestamptz yes — — Set on logout / token UNREGISTERED
created_at timestamptz no now() — First sign-in on this install
updated_at timestamptz no now() — Updated

<details><summary>DDL</summary>

CREATE TABLE user_devices (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES app_users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- Owner
  install_id uuid NOT NULL, -- Random id generated on first launch and kept in secure storage
  platform text NOT NULL CHECK (platform IN ('android','ios')), -- OS
  os_version text, -- e.g. 14
  app_version text NOT NULL, -- Semver of the build, e.g. 1.2.0
  build_number integer, -- Store build number
  device_model text, -- e.g. SM-A546E
  fcm_token text, -- Firebase Cloud Messaging token; NULL when push permission denied
  push_permission text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_determined' CHECK (push_permission IN ('granted','denied','not_determined','provisional')), -- OS permission state
  locale text, -- e.g. en-IN
  timezone text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Asia/Kolkata', -- IANA timezone
  last_seen_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Last API call from this install
  token_updated_at timestamptz, -- When fcm_token last changed
  revoked_at timestamptz, -- Set on logout / token UNREGISTERED
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- First sign-in on this install
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now() -- Updated
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_user_devices_install ON user_devices (user_id, install_id);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_user_devices_token ON user_devices (fcm_token) WHERE fcm_token IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_user_devices_user_active ON user_devices (user_id) WHERE revoked_at IS NULL;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_user_devices_updated BEFORE UPDATE ON user_devices FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

</details>

Indexes: uq_user_devices_install (unique) on (user_id, install_id); uq_user_devices_token (unique) on (fcm_token) WHERE fcm_token IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL; idx_user_devices_user_active on (user_id) WHERE revoked_at IS NULL

user_notifications

The in-app notification inbox for every user: transactional events and copies of admin campaigns.

Column Type Null Default Constraints / References Description
id uuid no gen_random_uuid() PK Primary key
user_id uuid no — FK → app_users.id (on delete cascade) Recipient
category text no — CHECK category IN ('account','verification','leads','demos','reviews','payments','subscription','referral','complaints','recommendations','announcements') Preference bucket
event_type text no — — Machine event, e.g. teacher.approved, lead.received, review.published
title text no — — Max 65 chars
body text no — — Max 240 chars
image_url text yes — — Optional rich image (CDN URL)
deep_link text yes — — App route opened on tap, e.g. gc://leads/<id>
data jsonb no '{}'::jsonb — Extra payload, e.g. {"leadId":"…"}
campaign_id uuid yes — FK → notifications.id (on delete set null) Set when the item comes from an admin campaign
dedupe_key text yes — — Prevents duplicates when an event is retried, e.g. lead.received:<leadId>

CREATE TABLE user_notifications (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES app_users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- Recipient

);
