14. State Management

  • registrationKeys.context — not persisted (one-time token, no value in caching across app restarts).
  • useRegistrationFlags (Zustand, memory): { referralCode, referralValid, programCode } — cleared the moment a role tile is tapped and handed forward as route params, not re-derived from a global store inside the role screens.
  • useRegistrationDraft(role) (Zustand + encrypted MMKV) — shared shape { values: Record<string, unknown>, savedAt } per role; this module defines the hook, M06/M11/M14/M21 are its only callers.

15. Offline Handling

GET /registration/context and referral validation are online only (conventions §8 class 3 — the whole registration token is time-boxed and worthless to cache). The role tiles themselves render from the already-fetched context, so a brief connectivity blip after context loads doesn't kick the user out; tapping a tile while offline is still allowed (pure navigation) but the destination form's own submit is blocked until connectivity returns, same as any other online-only write.

16. Push Notification Requirements

None. No account exists yet for any of these calls to notify.

17. Security Rules

  • The registrationToken is the only credential; it is never stored (memory-only route param / one query), never logged, and expires in 30 minutes with no server-side revocation needed (BR-4.8).
  • Referral validation never reveals a personal code owner's phone/email, only a first name — enough for "Lakshmi's code" reassurance, not enough to identify or contact them.
  • No FLAG_SECURE needed (nothing on screen is sensitive); the maskedContact under the heading is already partially masked for phone (email is shown in full, matching what the user just typed at M04).

18. Error Handling

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
Registration token expired/invalid AUTH_REQUIRED 401 Route to M04 entry, "let's verify your number again"
Referral code malformed VALIDATION_FAILED 422 Inline under the field
Referral code not found/expired/disabled/limit reached — (200, valid:false) 200 Muted inline "We couldn't find that code"; Apply stays disabled, sheet can still be dismissed with none
Context fetch fails (network) NETWORK_OFFLINE / INTERNAL_ERROR — / 500 ErrorState with Retry; role tiles are not shown until context loads

19. Testing Scenarios

  • T5.1 Fresh registrationToken → GET /registration/context returns the four roles and no referral; Maestro flow registration_router_basic.
  • T5.2 Opened from gc://r/SCHOOLFAIR26 → context's referralCode is prefilled and shown as an applied chip without an extra tap.
  • T5.3 Type a valid code manually → green "Valid — Lakshmi's code"; type a nonsense code → muted "We couldn't find that code", Apply stays disabled.
  • T5.4 Tap "Teacher" → lands on M14 with registrationToken, referralCode (if any) and no prefill (phone contact type has none).
  • T5.5 Google contactType → prefill.fullName/photoUrl present in context and pre-fill the next screen's name/photo fields.
  • T5.6 Registration token expires while sitting on RegistrationRouter (wait 30 min) → next action returns AUTH_REQUIRED → routed back to M04.
  • T5.7 Kill the app mid-fill on M06 (Parent) → relaunch, verify the same contact again → draft is restored from registrationDraft:parent:<hash> (values still present, new token).
  • T5.8 A code valid for TEACHER_REFERRAL is entered while the user later picks "Parent" at the tile screen → M06's submit still succeeds but referralApplied:false (BR-5.7 step 2), no referrals row created.
  • T5.9 Two devices submit registration for the same phone number within the same second → one succeeds, the other gets CONFLICT_DUPLICATE (BR-5.8).
  • T5.10 Airplane mode on RegistrationRouter → tiles are visible and tappable (context already loaded); the next screen's submit button is disabled until connectivity returns.

20. Audit Log Events

None directly — GET /registration/context and referral validation are reads with no account yet to attribute them to. Each role's actual app.<role>_registered event (BR-5.7 step 9) is audited by that role's own module (M06/M11/M14/M21).

21. Future Scalability Notes

  • A fifth "I'm not sure" tile that asks two quick questions (age, "do you teach or do you want a teacher?") and recommends a role, for users confused by the four-way choice.
  • Server-driven role tile ordering/copy (A/B test "Teacher" vs "Institute" phrasing) once remote config exists.
  • Multi-role accounts (e.g. a parent who is also a part-time tutor) — out of scope for v1 ("a user has exactly one role", conventions §4); would need a role-switch flow and a rethink of app_users.user_type as the sole role source.
  • Save-and-resume by email link ("finish signing up later") for the longer Teacher/Institute forms, instead of relying solely on the on-device encrypted draft.

Module 6 · Parent Registration

Phase 2 · Parent · Used by: Registration token · Depends on: M05 (router, shared consent/draft/referral contract), M04 (OTP verify for a secondary mobile, issueSession), M00 (masters for state/city/area) · New tables: none · Uses: app_users, parents, user_auth_identities, app_sessions, states, cities, areas, referrals · Build estimate: 3 days

1. Module Purpose

The shortest of the four registration forms: name, mobile, email, city, state and an optional area. One screen, one submit, and — because it is the highest-volume role by far — one transaction that creates app_users, parents, the auth identity/identities, an optional referrals row, both consent rows and a live session, so a parent lands straight in Child Setup (M07) with no extra steps.

2. User Stories

  • As a parent who verified by phone, I want the form to already know my number so that I only type my name, email and location.
  • As a parent who signed up with Google, I want my name pre-filled from my Google account so that I don't retype it.
  • As a parent who signed up by email, I want to be asked for a mobile number too, verified right there, because teachers and support need a phone number that actually reaches me.
  • As a parent in a small town, I want to skip the area field if my locality isn't listed, so that a missing dropdown entry doesn't block me from signing up.
  • As operations, I want a referral code applied at sign-up recorded properly so that the referrer gets credit once I subscribe.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-6.1 Fields. fullName (required), mobile (required — see BR-6.2 for when it needs its own verification), email (optional), stateId (required), cityId (required, must belong to stateId), areaId (optional, must belong to cityId). No date of birth, no photo, no password field — the account's sign-in method is whatever was already verified to reach this screen (BR-6.3). BR-6.2 Mobile number handling by contact type. If registrationToken.contactType = 'phone', mobile is pre-filled read-only with the verified number and needs nothing further. If contactType is 'email' or 'google', the form shows an editable mobile field with its own inline "Verify" step: tapping it calls M04 POST /auth/otp/request (this module reuses that endpoint directly, it does not duplicate OTP-sending logic) and then POST /auth/otp/verify with purpose resolved server-side to signup (BR-4.2's channel-agnostic verify, called with the same shape but no session/registrationToken is returned for a signup-purpose challenge — just a verified flag); the resulting challengeId is submitted alongside the form as mobileOtpChallengeId. The registration submit re-checks that challenge: channel='sms', verified_at IS NOT NULL, destination = body.mobile exactly, and not already consumed by a different account (a challenge can only ever back one account, checked by a short-lived Redis claim otp:claimed:<challengeId> set at submit time to stop a replay across two submits). BR-6.3 Transaction (single DB transaction).

  1. Re-verify the registrationToken (M05 BR-5.7 step 1); re-check the phone and email (if given) are still unclaimed by any live app_users/user_auth_identities row → 409 CONFLICT_DUPLICATE otherwise.
  2. If mobileOtpChallengeId was required (BR-6.2), re-validate it as described.
  3. Validate stateId/cityId/areaId are active and correctly nested (422 VALIDATION_FAILED "Pick an area in the selected city." if not).
  4. If a referralCode was carried from M05, re-validate it against program_code = 'LEARNER_REFERRAL' specifically (M05 BR-5.7 step 2) — a code for a different program is silently dropped (referralApplied:false).
  5. Insert app_users (user_type='parent', phone=mobile, email, full_name=fullName, auth_provider = the method from registrationToken.contactType (otp→otp, email→password if a password identity is being created alongside, else the email-OTP path stores auth_provider='otp' too since there's no password), account_status='active', signup_source = 'referral' if a code applied, else 'deep_link' if useAppFlags.pendingDeepLink was present at registration start, else 'organic').
  6. Insert parents (user_id, public_code auto-generated, full_name, email, phone=mobile, state_id, city_id, area_id, account_status='active', referral_code_used = the applied code's text or null).
  7. Insert user_auth_identities: always one provider='phone' row for mobile (last_used_at=now() only if this was the method used to reach the screen — otherwise last_used_at=null, it's simply now available for future logins); plus one provider='google' row if contactType='google' (provider_subject = the Google sub from the registrationToken, not re-verified — it was already verified by M04 to mint the token); email-only sign-ups with no password chosen do not get a provider='password' row here (they can set one later from Account Settings, or simply keep using email-OTP to sign in).
  8. If the referral applied: insert referrals (referral_code_id, referrer_user_id from the code, referee_user_id = the new user, referral_setting_id = the program's current active version, status='pending').
  9. Insert the two mandatory user_consents rows (M05 BR-5.6), plus a third marketing row if the form's marketing checkbox was shown and interacted with.
  10. Call issueSession (M04 BR-4.9) with auth_method matching whichever identity was actually used to reach this screen (otp, google, or email_otp).
  11. Commit. Response returns the same { accessToken, refreshToken, session, user } shape as M04 login, with user.registration.nextStep = 'child_setup'. BR-6.4 Mandatory next step. A parent account with zero live parent_children rows always has registration.nextStep = 'child_setup' in /me (M00 BR-0.12) until at least one child is added (M07); Splash (M01 BR-1.5) and Home routing both honour this — there is no way to reach the Parent Home dashboard with no children on file. This is enforced by M07, not re-implemented here; this module only sets the initial condition (a parent with no children yet). BR-6.5 Idempotency. The client sends Idempotency-Key on submit (a uuid generated once when the form is first opened, reused on retry) so a network timeout followed by an automatic retry can't create two parents rows for one registrationToken; the server caches the first successful response body against that key for 24 h and replays it on an exact retry rather than re-running the transaction.

6. Screen Wireframe Description

ParentRegistration — heading "Tell us about you", then, top-to-bottom: TextField "Full name" (placeholder "Lakshmi Venkatesh"), PhoneField "Mobile number" (+91, read-only with a small "Verified" check icon when contactType='phone'; otherwise editable with a trailing text button "Verify" that opens the OtpVerify sheet inline and turns into the same "Verified" check on success), TextField "Email (optional)" (placeholder "lakshmi.v@gmail.com", pre-filled and read-only if contactType='email'), Select "State" (bottom-sheet list with search, placeholder "Karnataka"), Select "City" (disabled until a state is chosen, placeholder "Bengaluru"), Select "Area (optional)" (disabled until a city is chosen, placeholder "Koramangala"), optional marketing checkbox "Send me offers and tips by WhatsApp/email" (unchecked by default), sticky button "Create account" (disabled until name, verified mobile, state and city are all present).

ParentRegistrationScreen

12. PostgreSQL Tables & Columns

Existing tables this module reads or writes (full definitions in the owning module)

Table Owner Purpose
app_users Admin M00 Login identity for every mobile app account (parent, student, teacher, institute staff). Role profiles hang off this table.
parents Admin M28 Parent profile, one per parent app account.
user_auth_identities App M04 Sign-in methods linked to an account: phone OTP, email + password, Google.
app_sessions App M04 Refresh-token sessions for app users, one per signed-in install. Refresh tokens rotate on every use.
states Admin M08 States and union territories within a country.
cities Admin M09 Cities where teachers and institutes can be listed.
areas Admin M10 Localities within a city, used for "nearby" search and teacher coverage.
referrals Admin M42 One row per referred user, tracking qualification, fraud checks and reward payout.
  • parents: this module is the sole inserter for the app; public_code uses the existing seq_parent_code default, no app-side generation needed. suspended_* columns are never touched here (admin-only, M28).
  • app_users: signup_source set per BR-6.3 step 5, matching M00's BR-0.13 column definition exactly.
  • user_auth_identities: this module inserts rows but never the password_hash — a parent who registered by email/Google without setting a password has no provider='password' row until they add one later (M51).
  • app_sessions: created via M04's shared issueSession; this module supplies only auth_method, not the row shape.
  • referrals: written only when a LEARNER_REFERRAL-program code validated against this submission; referral_setting_id is resolved fresh at submit time (never from a value cached since M05's earlier preview).
  • states/cities/areas: read-only, validated for nesting and is_active before insert.

13. Relationships

14. State Management

  • registrationDraft:parent:<hash> (M05 shared hook) — { fullName, mobile, email, stateId, cityId, areaId, marketingOptIn }.
  • useMobileVerify — local component state only (idle|sending|verifying|verified), not persisted (an unverified in-flight OTP challenge should never survive an app restart as "verified").
  • mastersKeys.* reused from M00's persisted masters cache — states/cities/areas render instantly even on a slow connection.

15. Offline Handling

The form itself can be filled offline (draft persistence, M05 BR-5.5) except the state/city/area pickers need the masters cache to already be warm (it usually is, fetched at Splash) — if not cached, the pickers show a loading skeleton and an offline hint. Verify (mobile OTP) and the final Create account submit are online only (conventions §8 class 3); the sticky button is disabled with "Needs internet" until connectivity returns, and the typed values are never lost while waiting.

16. Push Notification Requirements

None sent by this module at submit time; the very first push a parent might see is the pre-permission explainer after their first favourite or lead, per conventions §9 — registration itself does not prompt for push permission.

17. Security Rules

  • ParentRegistration is not FLAG_SECURE (no credentials entered here — the credential was already verified at M04).
  • The inline mobile OTP reuses M04's rate limits and lockouts verbatim (BR-4.1/4.14) — this module adds no separate throttle, only the extra "must belong to this submit" claim check (BR-6.2's Redis claim).
  • Ownership: every field in the request is attributed to the registrationToken's verified contact server-side; the client cannot register an account for a phone/email it hasn't verified by supplying it in the body alone.

18. Error Handling

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
Phone or email already registered (race) CONFLICT_DUPLICATE 409 "An account already exists with this phone number." — offers "Sign in instead" back to M04
Area doesn't belong to the chosen city VALIDATION_FAILED 422 "Pick an area in the selected city."
Mobile not verified (email/google contact type) VALIDATION_FAILED 422 details.reason = "mobile_not_verified"; Create account stays disabled until Verify succeeds
Registration token expired mid-fill AUTH_REQUIRED 401 Route back to M04; draft is preserved for the next attempt
Referral code for the wrong program — (200, referralApplied:false) 201 Account still created; no special message, referral chip simply disappears from the next screen

19. Testing Scenarios

  • T6.1 Phone-contact happy path: mobile pre-filled and marked verified, fill name/state/city, submit → session issued, nextStep='child_setup'. Maestro flow parent_registration_phone.
  • T6.2 Email-contact path: mobile field editable, tap Verify, receive test OTP, verify, then submit → succeeds with both a phone and no password identity row.
  • T6.3 Google-contact path: name pre-filled from Google prefill, editable but correct by default; submit creates both phone and google identity rows.
  • T6.4 Submit with an unverified mobile (Verify never tapped) → VALIDATION_FAILED, details.reason="mobile_not_verified".
  • T6.5 Area selected for a city that isn't the chosen one (forced via a stale cached list) → VALIDATION_FAILED "Pick an area in the selected city."
  • T6.6 Valid LEARNER_REFERRAL code applied → response referralApplied:true and a referrals row exists with status='pending'.
  • T6.7 A TEACHER_REFERRAL code carried from M05 → submit still succeeds, referralApplied:false, no referrals row.
  • T6.8 Duplicate submit with the same Idempotency-Key after a timeout → the cached first response is replayed, no second parents row created.
  • T6.9 Kill the app after typing name/email but before submit → relaunch, re-verify the same phone → draft restores exactly those fields.
  • T6.10 Airplane mode with a filled form → Create account disabled with "Needs internet"; typed values remain after reconnecting.

20. Audit Log Events

Event When Details
app.parent_registered Successful submit city, referral applied (yes/no), signup source

21. Future Scalability Notes

  • Optional profile photo at registration once product wants richer parent profiles (currently deferred to M09 Parent Profile, post-registration).
  • Auto-detect city from expo-location (foreground only) to pre-select the state/city pickers, falling back to the manual pickers exactly as today.
  • Multi-language registration form once Hindi strings ship (conventions §2 i18n), reusing the same fields.
  • Bulk/import registration for schools onboarding many parents at once (an admin-portal feature, not this app screen) — noted for Admin portal additions if requested later.

Module 7 · Parent Child Setup

Phase 2 · Parent · Used by: Parent · Depends on: M06 (a parent account must exist), M00 (masters), M08/M30 (consume the recommendations this module triggers) · New tables: none · Uses: parent_children, parent_child_subjects, parent_child_teacher_categories, classes, boards, subjects, teaching_modes, teacher_categories · Build estimate: 4 days

1. Module Purpose

The screen every new parent must complete before reaching Home: add each child they're finding a teacher for — first name, class, board, the subjects needed (filtered to what's actually offered at that class), optionally a preferred teaching mode and the kinds of teacher wanted — up to limits.parent_max_children children (seeded at 3). Every save recomputes that child's recommendations and previews the top 3 matches inline, so a parent sees the platform actually working before they've paid anything. It is the single richest input to both the v0 rule-based dashboard (M08) and, later, the full recommendation engine (M30) — both read the same per-child cache this module invalidates.

2. User Stories

  • As a new parent with two children, I want to add both, each with their own class and subjects, so that recommendations are right for each child separately, not blended together.
  • As a parent whose child just moved up a grade, I want to edit the class and have the subject list update to match, without accidentally keeping a subject that's no longer taught at that level.
  • As a parent who isn't sure what "teaching mode" means yet, I want that field to be optional so that it never blocks me from finishing.
  • As a parent with three children already added, I want a clear message when I try to add a fourth, so that I understand the limit rather than thinking the app is broken.
  • As a parent on a slow connection, I want to see at least a rough set of matches for my child right after saving, even before the full search screen loads, so that I feel the wait was worth it.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-7.1 Child limit. A parent may have 1…limits.parent_max_children (default 3, from bootstrap limits.parentMaxChildren) live (deleted_at IS NULL) parent_children rows. POST /parent/children re-checks the live count server-side at insert time (never trusts the client's cached count) and returns 409 LIMIT_REACHED { details: { reason: "max_children", limit: 3, current: 3 } } past the limit — the setting is admin-editable, so the server value always wins over whatever the app last cached from bootstrap. BR-7.2 Fields. childName — first name only, 1–40 chars, letters and spaces (data minimisation for minors, conventions §12: no date of birth, no photo, no school-leaving-certificate — just enough to personalise recommendations and the UI). classId — required. boardId — optional; if the chosen board has a non-null state_id (a state board), it must equal the parent's parents.state_id, or the board's type is national/international/university/other (a Karnataka parent can still pick "CBSE" or "Other", just not, say, "Maharashtra State Board"). subjectIds — 0–6, each must be offered for the chosen class (BR-7.3). categoryIds (teacher types wanted) — 0–4, from teacher_categories. preferredModeId — optional, from teaching_modes. schoolName — optional free text, ≤ 120 chars (kept for context, never shown to teachers before contact unlock). BR-7.3 Subject filtering by class. A subject is offered for a class when subjects.min_class_order IS NULL OR subjects.min_class_order <= classes.level_order and subjects.max_class_order IS NULL OR subjects.max_class_order >= classes.level_order, compared against the chosen class's level_order. The subject picker (a searchable multi-select sheet) is filtered live to only offered subjects the moment a class is picked; it is empty and disabled until a class is chosen. Changing an already-saved child's class to one where a previously-chosen subject no longer qualifies silently drops that subject from the saved set (server-side, on PATCH) and the response includes droppedSubjects: [...] so the app can show a one-line toast ("Removed Physics — not offered for Class 5") rather than a blocking error. BR-7.4 Create. POST /parent/children { childName, classId, boardId?, subjectIds[], categoryIds[], preferredModeId?, schoolName? } (Idempotency-Key). In one transaction: re-check BR-7.1's limit, insert parent_children (sort_order = current max + 1), insert parent_child_subjects/parent_child_teacher_categories join rows. Then, synchronously, before responding (BR-7.6): compute and cache the child's recommendations and return the top 3 inline as recommendationsPreview. BR-7.5 Edit and reorder. PATCH /parent/children/:id (If-Match, any subset of BR-7.2's fields) applies BR-7.3's drop-on-class-change rule, then re-triggers BR-7.6 exactly as create does (any field change can change who's a good match). PUT /parent/children/order { orderedIds: [...] } sets sort_order to each id's index in the array — purely cosmetic (the child switcher's order), never touches recommendations. BR-7.6 Recommendation trigger — what "recompute" means. On every create or qualifying edit (class, board, subjects, categories or mode changed — a pure childName/schoolName/reorder edit does not trigger this): 1) delete the Redis cache key rec:<childId> (M29 FR-29.4's cache, shared with the admin-side debug view) so it can never serve a stale list; 2) run the same scoring formula inline for a synchronous top-3 preview: eligible teachers are approved, active, with a teacher_classes row matching the child's class (board NULL or equal), scored 5 (class) + 3×(category match count) + 3×(subject match count) + 1×(mode match) + trust_score/100 + 0.5×(within 4 km of the parent's area); 3) write the full top-20 back into rec:<childId> (6-hour TTL) so the immediately-following dashboard (M08, v0 rule-based ranking reading this exact cache) and, once it ships, M30's GET /recommendations (same cache key, same formula, replacing this module's inline scoring with its own richer one behind the same contract) both see fresh data without recomputing again. If fewer than 3 teachers qualify, recommendationsPreview returns whatever is available (0–3) rather than padding with irrelevant results. BR-7.7 Delete. DELETE /parent/children/:id (soft: deleted_at). The join rows (parent_child_subjects/parent_child_teacher_categories) are left in place (harmless — every query joins through parent_children.deleted_at IS NULL); the rec:<childId> cache key is deleted; any user_favorites/user_search_history rows that reference the child keep doing so (ON DELETE SET NULL only fires on a hard delete, which never happens here) and simply stop being offered as a "for {childName}" filter option once the child no longer appears in the switcher. BR-7.8 Empty state gate (ties to M06 BR-6.4). With zero live children, the parent cannot reach Home; the child list screen shows a mandatory empty state with no way to skip, and the tab bar itself is not rendered until the first child is saved successfully.

4. Screen List

Screen Route name Purpose
My children MyChildren List of children (or the mandatory empty state), add/reorder entry point
Add / edit child ChildForm (modal) Name, class, board, subjects, categories, mode
Recommendations preview (bottom sheet, shown after save) Top 3 matches for the just-saved child

5. Screen Flow & Navigation

Diagram loads when this page is online…

The preview sheet always appears after a successful save (create or a qualifying edit); "Done" returns to MyChildren, where the tab bar becomes visible for the first time once at least one child exists. A non-qualifying edit (name/school/reorder only) returns straight to MyChildren with no preview sheet.

6. Screen Wireframe Description

MyChildren (empty state) — illustration of a parent and child, heading "Add your first child", body "We'll recommend teachers based on their class, board and subjects.", sticky button "Add a child" (no skip option, no back-to-Home).

MyChildren (populated) — header "My children (2 of 3)"; child cards, each: avatar-style initial chip, name "Aarav", subtitle "Class 5 · CBSE · Mathematics, English +1", trailing chevron opening ChildForm in edit mode, long-press to drag-reorder; below the cards, if under the limit, a dashed "+ Add another child" card; at the limit (3 of 3), the add card is replaced by muted text "You've reached the maximum of 3 children."

ChildForm — heading "Add a child" (or "Edit {childName}"), TextField "Child's first name" (placeholder "Aarav"), Select "Class" (bottom sheet, e.g. "Class 5"), Select "Board (optional)" (e.g. "CBSE"), MultiSelect "Subjects needed" (chip-style, disabled with helper "Choose a class first" until classId is set; once set, shows only offered subjects e.g. Mathematics, English, Science, Hindi, EVS for Class 5), MultiSelect "Type of teacher (optional)" (e.g. "Home Tutor", "School Teacher"), Select "Preferred mode (optional)" (e.g. "Home tuition"), TextField "School name (optional)", sticky button "Save child".

Recommendations preview (bottom sheet) — heading "3 teachers found for Aarav", three compact TeacherCard rows (photo, name, Trust Score ring, one-line "Class 5 · Mathematics · 2.1 km"), sticky button "See all matches" (primary) and text link "Done" (secondary, dismisses to MyChildren). If fewer than 3 matched: heading "{n} teacher{s} found for Aarav" (n could be 0 — "We'll notify you as soon as a match appears nearby.").

MyChildrenScreen

Hooks: useChildrenQuery() (list), useAddChildMutation(), useEditChildMutation(id), useDeleteChildMutation(id), useReorderChildrenMutation(), useSubjectsForClass(classId) (derives from the already-cached masters payload, no extra network call), TeacherCard({ teacher, onPress, onFavourite, variant: "compact"|"full" }) (shared component, M00 shell + completed by M31 profile view).

12. PostgreSQL Tables & Columns

Existing tables this module reads or writes (full definitions in the owning module)

Table Owner Purpose
parent_children Admin M29 Children a parent is finding teachers for. Drives per-child recommendations.
parent_child_subjects Admin M29 Subjects needed for a child.
parent_child_teacher_categories Admin M29 Types of teacher the parent wants for a child (Home Tutor, Competitive Exam Faculty, …).
classes Admin M11 Grades and levels learners study at, from Class 1 to competitive exam preparation.
boards Admin M13 Education boards and curricula, e.g. CBSE, ICSE, state boards, IB.
subjects Admin M12 Subjects, exams and skills teachers can teach.
teaching_modes Admin M14 How classes are delivered, e.g. Online, Offline at teacher's place, Home tuition, Hybrid.
teacher_categories Admin M15 Types of teacher shown as categories and used in parent preferences, e.g. Home Tutor, Coaching Faculty.
  • parent_children: this module is the only app-side writer; admins may also edit/soft-delete via Admin M29 (support corrections), which is why every read here filters deleted_at IS NULL and never assumes it's the sole author of history.
  • parent_child_subjects / parent_child_teacher_categories: fully replaced (delete-then-reinsert the join rows) on every PATCH that changes subjectIds/categoryIds, rather than diffed — simpler and cheap at ≤ 6/≤ 4 rows per child.
  • classes/subjects/boards/teaching_modes/teacher_categories: read-only masters, already cached from M00 GET /masters; this module adds no new master-data endpoint, only the class-based subject filter (BR-7.3) computed client-side from the cached payload (and re-validated server-side on every write).

13. Relationships

Entity relationship diagram (tables this module uses; admins omitted)

Diagram loads when this page is online…

14. State Management

  • childrenKeys.list (TanStack Query, persisted — this is exactly the kind of "profile" data conventions §7 caches for instant offline reads) — invalidated after every add/edit/delete/reorder mutation.
  • useChildFormDraft (per M05's shared draft hook, keyed registrationDraft:parent:children:<childId|"new">) — though child setup is post-registration, the same encrypted-MMKV draft pattern is reused so a half-filled ChildForm survives an app kill exactly like the registration forms do.
  • No optimistic update for add/edit (the response's recommendationsPreview must come from the server — nothing to optimistically show); reorder is optimistic (instant local reorder, rolled back with a toast if PUT /parent/children/order fails).

15. Offline Handling

GET /parent/children is persisted and renders instantly from cache (offline banner shown if stale). Add/edit/delete are save draft, submit online (conventions §8 class 2): the form can be filled entirely offline and the draft survives a restart, but Save child is disabled with "Needs internet — we'll show matches once you're back online" until connectivity returns (a recommendations preview genuinely cannot be computed offline). Reorder is queue offline (class 1, idempotent, latest-wins) since it's cosmetic only.

16. Push Notification Requirements

Event Recipient Title / Body Deep link Category Urgent
New match appears later for a child with zero matches at save time Parent "A teacher for {childName} just joined" / "{teacherName} teaches {subject} near you." gc://t/{teacherPublicCode} recommendations no
No push at save time itself — the in-app preview sheet (BR-7.6) already shows the result synchronously; the push above only fires later, from the same recommendation-recompute job triggered elsewhere (a newly approved teacher), for a child that previously had none.

17. Security Rules

  • Ownership: every endpoint scopes by the parent id resolved from the access token (pid claim), never a parentId in the body or query — a parent can only ever see or edit their own children.
  • Children are minors: childName is first-name-only by validation (BR-7.2); no photo, DOB or full name is ever accepted, requested or displayed anywhere in this module, matching conventions §12.
  • ChildForm is not FLAG_SECURE — nothing sensitive is shown, and children's names are already visible throughout the app (dashboard, search filters) once added.
  • The recommendation preview never exposes a teacher's phone/email (contact stays locked until a lead is created and unlocked, M37) — only name, photo, Trust Score and distance.

18. Error Handling

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
Already at the child limit LIMIT_REACHED 409 "You can add up to 3 children." — Add card replaced by the limit message
Subject not offered for the chosen class VALIDATION_FAILED 422 "Physics isn't offered for Class 5." under the subject picker
More than 6 subjects / 4 categories selected VALIDATION_FAILED 422 "Choose up to 6 subjects." / "Choose up to 4 teacher types."
Board doesn't match the parent's state VALIDATION_FAILED 422 "Choose a board available in your state."
Stale edit (another device changed the child first) VERSION_CONFLICT 409 "Updated on another device. Review and save again." — refetches before re-showing the form
Editing/deleting a child that isn't the caller's FORBIDDEN 403 Toast "You can't do that." (should be unreachable from the UI; defence in depth)

19. Testing Scenarios

  • T7.1 Add Child 1 (Aarav, Class 5, Mathematics+English) → preview sheet shows up to 3 matches; child appears in MyChildren. Maestro flow child_setup_add_first.
  • T7.2 Add Child 2 (Priya, Class 9) and Child 3 (Rohan, Class 11) → "3 of 3" header; the "+ Add another child" card is replaced by the limit message.
  • T7.3 Attempt a 4th add via a direct API replay (bypassing the now-hidden UI control) → 409 LIMIT_REACHED.
  • T7.4 Pick Class 5 in ChildForm → subject picker shows only Class-5-eligible subjects (e.g. no "Organic Chemistry"); switch to Class 11 → picker refreshes to Class-11-eligible subjects, previously chosen out-of-range subjects are cleared client-side before save.
  • T7.5 Edit a saved child's class from 9 to 5 where a previously chosen subject no longer fits → response includes droppedSubjects, app shows the removal toast, saved subject list no longer contains it.
  • T7.6 Choose a state-board that isn't the parent's state and isn't marked national/international/university/other → VALIDATION_FAILED "Choose a board available in your state."
  • T7.7 Drag-reorder two children → optimistic instant reorder; kill network before the PUT completes → reverts with a toast on failure.
  • T7.8 Delete a child → soft-deleted, disappears from MyChildren and from the child-filter chips on Search/Recommendations; the underlying parent_child_subjects rows are left in the database (verified via a direct query in the API test, not user-visible).
  • T7.9 Offline: form fills and draft persists; Save child disabled with "Needs internet"; reconnect → save proceeds and the preview sheet appears.
  • T7.10 A child with zero matching teachers at save time (rural pincode, uncommon subject) → preview sheet shows "0 teachers found for {childName}" with the "notify me" copy, not an error state.
  • T7.11 Two devices edit the same child concurrently (stale If-Match) → the second save gets VERSION_CONFLICT.

Module 8 · Parent Dashboard

Phase 2 · Parent · Used by: Parent · Depends on: M00, M06, M07 (children); Admin M29 (children/recommendation contract), Admin M36 (trust score), Admin M44 (banners); replaced ranking: M30 · New tables: none · Uses: parent_children, parents, teachers, institutes, trust_scores, teacher_locations, banners · Build estimate: 4–5 days

1. Module Purpose

The parent's home screen: a child switcher, promotional banners and five ranked rails of teachers and institutes — Recommended Teachers, Recommended Institutes, Nearby Teachers, Top Rated Teachers and Verified Teachers. Everything loads from one call so the screen is interactive from cache in under 1.5 s. This module ships a rule-based v0 ranking; Module 30 (Recommendation Engine) later swaps the scoring behind the same GET /home/parent response, so the app never changes.

2. User Stories

  • As a parent with two children, I want to switch between them and see teachers matched to each child's class and subjects so that I don't mix up recommendations.
  • As a parent on a slow connection in Hubballi, I want the dashboard to open instantly from what I saw last, with a small "Updated 3 h ago" note, so that I'm not staring at spinners.
  • As a new parent with no children added yet, I want the dashboard to prompt me to add a child instead of showing empty rails.
  • As a parent, I want to see verified and top-rated teachers near me even before I've picked a specific subject so that I can browse.
  • As a parent, I want to tap a seasonal banner and land on the right screen (a search, the plans screen, a blog) without extra taps.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-8.1 One call, five rails. GET /home/parent returns, in one response: the parent's children (for the switcher), banners, and the first page of all five rails scoped to the selected child (childId, defaults to the child with the lowest sort_order, or null if the parent has none). Each rail has its own cursor for "See all"; passing ?rail=<code>&cursor= on the same endpoint returns one rail's next page (used by "See all" and pull-to-refresh of a single rail), so there is exactly one owned endpoint.

Rail code Shown as Child-specific
recommended_teachers Recommended Teachers yes
recommended_institutes Recommended Institutes yes
nearby_teachers Nearby Teachers no (parent's city/area)
top_rated_teachers Top Rated Teachers no (parent's city)
verified_teachers Verified Teachers no (parent's city)
Rails default to 10 cards on the combined call and 20 on a "See all" page; limit 1–20.

BR-8.2 Eligibility (every rail). Teachers: teachers.verification_status = 'approved', teachers.account_status = 'active'. Institutes: institutes.verification_status = 'approved', institutes.account_status = 'active'. Both exclude rows the parent dismissed (recommendation_dismissals, Module 30 table — read here so v0 also respects "Not interested") and rows in user_blocks either direction.

BR-8.3 Recommended Teachers (v0 formula, per child). Candidates: teachers with a teacher_classes row matching the child's class_id (board NULL or equal to the child's board_id). Score, identical to Admin Module 29's FR‑29.4 so admin and app explain the same number:

score = 5                                          -- class always matches (filter)
      + 3 × matchedCategories(child, teacher)       -- 0..4, teacher_categories overlap
      + 3 × matchedSubjects(child, teacher)         -- 0..6, teacher_subjects overlap
      + 1 × (teacher offers child.preferred_mode_id ? 1 : 0)   -- 0 if no preference set
      + trust_scores.score / 100                    -- 0..1
      + 0.5 × (teacher has a teacher_locations row in the parent's area, radius covers it ? 1 : 0)

Ties broken by trust_scores.score desc, then teachers.rating_avg desc, then random() seeded per day (so the order is stable for a day, not identical for every parent). Top 20 per child computed and cached in Redis home:rec:teacher:<childId> for 6 hours; invalidated when the child's class/board/subjects/categories/mode change (Module 7) or when a matched teacher's teacher_classes/teacher_subjects/teacher_categories/teacher_locations/verification status changes (a targeted cache-bust, not a full flush). A child with 0 candidates shows the rail's empty state, not a hidden rail.

BR-8.4 Recommended Institutes (v0 formula, per child). Candidates: approved institutes in the child's city_id (parent's city_id, from parents). Score (v0, coarser than teachers because institute-level subject/class mapping is Module 24/26 data, added properly in Module 30):

score = 3 × (institute.area_id = child's area ? 1 : 0)
      + 2 × (institute.is_premium ? 1 : 0)
      + institute.overall_rating              -- 0..5, admin evaluation
      + institute.user_rating_avg / 2          -- 0..2.5

Top 20 cached in Redis home:rec:institute:<childId> for 6 hours, invalidated on institute rating/status change or child location change.

BR-8.5 Nearby Teachers. Approved teachers with a teacher_locations row where area_id = parent.area_id, or (if none in-area) city_id = parent.city_id; ordered by is_primary desc, then travel_radius_km asc (a smaller radius reads as "closer"), then trust_scores.score desc. Cached in Redis home:nearby:<cityId>:<areaId> for 15 minutes (shared across parents in the same area — not personalised). If the parent has no area_id set, the rail falls back to city-only and its header shows "Near {city}" instead of "Near {area}".

BR-8.6 Top Rated Teachers. Approved teachers in the parent's city with rating_count ≥ 5, ordered by rating_avg desc, then trust_scores.score desc. Cached home:topRated:<cityId> 15 minutes.

BR-8.7 Verified Teachers. Approved teachers in the parent's city with is_verified_badge = true, ordered by trust_scores.score desc, then rating_avg desc. Cached home:verified:<cityId> 15 minutes.

BR-8.8 Banners. home_top (max 3, shown as a carousel) and home_middle (max 2, shown as single cards between rails) placements are fetched by re-using Module 44's serving query (audience IN ('all','parents'), city match, active window, priority desc, max 5 combined) — this module does not define a second banner endpoint; it calls the same BannerService.getForPlacement function and embeds the result so the whole screen is one round trip. Impressions and clicks are sent through POST /events (Module 0) with names home_banner_impression / home_banner_click and { bannerId, placement }; a nightly job (Module 44) aggregates these into banners.impressions / .clicks.

BR-8.9 Child switcher. Chips show each child's first name in parent_children.sort_order; the active chip is bold with an underline. Switching child re-fetches only the two per-child rails (recommended_teachers, recommended_institutes); the other three rails and banners stay mounted. A "+ Add child" chip at the end opens Module 7. Zero children: the switcher is replaced by a single card "Add your first child to get matched teachers" with a button that opens Module 7, and all rails run in "no child" mode (recommended rails hidden; nearby/top rated/verified still show, since they need no child).

BR-8.10 Rail pagination ("See all"). Tapping a rail's "See all" opens RailListScreen with GET /home/parent?rail=<code>&childId=&cursor= (cursor pagination, meta.nextCursor), same eligibility and order as the rail, page size 20. It is a read-through of the same cached list for recommended_* rails (cursor indexes into the cached top-20; beyond position 20 it falls through to a live query with the same formula, uncached).

BR-8.11 Freshness. GET /home/parent response carries meta.rails = { [code]: { cachedAt } } per rail so the app can show "Updated {relative time}" and knows when to silently refetch (rail cache older than its TTL) versus serve straight from the app's own query cache.

BR-8.12 Replacement by Module 30. When Module 30 ships, resolveRailScore for recommended_teachers/recommended_institutes is swapped for the trained/heavier scorer; the request/response shape, cache keys and cache TTLs are unchanged, so this module's screens need no change. nearby/top_rated/verified are not touched by Module 30 (they are not personalised).

6. Screen Wireframe Description

ParentHome — header "Hi, Lakshmi" with a bell icon (unread badge, opens M48) and avatar (opens M09). Below it, a horizontal chip row: "Aarav" (active, underlined), "Riya", "+ Add child". Home-top banner carousel (16:7 image, dot indicator, auto-advances 5 s, pauses on touch). Then, per rail, a SectionHeader ("Recommended Teachers for Aarav" · "See all") and a horizontal FlashList of TeacherCards (photo, name, verified badge if any, category, "₹{fee}/hr" or "Fee on request", rating stars + count, trust score ring, distance chip if known, "Book free demo" quick action). A home-middle banner card sits between the second and third rail. Institute rail uses InstituteCard (logo, name, type, city/area, overall rating stars, "25 teachers" count, Premium ribbon if any). Empty rail: illustration + "No matches yet — try widening your child's subjects" with a button to Module 7. Loading: 4 skeleton cards per rail. Error (a single rail failed): inline "Couldn't load this — Retry" without breaking the rest of the screen. Pull-to-refresh re-fetches the whole dashboard.

No children card — illustration of a child with books, heading "Add your first child", body "Tell us their class and subjects so we can match the right teachers.", button "Add child".

RailListScreen — header with the rail's title and child chip (if per-child); vertical FlashList (2-column grid on tablets) of the same cards; ListFooterLoader while fetching the next cursor page; empty and error states as above.

Table Owner Purpose

14. State Management

  • useChildSwitcher (Zustand + MMKV): { selectedChildId, setSelectedChildId() }; seeded from the server's selectedChildId on first load, then sticky across sessions.
  • Query keys: homeKeys.parent(childId) (persisted, staleTime = the rail's own TTL from meta.rails[*].cachedAt, refetch on app foreground), homeKeys.rail(code, childId) for RailListScreen's infinite query (not persisted beyond the first page).
  • Switching a child does not clear homeKeys.parent(oldChildId) from cache — chips flip instantly to cached data while recommended_teachers/recommended_institutes refetch in the background.
  • Invalidation: Module 7 child add/edit/delete invalidates homeKeys.parent(*); favouriting a card (Module 40) optimistically updates its isFavourite flag inside the cached rail item.

15. Offline Handling

  • The whole combined response is persisted (meta: { persist: true }); a parent opens the dashboard fully from cache offline, with "Updated {time}" on each rail and the global offline banner.
  • RailListScreen beyond the first cached page is online-only ("You're offline — showing recent recommendations only.").
  • Banner and card taps that need a network call (favourite, demo request) queue per their own module (Module 40, Module 38); tapping through to a profile works from any cached rail item.

16. Push Notification Requirements

None from this module. Rail contents change silently; Module 30 may later add a "New teacher matches your child" push, and Module 44 owns banner campaign pushes.

17. Security Rules

  • childId is always checked against parent_children.parent_id = :pid; another parent's child id → FORBIDDEN.
  • Cards never include a teacher's or institute's phone/email; contact requires Module 37/39's unlock flow.
  • Banner deepLink is opened only through lib/deeplinks.ts's allow-list (conventions §4/Module 44 FR‑44.5), never as a raw WebView URL.
  • Redis rail caches are keyed by opaque ids only, never contain PII, and are city/area-scoped (not personal) for the three shared rails.

18. Error Handling

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
childId belongs to another parent FORBIDDEN 403 Toast "You can't do that."; falls back to the default child
Unknown rail code VALIDATION_FAILED 422 Client bug guard only; ignored by the UI
Parent has no city/area set — 200 Nearby/Top rated/Verified show "Set your area" card linking to Module 9
One rail's Redis lookup fails — 200 (rail degrades) That rail computes live (uncached) once; if that also fails the rail shows inline Retry
Stale cursor (rail list changed) NOT_FOUND on a specific item, ignored 200 Skipped row; pagination continues

19. Testing Scenarios

  • T8.1 (Maestro parent_home_load) Parent with 2 children opens Home → both chips render, Aarav selected by default, all 5 rails populated.
  • T8.2 Switch chip to Riya → only Recommended Teachers/Institutes refetch; Nearby/Top Rated/Verified keep their scroll position and data.
  • T8.3 Parent with 0 children → No-children card shown; recommended rails absent; nearby/top-rated/verified still show for the parent's city.
  • T8.4 Child's subjects changed in Module 7 → Recommended Teachers cache for that child is invalidated within 5 s; next open shows updated order.
  • T8.5 Airplane mode → dashboard opens fully from cache with "Updated 2 h ago" and the offline banner; "See all" beyond cache shows the offline message.
  • T8.6 See all on Recommended Teachers → RailListScreen paginates past the cached top 20 into a live (uncached) tail without duplicates.
  • T8.7 Two teachers tie on score → order is stable across two loads the same day (seeded random), and differs the next day.
  • T8.8 Parent taps a home_top banner → home_banner_click event sent once; deep link to gc://search?classId=… opens Search pre-filtered.
  • T8.9 Parent blocks a teacher (Module 49) → that teacher disappears from every rail on next refresh.
  • T8.10 Concurrent requests for two different children (fast chip double-tap) → responses applied in request order, no flicker to the wrong child's cards.
  • T8.11 One rail's dependency (Redis) times out → the other four rails still render; the failed rail shows Retry, not a full-screen error.

20. Audit Log Events

None — dashboard reads are not audit-logged (conventions §11). Impressions and clicks are analytics events (home_rail_impression, home_banner_impression, home_banner_click) via POST /events, feeding teacher_profile_views/institute_profile_views per conventions §9's analytics note, not an audit trail.

21. Future Scalability Notes

  • Replace the v0 formulas with Module 30's learned scorer without any app change (BR-8.12).
  • Precompute rail caches in a nightly/streaming job instead of on first request, to remove the cold-cache latency spike after a child edit.
  • A "For You" mixed rail blending teachers and institutes once click-through data exists.
  • Per-rail A/B testing of card layout and copy, keyed by algo_version (reusing Module 30's column).
  • Server-driven layout (rail order and count configurable by admin/segment) once more rail types exist.

Module 9 · Parent Profile

Phase 2 · Parent · Used by: Parent · Depends on: M00 (uploads), M04 (contact verification), M06 (registration); Admin M28 (parents directory) · New tables: none · Uses: parents, app_users, files · Build estimate: 1–2 days

1. Module Purpose

The parent's own profile: name, photo, phone/email (read-only here — changed from Module 51 Account Settings), city/area, and the account actions a parent reaches from their tab (children, subscription, privacy, support, sign out). This module owns just the profile view/edit; children live in Module 7, subscription in Module 10, notifications in Module 20/48, privacy in Module 52.

2. User Stories

  • As a parent, I want to add a profile photo so that my teacher and institute contacts feel more personal (photos never leave gc-public, they're optional).
  • As a parent who moved from Mysuru to Bengaluru, I want to update my city and area so that my Nearby rail and recommendations stay relevant.
  • As a parent, I want one screen that lists my children, subscription and settings so that I don't hunt through menus.
  • As a low-connectivity parent, I want my profile edits saved as soon as I'm back online, without losing what I typed.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-9.1 Read. GET /parent/profile returns full_name, photoUrl (via profile_photo_file_id → files/CDN), masked phone/email (full values are for display only, taken from app_users; editing them routes to Module 51), city, area, publicCode, createdAt, plus summary counts (children count, unread notifications) used by the profile screen's header — not by the dashboard.

BR-9.2 Edit. PATCH /parent/profile (If-Match: <updatedAt>) updates full_name, city_id, area_id, profile_photo_file_id (from a completed Module 0 upload, purpose avatar). Changing city_id clears area_id unless the new area belongs to the new city. In one transaction: update parents, and if profile_photo_file_id changed also update app_users.profile_photo_file_id (Module 0's shared column, since the avatar is shown across the app header) — write audit_logs (module = 'app.parent_profile').

BR-9.3 City/area change side effects. A changed city_id/area_id invalidates Module 8's non-personalised rail caches for both the old and new (cityId, areaId) pairs is unnecessary (those are shared caches, not per-parent); instead it invalidates this parent's own homeKeys.parent(*) client-side query cache so the next dashboard load re-scopes Nearby/Top Rated/Verified immediately.

BR-9.4 Photo upload. Standard Module 0 flow (presign purpose avatar → PUT → confirm); client-side crop to a 1:1 square before upload, max 5 MB, jpeg/png/webp. Removing the photo (profile_photo_file_id: null) reverts to initials avatar.

BR-9.5 Profile menu. The Profile tab (not a separate endpoint) shows: My children (Module 7) with child count, Membership (Module 10) with the current plan name/status, Notification settings (Module 20), Privacy (Module 52), Payment history (Module 45), Refer & earn (Module 46), Help & support (Module 53), Report a problem (Module 49), Delete account (Module 54), Sign out.

BR-9.6 Sign out. POST /auth/logout (Module 4) then local clear per conventions §7; "Sign out of all devices" opens Module 51's session list.

14. State Management

  • Query keys: parentProfileKeys.me (persisted, staleTime 5 min).
  • useUpdateParentProfileMutation invalidates parentProfileKeys.me and meKeys.me (name/photo shown in the app header) on success; on city_id/area_id change it also invalidates homeKeys.parent(*) (Module 8, client-side only, no refetch until the tab is revisited).
  • Edit form state is a React Hook Form instance backed by ParentProfileInputSchema; not a Zustand draft (single screen, no multi-step flow), but unsaved changes are kept in MMKV as profileDraft so a killed app resumes the edit (cleared on save or explicit discard).

15. Offline Handling

  • GET /parent/profile is persisted; the profile screen opens instantly offline.
  • PATCH /parent/profile is save draft, submit online (conventions §8 class 2): the Save button is disabled offline with "You're offline — changes will be enabled when you're back online." (money/security-free but touches If-Match, so it is not queued blindly to avoid silent conflicts).
  • Avatar upload is online-only (Module 0 rule).

16. Push Notification Requirements

None. Profile changes are not announced; a phone/email change (Module 51) sends its own OTP-confirmation push.

17. Security Rules

  • Ownership: parent_id resolved from the token (pid), never from the request body.
  • Phone/email are masked in every response from this endpoint; the unmasked value is only ever shown on the device that owns it, inside Module 51.
  • FLAG_SECURE is not required here (no documents/OTP/payment), but the avatar viewer respects the system screenshot setting.
  • profilePhotoFileId ownership is checked (files.uploaded_by_id = sub) before linking, preventing a parent linking another user's uploaded file.

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
Area doesn't belong to the chosen city VALIDATION_FAILED 422 Inline under Area
Stale edit (If-Match mismatch) VERSION_CONFLICT 409 "Updated on another device. Review and save again." + refetch
Photo file not owned / not active VALIDATION_FAILED 422 "That photo didn't upload. Try again."

  • T9.3 Upload a 6 MB photo → rejected client-side before presign.

  • T9.5 Kill the app mid-edit → relaunch → EditParentProfile reopens with the unsaved draft restored.
  • T9.6 Go offline mid-edit → Save button disables; reconnect → Save enables and succeeds with the same If-Match (refetches first if stale).
  • T9.7 Remove profile photo (profilePhotoFileId: null) → avatar falls back to initials "LV" everywhere (header, cards on Module 8 impossible since parents aren't shown there, but the app header and Module 51 update).
  • T9.8 Sign out from the menu → confirm sheet → session cleared, Login screen shown.

Module 10 · Parent Subscription

Phase 2 · Parent · Used by: Parent · Depends on: M00, M04, M43 (payment gateway and PaymentSheet — see build-order note below); Admin M05 (pricing), Admin M30, Admin M41 (subscription engine) · New tables: none · Uses: subscriptions, payment_configurations, transactions, parents · Build estimate: 3 days

1. Module Purpose

Membership purchase and renewal for parents: trial, monthly and yearly plans, current status, auto-renew control and cancellation. This module owns GET /plans and GET /subscriptions/current, both re-used as-is by Module 13 (student subscription, ?role=student) and Module 44 (boosts reuse the same subscription read model). Contact with teachers, demo bookings and full profile access are gated on having a live subscription (trial/active/grace/free_access); this module is where a parent gets one.

Build-order note. Purchasing calls Module 43's POST /payments/orders and opens its PaymentSheet. Build Module 43's API and PaymentSheet component before wiring this module's Pay button; until then this module ships in "view plans" mode (plans and current status visible, Subscribe button disabled with "Payments coming soon").

2. User Stories

  • As a new parent, I want a 7-day free trial with full access so that I can try contacting a couple of teachers before paying.
  • As a parent whose trial is ending tomorrow, I want a clear banner and an easy way to subscribe so that I don't lose access mid-search.
  • As a parent who pays yearly, I want to see exactly when my membership renews and turn off auto-renew if I don't want to continue.
  • As a parent in a city where GuruConnect made membership free during launch, I want full access without seeing a paywall.
  • As a parent on a slow connection, I want the plans screen to load from cache so I can at least see prices while my payment can't go through yet.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-10.1 Plans. GET /plans?role=parent reads the active payment_configurations for PARENT_SUBSCRIPTION_MONTHLY and PARENT_SUBSCRIPTION_YEARLY (Admin M05 resolveFee, same function Module 43 uses so the price shown here is exactly what checkout will charge) and returns both cards with isEnabled, amountPaise, billingPeriod, validityDays, trialDays, a computed per-month figure for the yearly card, and whether the parent is trial-eligible (BR-10.2). A disabled plan is omitted from the list, not shown greyed out (Admin M05 FR-5.10); if both are disabled the screen shows "Membership is free right now" (the parent already has free_access, Admin M41 FR‑41.5).

BR-10.2 Trial eligibility. A parent is trial-eligible only if they have never had a subscriptions row with subscriber_type = 'parent' before (any status) — i.e. first purchase only; trial_days comes from whichever plan's active version they buy first, and Module 43/Admin M41 create the trial row on first successful purchase of a fee whose trial_days > 0. The plans screen shows "{n}-day free trial, then {price}" only when eligible; otherwise "{price}, billed {period}".

BR-10.3 Current status. GET /subscriptions/current?role=parent returns the parent's single live-or-most-recent subscriptions row (the uq_subscriptions_one_live row if one exists, else the latest by created_at): status, feeCode, plan name, startsAt, endsAt/trialEndsAt, autoRenew, daysLeft, and canPurchase (false only when a live active/grace row has endsAt more than 30 days away — Module 43 BR‑43.9 — since a nearer renewal can be bought now and queued).

BR-10.4 Purchase. The Subscribe button opens Module 43's PaymentSheet with feeCode, context: {}, returnTo: { route: 'ParentSubscription' }. This module defines no purchase endpoint of its own; on PaymentResult success it invalidates subscriptionKeys.current('parent') and planKeys.parent and shows a success banner on return ("Your membership is active till {date}").

BR-10.5 Auto-renew. Toggling off calls Admin/shared POST /subscriptions/:id/auto-renew { enabled: false } (Module 44 owns the enum; this module's UI just confirms "You'll keep access until {endsAt}, then your membership won't renew." and calls the shared endpoint with the parent's own subscription id — ownership checked user_id = sub). Turning auto-renew on is not supported from this screen in v1 (no stored mandate re-activation flow yet); the parent buys the next period manually near expiry instead.

BR-10.6 Cancel. POST /subscriptions/:id/cancel { mode: 'at_period_end' | 'immediately', reason } (shared endpoint, ownership-checked). immediately is offered only within 24 hours of first purchase (a lightweight cooling-off window) and always shows the refund policy link; after 24 hours only at_period_end is offered. A refund, if any, is requested through Module 45's flow, not created here.

BR-10.7 Fee switched off / on. When PARENT_SUBSCRIPTION_* is disabled (Admin M05), existing paid parents keep their period; new/lapsed parents get free_access (Admin M41 FR‑41.5) and this screen shows a "Free access" state with no Subscribe button. Re-enabling either moves them to a fresh trial (subscriptions.free_access_to_trial_on_enable, default true, from system_settings) or ends access with 3 days' notice; either way the parent gets a push (BR-10.9) and the screen reflects the new state on next open.

BR-10.8 Renewal reminder. 7 days before endsAt (if auto_renew), Admin M41's job sets renewal_reminder_sent_at and this module's push template fires (BR‑10.9); the plans screen shows "Renews on {date} for {price}" from that point.

6. Screen Wireframe Description

ParentPlans — status banner at top, colour and copy by state: trial → amber "Trial ends in 4 days" with a Subscribe button inline; active/auto-renew → green "Active · renews 26 Oct for ₹1,999"; grace → red "Payment failed — renew now to keep access"; free_access → neutral "Membership is free right now, courtesy of GuruConnect." Below, two plan cards side by side (yearly marked "Best value — save 44%" when its per-month price beats monthly): plan name, price big, "≈ ₹167/month" for yearly, trial line if eligible, bullet list ("Unlimited teacher contacts", "Free demo bookings", "Priority support"), sticky-per-card button "Subscribe" (or "Current plan" disabled state on the active one). Footer link "View my subscription" → detail screen. Loading: two skeleton cards. Payments-not-ready mode: buttons read "Coming soon" (disabled) with a tooltip.

ParentSubscriptionDetail — plan name and status pill at top; PeriodProgress-style bar from start to end with days-left label; rows: "Started" date, "Renews/Ends" date, "Auto-renew" (Switch, confirm sheet on turning off), "Price paid" ₹ amount; section "Cancel membership" (destructive text button) opening a bottom sheet with mode choice (disabled immediately after 24 h, greyed with "Only available within 24 hours of purchase"), reason (optional, free text ≤300 chars), and a link to the refund policy; primary button in the sheet "Confirm cancellation".

9. API Endpoints

This module owns no new endpoints; it reads and calls shared ones (Admin M41/App M43/M44 scope), always with role=parent and ownership enforced server-side by the token.

Method Path Auth Description
GET /plans Any user Active plans for the caller's role (?role=parent)
GET /subscriptions/current Any user Caller's current/most recent subscription (?role=parent)
POST /subscriptions/:id/auto-renew Any user (owner) Turn auto-renew off
POST /subscriptions/:id/cancel Any user (owner) Cancel now or at period end

12. PostgreSQL Tables & Columns

Existing tables this module reads or writes (full definitions in the owning module)

Table Owner Purpose
subscriptions Admin M41 Paid access periods for parents, students, teachers and institutes, including trials.
payment_configurations Admin M05 One row per version of each fee. The app charges whichever version is active at payment time.
transactions Admin M40 Every payment attempt through Razorpay, plus refunds and reward payouts. Amounts in paise.
parents Admin M28 Parent profile, one per parent app account.
  • subscriptions: read-only here except for the two shared write endpoints (auto-renew, cancel), which are owned by Admin M41 and reused with subscriber_type = 'parent' enforced from the token, not the body.
  • payment_configurations: read via resolveFee for plan cards; never written.
  • transactions: read only to show "Price paid" (subscriptions.last_transaction_id → transactions.amount_paise).
  • parents: read to check the subscriber identity (user_id = sub); no columns written.

14. State Management

  • Query keys: planKeys.parent (persisted, staleTime 5 min — prices rarely change), subscriptionKeys.current('parent') (persisted, staleTime 60 s, refetch on foreground so a renewal/expiry reflects promptly).
  • useAutoRenewMutation/useCancelSubscriptionMutation invalidate subscriptionKeys.current('parent') and meKeys.me (subscription summary shown in /me) on success; no optimistic update (state changes are consequential, confirmed server-first).
  • Payment success (Module 43) invalidates the same keys (BR-10.4).

15. Offline Handling

  • GET /plans and GET /subscriptions/current are persisted; the screen opens from cache offline with "Updated {time}".
  • Subscribe, auto-renew toggle and cancel are online only (conventions §8 class 3 — money/state-changing); all three buttons are disabled offline with a hint.

16. Push Notification Requirements

Event Recipient Title / Body Deep link Category Urgent
subscription.trial_ending Parent "Your trial ends tomorrow" / "Subscribe to keep contacting teachers without interruption." gc://plans subscription no
subscription.renewal_reminder Parent "Renews in 7 days" / "Your {plan} renews on {date} for {price}." gc://plans subscription no
subscription.grace_started Parent "Payment failed" / "We couldn't renew your membership. Update payment within 3 days to avoid losing access." gc://plans subscription yes
subscription.expired Parent "Membership ended" / "Subscribe again to keep contacting teachers." gc://plans subscription no
subscription.moved_to_free_access / .moved_to_trial Parent "Membership is now free" / "on your {plan} switch from free" gc://plans subscription no
In-app inbox mirrors all of the above (Module 48); none are urgent except the grace start (protects against a lapse the parent didn't notice).

17. Security Rules

  • Every action resolves the subscription id against the caller's own user_id/role; a parent can never act on another user's subscription (FORBIDDEN, not NOT_FOUND, to avoid leaking existence — actually returns NOT_FOUND per conventions to avoid confirming the id belongs to someone: "This is no longer available.").
  • No card, UPI or bank data is handled here — purchase entirely delegates to Module 43's PaymentSheet.
  • Cancellation reason free text is scanned by the same contact-info masking as reviews (conventions §13) before being stored, in case a parent pastes a phone number by habit.

18. Error Handling

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
Cancel immediately after 24 h VALIDATION_FAILED 422 Inline in the cancel sheet; only at_period_end enabled
Auto-renew off on a non-live subscription CONFLICT_STATE 409 Toast "Only an active plan can have auto-renew changed."
Cancel on an already-cancelled subscription CONFLICT_STATE 409 Toast + refetch
Acting on another user's subscription id NOT_FOUND 404 "This is no longer available."
Buy while active with > 30 days left CONFLICT_STATE (already_subscribed, from M43) 409 Toast "You already have an active plan till {date}."

19. Testing Scenarios

  • T10.1 (Maestro parent_subscribe_trial) New parent opens Plans → both cards show "7-day free trial" → Subscribe on Yearly → PaymentSheet → pay → returns with "Active" banner and trial dates removed on next fetch (server started the paid period immediately per Module 43/Admin M41 FR‑41.2).
  • T10.2 Existing parent (already had a trial before) → cards show no trial line, straight price.
  • T10.3 Turn off auto-renew on an active plan → confirm sheet → status stays active, autoRenew:false, "Renews" copy becomes "Ends 22 Oct 2026, no further charge."
  • T10.4 Cancel immediately at hour 25 after purchase → blocked client-side and server-side with the same message.
  • T10.5 Grace period: simulate a failed renewal → red banner shown, subscription.grace_started push received, still full access.
  • T10.6 Admin disables both parent fees mid-session → next GET /plans returns an empty list → screen shows "Membership is free right now."
  • T10.7 Offline → Subscribe/auto-renew/cancel buttons disabled; cached status still visible.
  • T10.8 SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED thrown while unlocking a contact → ParentPlans opens as a modal; back returns to the contact screen unchanged.
  • T10.9 Two devices both open the cancel sheet; one cancels first → the second's action gets CONFLICT_STATE and refetches to show the new state.
  • T10.10 Renewal reminder push tap → deep link opens ParentPlans directly (not the notification inbox).

Module 11 · Student Registration

Phase 3 · Student · Used by: Registration token, Student · Depends on: M00, M04, M05 (registration context/referral); Admin M31 (student directory, parent link, minors), Admin M52 (consent record); parent-side confirmation of an account link is admin-mediated (see BR-11.9) · New tables: none · Uses: students, app_users, user_consents, otp_challenges, classes · Build estimate: 3–4 days

1. Module Purpose

Turns a verified phone/email (a Registration token) into a student account: name, class, board, school, subjects of interest, and city/area. Because many students are minors, this module implements the DPDP Act 2023 requirement for verifiable parental consent: a student whose class falls below the platform's no-consent threshold cannot contact a teacher until a parent confirms an OTP sent to the parent's own phone. It also lets the student name an existing parent's phone to be linked to that parent's account (confirmed by support, per Admin M31), without requiring a parent-side app action in v1.

2. User Stories

  • As a Class 11 aspirant (JEE) signing up on my own, I want to register with just my class, board and subjects, with no parental step, so that I can start browsing immediately.
  • As a Class 8 student, I want the app to be upfront that my parent needs to approve, with a clear "why" and a fast SMS step, so that I'm not confused mid-registration.
  • As a parent whose child is registering, I want a one-tap SMS code to approve, without installing anything, so that I don't have to learn the app myself.
  • As a student whose mother already has a GuruConnect account, I want to mention her number so demo bookings show up for her too.
  • As a student on a flaky connection in a small town, I want my registration form saved as a draft so a dropped signal doesn't make me start over.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-11.1 Entry. Reached from Login (M04) after a new phone/email is verified (REGISTRATION_REQUIRED) with role intent student, or from Role Select (M03). GET /registration/context (M05) supplies masters needed by the form (classes, boards) and whether a referral code was pre-filled from a deep link.

BR-11.2 Fields. Name (full name, own), Class (required), Board (optional — state boards filtered to the student's chosen state via city, else "Other"), School/college name (optional), Subjects of interest (0–6, multi-select — see BR-11.8 for how these are used), City (required), Area (optional, dependent on city), and, only if the class requires it (BR-11.3), a parent's name and phone.

BR-11.3 Minor determination (DPDP proxy). The app does not collect a student's date of birth (data-minimisation, conventions §12). "Under 18" is operationalised the same way as Admin M31 FR‑31.6: requiresConsent = classes.level_order(classId) < classes.level_order('Class 9') (i.e. below secondary school). system_settings['students.min_age_without_consent'] (default 18) is the number shown in the app's help text and Terms; the class threshold is the mechanism that implements it without collecting an age. When requiresConsent, the parent's name and phone become required fields and the form shows an inline notice: "Since {name} is in {class}, a parent needs to approve by SMS after this step."

BR-11.4 Submit (POST /registration/student, registration token, idempotent by token — a token can only be redeemed once). In one transaction:

  1. Create app_users (user_type = 'student', contact from the token, account_status = 'active', signup_source per conventions BR‑0.13).
  2. Create students (public_code auto GC-S…, full_name, class_id, board_id, school_name, city_id, area_id, parent_name, parent_phone, parental_consent = requiresConsent ? 'pending' : 'not_required', referral_code_used).
  3. Insert user_consents: terms and privacy_policy (method = 'checkbox', document_version from GET /registration/context), and marketing if the optional box was ticked. Not yet data_processing_minor/parental_consent — those are only written once a parent actually confirms (BR-11.7), never at submission.
  4. If parentPhone exactly matches the phone of a live (deleted_at IS NULL), active parents row, set students.parent_id and parent_link_status = 'pending' (Admin M31 confirms this manually when the parent calls in, per its FR‑31.4 story — there is no self-serve parent-side confirmation screen in v1; see BR‑11.9).
  5. If requiresConsent, create the first otp_challenges row (BR-11.6) and send the SMS.
  6. Issue the app's normal session (access + refresh token, app_sessions row) — the student is signed in immediately regardless of consent status; consent only gates contacting teachers (BR-11.7).
  7. Write audit_logs (module = 'app.student_registration', actor_type = 'app_user'). A second submit with the same (already-consumed) registration token → AUTH_REQUIRED (token already used); the client should not retry automatically.

BR-11.5 Subjects are a cold-start signal, not a stored profile (schema request). The schema has no student_subjects table (only parent_child_subjects exists, for children). The 0–6 subjectIds chosen here are cached in Redis student:coldstart:<userId> for 30 days and read once by Module 12's dashboard to bias its v0 ranking before real signals (favourites, search history, leads) accumulate; they are not persisted to Postgres and cannot be edited later in v1. A durable student_subjects junction table (mirroring parent_child_subjects) is the natural follow-up — see Schema requests in the module summary.

BR-11.6 Parental consent OTP (otp_challenges, purpose = 'parent_consent'). channel = 'sms', destination = students.parent_phone, 6-digit code (auth.otp_length), hashed (code_hash), expires_at = now() + 24h (longer than login OTP since the parent may not check their phone right away), resend_count, attempts. SMS text: "{studentName} added you as their parent on GuruConnect. Enter {code} in their app to approve, or ignore to do nothing. Code valid 24 hours." The code is meant to be read by the parent and typed into the student's own device (no separate parent app flow in v1) — the OTP being sent to a distinct phone number the parent controls is what makes the consent "verifiable" against a self-declared checkbox.

BR-11.7 Consent request/verify.

  • POST /student/parent-consent/request (Student, no body) resends the code to students.parent_phone if parental_consent = 'pending'; cooldown auth.otp_resend_after_seconds (30 s), max auth.otp_max_per_hour (5) per student. CONFLICT_STATE if parental_consent is already confirmed/not_required.
  • POST /student/parent-consent/verify { code } (Student) checks the latest non-consumed, non-expired otp_challenges row for this student: on match, in one transaction, set students.parental_consent = 'confirmed', parental_consent_at = now(), consume the challenge (consumed_at), and insert two user_consents rows: parental_consent and data_processing_minor (both granted = true, method = 'otp', guardian_phone = students.parent_phone, document_version = the current privacy policy version). 5 wrong codes → OTP_LOCKED for 15 minutes (conventions §5); expired → OTP_EXPIRED with a Resend action.
  • There is no in-app "decline" action: a parent who objects contacts support, who sets parental_consent = 'declined' (Admin M31), which the app shows as a blocking screen (BR-11.8).

BR-11.8 What pending/declined consent blocks. While parental_consent = 'pending', the student can sign in, browse, search and save favourites, but every contact/demo action (Module 37, 38) returns FORBIDDEN with details.reason = "parental_consent_pending"; the app shows a persistent banner on Home ("Ask your parent to approve — Resend code") instead of hiding the whole app, so the student isn't locked out of exploring. declined blocks the same actions and additionally shows a full "Contact support" screen with no dismiss, since continuing to use the platform against a parent's stated objection isn't appropriate for a minor account.

BR-11.9 Parent account linking is admin-mediated in v1. Setting parent_link_status = 'pending' at BR‑11.4 step 4 does not notify the parent's app (no confirm/decline endpoint exists for this in the current module map) — it is a hint for support, matching Admin M31's own story ("Support Admin … link a student to their parent's account when the parent asks"). The registration screen tells the student: "If {parentName} already has a GuruConnect account, they can confirm the link by calling support." This is independent of parental consent (BR-11.3–11.7): a Class 12 student with no consent requirement can still optionally link a parent's account for visibility into their demo bookings.

BR-11.10 Draft persistence. The multi-field form is a Zustand + encrypted MMKV draft (studentRegistrationDraft), restored on relaunch until submitted or the registration token expires (30 minutes) — after expiry the draft is kept but the student is routed back through phone verification (M04) before resubmitting.
