6. Screen Wireframe Description

StudentRegistrationForm — header "Tell us about yourself"; fields: Full name (text, "e.g. Aarav Kumar"), Class (select, bottom sheet grouped by stage), Board (select, "e.g. CBSE", optional), School/college (text, optional, "e.g. National Public School, Koramangala"), Subjects of interest (multi-select chips, up to 6, helper "We'll use this to show you relevant teachers until you start searching"), City (select with search), Area (select, disabled until city chosen). Sticky button "Continue".

StudentParentContactStep — when requiresConsent: banner "Since Aarav is in Class 8, a parent needs to approve by SMS after this step." with a "Why?" link opening a sheet explaining DPDP consent in plain language; fields Parent's name (text) and Parent's phone (PhoneField, +91 prefix), both required. When not required: same fields under a collapsed "Add a parent's number (optional)" disclosure, both optional, helper "So they can see your demo bookings too." Sticky button "Finish sign-up" (label "Continue to approval" when consent is required).

ParentConsentPending — illustration of a phone with a message bubble; heading "Ask your parent to approve"; body "We sent a code to +91 98450 XXXXX. Ask them to read it to you, or hand them your phone." button Enter code; secondary "Resend code" (disabled with a 30 s countdown right after sending); text link "Skip for now — you can still browse" routing to Home with the banner.

ParentConsentOtp — OtpInput (6 cells, no autofill — the SMS is not addressed to this device), helper "Entered by your parent", countdown "Code expires in 23h 58m", "Resend code" link, error text under the input for wrong/expired code, sticky button Approve.

13. Relationships

Entity relationship diagram (tables this module uses; admins omitted)

14. State Management

  • useRegistrationDraft (Zustand + encrypted MMKV, key studentRegistrationDraft): all form fields, step: 'details' | 'parent' | 'submitted'.
  • Query keys: registrationContextKeys.current (persisted, short staleTime); consent screens poll nothing (the student explicitly re-checks by resending/verifying, no background polling of a phone-based flow).
  • On successful submit, useSession.setTokens() signs the student in immediately (BR-11.4 step 6); meKeys.me is fetched fresh so the role-tab navigator switches to Student tabs even while consent is pending.

15. Offline Handling

  • The form itself is a save draft, submit online flow (conventions §8 class 2): fields persist across app restarts; "Continue"/"Finish sign-up" are disabled offline with a hint.
  • POST /student/parent-consent/request and /verify are online only (OTP, conventions §8 class 3).

16. Push Notification Requirements

Event Recipient Title / Body Deep link Category Urgent
student.parental_consent_confirmed Student "Your parent approved!" / "You can now contact teachers and book demos." gc://home account no
student.parental_consent_declined Student "Account on hold" / "Your parent asked us to hold your account. Contact support for help." gc://support account yes
The OTP itself is SMS, not a push (the parent has no app session). In-app only: the pending banner on Home is derived from /me, not a stored notification.

17. Security Rules

  • The registration token (aud gc-register) is the only credential POST /registration/student accepts; it is single-use and scoped to the verified contact, so no account can be created for a phone/email the student doesn't control.
  • parentPhone is validated to differ from the student's own verified phone (prevents a student self-approving by entering their own number).
  • OTP codes are hashed (code_hash), rate-limited (BR-11.6/11.7), and never logged or sent to Sentry/analytics.
  • students.parent_phone/parent_name are visible to the student who entered them and to admins with students.read; they are never shown to other app users.
  • Consent-gated actions check students.parental_consent server-side on every attempt (Module 37/38), never trusting a cached client flag.

18. Error Handling

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
Registration token already used AUTH_REQUIRED 401 Route back to Login; "Please verify your number again."
Class requires consent but no parent phone given VALIDATION_FAILED 422 Inline on parentPhone, form won't submit
Parent phone equals the student's own number VALIDATION_FAILED 422 "This can't be your own number."
Consent OTP expired (> 24 h) OTP_EXPIRED 410 "That code expired." + Resend
Consent OTP wrong 5 times OTP_LOCKED 429 "Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes."
Resend before cooldown RATE_LIMITED 429 Countdown shown on the button
Verify when already confirmed CONFLICT_STATE 409 Toast + route to Home
Contact action while pending/declined FORBIDDEN (parental_consent_pending/_declined) 403 Banner (pending) or blocking screen (declined) from Module 37/38

19. Testing Scenarios

  • T11.1 (Maestro student_registration_minor) Class 8 student registers with a parent phone → account created, signed in, ParentConsentPending shown; parent's number receives the SMS (test-mode provider); entering the correct code on ParentConsentOtp confirms consent and clears the Home banner.
  • T11.2 (Maestro student_registration_adult) Class 12 student registers with no parent phone → straight to Home, parentalConsent: "not_required", no banner.
  • T11.3 Attempt POST /leads while parental_consent = 'pending' → 403 parental_consent_pending; banner deep-links to ParentConsentPending.
  • T11.4 Wrong code 5 times → OTP_LOCKED for 15 minutes; correct code after the lock clears succeeds.
  • T11.5 Resend twice within 30 s → second call RATE_LIMITED; after 30 s it succeeds and invalidates the previous code.
  • T11.6 Registration with a parentPhone matching an existing parent account → students.parent_id set, parent_link_status = 'pending'; Admin M31's student detail shows "Link pending" for support to confirm.
  • T11.7 Kill the app mid-form after entering class and subjects → relaunch → StudentRegistrationForm restores the draft.
  • T11.8 Registration token expires (31 minutes) before submit → submit fails AUTH_REQUIRED; draft is kept, student re-verifies phone and resumes on the same form.
  • T11.9 "Skip for now" from ParentConsentPending → Home opens with the persistent banner; tapping the banner returns to ParentConsentPending (not the OTP screen directly, since the code may have expired).
  • T11.10 Offline on StudentRegistrationForm → Continue disabled with an offline hint; back online → enabled, submits normally.
  • T11.11 subjectIds chosen at registration influence Module 12's first Recommended Teachers rail before any search has happened; after 30 days (or first real search), the cold-start hint is ignored even if the Redis key hasn't expired exactly on schedule.

21. Future Scalability Notes

  • Schema request: a student_subjects table (mirroring parent_child_subjects) to make subject interest durable and editable, replacing the 30-day Redis cold-start hint (BR-11.5).
  • Schema request / v1.1 feature: a parent-side confirm/decline endpoint and push for a pending account link, removing the current admin-mediated step (BR-11.9).
  • A short in-app explainer video for "Why does my parent need to approve?" to raise consent completion rate.
  • Email as a fallback parental-consent channel for households where the parent's number can't receive SMS reliably.
  • Re-verification of consent if the student's class crosses back below the threshold is not applicable (class only increases), but a periodic re-confirmation (e.g. yearly) could be added if regulation requires it.

Module 12 · Student Dashboard

Phase 3 · Student · Used by: Student · Depends on: M00, M11 (registration, cold-start subjects); Admin M36 (trust score), Admin M44 (banners); replaced ranking: M30 · New tables: none · Uses: students, teachers, institutes, trust_scores, teacher_locations, banners · Build estimate: 3 days

1. Module Purpose

The student's home screen: banners plus four ranked rails — Recommended Teachers, Recommended Institutes, Nearby Teachers, Top Rated Teachers and Verified Teachers, mirroring Module 8's shape but for a single learner rather than a family of children. There is no child switcher; "Recommended" is scoped to the student themself, seeded at first run by Module 11's cold-start subject hint and, from then on, by the student's own search and favourite activity. Like Module 8, this ships a v0 rule-based ranking that Module 30 later swaps in behind the same response.

2. User Stories

  • As a new student straight out of registration, I want relevant teachers on my very first Home screen, before I've searched for anything, so that the app feels useful immediately.
  • As a JEE aspirant, I want Verified and Top Rated teachers in my city visible even while I'm still deciding what to search for.
  • As a student with pending parental consent, I want to browse fully so that being on hold doesn't feel like the app is broken.
  • As a student on a 2G connection in a small town, I want the dashboard to render from cache instantly.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-12.1 One call, four rails. GET /home/student returns banners and the first page of four rails (no child switcher, unlike Module 8): recommended_teachers, recommended_institutes, nearby_teachers, top_rated_teachers, verified_teachers is folded together with top-rated the same way Module 8 keeps them separate — this module keeps all five rail codes identical to Module 8's set for a consistent client component (RailSection is shared between M08 and M12). ?rail=<code>&cursor=&limit= pages one rail, exactly as Module 8's BR-8.1.

BR-12.2 Eligibility. Same as Module 8 BR-8.2: verification_status = 'approved', account_status = 'active', excluding this student's recommendation_dismissals and user_blocks in either direction. Parental-consent status (Module 11) does not affect what the dashboard shows — only contacting (Module 37/38) is gated — so a pending student still gets full, useful browsing.

BR-12.3 Recommended Teachers (v0, per student). Because students has no subject/category preference table (unlike parent_children), candidates are scored from three signals, each optional and additive so a brand-new student still gets a reasonable list:

score = 2 × (class match: teacher has a teacher_classes row for students.class_id, board NULL or equal)
      + 2 × coldStartSubjectMatch      -- 0 or 1, from Module 11's Redis cold-start hint (0 after it expires/clears)
      + 3 × searchAffinitySubjectMatch -- 0..1, share of this student's last 20 `user_search_history` filters.subjectIds that overlap the teacher's subjects (0 with no search history)
      + 1 × favouriteCategoryMatch     -- 1 if the teacher's category appears among this student's `user_favorites` teachers' categories, else 0
      + trust_scores.score / 100
      + 0.5 × (teacher_locations row in the student's area, radius covers it ? 1 : 0)

A student with none of the three signals yet (no class set, no cold-start hint, no history, no favourites) falls back to Top Rated + Verified teachers in their city, and the rail header reads "Popular near you" instead of "Recommended for you" until a real signal exists.

BR-12.4 Recommended Institutes. Same formula as Module 8 BR-8.4, using the student's own city_id/area_id instead of a child's.

BR-12.5 Nearby / Top Rated / Verified. Identical logic and cache keys to Module 8 BR-8.5–8.7, scoped by students.city_id/area_id (these caches are shared across parents and students in the same city/area — one home:nearby:<cityId>:<areaId> entry serves both modules).

BR-12.6 Banners. Same mechanism as Module 8 BR-8.8 (reuses Module 44's BannerService.getForPlacement), with audience IN ('all','students').

BR-12.7 Cache keys and freshness. home:rec:teacher:student:<studentId> / home:rec:institute:student:<studentId>, 6 hours, invalidated when the student's class_id/city_id/area_id changes (Module 51 account edit — students have no Module-9-equivalent profile editor beyond Account Settings) or a new search/favourite changes the top affinity signal (targeted bust, not full flush, same as Module 8). meta.rails[*].cachedAt is returned exactly as in Module 8's BR-8.11.

BR-12.8 Replacement by Module 30. As Module 8 BR-8.12 — request/response shape and cache keys are unchanged when Module 30's engine takes over recommended_teachers/recommended_institutes.

Module 13 · Student Subscription

Phase 3 · Student · Used by: Student · Depends on: M00, M04, M11, M43 (payment gateway and PaymentSheet — same build-order note as M10); Admin M05 (pricing), Admin M32, Admin M41 (subscription engine) · New tables: none · Uses: subscriptions, payment_configurations, transactions, students, parents · Build estimate: 2 days

1. Module Purpose

Membership purchase and renewal for students — the same job Module 10 does for parents, reusing its owned GET /plans and GET /subscriptions/current with role=student, STUDENT_SUBSCRIPTION_MONTHLY/_YEARLY fee codes, and the student-specific trial rule: a limited number of free contacts during the trial instead of (or alongside) a time-boxed trial, and a "covered by parent's plan" shortcut for linked students.

Build-order note. As Module 10: purchasing opens Module 43's PaymentSheet; until Module 43 ships, this module shows plans and status only, with the Subscribe button disabled ("Payments coming soon").

2. User Stories

  • As a student without a linked parent, I want a free trial with a limited number of teacher contacts so that I can try the platform before paying.
  • As a student whose mother already has an active parent membership, I want to see that I'm already covered, without being asked to pay again.
  • As a scholarship student, I want to know if support has granted me free access, and see that clearly instead of a paywall.
  • As a student who used up their trial contacts early, I want a clear nudge to subscribe rather than a confusing dead end.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-13.1 Plans. GET /plans?role=student mirrors Module 10 BR-10.1 for STUDENT_SUBSCRIPTION_MONTHLY/_YEARLY, via the same resolveFee used by Module 43. trialEligible mirrors Module 10 BR-10.2 (first-ever student subscription only).

BR-13.2 Trial shape for students. A student's trial (subscriptions.status = 'trial', trial_ends_at from the fee's trial_days) additionally carries a free-contact allowance: system_settings['limits.student_trial_free_contacts'] (default 5). GET /subscriptions/current?role=student returns trialContactsUsed/trialContactsLimit alongside the usual fields; Module 37 (Contact Teacher) decrements the allowance on each new lead created during a trial and returns SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED once it reaches the limit, even if trial_ends_at hasn't passed yet — whichever comes first ends trial access. trialContactsUsed is computed live as count(leads where requester_user_id = sub and created_at >= subscriptions.starts_at), not stored on the subscription row, so it is always exact.

BR-13.3 One trial per phone/device (Admin M32 FR‑32.2). A registration or subsequent purchase attempt from a device fingerprint that already hosts another trial account skips the trial: the first subscription created for that account is active (goes straight through Module 43's checkout) rather than trial. The app never explains "why no trial" beyond the plan card simply showing the price with no trial line (trialEligible: false); the reason is logged server-side only (trial_blocked: device_reused, an app analytics event, not shown to the user).

BR-13.4 Covered by parent's plan. If students.parent_id is set, parent_link_status = 'confirmed', and that parent's subscriptions row (subscriber_type = 'parent') is live (trial, active, grace, free_access), the student is treated as fully covered: GET /subscriptions/current?role=student returns status: 'covered_by_parent' (a client-facing status distinct from the six database enum values — computed, never written to subscriptions), canPurchase: false, and Module 37/38 skip the subscription check entirely for this student. No student subscriptions row is created while covered. If the parent's plan later lapses, the student falls back to their own trial/paid status (creating a fresh trial only if BR‑13.1's eligibility still holds, i.e. it's genuinely their first time).

BR-13.5 Purchase, auto-renew, cancel. Identical mechanics to Module 10 BR-10.4–10.6, with feeCode from the student fee codes and returnTo: { route: 'StudentSubscription' }. Purchasing is hidden entirely (not just disabled) while covered_by_parent (BR-13.4).

BR-13.6 Fee switched off/on and renewal reminders. Same as Module 10 BR-10.7–10.8, scoped to subscriber_type = 'student'.

  • Same ownership model as Module 10 (user_id = sub on every subscription action).

Same table as Module 10 BR-10 errors, plus:

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
Purchase attempted while covered_by_parent CONFLICT_STATE (covered_by_parent) 409 Toast "You're covered by your parent's membership."; UI shouldn't have shown Subscribe at all
Contact attempted after trial contacts exhausted (pre-trial_ends_at) SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED 402 Module 37 opens StudentPlans

19. Testing Scenarios

  • T13.1 (Maestro student_subscribe_trial) New unlinked student → Plans shows 7-day trial with 5 free contacts → contacts 5 teachers → 6th contact attempt blocked with SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED even though 2 trial days remain.
  • T13.2 Student with parent_link_status = 'confirmed' and the parent on an active yearly plan → Plans shows "Covered by parent", no plan cards, Subscribe hidden.
  • T13.3 Parent's plan expires → student's own trial/paid state takes over on next check; if the student never had a subscription row, a fresh trial starts.
  • T13.4 Second registration on the same device fingerprint → new account's first subscription is active from first payment, no trial line shown on Plans.
  • T13.5 4th of 5 trial contacts made → subscription.trial_contacts_low push received.
  • T13.6 Subscribe on Yearly → PaymentSheet → pay → trial ends immediately, active starts (Module 43/Admin M41 FR-41.2), contacts become unlimited.
  • T13.7 Turn off auto-renew, then cancel at period end → same behaviour and messages as Module 10 T10.3/T10.9.
  • T13.8 Offline → Subscribe/auto-renew/cancel disabled; cached status (including trial contacts remaining) still visible.
  • T13.9 Admin grants a scholarship (programTag: 'scholarship', Admin M32 FR‑32.3) → student's Plans shows free_access-equivalent "active" state with price_paise = 0, no trial UI.
  • T13.10 SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED thrown from a demo booking attempt (Module 38) → StudentPlans opens as a modal; back returns to the booking screen.

21. Future Scalability Notes

  • Exam-season short plans (e.g. 90-day JEE crash plan) as additional fee codes, per Admin M32 §21.
  • A visible "why no trial" state for device-reuse cases if support tickets show it's confusing (currently silent by design, BR-13.3).
  • Institutional/school bulk licences that would set many students to free_access at once (Admin M32 §21).
  • Merge trial-contacts tracking into Module 30's engine so "contacts remaining" also informs recommendation urgency messaging (e.g. nudge to contact a strong match before contacts run out).

Module 14 · Teacher Registration

Phase 4 · Teacher · Used by: Registration token (account creation), Teacher (remaining steps) · Depends on: M00, M05 (registration context, consents); Admin M16 (teachers state machine); leads to M15 · New tables: teacher_qualifications · Uses: teachers, teacher_subjects, teacher_classes, teacher_teaching_modes, teacher_locations, teacher_categories · Build estimate: 5–6 days

1. Module Purpose

The seven-step wizard that turns a phone-verified registration token into a teachers row in verification_status = 'draft', fully described (personal details, qualifications, experience, subjects, classes, teaching modes, locations) so that Module 15 has everything it needs to accept documents and submit for verification. Every step writes straight to its server table as it is completed — there are no lost drafts if the app is killed — while a local Zustand draft holds the in-progress screen so a half-typed field survives a rotation or a brief network drop. A progress indicator and a resumable nextStep keep a teacher who registers on a train and finishes on Wi-Fi from ever starting over.

2. User Stories

  • As a new teacher, I want to register once with my phone number and pick up exactly where I left off if I close the app, so that a slow evening doesn't cost me my progress.
  • As a school teacher tutoring part-time, I want to add two qualifications and mark my B.Ed. as the highest, so that verification sees my strongest credential first.
  • As a home tutor with no fixed classroom, I want to register as "Home tuition" only and skip picking a fixed address until I add a serviceable area, so that I'm not blocked by a step that doesn't apply to me.
  • As a teacher on a 2G connection in a small town, I want each step saved the moment I tap Next, so that I don't have to redo my qualifications if the app crashes on the next screen.
  • As a teacher who mistyped their category, I want to go back and change my primary category before I submit, so that I show up in the right search results.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-14.1 Account creation. POST /registration/teacher (Registration token, aud gc-register, role teacher) is the only entry point. In one transaction: insert app_users (phone from the token's verified contact, role = 'teacher', signup_source per conventions §13, preferred_language), insert teachers (user_id, full_name, gender, date_of_birth, category_id, verification_status = 'draft', account_status = 'active', profile_completeness = 0), insert user_consents (terms + privacy, accepted_at = now(), owned by M52), apply referralCode if present (validated the same way as M05 POST /registration/referral/validate; stored for M46 to pay out once the teacher is approved), create an app_sessions row and issue access + refresh tokens exactly like POST /auth/refresh (conventions §6). Response includes the new teacherId, tokens, and nextStep: "qualification". A registration token already consumed (an app_users row already exists for that phone) returns CONFLICT_STATE and the app routes to Login instead. BR-14.2 Step order and ownership. Personal details (this endpoint) → Qualification → Experience → Subjects → Classes → Teaching modes → Locations → (Module 15 Documents). "Personal details" and "Experience" are both partial edits of the teachers row and share one endpoint, PATCH /teacher/registration/basics (If-Match on teachers.updated_at): the Personal Details screen sends { fullName, gender, dateOfBirth, email, categoryId, languages }; the Experience screen sends { experienceYears, highestQualification, bio, feePerHourPaise, demoAvailable }. Both are optional partial payloads — only the fields present are validated and updated. BR-14.3 Progress and resume. GET /teacher/registration returns the current draft (teachers row + qualifications + subjects + classes + modes + locations), completedSteps (each step is "complete" per the rule in BR-14.4) and nextStep (first incomplete step, or "documents" when all seven are done). GET /me (M00) surfaces the same nextStep under registration.nextStep so Splash (M01) resumes the wizard on relaunch without a second network call once /me is cached. BR-14.4 Step completion rules.

Step Complete when
Personal details full_name, gender, date_of_birth, category_id set
Qualification ≥ 1 row in teacher_qualifications
Experience experience_years and highest_qualification set
Subjects ≥ 1 row in teacher_subjects
Classes ≥ 1 row in teacher_classes
Teaching modes ≥ 1 row in teacher_teaching_modes
Locations ≥ 1 row in teacher_locations, OR every selected teaching mode has requires_location = false (pure online tutor)
BR-14.5 Qualifications (owns teacher_qualifications). POST /teacher/qualifications { level, degree, institution, yearCompleted, grade, isHighest } appends a row (sort_order = current max + 1). PATCH /teacher/qualifications/:id edits one row (ownership: teacher_id = pid). DELETE /teacher/qualifications/:id soft-deletes (deleted_at); at least one qualification must remain once the step is marked complete elsewhere (deleting the last one is allowed while still in draft — it simply un-completes the step). Setting isHighest: true unsets it on every other row of the same teacher in the same transaction (is_highest is not a database-unique constraint — enforced in the service layer since a teacher may have zero qualifications marked highest transiently while editing). document_id is written later by Module 15 when the teacher attaches a certificate to a qualification; it is never set from this module.
BR-14.6 Replace-set steps (subjects, classes, teaching modes, locations). Each of PUT /teacher/subjects, PUT /teacher/classes, PUT /teacher/teaching-modes, PUT /teacher/locations replaces the whole set for the teacher in one transaction (diffed: insert new, delete removed, update changed — same pattern as Admin M18). Limits: subjects 1–10 with exactly one isPrimary (auto-promotes the first item if none is flagged, matching Admin FR-18.2); classes 1–20, each optionally paired with a boardId; teaching modes 1–4 (the full active teaching_modes list); locations 0–5, each { cityId, areaId?, isPrimary, travelRadiusKm?, addressLine?, latitude?, longitude? } with exactly one isPrimary when the set is non-empty. A location is required unless every chosen teaching mode has requires_location = false (BR-14.4); the Locations screen shows "Skip — you teach online only" only in that case.
BR-14.7 Category change guard. Changing categoryId after subjects have been added shows a confirmation ("Your subjects were set up for {old category}. Review them next.") but does not clear the subject set — the teacher is taken back to the Subjects step.
BR-14.8 Locking during review. The four replace-set endpoints (subjects, classes, teaching-modes, locations) and the qualification endpoints check teachers.verification_status IN ('draft', 'approved'); any other status (pending, under_review, reupload_requested, rejected) returns 409 CONFLICT_STATE with details.reason = "verification_in_progress" so an application being actively reviewed can't shift mid-review. draft is the registration wizard itself; approved is these same six endpoints reused, unchanged, as Module 17's Subjects / Classes / Teaching modes / Locations / Qualifications editors after launch — Module 17 owns no separate endpoints for these. PATCH /teacher/registration/basics is narrower and draft-only: once approved, the equivalent personal/experience fields are edited through Module 17's PATCH /teacher/profile instead (which additionally requires a reason for identity-linked fields, per Admin FR-17.3). While reupload_requested, only Module 15's document endpoints are open; while pending/under_review/rejected, nothing in Modules 14, 15 or 17 is editable until Module 16's resubmit flow or a support-assisted re-application returns the teacher to draft.
BR-14.9 Side effects. After every write in this module: recompute teachers.profile_completeness using the Admin M17 formula (photo 15, bio ≥ 100 chars 10, qualification 10, experience 5, ≥ 1 subject 15, ≥ 1 class 10, ≥ 1 location or online mode 10, fee 5, languages 5, ≥ 1 certificate approved 15 — the last two are always 0 until Module 15/17 run, so a fresh draft tops out at 60); write no audit row per keystroke, only per successful step save (conventions §11); emit teacher.registration_step_saved for analytics (event name only, no PII).
BR-14.10 Rate limits. POST /registration/teacher is limited to 5 attempts per registration token (a token is single-use regardless — a second call after success returns CONFLICT_STATE); qualification/set-replace endpoints are limited to 30 requests/minute per teacher (protects against a runaway autosave loop).

6. Screen Wireframe Description

Registration intro — illustration of the four steps (Profile → Documents → Verification → Live); heading "Let's get you verified"; three bullet lines ("Takes about 10 minutes", "Documents reviewed within 24 hours", "₹499 one-time registration fee" — hidden entirely when TEACHER_REGISTRATION is disabled per M05); sticky button "Start".

Personal details — progress bar "Step 1 of 7"; fields: Full name (placeholder "As on your Aadhaar", text), Gender (segmented: Female/Male/Other/Prefer not to say), Date of birth (date picker, must be 18+), Email (optional, placeholder "ananya.iyer@gmail.com"), Category (bottom-sheet single-select: Home Tutor, Coaching Faculty, Online Tutor, Institute Faculty…), Languages (chip multi-select: English, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil…). Sticky "Next".

Qualifications — progress "Step 2 of 7"; empty state "Add your first qualification" with illustration; once added, a card per qualification: "M.Sc. Physics · Bangalore University · 2010 · Highest" with edit/delete icons; "+ Add qualification" outline button; sticky "Next" disabled until ≥ 1 row.

Add qualification (sheet) — Level (select: Secondary, Senior secondary, Diploma, Graduate, Postgraduate, Doctorate, Professional, Certification), Degree (text, "M.Sc. Physics"), Institution (text, "Bangalore University"), Year completed (number, 1960–2026), Grade (optional text, "First class"), "This is my highest qualification" (switch). Buttons "Cancel" / "Save".

Experience — progress "Step 3 of 7"; Experience in years (stepper, 0–60), Highest qualification (auto-filled from the qualification marked highest, editable text), About you (bio textarea, 0/2,000, placeholder "I've taught JEE Physics for 14 years and focus on..."), Indicative fee per hour (₹ input, helper "You can set detailed plans later in your profile"), "I offer a free demo class" (switch, default on). Sticky "Next".

Subjects — progress "Step 4 of 7"; search box; subjects grouped by category (Academic, Competitive exam, Skills) as checkable rows with an experience-years stepper once checked; a star icon marks the primary subject (tap to change); footer "3 selected · 10 max"; sticky "Next" disabled at 0 selected.

Classes — progress "Step 5 of 7"; grouped by stage (Primary, Middle, Secondary, Senior secondary, Competitive); each row a class chip with an optional board dropdown once selected; sticky "Next".

Teaching modes — progress "Step 6 of 7"; four large selectable cards (Online, Home tuition, At teacher's place, Hybrid) with a one-line description each; sticky "Next".

Locations — progress "Step 7 of 7" (or hidden entirely with a single confirmation card "You teach only online — no location needed. Continue." when every selected mode has requiresLocation = false); otherwise: City picker, Area picker (searchable, filtered by city), travel radius slider (2–25 km, shown only for Home tuition), address line (optional, placeholder "Koramangala 5th Block"), "+ Add another area" (up to 5), one marked "Primary"; sticky "Finish profile — continue to documents".

<details><summary>DDL</summary>

CREATE TABLE teacher_qualifications (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  teacher_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES teachers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- Owner
  level text NOT NULL CHECK (level IN ('secondary','senior_secondary','diploma','graduate','postgraduate','doctorate','professional','certification')), -- Level
  degree text NOT NULL, -- e.g. M.Sc. Physics, B.Ed.
  institution text NOT NULL, -- University / board / body
  year_completed smallint CHECK (year_completed BETWEEN 1960 AND 2100), -- Year
  grade text, -- e.g. 78% / 8.4 CGPA (optional)
  document_id uuid REFERENCES teacher_documents(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, -- Supporting certificate (Module 15)
  is_highest boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, -- Shown on cards; mirrors teachers.highest_qualification
  sort_order smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Display order
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Created
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Updated
  deleted_at timestamptz -- Soft delete
);
CREATE INDEX idx_teacher_qualifications_teacher ON teacher_qualifications (teacher_id, sort_order) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_teacher_qualifications_highest ON teacher_qualifications (teacher_id) WHERE is_highest AND deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_teacher_qualifications_updated BEFORE UPDATE ON teacher_qualifications FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

</details>

14. State Management

  • useTeacherRegistrationDraft (Zustand + encrypted MMKV, keyed teacherReg): per-step in-progress field values, cleared on successful save of that step and entirely on reaching nextStep: "documents".
  • Query key teacherRegKeys.context — the whole GET /teacher/registration payload; every mutation invalidates it (and, for subjects/classes, also mastersKeys.all is left untouched since masters don't change).
  • useSaveBasicsMutation, one useQualification{Add,Edit,Delete}Mutation, useReplace{Subjects,Classes,Modes,Locations}Mutation — each optimistic only for the in-flight step's own screen (rolls the list back on error with a toast), never cross-step.

15. Offline Handling

  • GET /teacher/registration is persisted; the wizard can be reviewed offline but every save button is disabled offline with "Connect to save this step" (registration writes are conventions §8 class 2 — draft locally, submit online).
  • The local Zustand draft survives app restarts and offline periods; nothing is queued for background replay (unlike favourites) because step order and validation must be confirmed by the server before advancing.
  • POST /registration/teacher is online-only (class 3, like OTP and payments) since it creates the account and issues tokens.

16. Push Notification Requirements

None from this module. The teacher gets no push until Module 15 submits for review (Module 16/20 then send verification-status pushes). The end of registration (after Locations, before Documents) is the point Module 20 prompts for notification permission ("Get notified the moment you're verified").

17. Security Rules

  • Every write endpoint scopes by teacher_id derived from the access token's pid, never from the body.
  • POST /registration/teacher accepts only a gc-register token whose role claim is teacher; any other role is 403 FORBIDDEN.
  • PATCH /teacher/registration/basics (draft-only) and the qualification/replace-set endpoints (draft or approved) reject in every other status (BR-14.8), so a teacher can never edit these fields while an application is actively under review.
  • Bio is scanned for phone numbers, emails and URLs (same regex as Admin FR-17.5) and rejected with VALIDATION_FAILED, keeping contact off-platform even before verification.
  • No document upload happens in this module, so FLAG_SECURE is not required on these screens.

18. Error Handling

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
Registration token expired/invalid AUTH_REQUIRED 401 Back to phone verification
Token already used (account exists) CONFLICT_STATE 409 Route to Login
Write while under review (reason: verification_in_progress) CONFLICT_STATE 409 Toast + route to Verification status (M16)
Stale edit on basics VERSION_CONFLICT 409 "Updated on another device. Review and save again." refetch and reopen
More than 10 subjects / 20 classes / 4 modes / 5 locations VALIDATION_FAILED 422 Inline count warning at the limit
Two primary subjects/locations sent VALIDATION_FAILED 422 Client blocks before submit; server double-checks
Bio contains a phone/email/URL VALIDATION_FAILED 422 Inline under the bio field
Location required but none given VALIDATION_FAILED (reason: location_required) 422 Banner "Add at least one city you teach in"
Network error mid-step NETWORK_OFFLINE / GATEWAY_ERROR — Local draft kept; Retry button; Next stays disabled

19. Testing Scenarios

  • T14.1 Happy path: register → 7 steps → lands on Documents with nextStep: "documents". Maestro flow teacher_registration_happy_path.
  • T14.2 Kill the app after saving Qualifications, relaunch → GET /teacher/registration resumes at Experience with the qualification intact.
  • T14.3 Registering with an under-18 date of birth is rejected client-side and server-side.
  • T14.4 Adding a second qualification with isHighest: true unsets the first; GET /teacher/registration shows only one highest.
  • T14.5 Selecting only "Online" as a teaching mode skips the Locations screen entirely; completedSteps includes locations without any row.
  • T14.6 Selecting "Home tuition" and leaving Locations empty blocks Next with location_required.
  • T14.7 Editing basics after Module 15 has submitted the application (verification_status = 'pending') returns 409 and the app shows "Your application is already under review."
  • T14.8 Offline: opening any step shows cached data but every Save/Next button is disabled with a hint.
  • T14.9 Stale If-Match on PATCH /teacher/registration/basics (edited on another device) surfaces the conflict message and reloads the latest basics.
  • T14.10 11th subject in PUT /teacher/subjects is rejected with VALIDATION_FAILED before any row changes (transaction rolled back, existing 10 untouched).
  • T14.11 A valid referral code on POST /registration/teacher is recorded and visible later in Module 46 once the teacher is approved.
  • T14.12 Concurrent duplicate POST /registration/teacher with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same teacherId and tokens without creating a second row.

Event When Details
app.teacher_registered Account created category, referral code used (boolean)
app.teacher_registration_step_saved Any step successfully saved step name
app.teacher_qualification_added / _updated / _deleted Qualification changes qualification id, level, isHighest
app.teacher_subjects_set / _classes_set / _modes_set / _locations_set Replace-set writes added, removed counts

21. Future Scalability Notes

  • Server-side draft validation shared with Admin M16's manual-creation form (FR-16.10) so both entry points enforce identical rules.
  • A "resume by SMS link" flow (deep link straight to nextStep) for teachers who abandon the wizard, driven by a reminder job reading teachers.verification_status = 'draft' and created_at age.
  • Bulk-import qualifications from a resume/CV photo via OCR as an optional shortcut before manual entry.
  • Category-specific step sets (e.g. institute-affiliated teachers skip Locations) once Module 25 institute-linked teachers are common.

Module 15 · Teacher Document Upload

Phase 4 · Teacher · Used by: Teacher · Depends on: M00 (presign/confirm, FLAG_SECURE); M14 (registration draft complete); M43 (registration fee); leads to M16 · New tables: none · Uses: teacher_documents, files, teachers · Build estimate: 4–5 days

1. Module Purpose

Collects the identity and qualification evidence a teacher must provide before GuruConnect will show them in search: Aadhaar, PAN, education certificates, an optional professional certificate and experience letter, and a verification selfie ("photo") compared against the Aadhaar photo by Admin M16's automated checks. Every file goes to the private R2 bucket through Module 0's presign/confirm flow; identity numbers are masked immediately and only an HMAC hash is kept for duplicate detection. Once every required document is present, the teacher pays the registration fee (if one is configured) and submits, moving teachers.verification_status from draft to pending and handing the case to the Admin M16 queue.

2. User Stories

  • As a new teacher, I want to photograph my Aadhaar and PAN with my phone camera and see instantly that they uploaded, so that I don't wonder if it worked.
  • As a teacher who typed my Aadhaar number wrong, I want to see only the masked number afterwards and re-upload if it's wrong, so that I'm never shown my own full number by mistake and don't have to guess if it saved correctly.
  • As a teacher whose certificate photo came out blurry, I want to replace it before I submit, so that I'm not rejected for something I can still fix myself.
  • As a teacher registering when the launch promotion has registration free, I want to submit without being asked to pay, so that I'm not blocked by a fee that doesn't apply to me.
  • As a teacher on a weak connection, I want an interrupted upload to resume, not restart from zero, so that a large certificate scan isn't wasted data.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-15.1 Preconditions. GET/POST/DELETE /teacher/documents require teachers.verification_status IN ('draft', 'reupload_requested') (uploading or replacing a flagged document works in both states); any other status is 409 CONFLICT_STATE (reason: not_editable) and the app routes to Module 16 Verification Status instead. POST /teacher/registration/submit (BR-15.8) is narrower: it only fires the first-time draft → pending transition and requires verification_status = 'draft' exactly — the corresponding reupload_requested → pending transition after a re-upload is a different endpoint, owned and detailed by Module 16 (POST /teacher/verification/resubmit), not this module; this module's role in that path ends at uploading the replacement document. The Documents screen itself is reachable only once Module 14's seven steps are complete (nextStep = "documents"); reaching it earlier redirects to the first incomplete step. BR-15.2 Upload flow (per document). 1) Camera or gallery/file picker per doc_type, resized/compressed per conventions §10 (images) or kept as-is for PDF (certificates only). 2) POST /uploads/presign { purpose: "teacher_document", mimeType, sizeBytes, fileName } (Module 0) → presigned PUT to gc-private. 3) App PUTs the file with progress. 4) POST /uploads/:fileId/confirm. 5) POST /teacher/documents { docType, fileId, title?, docNumber? } creates or replaces the current document for that type in one transaction: if a current row of the same doc_type exists, set its is_current = false; insert a new row with version = previous + 1 (or 1), is_current = true, status = 'submitted'. For aadhaar and pan, docNumber is required, sent once over TLS, never stored or logged in full: the server strips spaces/case, computes doc_number_masked (Aadhaar → "XXXX XXXX " + last4; PAN → first character + "XXXXX" + last 4 characters) and doc_number_hash = HMAC-SHA256(normalisedNumber, docHashKey) (key in KMS, conventions §13); the request body field is discarded after this step and never appears in any response, log or audit row. BR-15.3 Document types and rules. aadhaar and pan: exactly one current row each, docNumber required, image or PDF. education_certificate: 1–5 current rows allowed simultaneously (each is its own "slot", not replaced by a new upload unless the teacher explicitly deletes and re-adds — see BR-15.5), title required (e.g. "B.Ed., Bangalore University 2010"); may optionally be linked to a teacher_qualifications row via qualificationId in the request, which is written to teacher_qualifications.document_id. professional_certificate and experience_letter: 0–5 current rows, optional, same slot behaviour as certificates. photo: exactly one current row, a live selfie (camera capture only — the picker is disabled for this type to discourage uploading an old photo), used only for the automated face-match check (Admin FR-16.4) and never shown publicly; it is unrelated to the public profile photo the teacher sets later in Module 17 (teachers.profile_photo_file_id). BR-15.4 Duplicate hint. After an Aadhaar or PAN upload, the app calls nothing extra — duplicate checking against other teachers' current documents is Admin M16's automated check (FR-16.4), run when the teacher submits, not shown to the teacher. If the same teacher re-uploads an Aadhaar with a hash identical to their own previous rejected upload, the app shows an informational note ("This looks the same as your last upload — check your camera focus") client-side only (compares to the last known masked value locally; no extra call). BR-15.5 Delete / replace. DELETE /teacher/documents/:id is allowed only on the current version of education_certificate, professional_certificate or experience_letter (multi-slot types) and only while verification_status = 'draft' — since nothing has been reviewed yet, the row is hard-deleted along with a request to clean up the files row (soft status = 'deleted', object removed by the nightly job). aadhaar, pan and photo cannot be deleted, only replaced (a fresh POST /teacher/documents supersedes the current row as in BR-15.2); this keeps exactly one current identity/photo row at all times, matching uq_teacher_documents_current_identity. While verification_status = 'reupload_requested', DELETE is disabled entirely — the teacher may only upload a replacement for the document(s) Module 16 flagged (each new upload via BR-15.2 automatically supersedes the flagged version); once every flagged document has a new submitted row, the teacher taps "Resend for review" (Module 16 POST /teacher/verification/resubmit), which this module does not own. BR-15.6 Required set for submission. GET /teacher/documents reports readiness: current aadhaar present, current pan present, ≥ 1 current education_certificate, current photo present. All four are mandatory; professional_certificate and experience_letter are optional and never block submission. BR-15.7 Registration fee gate. The Documents screen's sticky action reads GET /api/v1/app/pricing (Module 5, via Module 43's GET /payments/quote?feeCode=TEACHER_REGISTRATION) for the current TEACHER_REGISTRATION fee. If enabled = false, the button is "Submit for verification" and skips straight to BR-15.8. If enabled = true, the button is "Pay ₹{amount} & submit": tapping it runs the Module 43 payment flow (GET /payments/quote → POST /payments/orders → Razorpay Checkout → POST /payments/verify); on a captured payment the app immediately calls POST /teacher/registration/submit { transactionId }. BR-15.8 Submit (first submission only). POST /teacher/registration/submit { transactionId? } requires verification_status = 'draft': 1) re-checks BR-15.6's required set and the fee precondition (transactionId required and its transaction status = 'captured', fee_code = 'TEACHER_REGISTRATION', payer = teacher's user_id, unused by another teacher, only when the fee is enabled); 2) in one transaction sets teachers.verification_status = 'pending', submitted_at = now(), registration_transaction_id = transactionId (or NULL when the fee is disabled); 3) writes teacher_verification_logs (action = 'submitted', from_status = 'draft', to_status = 'pending'); 4) audits app.teacher_registration_submitted; 5) sends the teacher a confirmation push/in-app message ("We've received your application — most reviews finish within 24 hours."). A teacher whose status is already pending/under_review/approved gets CONFLICT_STATE; a teacher in reupload_requested gets a clear CONFLICT_STATE pointing at Module 16's "Resend for review" action instead (no fee is ever charged twice). BR-15.9 Idempotency. POST /teacher/registration/submit is idempotent on teacher_id — a duplicate double-tap after the first success simply returns the already-pending state (200, not a new log row) as long as no other write has moved the status since.

6. Screen Wireframe Description

Documents overview — header "Upload your documents"; four rows in order Aadhaar, PAN, Education certificate(s), Photo, each with an icon, status pill (Not uploaded / Uploaded / Uploaded · under review flagged with a reason chip only when reupload_requested) and a chevron; below, a collapsed "Optional" section (Professional certificate, Experience letter) expandable; footer summary "2 of 4 required uploaded"; sticky button, disabled until all four required are present, reading "Pay ₹499 & submit" or "Submit for verification".

Document capture (Aadhaar/PAN) — camera viewfinder with a document-shaped guide overlay; below the shutter, a text field "Aadhaar number" (12-digit grouped XXXX XXXX XXXX, masked-as-you-type after the first 8 digits) or "PAN number" (10-char, auto-uppercase); helper text "We only store the last 4 digits — never the full number."; FLAG_SECURE active; sticky "Use this photo".

Document capture (certificate/photo) — for certificates: "Take photo" and "Choose from files" (PDF allowed) plus a Title field ("e.g. B.Ed., Bangalore University 2010") and an optional "Link to a qualification" picker (from Module 14's list); for photo: camera-only with a face-oval guide and the line "A clear, recent selfie — no filters or sunglasses."

Document preview — thumbnail, masked number line ("XXXX XXXX 2978") for identity docs, title for certificates; buttons "Retake" and "Looks good — upload".

Submitted confirmation — checkmark illustration; heading "Application submitted"; body "We're reviewing your documents. Most applications are decided within 24 hours."; button "See verification status" → Module 16; small text "You'll get a notification the moment there's an update."

13. Relationships

Entity relationship diagram (tables this module uses; admins omitted)

Diagram loads when this page is online…

14. State Management

  • Query key teacherDocKeys.list — the whole GET /teacher/documents payload; every upload/delete invalidates it.
  • useUpload('teacher_document') (Module 0) drives the per-file { progress, status } shown on the capture screen; not persisted (uploads are always resumed from a fresh presign, per conventions §8).
  • No Zustand store beyond the ephemeral in-flight capture (camera frame, entered doc number) which is never persisted to MMKV or query cache (PII).

15. Offline Handling

  • GET /teacher/documents is persisted so the checklist renders offline, but every action (capture, upload, delete, submit) is online-only (conventions §8 class 3 — security/PII/money) and disabled with "Connect to upload documents."
  • An upload interrupted mid-transfer resumes on next launch by re-presigning (Module 0 BR-0.8); the local file bytes are kept in the app's cache directory until confirmed.
  • Payment for the registration fee follows Module 43's offline rules (online only, never queued).

16. Push Notification Requirements

Event Recipient Title / Body Deep link Category Urgent
Registration submitted Teacher "Application submitted" / "We're reviewing your documents. Most reviews finish within 24 hours." gc://teacher/verification verification No
No push for individual document uploads — only the submission confirmation (also shown in-app immediately, so the push mainly reaches a backgrounded app).

17. Security Rules

  • Every document row is scoped to teacher_id = pid; a teacher can never read or list another teacher's documents.
  • Aadhaar/PAN numbers are never persisted in full and never appear in any response after the initial POST /teacher/documents call (which itself returns only the masked value) — not in logs, Sentry breadcrumbs, or audit rows.
  • docHashKey (HMAC key) lives in KMS; only the verification service can compute or compare hashes.
  • TeacherDocumentCaptureScreen and TeacherDocumentPreviewScreen enable FLAG_SECURE (Android) and the iOS app-switcher privacy overlay (conventions §13) for the whole time an identity number or document image is on screen.
  • Private files are only ever fetched through Module 0's 60-second signed GET /files/:id/url, requested lazily per row, never bulk-downloaded.
  • Rate limit: 20 document writes/hour and 5 submit attempts/hour per teacher.

18. Error Handling

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
Wrong status for editing (pending/approved/etc.) CONFLICT_STATE (not_editable) 409 Route to Verification Status (M16)
Invalid Aadhaar checksum / PAN format VALIDATION_FAILED 422 Inline under the number field
File too large / wrong type FILE_TOO_LARGE / FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED 413/415 Inline under the picker, retake prompted
Submit with missing required docs VALIDATION_FAILED (details.missing[]) 422 Overview highlights the missing rows
Submit with fee enabled but no captured payment VALIDATION_FAILED (reason: payment_required) 422 Reopens the payment sheet
Delete an identity/photo document FORBIDDEN 403 "Upload a new one instead — Aadhaar can't be removed."
Delete while reupload_requested CONFLICT_STATE 409 "Upload a replacement instead of deleting."
Duplicate double-submit — (idempotent) 200 No-op, same confirmation screen

Module 16 · Teacher Verification Status

Phase 4 · Teacher · Used by: Teacher · Depends on: M15 (documents submitted); Admin M16 (queue, decisions, logs) · New tables: none · Uses: teachers, teacher_documents, teacher_verification_logs · Build estimate: 2–3 days

1. Module Purpose

The single screen a teacher checks after submitting: where their application stands, which documents (if any) need attention, and a full timeline of what's happened. It translates the six internal teachers.verification_status values into four things a teacher actually needs to see — Pending, Approved, Rejected, Re-upload Required — while still showing per-document detail from teacher_documents.status so a teacher whose Aadhaar is already approved but whose certificate is still being checked isn't left guessing. It also owns the resubmit action that returns a reupload_requested teacher to the queue after they've replaced the flagged documents in Module 15.

2. User Stories

  • As a teacher waiting on my first application, I want to see "Pending" with roughly how long it usually takes, so that I don't call support after just two hours.
  • As a teacher asked to re-upload my PAN, I want to see exactly which document and why, so that I fix the right thing the first time.
  • As a teacher who has re-uploaded everything that was flagged, I want one clear button to send it back, so that I know my case is back in the queue.
  • As a rejected teacher, I want to understand why and whether I can try again, so that I'm not stuck with no path forward.
  • As a newly approved teacher, I want a clear "You're verified" moment, so that I know I can now be found by parents.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-16.1 Status mapping. teachers.verification_status maps to the app-facing status as: draft → not shown (this screen is only reachable after Module 15's submit); pending and under_review → Pending (both are "we're reviewing it" from the teacher's side — the internal claim/assignment mechanics of Admin M16 are never exposed); reupload_requested → Re-upload Required; approved → Approved; rejected → Rejected. GET /teacher/verification returns both the raw verificationStatus (for deep-link/analytics use) and the mapped displayStatus. BR-16.2 Document checklist. For each of the six teacher_documents.doc_type values with a current row, the screen shows teacher_documents.status as one of: Uploaded (submitted), Approved, Needs re-upload (reupload_requested, with review_note shown verbatim — it is always teacher-safe copy per Admin FR-16.5/validation), Rejected (with review_note). A missing optional type (professional_certificate, experience_letter) shows nothing. This lets a teacher see partial progress (e.g. "3 of 4 approved") while the overall status is still Pending. BR-16.3 Non-internal notes. teacher_verification_logs rows with is_internal = false are shown in the timeline as messages from GuruConnect (e.g. a reviewer's non-internal note); is_internal = true rows are never returned by this endpoint at all — the API filters them server-side, not the client. BR-16.4 Timeline. GET /teacher/verification includes the last 20 teacher_verification_logs rows for the teacher (oldest first), each rendered as one of: "Application submitted" (submitted), "Re-submitted" (resubmitted), a per-document line "{doc type} approved/needs changes" (document_approved/document_rejected/reupload_requested, using document_id to label the type), "Application approved" (approved), "Application rejected" (rejected, with the rejection reason in plain copy — see BR-16.6), "Verified badge granted" (badge_granted, shown only if is_verified_badge). assigned, note_added (internal), and auto_check rows are never surfaced. BR-16.5 Approved. When displayStatus = 'Approved', the screen also shows whether the Verified badge was granted (teachers.is_verified_badge) and a "Complete your profile" call to action into Module 17 (fee plans, availability, bio) since a bare-minimum approved profile ranks poorly in search. BR-16.6 Rejected. Shows teachers.rejection_reason_code translated to teacher-safe copy (e.g. NAME_MISMATCH → "The name on your documents didn't match.") and rejection_note. Per Admin FR-16.9, a rejected teacher may re-apply: the screen shows "You can apply again in {n} days" counting 30 days from rejected_at, or "You can apply again" with a button once that window has passed — re-applying is a fresh POST /registration/teacher-style flow handled by Admin support resetting the record to draft (out of this module's scope; the button simply deep-links to Module 5's registration-context check, which routes appropriately). FORGED_DOCUMENT rejections additionally show a permanent "This account can't reapply — contact support" state (the account is suspended server-side; GET /me already reflects ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED and Module 0 routes to AccountBlocked before this screen would even load). BR-16.7 Resubmit. POST /teacher/verification/resubmit requires teachers.verification_status = 'reupload_requested' and that every current document with status IN ('reupload_requested', 'rejected') at the time re-upload was requested now has a newer current version with status = 'submitted' (Module 15 uploads already guarantee this — a fresh upload always creates a new current row with status = 'submitted'). In one transaction: teachers.verification_status = 'pending' (NOT submitted_at, which keeps its original value so Admin M16's SLA clock is unaffected — Admin FR-16.7); insert teacher_verification_logs (action = 'resubmitted', from_status = 'reupload_requested', to_status = 'pending'); audit app.teacher_verification_resubmitted; push/in-app confirmation. If any flagged document still shows reupload_requested/rejected, the call fails with VALIDATION_FAILED (details.pending[] lists the doc types still outstanding) and the button stays labelled "Upload the remaining documents first" client-side. BR-16.8 Polling and push. The screen refetches on foreground and pulls to refresh; it also listens for the verification push category (Module 20) to invalidate and refetch immediately rather than waiting for the next foreground, so a teacher who has the app open in the background sees the update the moment the push arrives.

6. Screen Wireframe Description

Pending — top banner (amber, clock icon) "Under review"; sub-line "Submitted 2 days ago · Most applications are decided within 24 hours"; document checklist below with per-row status pills (Uploaded / Approved) — no action needed, purely informational; timeline card ("Application submitted — 24 Sep, 10:15 AM"); no buttons except "Contact support" as a text link.

Re-upload Required — top banner (red, alert icon) "Action needed"; a card per flagged document: icon, name ("PAN card"), reason in plain copy ("The image is blurry — please retake it in good light."), button "Re-upload" → Module 15 scoped to that type; once every flagged item shows "Replaced ✓", a sticky button appears "Send back for review" → POST /teacher/verification/resubmit.

Approved — top banner (green, check icon, confetti once on first view) "You're verified!"; badge chip if isVerifiedBadge; card "Your profile is 62% complete" with a progress bar and button "Complete your profile" → Module 17; timeline below.

Rejected — top banner (grey, cross icon) "Application not approved"; reason line in plain copy; either "You can apply again in 18 days" (disabled button) or "Apply again" (enabled) depending on the 30-day window; "Contact support" link. FORGED_DOCUMENT case instead shows "This account can't be used to register — contact support" with no re-apply path at all.

14. State Management

  • Query key teacherVerificationKeys.status; invalidated by the resubmit mutation and by a verification-category push (Module 0's deep-link/inbox handling calls queryClient.invalidateQueries directly, bypassing the normal foreground-only refetch).
  • No Zustand store; nothing here needs to survive navigation beyond the query cache.

15. Offline Handling

  • GET /teacher/verification is persisted (read-only screens work offline, showing "Updated 3 h ago").
  • POST /teacher/verification/resubmit is online-only (conventions §8 class 3 — it changes a security-relevant workflow state); the button is disabled offline with a hint.

16. Push Notification Requirements

Event Recipient Title / Body Deep link Category Urgent
Document approved Teacher "Document approved" / "Your {docType} has been approved." gc://teacher/verification verification No
Re-upload requested Teacher "Action needed on your application" / "We need a clearer copy of your {docType}." gc://teacher/verification verification No
Application approved Teacher "You're verified! 🎉" / "Your GuruConnect profile is now live. Complete it to start getting leads." gc://teacher/verification verification Yes
Application rejected Teacher "Update on your application" / "Your application wasn't approved this time." gc://teacher/verification verification No
All are sent by Admin M16's actions (Module 0's NotificationService) and Module 15's submit confirmation; this module only consumes them to refresh its own screen (BR-16.8).

17. Security Rules

  • GET /teacher/verification and POST /teacher/verification/resubmit are scoped to teacher_id = pid; a teacher can never see another teacher's verification detail.
  • Only teacher-safe copy ever reaches the app: review_note/rejection_note are validated admin-side to be free of internal jargon (Admin validation rules), but this endpoint additionally strips any note flagged is_internal regardless of source table, as defence in depth.
  • No document thumbnails are shown on this screen (that's Module 15's job while editable); this screen is read-mostly and does not need FLAG_SECURE.

18. Error Handling

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
Teacher not yet submitted (draft) NOT_FOUND 404 Redirect to Module 14/15 instead of showing this screen
Resubmit with documents still flagged VALIDATION_FAILED (details.pending[]) 422 Button stays "Upload the remaining documents first", list highlighted
Resubmit when status isn't reupload_requested CONFLICT_STATE 409 Refetch; screen just shows the current (already-changed) status
Network error on load NETWORK_OFFLINE / GATEWAY_ERROR — Cached status shown with "Updated Xh ago"; Retry banner

19. Testing Scenarios

  • T16.1 pending and under_review both render as "Under review" with no functional difference visible to the teacher.
  • T16.2 One document reupload_requested, others approved → checklist shows 3/4 approved and only the flagged one actionable.
  • T16.3 Resubmit blocked while the flagged PAN hasn't been re-uploaded; unblocked immediately after Module 15 uploads a new current PAN version.
  • T16.4 Successful resubmit sets status to Pending in the UI without a page reload and keeps the original submitted-at date shown ("Submitted 6 days ago", not reset to today).
  • T16.5 Approved teacher sees the Verified badge chip only when isVerifiedBadge is true.
  • T16.6 Rejected with NAME_MISMATCH shows the 30-day re-apply countdown; after the countdown, "Apply again" becomes enabled.
  • T16.7 Rejected with FORGED_DOCUMENT never shows a re-apply path (this state is in practice unreachable in-app since the account is suspended first, but the copy is tested in isolation).
  • T16.8 A verification push arriving while the screen is open triggers an immediate refetch, not just on next foreground.
  • T16.9 Internal-only log rows (is_internal = true, assigned, note_added, auto_check) never appear in the rendered timeline (asserted against a fixture with mixed rows).
  • T16.10 Offline: cached "Pending" status renders with a staleness hint; the resubmit button is disabled with "Connect to send this back for review."

21. Future Scalability Notes

  • Estimated review time shown from a rolling p50 of Admin M16's actual decision times instead of the fixed "24 hours" copy.
  • In-app chat with the verification team for edge cases, reusing Module 53's support-ticket infrastructure instead of "Contact support" as a bare link.
  • Push-driven live timeline updates via a lightweight WebSocket/SSE channel once polling load becomes noticeable at scale.
  • Self-service re-application flow that resets a rejected teacher to draft directly from the app (today requires Admin support), once the 30-day rule is stable enough to automate safely.

Module 17 · Teacher Profile Builder

Phase 4 · Teacher · Used by: Teacher · Depends on: M14 (reuses its subjects/classes/teaching-modes/locations/qualification endpoints while approved); M16 (approved status); links to M19 (availability) · New tables: teacher_fee_plans · Uses: teachers, teacher_qualifications, teacher_subjects, teacher_classes · Build estimate: 4–5 days

1. Module Purpose

The teacher's "Profile" tab: everything that makes an approved teacher's public listing complete and competitive — About (bio, photo), Experience, Languages, Subjects and Classes (reusing Module 14's own editors), a Fee Structure builder (owns teacher_fee_plans), and a link out to Availability (Module 19). It computes and shows the same profile-completeness percentage Admin M17 computes server-side, so a teacher always sees the identical number an admin would. A live preview screen renders the profile exactly as parents see it, so a teacher can check their own listing before it goes live in search.

2. User Stories

  • As a newly approved teacher, I want to see my profile is only 60% complete and exactly what's missing, so that I know what to do next to start getting leads.
  • As a teacher with three different fee structures (per hour, per month for a batch, per course for exam prep), I want to list all three clearly, so that parents know my pricing upfront.
  • As a teacher who corrected a typo in my name after approval, I want that change to be tracked so support can see why it changed, so that I'm not accused of impersonation later.
  • As a teacher checking my own listing, I want to see my profile exactly as a parent would, so that I can catch anything that looks wrong before a parent does.
  • As a teacher who just got approved, I want a single screen to reach Subjects, Classes, Fees and Availability instead of hunting through menus, so that finishing my profile doesn't feel like a chore.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-17.1 Access gate. GET /teacher/profile and GET /teacher/profile/preview work in every verification_status (a not-yet-approved teacher can review their draft data, shown with a "Not visible to parents yet" watermark on the preview). Every write endpoint (PATCH /teacher/profile, all /teacher/fee-plans writes) requires verification_status = 'approved'; any other status returns 409 CONFLICT_STATE (reason: not_approved) and the screen shows the Module 16 verification banner instead of edit controls. Subjects, Classes, Teaching modes and Locations sections on this tab are read-only summaries that deep-link into Module 14's own editors (BR-14.8 already gates those to draft/approved). BR-17.2 Profile fields. PATCH /teacher/profile { fullName?, gender?, dateOfBirth?, email?, categoryId?, languages?, experienceYears?, highestQualification?, bio?, feePerHourPaise?, demoAvailable?, profilePhotoFileId?, reason? } (If-Match on teachers.updated_at) — a superset partial update of the same columns Module 14 sets during registration, now available post-approval. fullName and dateOfBirth are identity-linked: changing either on an approved teacher requires reason (10–500 chars) and writes a teacher_verification_logs row (action = 'note_added', is_internal = true, metadata: { profile_changed_after_approval: true, field, oldValue, newValue }) so Admin M16/M17 see it in the timeline, matching Admin FR-17.3; it does not change verification_status. profilePhotoFileId must reference a files row with purpose = 'teacher_photo', status = 'active', uploaded by this teacher (Module 0 presign, public bucket) — this is the public listing photo, distinct from the private verification selfie Module 15 collected. BR-17.3 Fee plans (owns teacher_fee_plans). POST /teacher/fee-plans { label, subjectId?, classFromId?, classToId?, teachingModeId?, feeUnit, amountPaise, sessionsPerWeek?, sessionMinutes?, notes? } appends a plan (sortOrder = max + 1, isActive = true). PATCH /teacher/fee-plans/:id edits one (ownership-scoped). DELETE /teacher/fee-plans/:id soft-deletes (deleted_at) — plans are never hard-deleted since they may be referenced from a lead or demo conversation history. GET /teacher/fee-plans (folded into GET /teacher/profile) lists active plans ordered by sort_order. Limit: 1–12 active plans per teacher. BR-17.4 Fee plan validation logic. classFromId's level_order (Module 0 masters) must be ≤ classToId's; subjectId, if set, must be one of the teacher's current teacher_subjects; teachingModeId, if set, must be one of the teacher's current teacher_teaching_modes; feeUnit = 'per_hour' requires sessionMinutes (15–180); per_month/per_course require sessionsPerWeek (1–14). amountPaise follows the same ceiling as Admin FR-17.5: 0–1,00,00,000 paise (₹1,00,000), sense-checked client-side against per_hour plans over ₹10,000/hour with a soft confirmation ("That's an unusually high rate — are you sure?"). BR-17.5 Profile completeness (matches Admin FR-17.8 exactly). Recomputed after every write from this module or from Module 14's reused endpoints (subjects/classes/locations/qualifications) and written to teachers.profile_completeness: photo 15 (profile_photo_file_id set), bio 10 (bio ≥ 100 chars), qualification 10 (≥ 1 teacher_qualifications row), experience 5 (experience_years set), subjects 15 (≥ 1 teacher_subjects row), classes 10 (≥ 1 teacher_classes row), locations 10 (≥ 1 teacher_locations row OR every teaching mode is online-only), fee 5 (≥ 1 active teacher_fee_plans row OR fee_per_hour_paise set), languages 5 (≥ 1 language), certificate 15 (≥ 1 teacher_documents of type education_certificate with status = 'approved' — the only factor this module cannot itself satisfy; it can only reach 85 until Module 16's admin approves a certificate). GET /teacher/profile returns the total plus a per-item checklist ({ key, label, earned, of }) driving the "Complete your profile" card. BR-17.6 Preview. GET /teacher/profile/preview returns the same shape Module 31 (public Teacher Profile View) would show a parent — trust score, rating, fee plans, availability summary from Module 19, verified badge — so the teacher sees exactly what's public. While not approved, every field is still returned but the response carries visibleToParents: false and the app renders a "Preview only — not visible until approved" banner over it. BR-17.7 Availability link. This tab shows a summary card ("3 weekly slots · Demos available Mon–Fri evenings") read from Module 19's own endpoint (GET /teacher/availability, called by this screen, not owned here) with a "Manage availability" button that navigates to Module 19; no availability data is written from this module.

6. Screen Wireframe Description

Profile home — header with avatar, name, verified badge, trust-score ring (read-only, links to Module 42 for the breakdown); completeness bar "72% complete" with an expandable "What's missing" list ("Add a certificate for +15%"); section rows: About, Subjects (3), Classes (5), Teaching modes (2), Locations (1), Fee plans (2), Availability ("3 slots this week"); sticky footer link "Preview my profile".

About editor — Photo (tap to change, expo-image-picker + crop to square), Bio (textarea, counter 0/2,000, helper "Parents see the first two lines in search — make them count"), Languages (chip multi-select), Category (select, shows the confirmation from Module 14 BR-14.7 if changed after subjects exist); sticky "Save".

Fee plans list — card per plan: "Physics · Class 9–12 · Online · ₹1,200/hour"; swipe-to-delete; "+ Add fee plan" button; empty state "Add your pricing so parents know what to expect."

Fee plan editor (sheet) — Label (text, "JEE Physics batch"), Subject (optional select, from the teacher's own subjects), Class range (two selects, from–to), Teaching mode (select, from the teacher's own modes), Fee unit (segmented: Per hour / Per month / Per course), Amount (₹ input), Sessions per week (stepper, shown for month/course), Session length in minutes (stepper, shown for per-hour), Notes (optional, ≤ 200 chars); buttons "Cancel" / "Save".

Profile preview — exact re-use of Module 31's TeacherProfileView component tree in read-only mode, with a top banner "This is how parents see your profile" (green, if approved) or "Preview only — not visible until you're approved" (amber, otherwise).

<details><summary>DDL</summary>

CREATE TABLE teacher_fee_plans (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  teacher_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES teachers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- Owner
  label text NOT NULL, -- e.g. Class 11–12 Physics · Online
  subject_id uuid REFERENCES subjects(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- NULL = all subjects the teacher teaches
  class_from_id uuid REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Lowest class covered
  class_to_id uuid REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Highest class covered
  teaching_mode_id uuid REFERENCES teaching_modes(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- NULL = any mode
  fee_unit text NOT NULL CHECK (fee_unit IN ('per_hour','per_month','per_course')), -- Billing unit
  amount_paise bigint NOT NULL CHECK (amount_paise BETWEEN 5000 AND 50000000), -- ₹50 to ₹5,00,000
  sessions_per_week smallint CHECK (sessions_per_week BETWEEN 1 AND 14), -- For per_month plans
  session_minutes smallint CHECK (session_minutes BETWEEN 30 AND 240), -- Length of one session
  notes text, -- e.g. Includes weekly test, max 200 chars
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, -- Hidden when false
  sort_order smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Display order
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Created
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Updated
  deleted_at timestamptz -- Soft delete
);
CREATE INDEX idx_teacher_fee_plans_teacher ON teacher_fee_plans (teacher_id, sort_order) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_teacher_fee_plans_updated BEFORE UPDATE ON teacher_fee_plans FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

</details>

14. State Management

  • Query key teacherProfileKeys.detail — the whole GET /teacher/profile payload; every mutation here and every Module 14 replace-set mutation invalidates it (cross-feature invalidation by key prefix teacherProfileKeys and teacherRegKeys, since both read the same underlying teachers row).
  • teacherProfileKeys.preview for the preview screen, staleTime 0 (always fresh — a teacher checking their own listing wants the latest).
  • No Zustand store; fee-plan and about/experience forms are local React Hook Form state until saved.

15. Offline Handling

  • GET /teacher/profile and GET /teacher/profile/preview are persisted; the whole tab is readable offline with a staleness hint.
  • Fee-plan writes and PATCH /teacher/profile are save draft, submit online (conventions §8 class 2): the form keeps unsent edits locally and disables Save with "Connect to save changes", rather than silently queuing (unlike a favourite toggle, a profile edit should be seen and confirmed, not fired-and-forgotten).

16. Push Notification Requirements

None from this module directly. A completed profile crossing 80% triggers an in-app (not push) nudge card on the Dashboard (Module 18) suggesting the next missing item; Module 20 is not asked to push for profile completeness.

17. Security Rules

  • Every endpoint scopes by teacher_id = pid; ownership checked on every fee-plan id.
  • PATCH /teacher/profile blocks writes unless verification_status = 'approved' (BR-17.1); identity-linked field changes are logged even though they don't change verification state, giving support a paper trail (BR-17.2).
  • Bio is scanned for phone numbers, emails and URLs (same rule as Module 14), keeping contact off-platform.
  • profilePhotoFileId must be gc-public and owned by the caller — a teacher cannot set another user's uploaded file as their photo.
