Module 18 · Teacher Dashboard

Phase 4 · Teacher · Used by: Teacher · Depends on: M16 (approved status), M17 (completeness nudge), M36 (trust score), M38 (leads), M39 (demos), Admin M21 (roll-up job that feeds teacher_daily_stats) · New tables: none · Uses: teacher_daily_stats, teacher_profile_views, leads, teacher_reviews, trust_scores · Build estimate: 3 days

1. Module Purpose

The first screen an approved teacher sees: how many people looked at their profile, how many leads and demos came from it, what their rating and trust score look like, and what needs attention right now (unanswered leads, a low completeness score, a document still needing re-upload). Every number here reads from the same teacher_daily_stats roll-up Admin M21 already computes nightly and hourly-for-today, so a teacher and an admin looking at the same teacher never see different figures.

2. User Stories

  • As a teacher who just started getting leads, I want to see today's numbers alongside the last 7 and 30 days, so that I know if things are improving.
  • As a teacher with 4 unanswered leads, I want that to be the first thing I see, so that I don't lose a family who's still waiting.
  • As a teacher whose profile is only 60% complete, I want a clear nudge on what to add next, so that I can improve my ranking without digging through menus.
  • As a teacher whose trust score dropped, I want to see why (a factor breakdown), so that I know what to fix.
  • As a teacher between classes on 3G, I want the dashboard to load fast from cache, so that I can check my numbers in a spare minute.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-18.1 Range. GET /teacher/dashboard?range=7|30 (default 7) aggregates teacher_daily_stats rows for stat_date in the last N days (IST calendar days, today included and refreshed hourly per Admin FR-21.2): profileViews = Σ profile_views, uniqueViewers = Σ unique_viewers (an approximation — daily uniques are not deduplicated across days, matching Admin M21's own totals so the two screens never disagree), leadRequests = Σ lead_requests, demoRequests = Σ demo_requests, demosCompleted = Σ demos_completed, reviewsPublished = Σ reviews_published, avgRating = Σ rating_sum / Σ reviews_published (null if zero). A previousPeriod block repeats the same aggregation for the N days before that, giving each tile a delta ("↑ 18% vs last 7 days"). BR-18.2 Live counters (not from the roll-up). unansweredLeads = count of the teacher's leads with status IN ('new','viewed') and created_at < now() - interval '24 hours' (matches Admin FR-38.4's "unanswered" definition); openLeads = count with status IN ('new','viewed','contacted'); upcomingDemos = count of demo_requests with status IN ('requested','confirmed','reschedule_proposed') and a start at or after now. These read live, not from yesterday's roll-up, since they drive an action banner that must be current. BR-18.3 Response rate. responseRatePct = leads with first_response_at set within 24 h of created_at ÷ non-spam leads created in the selected range (matches Admin FR-38.4/FR-21.3 exactly, computed the same way so a teacher's number matches what an admin sees on their profile). medianFirstResponseMinutes over the same set. BR-18.4 Trust score card. Reads trust_scores (current score, band: excellent ≥ 90, good 80–89, fair 60–79, poor < 60 — the same bands Admin M36's simulate endpoint uses) and the top-line factor with the most room to improve (the factor with the largest gap between its current value and 100, weighted by its weight) as a single suggestion line, e.g. "Add a certificate to improve your score" — the full breakdown itself is Module 42's job; this card only teases it with one line and a "See details" link. BR-18.5 Completeness nudge. Shows teachers.profile_completeness (Module 17) as a compact bar only while < 100; tapping it deep-links to the single highest-value missing item from Module 17's checklist (BR-17.5), not the whole Profile tab, to keep the action obvious. BR-18.6 Recent activity feed. The five most recent events across leads (created, converted), teacher_reviews (published) and demo_requests (completed, no_show) for this teacher, merged and sorted by time, each a one-line row with an icon and a deep link (to Module 37 Contact Teacher / Module 39 Demo detail / Module 34 review). BR-18.7 Verification/document banners. If verification_status = 'reupload_requested', the dashboard's top banner is the Module 16 action ("2 documents need your attention") ahead of everything else — a teacher who can't yet appear in search shouldn't be shown lead metrics as if things are normal. If pending/under_review, a lighter "Your application is under review" banner is shown above the (still-visible, currently-empty) metric tiles. BR-18.8 Refresh. Pull-to-refresh and refetch on foreground; staleTime 60 s (matches the hourly-for-today roll-up cadence — more frequent polling wouldn't show new numbers anyway).

Module 19 · Teacher Availability

Phase 4 · Teacher · Used by: Teacher · Depends on: M16 (approved); read by M38 (Demo Class Request) to generate bookable demo slots and by Module 31/17 to show availability summaries · New tables: teacher_availability, teacher_time_off · Uses: demo_requests · Build estimate: 3 days

1. Module Purpose

Lets an approved teacher declare the weekly hours they can take classes or demo requests, and mark date ranges they're away (exams, travel, illness) so demo booking blocks those dates and the profile shows "Away" instead of silently going unanswered. Module 38 reads these two tables (plus existing demo_requests) to compute the actual bookable slots a parent sees — this module owns the input, not the slot-generation algorithm.

2. User Stories

  • As a teacher who only takes classes after 5 PM on weekdays, I want to set that once as a recurring weekly window, so that parents never see or request a morning demo I can't give.
  • As a teacher going on a 10-day family trip, I want to mark those dates as time off so that I don't get demo requests I'll have to decline.
  • As a teacher with two confirmed demos during dates I'm about to block off, I want to be warned and choose what happens to them, so that a family isn't quietly cancelled without my knowing.
  • As a teacher who teaches online in the evening and in person on weekends, I want separate windows per mode, so that my online slots don't get offered to someone wanting a home visit.
  • As a teacher recovering from a short illness, I want to pause new leads for a few days without losing my profile or existing conversations, so that I come back to a fair inbox, not one I abandoned.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-19.1 Weekly windows (owns teacher_availability). PUT /teacher/availability { items: [{ dayOfWeek, startTime, endTime, teachingModeId?, acceptsDemos }] } replaces the whole set in one transaction (same replace-set pattern as Module 14/18's set endpoints): insert new, delete removed, update changed. dayOfWeek 0 (Sunday) – 6 (Saturday), IST. 0–5 windows per day; windows on the same day must not overlap regardless of teachingModeId (a teacher is one person and can only be in one window at a time even if one window is tagged "online" and another "home tuition"). teachingModeId, if set, must be one of the teacher's own teacher_teaching_modes (Module 14); if omitted, the window applies to any of the teacher's modes. acceptsDemos marks whether Module 38 may offer this window for a free demo (a teacher might keep weekday evenings for paying students only and reserve weekend slots for demos). BR-19.2 Time off (owns teacher_time_off). POST /teacher/time-off { startsOn, endsOn, reason?, pauseLeads } adds a date range (inclusive, IST calendar dates). Ranges for the same teacher must not overlap each other; max 10 active (non-expired) ranges at a time; endsOn − startsOn ≤ 90 days. pauseLeads: true additionally hides the teacher from new lead/demo requests for the duration (BR-19.4) and shows "Away until {date}" on the public profile (Module 31); pauseLeads: false only blocks new demo slots in that range (Module 38) without otherwise affecting lead visibility — e.g. a teacher who is simply not available for demos this week but still wants enquiry messages. BR-19.3 Clash with existing demos. Creating a teacher_time_off row (with either pauseLeads value) checks demo_requests for this teacher with status IN ('requested','confirmed','reschedule_proposed') and a start (confirmed_start_at or, if not yet confirmed, requested_start_at) inside [startsOn 00:00 IST, endsOn 23:59 IST]. If any are found and the request did not pass confirmForce: true, the call returns 409 CONFLICT_STATE with the list of affected demos ({ demoId, requesterName, startAt }) so the app can show "You have 2 demos in this range — Cancel them / Choose different dates". With confirmForce: true, the time-off row is created and, in the same transaction, every affected demo is set to status = 'cancelled', cancelled_by = 'teacher', cancel_reason = 'Teacher marked this period as time off'; both sides are notified (Module 38's cancellation push, not duplicated here) and the underlying lead is left open (matches Admin FR-39's cancellation semantics — a cancelled demo doesn't close the lead). BR-19.4 Effect of an active time off with pauseLeads = true. While now() (IST date) falls inside such a range: the teacher does not appear in Module 27 Teacher Search's default results (an explicit-name or shared-link view still works, marked "Away"); Module 37 blocks new leads to this teacher with BLOCKED-style messaging ("This teacher is away until {date}. Try again later or explore similar teachers.") — existing open leads and their messages remain fully usable; Module 38 shows no bookable demo slots for the range. None of this changes teachers.account_status or verification_status — it is a visibility flag read by those other modules, not a suspension. BR-19.5 Deleting time off. DELETE /teacher/time-off/:id removes it early (hard delete — nothing references it once removed; any demos already cancelled by BR-19.3 stay cancelled, they are not un-cancelled). Deleting a range that has already fully elapsed is a no-op cleanup allowed at any time. BR-19.6 Reads for other modules. GET /teacher/availability returns the weekly windows plus the active/upcoming time-off ranges in one payload; this is what the Profile Builder's Availability card (Module 17 BR-17.7) and the Dashboard summarise. Module 38's slot generation and Module 31's public "Availability" section call the same underlying data through their own read paths (documented there), not through this module's endpoints, to keep read-scaling independent of the teacher-facing screen.

5. Screen Flow & Navigation

Diagram loads when this page is online…

6. Screen Wireframe Description

Availability — header "Your availability"; a 7-column weekly grid (Sun–Sat) with tappable time blocks per day showing existing windows as coloured bars labelled with the mode ("Online 6–9 PM"); "+ Add window" per day opens a time-range picker with an optional mode select and "Accepts demo requests" toggle; below the grid, a "Time off" list (upcoming ranges as cards: "3–12 Oct · Family trip · Leads paused" with a delete icon) and "+ Add time off"; sticky "Save" only enabled while the weekly grid has unsaved changes (time-off writes save immediately per row, no batch step).

Time off form (sheet) — Start date / End date (calendar range picker, ≤ 90 days), Reason (optional text, "Family trip"), "Pause new leads while I'm away" (switch, default on, helper "Turns off new enquiries and demo requests until you're back — your existing conversations still work."); button "Save".

Clash dialog — heading "You have demos during this time"; list of affected demos (name, date/time); body "If you continue, these will be cancelled and the families notified."; buttons "Cancel these demos & continue" (destructive) and "Choose different dates" (default).

Field Rule Message shown
dayOfWeek 0–6 —
startTime / endTime HH:mm, endTime > startTime, window ≥ 30 min "End time must be after start time"
windows per day 0–5, non-overlapping "This overlaps another window on the same day"
teachingModeId optional, one of the teacher's own modes —
startsOn / endsOn (time off) dates, endsOn ≥ startsOn, span ≤ 90 days, startsOn ≥ today "Pick a range up to 90 days"
reason ≤ 200 chars, optional —
active time-off ranges ≤ 10, non-overlapping with each other "You already have time off marked for these dates"

14. State Management

  • Query key teacherAvailabilityKeys.all — both windows and time-off in one payload; every mutation invalidates it.
  • No Zustand store; the weekly grid keeps local unsaved edits in React state until "Save", matching the "review before you save" feel of a schedule (not autosaved per tap, unlike Module 14's replace-set screens, since a mis-tapped window is easy to make and easy to want to undo before committing).

15. Offline Handling

  • GET /teacher/availability is persisted; the screen renders offline with a staleness hint.
  • All writes here are save draft, submit online (conventions §8 class 2): the weekly grid's unsaved edits survive an app restart in memory-backed form state for the current session, but the Save/Add buttons are disabled offline with "Connect to save your availability."

16. Push Notification Requirements

Event Recipient Title / Body Deep link Category Urgent
Demo cancelled by time off Requester (parent/student) "Your demo was cancelled" / "{Teacher} marked this time as unavailable. Find another slot or teacher." gc://demos/:id demos No
Sent as part of Module 38's normal demo-cancellation notification pipeline when BR-19.3's confirmForce path runs; this module triggers the state change, Module 38/0 own the actual push template.

17. Security Rules

  • Every read/write is scoped to teacher_id = pid.
  • pauseLeads visibility (BR-19.4) is enforced server-side in Module 27/37/38's own queries (a filter on teacher_time_off), not by hiding data client-side, so it can't be bypassed by an old cached app build.
  • Cancelling demos via BR-19.3 requires the explicit confirmForce: true the teacher only sends after seeing the clash dialog — the server never silently cancels a demo the teacher hasn't been shown.

18. Error Handling

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
Overlapping windows same day VALIDATION_FAILED 422 Inline on the grid, new window highlighted
More than 5 windows in a day VALIDATION_FAILED 422 "Up to 5 windows per day"
Time-off clash without confirmForce CONFLICT_STATE 409 Clash dialog shown
Overlapping time-off ranges VALIDATION_FAILED 422 "You already have time off marked for these dates"
11th active time-off range VALIDATION_FAILED (reason: max_time_off) 422 "Remove an old range first"
Delete a non-existent/foreign time-off id NOT_FOUND 404 Toast, list refetched

19. Testing Scenarios

  • T19.1 Saving two non-overlapping windows on Monday succeeds; a third overlapping one is rejected before any write.
  • T19.2 Adding time off with no clashing demos succeeds immediately with cancelledDemoCount: 0.
  • T19.3 Adding time off overlapping one confirmed demo returns 409 with that demo listed; retrying with confirmForce: true cancels it and the requester is notified (asserted via Module 38's mocked notify call).
  • T19.4 pauseLeads: false time off blocks Module 38 demo slots for the range but a new lead (enquiry) can still be sent (cross-module fixture against Module 37).
  • T19.5 Deleting an upcoming time-off range removes it from GET /teacher/availability; a demo already cancelled by BR-19.3 stays cancelled.
  • T19.6 11th active time-off range is rejected until one is deleted or expires.
  • T19.7 A window without teachingModeId is treated as applying to all the teacher's modes when Module 38 generates slots (fixture asserts against Module 38's slot generator, not this module).
  • T19.8 Offline: the weekly grid renders cached windows; Save/Add are disabled with "Connect to save your availability."
  • T19.9 endsOn before startsOn is rejected client-side and server-side.
  • T19.10 A time-off range longer than 90 days is rejected.

21. Future Scalability Notes

  • Per-slot granularity (15/30-minute bookable slots with capacity) instead of open windows, once Module 38 needs finer-grained scheduling than "somewhere in this window."
  • Google/Outlook calendar two-way sync so a teacher's external calendar drives availability automatically (Admin M39 §21 already anticipates this on the demo side).
  • Recurring time off (e.g. "every Sunday") as a lighter-weight alternative to one-off ranges, if teachers ask for it often enough to justify the added complexity.
  • Per-window capacity (a coaching-institute teacher accepting multiple students in the same online slot) once group classes are modelled.

Module 20 · Teacher Notifications

Phase 4 · Teacher · Used by: Teacher (screen); the endpoints are shared and reused by every role via Module 47 · Depends on: M00 (NotificationService, device registration); M16 (verification pushes), M37/M38 (lead/demo pushes), M34/M36 (review pushes), M41/M44 (subscription pushes) all call the shared service this module's preferences gate · New tables: none · Uses: user_notifications, user_notification_preferences, user_devices · Build estimate: 2–3 days

1. Module Purpose

Owns the one notification-preferences screen and its two endpoints (GET/PUT /notification-preferences) shared by every role in the app — a parent, student, teacher or institute manager all land on the same screen shape, reading and writing the same user_notification_preferences table. This module also documents, for the Teacher role specifically, the full catalogue of alerts a teacher receives (new lead, unanswered-lead reminder, demo reminders, verification updates, review received, subscription expiry) so a developer building any of those triggering modules (M16, M37, M38, M39, M34, M41, M44) knows the exact category, urgency and copy to send through Module 0's NotificationService, without redefining the preferences plumbing in each of them.

2. User Stories

  • As a teacher, I want to turn off review-received emails but keep the push, so that my inbox isn't full but my phone still buzzes.
  • As a teacher who just went live, I want new leads to always reach me immediately, even during my quiet hours, so that I don't lose a family to a faster-responding teacher.
  • As a teacher who forgot to reply to a lead, I want a gentle reminder a few hours later, so that a busy day doesn't cost me a student.
  • As a parent (reusing the same screen), I want to mute promotional announcements without missing anything about my child's demo, so that the app doesn't feel noisy.
  • As a teacher who set quiet hours differently for leads than for everything else, I want that respected, so that only what truly can't wait wakes me up.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-20.1 Categories. The eleven categories are fixed by the user_notification_preferences.category enum: account, verification, leads, demos, reviews, payments, subscription, referral, complaints, recommendations, announcements. GET /notification-preferences returns all eleven for the caller's role (a missing row defaults to pushEnabled: true, emailEnabled: false, per Module 0 BR-0.7/schema default), each with an optional per-category quietHoursStart/quietHoursEnd override (null = use the platform default 21:30–08:00 IST, conventions §9). Only categories relevant to the caller's role are shown (e.g. a parent never sees verification); for the Teacher role the visible set is account, verification, leads, demos, reviews, payments, subscription, referral, complaints, announcements (recommendations is learner-only). BR-20.2 Locked categories. account and payments cannot have push disabled (they carry security/session and money-relevant information); PUT with pushEnabled: false for either is rejected client-side (the toggle is disabled, greyed, with a lock icon and helper "Security and payment alerts can't be turned off") and, defensively, server-side (VALIDATION_FAILED). Email remains toggleable for every category including these two. BR-20.3 Save. PUT /notification-preferences { items: [{ category, pushEnabled, emailEnabled, quietHoursStart?, quietHoursEnd? }] } upserts every row in one transaction (ON CONFLICT (user_id, category) DO UPDATE); a category omitted from the array is left unchanged (this is a partial upsert, not a replace-set, since the fixed category list never needs deletion). Each row's updated_at drives no If-Match — a genuine multi-device race here just means "last write wins" on a low-stakes settings screen, so no optimistic-lock friction is added. BR-20.4 New lead (urgent, category leads). Sent by Module 37 the moment a lead's target_type = 'teacher' row is inserted: urgent: true (bypasses quiet hours entirely, conventions §9) since a fast reply materially affects whether the family picks this teacher. Title "New lead!" · body "{requesterFirstName} is looking for a {subject} teacher for {class}." · deep link gc://teacher/leads/:id. BR-20.5 Unanswered-lead reminder (category leads). A job scans leads with target_type = 'teacher', status IN ('new','viewed'); sends a non-urgent reminder at created_at + 6h (dedupe key lead_reminder_1:<leadId>) and again at created_at + 20h (lead_reminder_2:<leadId>) if still unanswered, then stops (Module 38's own lifecycle closes it at 30 days without further reminders from this rule). Title "Still waiting for your reply" · body "{requesterFirstName}'s enquiry has been open for {n} hours." · deep link gc://teacher/leads/:id. Each dedupe key ensures at most one send per milestone even if the job re-runs. BR-20.6 Demo reminders (category demos). Sent by Module 38/39's own reminder job 1 hour before confirmed_start_at to both the teacher and the requester; documented here for completeness of the teacher's alert catalogue. Title "Demo in 1 hour" · body "Your demo with {requesterFirstName} starts at {time}." · deep link gc://demos/:id. BR-20.7 Verification updates (category verification). Document approved / re-upload requested / application approved / application rejected — full templates and urgency already specified in Module 16's @push table; cross-referenced here as the same category a teacher can (mostly) not disable in practice (push is technically toggleable for verification unlike account/payments, but the app strongly discourages it with a confirmation: "You may miss updates about your application."). BR-20.8 Review received (category reviews). Sent by Module 34/36 when a teacher_reviews row transitions to status = 'published' for this teacher. Non-urgent. Title "New review" · body "{rating}★ — "{comment, truncated to 60 chars}…"" · deep link gc://teacher/reviews/:id. BR-20.9 Subscription / boost expiry (category subscription). For a teacher with an active is_premium/is_featured period (Module 44 boosts) or an active subscriptions row, a job sends reminders at 7, 3 and 1 day(s) before expiry (dedupe key sub_expiry_<days>:<subscriptionOrBoostId>), non-urgent. Title "Your {planName} listing expires soon" · body "{n} days left. Renew to keep your premium placement in search." · deep link gc://plans. BR-20.10 Quiet hours interaction. For every non-urgent category, Module 0's NotificationService (BR-0.7) checks the category's own quiet_hours_start/quiet_hours_end if set, else the platform default; a push landing inside quiet hours is delayed to the end of the window, never dropped. urgent: true (new lead only, among this module's rules) always bypasses quiet hours regardless of category override.

Screen Route name Purpose
Notification settings NotificationSettings Per-category push/email toggles, optional quiet hours per category

6. Screen Wireframe Description

Notification settings — header "Notifications"; list of rows, each a category with a one-line description ("Leads — New enquiries and messages"), a push toggle and an email toggle side by side; account and payments rows show both toggles but push is a locked/disabled switch with a small lock icon; tapping a row's chevron (optional, advanced) reveals "Custom quiet hours for this category" with two time pickers, default "Same as your general quiet hours (9:30 PM–8 AM)"; changes save immediately per toggle (no sticky Save button — this is a settings screen, not a form).

NotificationSettingsScreen
├─ CategoryRow({ category, label, description, pushEnabled, emailEnabled, locked, onTogglePush, onToggleEmail })
└─ QuietHoursEditor({ start, end, onChange }) (expandable per row)

Hooks: useNotificationPreferencesQuery() (notificationPrefKeys.all), useUpdatePreferenceMutation() (optimistic per-row toggle, rolled back on error).

15. Offline Handling

Event Recipient Title / Body Deep link Category Urgent

Every row here is filtered through this module's preferences (BR-20.1–20.3) before Module 0's worker sends it; a category with pushEnabled: false still writes the user_notifications inbox row (Module 48 still shows it) but skips the FCM send (push_status = 'skipped_pref').

17. Security Rules

  • GET/PUT /notification-preferences are scoped to sub (the caller's own app_users.id); no user can read or change another user's preferences.
  • Locked categories (BR-20.2) are enforced server-side even though the client also disables the control, since a modified/old client build must not be able to silence security or payment alerts.
  • No PII is included in any push body beyond a first name and non-sensitive counts/subjects (conventions §13 — no full phone numbers, no document numbers).

19. Testing Scenarios

  • T20.1 Toggling reviews push off then back on round-trips correctly and the FCM send is skipped/resumed accordingly (integration test against a stubbed NotificationService).
  • T20.2 Attempting to disable payments push is rejected both client-side (button disabled) and server-side (direct API call in the test).
  • T20.3 A new lead push is delivered at 11:45 PM IST (inside quiet hours) immediately, because urgent: true bypasses quiet hours.
  • T20.4 An unanswered-lead reminder at the 6-hour mark is sent exactly once even if the reminder job runs twice in that window (dedupe key asserted).
  • T20.5 A teacher with leads push disabled still gets the lead in their in-app inbox (Module 48) with push_status = 'skipped_pref'.
  • T20.6 Custom quiet hours set only on demos (e.g. 22:00–06:00) don't affect delivery timing for leads.
  • T20.7 Toggling a preference while offline updates the UI immediately and replays once reconnected, resulting in exactly one server-side row update (not one per offline toggle if the user flips it twice offline — the queue coalesces to the latest value per category).
  • T20.8 A parent opening the same NotificationSettingsScreen sees recommendations in their list and does not see verification, confirming the role-filtered category set (BR-20.1).
  • T20.9 Subscription-expiry reminders fire at 7, 3 and 1 days before featured_until/premium_until and never twice for the same milestone.

Module 21 · Institute Registration

Phase 5 · Institute · Used by: Institute owner signing up (registration token), invited institute staff joining (registration token), primary manager editing basics before review · Depends on: M00, M04, M05, M22 (next step), M24 (staff invites); Admin M09, M10, M22, M25 · New tables: none · Uses: app_users, institutes, institute_managers, user_auth_identities, app_sessions, user_consents, referral_codes, referrals, referral_settings, states, cities, areas, audit_logs · Build estimate: 4–5 days

1. Module Purpose

Lets the owner of a coaching centre, tuition centre, school or academy create a GuruConnect institute account in two short steps: institute and owner details (Institute Name, Owner Name, Mobile, Email, Institute type, optional GSTIN) and location (address, city, area, PIN code, map pin). One submit creates, in a single database transaction, the owner's app_users row (user_type = 'institute_staff'), the institutes row in draft, and the owner's institute_managers row as the primary manager, then signs the owner in and sends them to document upload (M22). The same endpoint also lets a person invited by an institute manager (M24) join that institute as a manager or counsellor. Before the application is submitted for review, the primary manager can correct these basics.

2. User Stories

  • As an institute owner in Koramangala, I want to register my coaching centre with its GST number and exact map location so that parents nearby can find it after verification.
  • As an owner without a GST registration (small tuition centre), I want GST to be optional so that I can still join.
  • As an owner on a patchy 3G connection, I want my half-filled form to survive the app closing so that I don't retype everything.
  • As an institute counsellor invited by my manager, I want to sign in with my phone and join the institute in one step so that I can start answering enquiries.
  • As an owner, I want to fix a typo in the institute name before GuruConnect reviews it so that the listing is right from day one.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-21.1 Who can register. Only a caller holding a registration token (conventions §6) with role = institute_staff, issued by M04 after a new phone or email is verified, can call POST /registration/institute. One app account has one role and belongs to one institute in v1 (iid claim). The person who registers is the owner: they become the institute's primary manager (staff_role = 'manager', is_primary = true). Ownership can later be transferred only by GuruConnect support (Admin M25 FR-25.5).

BR-21.2 Owner mobile must be verified.

  • Token issued for a phone → the Mobile field is prefilled and locked.
  • Token issued for an email or Google sign-in → the Location step cannot be submitted until the owner verifies a mobile with M04 POST /auth/otp/request (purpose = signup) and POST /auth/otp/verify, sent with the current registration token; M04 returns a new registration token carrying both contacts (M05 shared rule). The email is then already verified.
  • The mobile must not belong to any live app_users row (deleted_at IS NULL); otherwise 409 CONFLICT_DUPLICATE, details.reason = "phone_in_use".
  • The owner mobile is stored in app_users.phone, institute_managers.phone and, as the institute's official number, institutes.phone (editable later only through support, M24 BR-24.6).

BR-21.3 Steps.

  1. Institute & owner — Institute Name, Institute type, Owner Name, Mobile, Email, GSTIN (optional).
  2. Location — Address, City, Area, PIN code, map pin, terms and privacy consent, optional referral code (field shown only when GET /registration/context (M05) reports the INSTITUTE_REFERRAL program enabled; it is off at launch). The draft is saved to encrypted MMKV after every field change (debounced 500 ms) under draft:instituteRegistration:<tokenSub> and deleted on success or after 7 days.

BR-21.4 GSTIN validation (client and server, isValidGstin(gstin, stateCode) in packages/shared).

  1. Normalise: trim, remove spaces, upper-case. Empty → stored as NULL.
  2. Pattern ^\d{2}[A-Z]{5}\d{4}[A-Z][1-9A-Z]Z[0-9A-Z]$ (15 chars: 2-digit state code, 10-char PAN, entity number, Z, check character).
  3. Checksum: with the alphabet 0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ, for each of the first 14 characters at index i (0-based) take v = indexOf(char), p = v × (i even ? 1 : 2), add floor(p / 36) + (p mod 36) to sum. Check character = alphabet[(36 − sum mod 36) mod 36]. It must equal the 15th character. Example: 29AAGCA4321M1ZJ is valid; 29AAGCA4321M1ZK fails.
  4. The first two digits must equal the GST state code of the selected city's state. GST_STATE_CODES in packages/shared maps states.code to the GST code (KA → 29, MH → 27, DL → 07, TN → 33, TG → 36, KL → 32, WB → 19, GJ → 24, UP → 09, RJ → 08, AP → 37, and the rest of the official list). Because the city is chosen in step 2, the client re-checks the state match when the city changes and moves the user back to step 1 with the error if it no longer matches.
  5. Server only: another live institute (deleted_at IS NULL, verification_status <> 'rejected') with the same gstin → 409 CONFLICT_DUPLICATE, details.reason = "gstin_in_use". The other institute's name is never revealed to the app. The GST portal lookup of legal name and address is done later by Admin M22 FR-22.5, not at registration.

BR-21.5 Location rules.

  • cityId: an active city (cities.is_active). Cities with is_serviceable = false are selectable with a "Launching soon" tag; the institute can register and be verified but is not listed in search (M28) until the city is serviceable.
  • areaId: required; active and belonging to the city.
  • pincode: ^[1-9][0-9]{5}$. Typing a PIN first filters the area list to areas of the city whose areas.pincodes contain it and auto-selects when exactly one matches. If the chosen area's pincodes is non-empty and does not contain the PIN, the app shows a soft warning ("560095 isn't usually in Koramangala. Please check.") but allows saving; Admin M22 FR-22.5 flags it.
  • Map pin: required. The pin starts at the area's latitude/longitude, else the city's, else Bengaluru centre. The owner drags the map under a fixed centre pin or taps "Use my current location" (foreground permission requested only on that tap, expo-location). Stored as latitude, longitude rounded to 6 decimals. If the city has coordinates, the pin must be within 40 km of them (haversine) → otherwise VALIDATION_FAILED "The pin is too far from Bengaluru. Move it to your institute." Maps use react-native-maps (Google Maps SDK on Android with the key injected by the Expo config plugin from an EAS secret; Apple Maps on iOS).

BR-21.6 Owner registration — server steps (mode = "owner"), one transaction.

  1. Middleware: registration token valid (aud gc-register, role institute_staff, not expired, jti not yet used — checked in Redis), Idempotency-Key present. A repeated key within 24 h returns the stored response.
  2. Validate InstituteRegistrationSchema; re-check phone uniqueness, GSTIN rules, city/area/PIN, pin distance.
  3. INSERT app_users (user_type = 'institute_staff', phone, phone_verified_at = now(), email, email_verified_at only if the token verified the email, full_name = ownerName, auth_provider from the token: otp / password / google, account_status = 'active', preferred_language from Accept-Language (default en), signup_source per M00 BR-0.13).
  4. INSERT user_auth_identities for each verified method (M04 rules: phone always; google or password when used).
  5. INSERT institutes (name, slug per BR-21.7, institute_type, phone = owner mobile, email, gstin, address_line, city_id, area_id, pincode, latitude, longitude, verification_status = 'draft', account_status = 'active'). public_code comes from the sequence (GC-I2143).
  6. INSERT institute_managers (institute_id, user_id, full_name, email, phone, designation = 'Owner', staff_role = 'manager', is_primary = true, status = 'active', invited_at = NULL, accepted_at = now()).
  7. INSERT user_consents two rows (terms, privacy_policy; granted = true, method = 'checkbox', document_version from the request, IP, install id).
  8. Referral (only if a valid code was sent and the program is enabled): INSERT referrals (status = 'pending'), qualifying event institute_approved (M46 / Admin M42).
  9. Create the session (M04 service: app_sessions row, refresh token) and INSERT audit_logs app.institute_registered.
  10. Commit; mark the token jti used; send the welcome email if an email exists. The response carries the tokens and nextStep = "institute_documents". Any failure rolls everything back — there are never half-created institutes.

BR-21.7 Slug. slugify(name + " " + areaName) (lower-case, ASCII, hyphens, max 80 chars), e.g. apex-jee-academy-koramangala. On collision append -2, -3 … (checked against uq_institutes_slug). The slug is fixed at registration; a name change before submission regenerates it; after approval only admins change it.

BR-21.8 Join as invited staff (mode = "join"). GET /registration/context (M05) lists pending invites for the token's phone (from institute_managers with status = 'invited', user_id IS NULL, same phone). The person sees "Join Apex JEE Academy as Counsellor" and submits { mode: "join", inviteId, fullName, consents }. Checks: invite exists, still invited, invited_at within 72 h (else CONFLICT_STATE, details.reason = "invite_expired" — the manager can resend, M24 BR-24.3), phone equals the token phone, institute not deleted and account_status = 'active'. Transaction: INSERT app_users (as step 3, full_name = fullName), identities, consents, then UPDATE institute_managers SET user_id, full_name, status = 'active', accepted_at = now(), session, audit app.institute_staff_joined. After commit M24's "staff joined" push goes to the inviting manager and the primary manager. nextStep = null (staff land on the Dashboard tab).

BR-21.9 Editing basics before review. PATCH /institute/registration/basics (If-Match = institutes.updated_at), caller must be an active manager of the institute. Allowed while verification_status is draft or docs_requested, or rejected with rejected_at ≥ 30 days ago (the first edit moves rejected → draft, clearing rejection_reason_code and rejection_note, and writes nothing to the verification log). In pending, under_review, visit_scheduled and evaluation_done → CONFLICT_STATE, details.reason = "in_review"; after approved → CONFLICT_STATE, details.reason = "approved_use_profile" (M24 handles profile edits and support requests). Editable fields: name, instituteType, ownerName (updates app_users.full_name and the primary's institute_managers.full_name), email (institute email only; account email changes go through M51), gstin, address, city, area, pincode, pin. The owner mobile is not editable here. Changing the city clears the area and requires a new pin; changing the name regenerates the slug (BR-21.7).

BR-21.10 After success. The app stores the tokens (M04), invalidates meKeys.me, clears the draft, shows the push pre-permission sheet ("Get notified when your institute is verified", conventions §9), then opens M22 Documents. GET /me for institute staff returns institute { id, name, staffRole, isPrimary, verificationStatus } and registration.nextStep = institute_documents (draft, required documents missing), institute_submit (documents complete, not submitted) or null. Splash (M01 BR-1.5) resumes at that step.

BR-21.11 Abuse limits. POST /registration/institute is limited to 5 calls per hour per install and 2 successful owner registrations per install per 30 days (LIMIT_REACHED, details.reason = "install_registrations"). Duplicate detection across GSTIN, registration number and phone happens again in Admin M22 FR-22.5.

6. Screen Wireframe Description

InstituteRegDetails — header "Register your institute", progress "Step 1 of 2" bar. Fields top to bottom:

  • "Institute name" — placeholder "e.g. Apex JEE Academy", default keyboard, auto-capitalise words, counter 0/120.
  • "Institute type" — select field showing "Choose type" → opens InstituteTypeSheet (radio list: Coaching centre · Tuition centre · School · Music school · Coding academy · Language institute · Sports academy · Other, each with a one-line hint, e.g. "Coaching centre — JEE, NEET, board exam coaching").
  • "Owner name" — placeholder "e.g. Suresh Menon", helper "The person responsible for this institute".
  • "Mobile" — PhoneField "+91 98450 12345"; locked with a green "Verified" tick when the token is a phone; otherwise editable with helper "We'll verify this number on the next step".
  • "Email" — placeholder "e.g. contact@apexjee.in", email keyboard, lower-cased.
  • "GSTIN (optional)" — placeholder "e.g. 29AAGCA4321M1ZJ", autoCapitalize="characters", max 15, live check icon; helper "Skip if your institute isn't GST registered". Sticky bar: "Next" (disabled until required fields are valid).

InstituteRegLocation — header "Where is your institute?", "Step 2 of 2".

  • "Address" — multiline 2 rows, placeholder "e.g. 3rd Floor, 80 Feet Road, 6th Block", counter 0/200.
  • "City" — select "Choose city" → CityAreaSheet (search box "Search city", list "Bengaluru, Karnataka"; non-serviceable cities show a "Launching soon" chip).
  • "Area" — select "Choose area" (disabled until city) → areas list with search.
  • "PIN code" — number pad, 6 digits, placeholder "560034"; soft warning line under the field when it doesn't match the area.
  • Map preview card 160 dp high with the pin and caption "Koramangala, Bengaluru"; button "Set exact location" (or "Adjust pin" once set) → InstituteMapPin.
  • Checkbox "I agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy" (links open in-app browser).
  • "Referral code (optional)" — shown only when the program is on. Sticky bar: "Create institute account" (loading "Creating…"). Offline: button disabled with hint "Connect to the internet to create your account."

InstituteMapPin — full-screen map, fixed pin in the centre with the shadow lifting while dragging, top search-free header "Move the map to your entrance", floating button (bottom-right) "Use my current location", bottom card with "Lat 12.935200, Long 77.624500" in small text and primary "Confirm location". If location permission is denied: toast "Location is off. Move the map to set the pin."

InstituteRegVerifyPhone — heading "Verify your mobile", body "We sent a 6-digit code to +91 98450 12345", OtpInput with autofill, "Resend in 0:30", button "Verify". Secure screen (FLAG_SECURE).

InstituteJoinInvite — institute logo (or initials avatar), heading "Join Apex JEE Academy", sub-text "Suresh Menon invited you as Counsellor", field "Your name" prefilled from the invite ("Kavita Rao"), terms checkbox, sticky "Join institute". Expired invite state: clock icon, "This invite has expired", body "Ask Suresh Menon to send it again.", button "Back to sign in".

InstituteRegDone — check illustration, heading "Apex JEE Academy is registered", body "Next, upload your registration certificate, PAN or GST certificate, owner Aadhaar and at least 6 campus photos. Verification usually takes 5 working days.", code line "Institute ID GC-I2143", primary "Upload documents", text button "I'll do it later" (goes to Dashboard, which shows the verification card).

InstituteBasicsEdit — header "Edit registration details", same fields in one scroll view grouped "Institute", "Owner", "Location"; the mobile shows read-only. Banner at top when status is docs_requested: "GuruConnect asked for changes. Update details and documents, then send for review." Sticky "Save changes". Locked state (in review): read-only fields with banner "Details can't be changed while GuruConnect reviews your application."

8. Validation Rules

Shared schemas in packages/shared: InstituteRegistrationSchema (owner mode), InstituteJoinSchema, InstituteBasicsPatchSchema (all fields optional, same rules), isValidGstin().

Field Rule Message shown
instituteName 3–120 chars after trim; letters, digits, spaces and . , & ' ( ) - /; not only digits "Enter your institute's name (3–120 characters)."
instituteType one of coaching_centre, tuition_centre, school, music_school, coding_academy, language_institute, sports_academy, other "Choose the type of institute."
ownerName 2–100 chars; letters, spaces, . ' - "Enter the owner's full name."
mobile +91 and 10 digits starting 6–9 "Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number."
mobile (server) not used by a live account; verified in the registration token "This number already has a GuruConnect account. Sign in instead."
email valid email, ≤ 254 chars, stored lower-case "Enter a valid email address."
gstin optional; BR-21.4 pattern "Enter a valid 15-character GSTIN."
gstin checksum BR-21.4 step 3 "This GSTIN doesn't look right. Check the last character."
gstin state first 2 digits = GST code of the city's state "This GSTIN is registered in another state."
gstin (server) not used by another live institute "This GSTIN is already registered on GuruConnect. Contact support if this is your institute."
addressLine 5–200 chars "Enter the full address (at least 5 characters)."
cityId active city "Choose your city."
areaId active area in the city "Choose your area."
pincode ^[1-9][0-9]{5}$ "Enter a 6-digit PIN code."
latitude / longitude −90…90 / −180…180, 6 decimals, both present, ≤ 40 km from city centre "Set your institute's location on the map." / "The pin is too far from Bengaluru. Move it to your institute."
consents.terms / consents.privacy must be true; documentVersion non-empty "Please accept the Terms and Privacy Policy."
referralCode optional, 4–20 chars [A-Z0-9], validated by M05 "This referral code isn't valid."
inviteId (join) uuid of a pending invite for this phone "This invite is no longer valid."
fullName (join) 2–100 chars as ownerName "Enter your full name."

9. API Endpoints

Method Path Auth Description
POST /registration/institute Registration token mode = owner: create owner account + draft institute + primary manager in one transaction; mode = join: accept a staff invite. Returns session tokens (Idempotency-Key). 5/hour per install
PATCH /institute/registration/basics Institute staff (manager) Edit registration details while draft, docs_requested or re-applying after rejection (If-Match). 30/hour

Uses: M05 GET /registration/context, POST /registration/referral/validate; M04 POST /auth/otp/request, POST /auth/otp/verify; M00 GET /masters, GET /masters/areas; M24 GET /institute/profile (prefill for editing).

12. PostgreSQL Tables & Columns

Existing tables this module reads or writes (full definitions in the owning module)

Table Owner Purpose
app_users Admin M00 Login identity for every mobile app account (parent, student, teacher, institute staff). Role profiles hang off this table.
institutes Admin M22 Coaching centres, tuition centres, schools and academies. Rated by GuruConnect after verification.
institute_managers Admin M25 App accounts that act for an institute. Exactly one active primary manager; counsellors can only handle leads.
user_auth_identities App M04 Sign-in methods linked to an account: phone OTP, email + password, Google.
app_sessions App M04 Refresh-token sessions for app users, one per signed-in install. Refresh tokens rotate on every use.
user_consents App M52 Record of every consent given or withdrawn (terms, privacy policy, parental consent, marketing), as required by the DPDP Act 2023.
referral_codes Admin M42 One personal referral code per app user.
referrals Admin M42 One row per referred user, tracking qualification, fraud checks and reward payout.
referral_settings Admin M06 Versioned rules for each referral program. One active version per program.
states Admin M08 States and union territories within a country.
cities Admin M09 Cities where teachers and institutes can be listed.
areas Admin M10 Localities within a city, used for "nearby" search and teacher coverage.
audit_logs Admin M00 Append-only record of every admin action and security event. Never updated or deleted by the application.
  • app_users: one row per owner or joining staff member, user_type = 'institute_staff'.
  • institutes: created in draft with the basics; phone = owner mobile; slug, public_code generated; latitude/longitude from the pin. Other profile columns (about, logo, facilities, capacity, fees) are filled later in M24.
  • institute_managers: owner row staff_role = 'manager', is_primary = true, status = 'active', designation = 'Owner'; join mode updates the invited row (user_id, status = 'active', accepted_at). The unique index uq_institute_managers_primary guarantees one live primary.
  • user_consents, user_auth_identities, app_sessions, referrals: written through the shared M04/M05 services inside the same transaction.
  • states.code is read to find the GST state code for the GSTIN check.

14. State Management

  • useInstituteRegDraft (Zustand + encrypted MMKV): { step, details: { name, instituteType, ownerName, mobile, email, gstin }, location: { addressLine, cityId, areaId, pincode, latitude, longitude }, referralCode, updatedAt, setDetails(), setLocation(), clear() }.
  • Query keys: registrationKeys.context, mastersKeys.all, mastersKeys.areas(cityId), instituteKeys.profile (M24), meKeys.me.
  • After useRegisterInstituteMutation / useJoinInstituteMutation success: useSession.setTokens(), invalidate meKeys.me, clear the draft, reset navigation to the institute stack.
  • After useUpdateInstituteBasicsMutation: invalidate instituteKeys.profile, instituteKeys.verification, meKeys.me. No optimistic updates (server regenerates the slug).

15. Offline Handling

  • Masters and areas come from the M00 cache, so both steps can be filled offline.
  • Class 2 (save draft, submit online): the form draft survives restarts; "Create institute account", "Join institute" and "Save changes" are disabled offline with the hint "Connect to the internet to continue."
  • The map needs network for tiles; offline, the map preview shows "Map needs internet" and the pin can be set when back online.
  • If the registration token expired while the user was offline (30 min), submit returns AUTH_REQUIRED with details.reason = "registration_token_expired"; the app goes to Login with "Please verify your number again to finish." and restores the draft afterwards.

16. Push Notification Requirements

Event Recipient Title / Body Deep link Category Urgent
Draft not submitted 24 h, 72 h, 7 days after registration Primary manager "Finish verifying Apex JEE Academy" / "Upload your documents so parents can find you." /institute/documents verification No
Invited staff joined (sent by this module, template owned by M24) Inviter and primary manager "Kavita Rao joined your team" / "They can now answer enquiries as Counsellor." /institute/staff account No

Registration itself sends no push (the device is registered only after sign-in); the owner gets a welcome email when an email is present. Reminders stop as soon as the institute leaves draft.

17. Security Rules

  • The registration token is single-use (jti stored in Redis for its lifetime) and only valid for /registration/* and M04 OTP calls.
  • The account is created only on successful submit; no pre-created rows can be hijacked.
  • Server never trusts mobile from the body when the token carries a phone: the token's phone is used.
  • The GSTIN duplicate message never reveals the other institute; lookups are exact-match and rate limited with the endpoint.
  • Join mode: invite must match the token's phone exactly; invite ids are uuids and never guessable; expired or disabled invites are rejected.
  • PATCH /institute/registration/basics checks institute_managers.staff_role = 'manager' and status = 'active' for the token's pid and iid; counsellors get FORBIDDEN.
  • No PII in analytics: events institute_reg_step_completed { step }, institute_reg_submitted { instituteType, hasGstin }.

18. Error Handling

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
Invalid field (incl. GSTIN format, checksum, state) VALIDATION_FAILED 422 Map details[].path to the field; GSTIN errors jump back to step 1
Mobile already has an account CONFLICT_DUPLICATE (phone_in_use) 409 Sheet "This number already has an account" with "Sign in"
GSTIN used by another institute CONFLICT_DUPLICATE (gstin_in_use) 409 Inline under GSTIN + "Contact support" link (M53)
Registration token expired AUTH_REQUIRED (registration_token_expired) 401 Login with "Please verify your number again to finish."; draft kept
Staff invite expired CONFLICT_STATE (invite_expired) 409 Expired invite state on InstituteJoinInvite
Edit basics while in review / approved CONFLICT_STATE (in_review / approved_use_profile) 409 Read-only screen with the banner; refetch
Stale edit VERSION_CONFLICT 409 "Updated on another device. Review and save again." and reload values
Counsellor edits basics FORBIDDEN 403 Toast "Only a manager can change these details."
Too many registrations from this phone LIMIT_REACHED (install_registrations) 429 "You've registered the maximum number of institutes from this phone. Contact support."
Too many attempts RATE_LIMITED 429 Disable the button until Retry-After
Network / 5xx GATEWAY_ERROR / INTERNAL_ERROR 502 / 500 Retry button; form values kept

19. Testing Scenarios

  • T21.1 Happy path (Maestro institute_registration_happy): phone OTP → both steps → pin set → account created; DB has one app_users (institute_staff), one institutes (draft), one institute_managers (manager, primary, active); lands on M22 Documents.
  • T21.2 Same Idempotency-Key sent twice (double tap / retry after timeout) → one set of rows; second call returns the same 201 body.
  • T21.3 GSTIN 29AAGCA4321M1ZJ with a Bengaluru city passes; 29AAGCA4321M1ZK fails checksum; 27AAPFU0939F1ZV with Bengaluru fails the state check.
  • T21.4 GSTIN of an existing approved institute → 409 gstin_in_use; message contains no institute name.
  • T21.5 GSTIN left empty → stored NULL; registration succeeds.
  • T21.6 PIN 560095 with area Koramangala (pincodes 560034, 560095) → no warning; PIN 560001 → soft warning but save succeeds.
  • T21.7 Pin 55 km from Bengaluru centre → 422 on the pin; moving it inside 40 km succeeds.
  • T21.8 Google sign-up: Location step requires phone OTP; after verification the new token carries both contacts and the account has email_verified_at set.
  • T21.9 Kill the app on step 2 → relaunch → draft restored with all fields; after success the draft is gone.
  • T21.10 Registration token older than 30 min → AUTH_REQUIRED; after re-login the draft is restored and submit works.
  • T21.11 Join mode: invite created 2 h ago → account created and institute_managers.status = 'active', user_id set; inviter receives the "joined your team" push. Invite 80 h old → invite_expired.
  • T21.12 Force a failure after the institutes insert (test hook) → no app_users, institutes or institute_managers row remains.
  • T21.13 PATCH basics in docs_requested succeeds and regenerates the slug; in pending → in_review; from a counsellor → FORBIDDEN; with an old If-Match → VERSION_CONFLICT.
  • T21.14 Rejected 31 days ago: PATCH basics moves the institute to draft; rejected 10 days ago → CONFLICT_STATE.

Event When Details

21. Future Scalability Notes

  • GST portal (GSTN public API) lookup during registration to prefill the legal name and address and warn on mismatch.
  • Google Places autocomplete for the address with automatic pin placement.
  • Branches: a parent_institute_id so chains register several centres under one owner account.
  • Owner identity through DigiLocker e-KYC instead of an uploaded Aadhaar image.
  • Allow one person to belong to several institutes (institute switcher in the app) by moving iid from the token into a selected-institute header.
  • Admin portal additions: none; registrations appear in Admin M22's queue once submitted, and drafts are visible in the Admin M24 directory with status draft.

Module 22 · Institute Verification

Phase 5 · Institute · Used by: Institute managers (upload, pay, submit), counsellors (view status only) · Depends on: M00 (uploads), M21, M43 (registration fee), M53 (support); Admin M05, M22, M23, M27, M40 · New tables: none · Uses: institutes, institute_documents, institute_verification_logs, institute_managers, files, transactions, payment_configurations, institute_ratings, audit_logs · Build estimate: 4–5 days

1. Module Purpose

Takes a registered institute from draft to a GuruConnect decision. Managers upload the required documents (registration certificate, PAN or GST certificate, owner Aadhaar, at least 6 campus photos) to the private R2 bucket, pay the INSTITUTE_REGISTRATION fee through M43 when that fee is enabled, and submit the application. The module then shows where the application is — every institutes.verification_status value including docs_requested, visit_scheduled and evaluation_done — with a manager-visible timeline from institute_verification_logs, re-upload requests with admin notes, evaluation visit details, and the approval or rejection outcome. Counsellors see the status but not the documents.

2. User Stories

  • As an institute manager, I want a checklist that shows exactly which documents are missing so that I can submit in one sitting.
  • As a manager, I want to photograph the registration certificate with my phone camera so that I don't need a scanner.
  • As a manager, I want to know the date and time of the evaluation visit and what to prepare so that the campus is ready.
  • As a manager whose certificate was cut off, I want to see the reviewer's note and re-upload only that document so that my application moves again quickly.
  • As an institute counsellor, I want to see whether we're verified yet so that I can answer parents who ask.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-22.1 Status machine (institutes.verification_status) as seen in the app.

Status Set by App title What managers can do
draft M21 registration; re-apply after rejection "Finish your application" Upload, replace, delete documents; edit basics (M21); pay; submit
pending This module on submit / resubmit "Submitted — waiting for review" View only
under_review Admin M22 opens the case "Documents are being checked" View only
docs_requested Admin M22 FR-22.4 "Action needed: update documents" Re-upload flagged documents, edit basics, resubmit
visit_scheduled Admin M23 FR-23.1 "Evaluation visit on Tue, 29 Sep · 11:00 AM" View visit details; contact support to reschedule
evaluation_done Admin M27 rating submitted "Evaluation complete — decision within 2 working days" View only
approved Admin M23 FR-23.3 "Verified" Add/replace campus photos, fire NOC, other documents
rejected Admin M23 FR-23.4 "Application not approved" Read reason; re-apply after 30 days (M21 BR-21.9 / BR-22.4)

Allowed app transitions: draft → pending (submit), docs_requested → pending (resubmit), rejected → draft (first edit or upload once rejected_at + 30 days ≤ now). All other transitions belong to Admin M22/M23/M27. SLA copy shown: "Documents are usually checked within 48 hours; the full decision takes about 5 working days."

BR-22.2 Required and optional documents (institute_documents.doc_type).

Type Required Count (current rows) Extra input Stored
registration_certificate Yes 1 "Registration number" 4–40 chars [A-Za-z0-9/-] institutes.registration_number
pan Yes, unless gst_certificate is uploaded 1 "PAN" ^[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z]$ doc_number_masked = first 3 + XXXXX + last 2, e.g. AAGXXXXX1M
gst_certificate Yes, unless pan is uploaded 1 none; requires institutes.gstin (the app asks for it and saves it through M21 PATCH basics first) —
manager_aadhaar Yes 1 (front side, number visible) "Last 4 digits of Aadhaar" ^\d{4}$ doc_number_masked = XXXX XXXX 4821
campus_photo Yes 6–20, images only "Caption" 2–60 chars, e.g. "Classroom A", "Test hall", "Entrance" caption
fire_safety_noc No 0–1 none —
other No 0–3 "What is this?" 2–60 chars caption
The full PAN and Aadhaar numbers are never sent to or stored by the server; the app sends only the masked form it builds locally. Admins read numbers from the image (Admin M22 unmask permission).

BR-22.3 Upload and link.

  1. App compresses images (conventions §10), then M00 POST /uploads/presign { purpose: "institute_document" } → PUT to gc-private → POST /uploads/:fileId/confirm.
  2. POST /institute/documents { fileId, docType, caption?, docNumberMasked?, registrationNumber?, replaceDocumentId? } (Idempotency-Key). Server checks: caller is an active manager of iid; the file was uploaded by the caller, has purpose institute_document, is confirmed and not linked to another document; type-specific inputs (BR-22.2); status allows uploads (BR-22.4); count limits.
  3. Versioning in one transaction: for single-slot types the current row of that type → is_current = false, new row version = old.version + 1, status = 'submitted'. For campus_photo and other, replaceDocumentId points at the row being replaced (same rule); without it a new slot starts at version = 1.
  4. registration_certificate also updates institutes.registration_number.
  5. Campus photos stay private; when admins publish the gallery (Admin M24 FR-24.7) the worker copies approved photos to gc-public as institute_gallery files.

BR-22.4 When uploads are allowed. draft and docs_requested: any type. approved: only campus_photo, fire_safety_noc, other (new rows start submitted and are reviewed in Admin M22; they don't change the status). rejected: only after 30 days; the first upload moves the institute to draft (same as M21 BR-21.9). pending, under_review, visit_scheduled, evaluation_done → CONFLICT_STATE, details.reason = "in_review". In docs_requested, documents whose current row is approved cannot be replaced (CONFLICT_STATE, details.reason = "already_approved"). Max 30 uploads per institute per day (LIMIT_REACHED, details.reason = "document_uploads_daily").

BR-22.5 Delete. DELETE /institute/documents/:id only for a current row with status = 'submitted' and reviewed_at IS NULL, while the institute is draft or docs_requested. The row is removed, its file marked deleted (object removed by the M00 cleanup job), and the previous version of that slot (if any) becomes current again. Reviewed documents are never deleted — they are replaced.

BR-22.6 Registration fee (M43). The fee is resolved with Admin M05 resolveFee('INSTITUTE_REGISTRATION') (launch placeholder ₹2,999/year, GST inclusive). It is required when the resolved version is_enabled and the institute is submitting from draft and has no qualifying payment. A qualifying payment is a transactions row with purpose = 'institute_registration', institute_id = iid, status = 'captured' and refunded_amount_paise = 0, referenced by institutes.registration_transaction_id. Flow:

  1. Review screen shows the price from M43 GET /payments/quote?feeCode=INSTITUTE_REGISTRATION and the button "Pay ₹2,999 & submit".
  2. M43 POST /payments/orders { feeCode: "INSTITUTE_REGISTRATION", instituteId } → Razorpay checkout (PaymentSheet) → M43 POST /payments/verify.
  3. M43's fulfilment for institute_registration sets institutes.registration_transaction_id and calls InstituteVerificationService.submitIfReady(instituteId) (defined here), which runs BR-22.7 if every precondition is met. So a manager who closes the app after paying is still submitted.
  4. The app then calls POST /institute/registration/submit; if already submitted it returns 200 with the current status (idempotent). Fee disabled → no payment step; button "Submit for review". Resubmission from docs_requested never charges again. After rejection the fee is refunded by Admin M23/M40 (reason institute_rejected); a re-application from draft must pay again. The yearly institute subscription starts on approval (Admin M23 FR-23.3, Admin M41), not here.

BR-22.7 Submit — POST /institute/registration/submit (Idempotency-Key), one transaction.

  1. Lock the institute row (SELECT … FOR UPDATE). Caller is an active manager.
  2. Status must be draft or docs_requested (already pending → return 200 unchanged).
  3. Preconditions, each failing with CONFLICT_STATE and details.reason: documents_incomplete (BR-22.2 counts, with details.missing[]), documents_need_update (a current document is rejected or reupload_requested), basics_incomplete (email or pin missing), fee_unpaid (BR-22.6, with details.quote).
  4. UPDATE institutes SET verification_status = 'pending', submitted_at = now() (resubmission also resets submitted_at so the SLA clock restarts).
  5. INSERT institute_verification_logs (action = 'submitted' or 'resubmitted', from_status, to_status = 'pending', is_internal = false, admin_id = NULL, metadata = { documents: 11, campusPhotos: 8, feeTransactionId }).
  6. INSERT audit_logs (app.institute_submitted / app.institute_resubmitted).
  7. After commit: in-app notification to all active managers ("Application submitted"), and the Admin M22 queue counter cache is purged.

BR-22.8 Status payload — GET /institute/verification. Returns: status, app title and body copy (server-provided so admins' wording stays consistent), a 4-step stepper (Documents → Review → Evaluation → Decision) with each step done | current | todo | action, the document checklist summary, fee state, visit details, rejection details, and the first 20 timeline entries. Visit details come from the latest non-internal visit_scheduled log (metadata.method, metadata.visitAt, note as "What to prepare"). Rejection shows rejection_reason_code mapped to plain copy (FAKE_REGISTRATION "We couldn't confirm your registration", ADDRESS_NOT_FOUND "We couldn't find the institute at this address", UNSAFE_PREMISES "The campus didn't meet safety requirements", UNQUALIFIED_FACULTY "Faculty qualifications couldn't be confirmed", DUPLICATE "This institute is already listed", DOCS_NOT_PROVIDED "Required documents weren't provided", OTHER "See the note from our team"), rejection_note, refund state and reapplyAfter = rejected_at + 30 days. When approved, it includes the current rating summary (M26) and badge: true|false.

BR-22.9 Timeline. Only rows with is_internal = false, newest first, cursor pages of 20 (?timelineCursor=). The actor is shown as "GuruConnect team" for admin rows and the manager's name for app rows; admin names are never returned. Action copy: submitted "Application submitted", resubmitted "Sent for review again", document_approved "{Document} approved", document_rejected "{Document} rejected", reupload_requested "{Document} needs a new upload", docs_requested "Changes requested", visit_scheduled "Evaluation visit scheduled", visit_completed "Evaluation visit completed", evaluation_saved "Evaluation completed", approved "Institute verified", rejected "Application not approved", badge_granted "Verified badge added", badge_revoked "Verified badge removed", suspended "Listing paused", activated "Listing active again", note_added "Message from GuruConnect".

BR-22.10 Viewing documents. GET /institute/documents returns current rows plus the last 2 superseded versions per slot, each with status, review_note, masked number and a thumbnail flag. Managers open a document through M00 GET /files/:id/url (60 s); the module-specific ownership rule is: the file belongs to an institute_documents row of the caller's institute and the caller is an active manager. manager_aadhaar files are never returned to the app after upload (the rule denies them): the app shows an ID-card icon with XXXX XXXX 4821.

BR-22.11 Reminders (worker, daily 10:00 IST). draft 24 h / 72 h / 7 days after registration (M21 push); docs_requested 48 h and 5 days after the request without resubmission; visit reminder 24 h before visitAt. Each reminder has a dedupe key inst-rem:<instituteId>:<kind>:<n>.

Shared schemas: InstituteDocumentInputSchema, InstituteSubmitSchema.

Field Rule Message shown
fileId uuid of a confirmed institute_document file uploaded by the caller "Upload failed. Please try again."

docNumberMasked (PAN) built on device from ^[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z]$ input; server accepts ^[A-Z]{3}X{5}[0-9A-Z]{2}$ "Enter a valid 10-character PAN."

campus photo count ≤ 20 current "You can add up to 20 campus photos."
other count ≤ 3 current "You can add up to 3 other documents."

Method Path Auth Description

12. PostgreSQL Tables & Columns

Existing tables this module reads or writes (full definitions in the owning module)

Table Owner Purpose
institutes Admin M22 Coaching centres, tuition centres, schools and academies. Rated by GuruConnect after verification.
institute_documents Admin M22 Institute verification documents and campus photos, versioned like teacher documents.
institute_verification_logs Admin M23 Timeline of institute verification events.
institute_managers Admin M25 App accounts that act for an institute. Exactly one active primary manager; counsellors can only handle leads.
files Admin M00 Metadata for every uploaded object stored in S3 / Cloudflare R2. Binary content never touches PostgreSQL.
transactions Admin M40 Every payment attempt through Razorpay, plus refunds and reward payouts. Amounts in paise.
payment_configurations Admin M05 One row per version of each fee. The app charges whichever version is active at payment time.
institute_ratings Admin M27 Evaluations by GuruConnect admins. The latest submitted version is current and drives the public rating.
audit_logs Admin M00 Append-only record of every admin action and security event. Never updated or deleted by the application.
  • institute_documents: inserted by POST /institute/documents (versioning per BR-22.3); status, review_note, reviewed_* are written only by Admin M22.
  • institute_verification_logs: this module inserts submitted / resubmitted rows (admin_id NULL, is_internal = false) and reads non-internal rows for the timeline.
  • institutes: reads verification_status, rejection_*, submitted_at, registration_transaction_id; writes verification_status, submitted_at, registration_number.
  • transactions / payment_configurations: read to decide whether the fee is required and paid; created by M43.
  • institute_ratings: the current row is read for the approved summary (through M26's service).

14. State Management

  • Query keys: instituteKeys.verification, instituteKeys.timeline (infinite), instituteKeys.documents. Verification and documents are persisted; staleTime 30 s; refetch on focus and when a verification push arrives in the foreground.
  • useUploadQueue (Zustand + MMKV, per module): { items: [{ localUri, docType, caption, docNumberMasked, replaceDocumentId, state }], add(), retry(), remove() } so interrupted uploads resume (conventions §8).
  • After POST /institute/documents or DELETE: invalidate instituteKeys.documents, instituteKeys.verification, meKeys.me. After submit: invalidate the same plus dashboardKeys.institute (M23). No optimistic updates (server decides versions).
  • After M43 payment success: invalidate instituteKeys.verification, then call submit.

15. Offline Handling

  • Status, documents list and timeline render from cache with "Updated 2 h ago".
  • Uploads are online only to start; the picked file and its inputs stay in useUploadQueue, and the sheet shows "Paused — will upload when you're online". On reconnect the queue presigns again and continues.
  • Submit and payment are online only (class 3); buttons disabled offline with "Connect to the internet to submit."

17. Security Rules

  • Every endpoint scopes by iid from the token; document ids from other institutes return NOT_FOUND.
  • Document endpoints need an active manager; counsellors get FORBIDDEN on /institute/documents and only read the status payload (which contains no file ids).
  • Files live in gc-private; view URLs are 60 s and never cached or persisted. Aadhaar images are never returned after upload.
  • Full PAN and Aadhaar numbers never reach the server, logs or analytics; only masked forms are stored.
  • Upload, viewer and payment screens use useSecureScreen() (FLAG_SECURE / iOS blur).
  • Admin names, internal notes (is_internal = true) and reviewer ids are never returned.
  • Submit locks the institute row, so two managers submitting at once produce one log entry.

18. Error Handling

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
Upload while in review CONFLICT_STATE (in_review) 409 Toast "Documents are locked while we review your application."; refetch
Replace an approved document during docs_requested CONFLICT_STATE (already_approved) 409 Toast "This document is already approved."
File too large / wrong type FILE_TOO_LARGE / FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED 413 / 415 Inline under the picker
Too many uploads today LIMIT_REACHED (document_uploads_daily) 429 "You've reached today's upload limit. Try again tomorrow."
Submit with missing documents CONFLICT_STATE (documents_incomplete) 409 Scroll to the first missing row and highlight it
Submit with rejected/re-upload documents CONFLICT_STATE (documents_need_update) 409 Highlight the rows with notes
Submit without fee CONFLICT_STATE (fee_unpaid) 409 Show the fee card and "Pay & submit"
Payment failed PAYMENT_FAILED 402 M43 result screen with Retry; documents untouched
Counsellor opens documents FORBIDDEN 403 Toast "Only a manager can manage documents."
Document deleted on another device NOT_FOUND 404 Refetch the list
R2 unavailable GATEWAY_ERROR 502 Upload paused with Retry

19. Testing Scenarios

  • T22.1 Happy path (Maestro institute_verification_submit): upload certificate, PAN, Aadhaar last 4, 6 photos → Review → Pay ₹2,999 (Razorpay test mode) → status pending, one submitted log row, registration_transaction_id set.
  • T22.2 Fee disabled in Admin M05 → no fee card; "Submit for review" moves to pending without a transaction.
  • T22.3 App killed right after payment capture → M43 fulfilment calls submitIfReady; on relaunch the status is pending.
  • T22.4 Submit with 5 campus photos → documents_incomplete with missing: ["campus_photo"].
  • T22.5 Admin requests re-upload of the certificate → push received; Documents shows the note; replacing it creates version 2 and "Send for review" moves to pending with a resubmitted log; no second payment.
  • T22.6 Upload in under_review → in_review; replacing an approved PAN in docs_requested → already_approved.
  • T22.7 Delete an unreviewed version 2 → version 1 is current again; deleting a reviewed document → CONFLICT_STATE.
  • T22.8 Aadhaar: request body contains only XXXX XXXX 4821; GET /files/:id/url for that file returns FORBIDDEN; viewer shows the masked card.
  • T22.9 Counsellor: status screen visible without buttons; GET /institute/documents → 403.
  • T22.10 Timeline hides is_internal rows and shows "GuruConnect team" as the actor for admin rows.
  • T22.11 Offline: pick a photo → queued; reconnect → uploads and links once (Idempotency-Key reused).
  • T22.12 Two managers submit simultaneously → one pending transition, one log row; the second call returns 200 unchanged.
  • T22.13 Rejected 31 days ago → upload moves the status to draft and the fee is required again.
