Module 23 · Institute Dashboard

Phase 5 · Institute · Used by: Institute managers and counsellors · Depends on: M00, M22, M24, M25, M26, M32 (records views), M39 (enquiries), M35 (review replies); Admin M38 (response-rate definition) · New tables: institute_profile_views, institute_daily_stats · Uses: institutes, leads, institute_reviews, institute_teachers, institute_batches, institute_managers, demo_requests, user_favorites, profile_shares, cities · Build estimate: 3–4 days

1. Module Purpose

The home tab for institute staff. It shows how the institute is doing — profile views, enquiries, response rate, reviews, GuruConnect and user ratings, teachers and batches — for the last 7, 30 or 90 days with comparison to the previous period, plus the newest enquiries and a short list of tasks (finish verification, add batches, complete teacher ID checks, reply to reviews). It owns the two stats tables: institute_profile_views (raw views recorded when someone opens the institute's profile) and institute_daily_stats (per-day counters written by a job). Before approval the dashboard focuses on verification progress; counsellors get an enquiry-focused version.

2. User Stories

  • As an institute manager, I want to see how many parents viewed our profile and enquired this month so that I know whether GuruConnect is working for us.
  • As a manager, I want to see our response rate so that I can make sure counsellors call parents back within a day.
  • As an institute counsellor, I want the newest enquiries at the top of my home screen so that I can respond first thing in the morning.
  • As a new institute owner, I want the dashboard to tell me what's left before we go live so that I don't miss a step.
  • As a manager on a slow connection, I want the dashboard to open instantly with yesterday's numbers so that I can check it anywhere.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-23.1 What the dashboard shows.

Institute state Manager Counsellor
draft, docs_requested, rejected Verification card (M22 hero copy + action), setup tasks, KPIs hidden with "Your stats start once you're verified" Verification card without action
pending … evaluation_done Verification card (progress), setup tasks (profile, batches, teachers can be done now) Verification card
approved + account_status = active KPI grid, trend chart, recent enquiries, tasks, rating card Enquiry KPIs (enquiries, response rate), recent enquiries, review replies task
account_status = suspended Red banner "Your listing is paused. Contact support." + frozen KPIs Same banner

BR-23.2 KPI definitions. Range r = last 7, 30 or 90 IST days including today; previous period = the same number of days before it. Delta % = (current − previous) / previous × 100, rounded to a whole number; hidden when previous = 0.

KPI Formula
Profile views SUM(institute_daily_stats.profile_views) over the range (unique viewers per day)
Enquiries SUM(leads) over the range (non-spam institute leads)
Response rate SUM(leads_responded) / SUM(leads) over the range excluding today (leads need 24 h to count); shown when the denominator ≥ 5, else "Not enough enquiries yet"; plus median first-response minutes from leads.first_response_at − created_at for the same leads (live query, max 500 rows)
Reviews Published institute_reviews in the range; total institutes.user_rating_count; unreplied = published with institute_reply IS NULL
Rating institutes.overall_rating, infrastructure_score, faculty_score (M26), user_rating_avg
Teachers institute_teachers with status = 'active', with status = 'id_pending', and the limit limits.institute_max_teachers (25)
Batches Active institute_batches (is_active, deleted_at IS NULL), SUM(seats_available), batches with starts_on in the next 14 days
Secondary Search impressions, campus visit requests, favourites added, shares — sums of the matching daily columns
The response-rate rule matches Admin M38 FR-38.4 (answered within 24 h ÷ non-spam leads).

BR-23.3 Recording profile views (InstituteViewRecorder.record, used by M32). Called when GET /institutes/:idOrSlug returns a full profile.

  1. Skip when the viewer is staff of that institute, when the institute is not approved, or when the User-Agent is a known bot.
  2. Signed-in viewer: INSERT institute_profile_views (institute_id, viewer_user_id, source, city_id) ON CONFLICT (institute_id, viewer_user_id, viewed_on) DO NOTHING — one row per viewer per institute per IST day.
  3. Anonymous viewer (shared link): dedupe in Redis ipv:<instituteId>:<installId or ip>:<yyyymmdd> (TTL 36 h); insert with viewer_user_id = NULL only on the first hit.
  4. source from the route param src (search, recommendation, dashboard, favorites, share_link, notification, else other); city_id = viewer's city (parent/student profile or the M27 search city).
  5. The insert is fire-and-forget after the response (failures logged, never shown).

BR-23.4 Daily stats job (institute-stats, BullMQ). Every 15 minutes it recomputes today and yesterday (IST) for institutes with any activity since the last run; at 00:30 IST it finalises the day before yesterday for all approved institutes. Upsert on (institute_id, stat_date):

  • profile_views = count of institute_profile_views rows with viewed_on = stat_date.
  • search_impressions = Redis counter stats:inst_impr:<date> hash field <instituteId> (incremented by M28 once per result page render), read and persisted.
  • leads = leads with target_type = 'institute', this institute, created on stat_date (IST), status <> 'spam', deleted_at IS NULL.
  • leads_responded = of those, first_response_at − created_at ≤ 24 h.
  • campus_visits = demo_requests with this institute_id created on stat_date.
  • favorites_added = user_favorites (target_type = 'institute') created on stat_date, not deleted.
  • shares = profile_shares with this institute_id created on stat_date.
  • computed_at = now(). A lead later marked spam is removed from the counters on the next recompute of its day (the admin action enqueues a recompute for that day).

BR-23.5 Tasks list (max 4, in this order, only for managers unless noted). Finish verification (not approved) · Add logo and cover (either missing) · Add your first batch (0 active batches) · Add teachers (0 non-removed teachers) · "3 teachers haven't completed ID checks" (id_pending older than 3 days) · "2 reviews waiting for a reply" (managers and counsellors) · "4 new enquiries not opened" (status new older than 2 h; managers and counsellors). Each task deep-links to its screen.

BR-23.6 Recent enquiries. Latest 3 leads for the institute (open statuses first: new, viewed) with requester display name (first name + initial), subject, class, age ("12 min ago") and status pill; tap opens M39 enquiry detail. Contact details are never included here.

BR-23.7 Caching and freshness. GET /institute/dashboard is cached in Redis 60 s per (institute, range, role); lead creation and review publish purge it. The response carries computedAt (latest institute_daily_stats.computed_at in the range) and the app shows "Updated 10 min ago". Pull-to-refresh bypasses the Redis cache once per 30 s.

BR-23.8 Retention. institute_profile_views rows older than 13 months are deleted monthly (the daily stats keep the totals). institute_daily_stats rows are kept for the life of the institute.

BR-23.9 Weekly summary. Monday 10:00 IST job sends each approved institute's active managers a summary push if the last 7 days had at least one view or enquiry; response rate below 50% (with ≥ 5 enquiries) adds an alert push the same day.

6. Screen Wireframe Description

InstituteDashboard (approved, manager) — header: logo avatar, "Apex JEE Academy", Verified tick, bell icon with unread badge (M48). Range chip "Last 30 days ▾" (opens DashboardRangeSheet). Muted line "Updated 10 min ago".

  • KPI grid 2 × 3 cards, each: label, big number, delta chip ("▲ 18%" green text + arrow, "▼ 6%" red text + arrow): "Profile views 1,284 ▲ 18%" · "Enquiries 41 ▲ 5%" · "Response rate 83% · median 42 min" · "Reviews 12 new · 486 total" · "Teachers 6 active · 2 ID pending · of 25" · "Batches 3 active · 14 seats left".
  • Rating card: "GuruConnect rating ★ 4.5" + "Infrastructure 8.8/10 · Faculty 9.1/10" + "Parents rate you 4.7 (486)" → M26.
  • Trend chart card "Views and enquiries": 30 thin bars (views) with a line (enquiries), x-axis dates "1 Sep … 26 Sep"; tap a bar shows a tooltip "24 Sep · 52 views · 3 enquiries".
  • "Recent enquiries" section with 3 rows: "Lakshmi V. · Physics · Class 12 · 12 min ago · New" and link "See all enquiries" (Enquiries tab, M39).
  • "To do" section: up to 4 task rows with icon, text and chevron ("2 reviews waiting for a reply").
  • Secondary stats row (small text): "Shown in search 9,420 · Visit requests 7 · Saved by 38 · Shared 11". Empty state (approved, no activity yet): illustration, "No activity yet", "Complete your profile and add batches to appear higher in search.", button "Add a batch".

InstituteDashboard (before approval) — header as above without Verified tick. Large verification card from M22 ("Submitted — waiting for review", stepper, button). "While you wait" task list (logo, batches, teachers). KPI area replaced by a muted card "Your stats start once you're verified".

InstituteDashboard (counsellor) — KPIs "Enquiries" and "Response rate" only, recent enquiries (5 rows), "To do" limited to enquiries and review replies. No teacher, batch or fee items.

DashboardRangeSheet — radio list "Last 7 days", "Last 30 days", "Last 90 days"; choice remembered on the device.

InstituteStatDetail — header = KPI name ("Profile views"), big total with delta, bar chart per day for the range with the previous period as a faint line, table below (date, value) for the last 14 days, explainer text ("A view is one person opening your profile on a day. Several visits by the same person on the same day count once."). Loading skeleton; error state with Retry.

InstituteDashboardScreen

12. PostgreSQL Tables & Columns

New tables owned by this module (migration sql/migrations/123_app_m23_institute_dashboard_views_and_daily_stats.sql)

institute_profile_views

Raw institute profile views from the app (one per viewer per institute per day).

Column Type Null Default Constraints / References Description
id uuid no gen_random_uuid() PK Primary key
institute_id uuid no — FK → institutes.id (on delete cascade) Viewed institute
viewer_user_id uuid yes — FK → app_users.id (on delete set null) Viewer (NULL for shared-link visitors)
source text no — CHECK source IN ('search','recommendation','dashboard','favorites','share_link','notification','other') Entry point
city_id uuid yes — FK → cities.id (on delete set null) Viewer's city

viewed_at timestamptz no now() — Time

<details><summary>DDL</summary>

CREATE TABLE institute_profile_views (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  institute_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES institutes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- Viewed institute
  viewer_user_id uuid REFERENCES app_users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, -- Viewer (NULL for shared-link visitors)
  source text NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('search','recommendation','dashboard','favorites','share_link','notification','other')), -- Entry point
  city_id uuid REFERENCES cities(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, -- Viewer's city
  viewed_on date NOT NULL DEFAULT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date, -- IST day, for de-duplication
  viewed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now() -- Time
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_institute_profile_views_daily ON institute_profile_views (institute_id, viewer_user_id, viewed_on) WHERE viewer_user_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_institute_profile_views_inst ON institute_profile_views (institute_id, viewed_at DESC);

</details>

Indexes: uq_institute_profile_views_daily (unique) on (institute_id, viewer_user_id, viewed_on) WHERE viewer_user_id IS NOT NULL; idx_institute_profile_views_inst on (institute_id, viewed_at DESC)

institute_daily_stats

Per-institute daily counters for the institute dashboard (written by the nightly job, today refreshed every 15 minutes).

Column Type Null Default Constraints / References Description
institute_id uuid no — PK; FK → institutes.id (on delete cascade) Institute
stat_date date no — PK IST day
profile_views integer no 0 — Unique viewers
search_impressions integer no 0 — Times shown in search results
leads integer no 0 — Enquiries received
leads_responded integer no 0 — Enquiries answered within 24 h
campus_visits integer no 0 — Demo / visit requests
favorites_added integer no 0 — Added to favourites
shares integer no 0 — Profile shares
computed_at timestamptz no now() — Last computed

Table constraints: PRIMARY KEY (institute_id, stat_date)

<details><summary>DDL</summary>

CREATE TABLE institute_daily_stats (
  institute_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES institutes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- Institute
  stat_date date NOT NULL, -- IST day
  profile_views integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Unique viewers
  search_impressions integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Times shown in search results
  leads integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Enquiries received
  leads_responded integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Enquiries answered within 24 h
  campus_visits integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Demo / visit requests
  favorites_added integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Added to favourites
  shares integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Profile shares
  computed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Last computed
  PRIMARY KEY (institute_id, stat_date)
);

</details>

14. State Management

  • Query keys: dashboardKeys.institute(range), dashboardKeys.instituteKpi(kpi, range); persisted; staleTime 60 s; refetch on tab focus and app foreground.
  • useDashboardRange (Zustand + MMKV): { range: '30d', setRange() }.
  • Invalidated by other modules: lead actions (M39), review replies (M35), batch and teacher changes (M24/M25), verification changes (M22), and any foreground push with category leads, reviews or verification.
  • No mutations in this module.

15. Offline Handling

  • Read-only screen: renders the last cached dashboard for the selected range with the offline banner and "Updated 3 h ago"; switching to an uncached range shows "Connect to the internet to see this range."
  • Chart and KPI detail use cached series when available.
  • No writes.

16. Push Notification Requirements

Event Recipient Title / Body Deep link Category Urgent
Weekly summary (Mon 10:00 IST) Active managers of approved institutes with activity "Your week on GuruConnect" / "142 profile views and 9 enquiries last week. Response rate 83%." /institute/dashboard account No
Response rate below 50% (weekly check, ≥ 5 enquiries) Active managers "Parents are waiting" / "Only 4 of 10 enquiries got a reply within a day. Faster replies rank you higher." /institute/enquiries leads No
Enquiry, review and verification pushes are defined by M39, M35 and M22.

17. Security Rules

  • Scoped by iid; role from institute_managers (active row for pid), never from the request.
  • Counsellor responses omit teacher, batch, fee and secondary stats fields entirely (not just hidden in the UI).
  • Recent enquiries show requester first name + initial only; no phone, email or child details.
  • institute_profile_views never exposes viewer identities to the institute — only counts leave the server.
  • View recording ignores the institute's own staff and dedupes per viewer per day, so staff and repeat visits can't inflate numbers; anonymous views are capped by the Redis key.

18. Error Handling

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
Staff row disabled while using the app FORBIDDEN 403 Sign out with "Your access to this institute was removed." (M24)
Institute suspended — 200 Suspension banner from the payload
Unknown kpi VALIDATION_FAILED 422 Stat detail shows "This chart isn't available."
Stats not computed yet (new institute) — 200 KPIs show 0 with "Stats update every 15 minutes."
Network / 5xx GATEWAY_ERROR / INTERNAL_ERROR 502 / 500 Cached dashboard + toast; ErrorState with Retry when no cache

19. Testing Scenarios

  • T23.1 Happy path (Maestro institute_dashboard_view): approved manager sees six KPI cards, rating card, chart and 3 recent enquiries; switching to 7 days refetches.
  • T23.2 Same parent opens the institute profile 5 times in a day → one institute_profile_views row; next IST day → second row.
  • T23.3 Staff member opens their own institute's profile → no row inserted.
  • T23.4 Shared-link anonymous opens from the same install twice → one row with viewer_user_id NULL.
  • T23.5 Stats job: 10 leads today, 8 answered within 24 h yesterday → leads_responded counts only those within 24 h; a lead marked spam disappears from leads on the next recompute.
  • T23.6 Response rate with 4 enquiries in range → "Not enough enquiries yet"; with 10 → percentage shown and matches the Admin M38 stats for the same range.
  • T23.7 Delta hidden when the previous period is 0; delta text contains an arrow and sign.
  • T23.8 Pending institute → verification card, kpis null, tasks for batches and teachers.
  • T23.9 Counsellor response contains no teachers, batches, secondary keys.
  • T23.10 Offline with cache → dashboard renders with "Updated …"; switching to an uncached range shows the offline message.
  • T23.11 Weekly summary sent Monday 10:00 IST only to institutes with activity; dedupe key prevents duplicates on job retry.
  • T23.12 Suspended institute → red banner, KPIs frozen, enquiry tasks hidden.

20. Audit Log Events

None. The dashboard and view recording are reads; views and counters are analytics data, not audited actions.

21. Future Scalability Notes

  • Partition institute_profile_views by month once it passes ~20M rows; move the job to incremental aggregation from an event stream.
  • Funnel view (impression → view → enquiry → visit → enrolled) using demo_requests.outcome.
  • Benchmarks: "Institutes like yours in Koramangala get 22 enquiries a month" from anonymised city/type medians.
  • Per-counsellor response metrics once enquiries record which staff member responded.
  • CSV export of daily stats for owners.
  • Admin portal additions: none; Admin M50 institute reports read institute_daily_stats.

Module 24 · Institute Manager

Phase 5 · Institute · Used by: Primary manager (the owner) and other managers — invite, edit and disable staff; edit the institute profile and batches; counsellors — view staff, profile and batches, no edits · Depends on: M00, M21 (owner/primary manager created there), M22 (verification status gates profile edits), M23 (dashboard tasks deep-link here); Admin M24, M25 · New tables: none · Uses: institute_managers, app_users, institutes, institute_batches, institute_ratings, classes, subjects, teaching_modes, files, audit_logs · Build estimate: 4–5 days

1. Module Purpose

Gives an institute's manager control of the team and the public profile. Any active manager can invite a new counsellor or manager by phone, edit their designation and role, and disable an account that has left; exactly one primary manager exists per institute and cannot be changed, demoted or disabled from the app (only GuruConnect support can replace one, Admin M25 FR-25.5). The same module edits everything about the institute's public listing that isn't part of registration — about, contact, logo, cover, facilities, capacity, fees — and the courses and batches shown on the profile. Counsellors can see the team, profile and batches but never change them; every write here checks institute_managers.staff_role = 'manager' and status = 'active' on the server, not just in the UI.

2. User Stories

  • As the owner of Apex JEE Academy, I want to invite my centre head as a manager and two front-desk staff as counsellors by phone so that they can start working without me sharing my login.
  • As a manager, I want to disable a counsellor who left last month so that she can't see new enquiries any more.
  • As a manager, I want to add a "JEE 2027 weekend batch" with seats and fee so that parents searching see it on our profile.
  • As a counsellor, I want to see who else is on the team and browse our batches so that I can answer a parent's question, even though I can't edit them.
  • As a manager updating fees after a price change, I want the edit to go live immediately without needing GuruConnect's approval so that the profile is always current.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-24.1 Roles (server-enforced on every endpoint in this module and in M25).

Capability Primary manager Manager Counsellor
View/respond to enquiries (M39), assign to a teacher ✓ ✓ ✓
View staff list, institute profile, batches ✓ ✓ ✓
Edit institute profile (about, contact, logo, cover, facilities, capacity, fees) ✓ ✓ —
Add / edit / remove batches ✓ ✓ —
Add / edit / remove institute teachers, assign subjects & classes (M25) ✓ ✓ —
Invite / edit / disable staff ✓ ✓ —
Reply to reviews (M35), registration documents and fee (M21/M22) ✓ ✓ —
Change own is_primary, disable the primary manager — — —
Every write endpoint loads the caller's institute_managers row by (institute_id = iid, user_id = sub) and requires staff_role = 'manager' and status = 'active'; a disabled or counsellor caller gets FORBIDDEN. is_primary is never editable from the app — only Admin M25 FR-25.5 can replace the primary manager.

BR-24.2 Staff list — GET /institute/staff. Returns every non-... row for the institute (invited, active, disabled, newest-first within status group: active managers, active counsellors, invited, then disabled), each with id, fullName, phone (masked for counsellors, full for managers — see BR-24.10), email, designation, staffRole, isPrimary, status, invitedAt, acceptedAt, disabledAt, lastActiveAt (from app_users / app_sessions, managers only), and inviteExpired (status = 'invited' and invited_at < now() − 72h). Counts { managers, counsellors, invitedPending } are included for the sticky "Invite" bar's limit hint.

BR-24.3 Invite — POST /institute/staff/invite, one transaction.

  1. Caller is an active manager. InstituteStaffInviteSchema: fullName 2–100 chars, phone E.164, staffRole (manager|counsellor), designation optional ≤ 60 chars.
  2. Phone uniqueness: another row for this institute with status <> 'disabled' and the same phone → if that row's status = 'invited', this call is treated as a resend (step 4) instead of an error; if status = 'active', 409 CONFLICT_DUPLICATE, details.reason = "already_on_team".
  3. Limit: counting rows with status IN ('invited','active'), at most 3 managers and 10 counsellors per institute (matches Admin M25 validation); over the limit → 409 CONFLICT_STATE, details.reason = "max_managers" / "max_counsellors", details.limit.
  4. Resend path: UPDATE institute_managers SET full_name, designation, staff_role, invited_at = now() on the existing invited row, at most once per 15 minutes (else 429 RATE_LIMITED). New path: INSERT institute_managers (institute_id, full_name, phone, designation, staff_role, is_primary = false, status = 'invited', invited_at = now(), created_by = NULL).
  5. Send an SMS: "Suresh Menon invited you to join Apex JEE Academy on GuruConnect as Counsellor. Open the GuruConnect app and sign in with this number." (no token in the link — the invitee signs in normally with M04 OTP; M05 GET /registration/context then surfaces the pending invite and M21 BR-21.8 completes the join).
  6. INSERT audit_logs app.institute_staff_invited.
  7. The invite is valid for 72 hours (invited_at); after that GET /institute/staff marks it inviteExpired: true and the only action is resend (step 4); Admin M25 can also resend. 10/hour per institute (Idempotency-Key not required — resend is naturally idempotent).

BR-24.4 Edit staff — PATCH /institute/staff/:id, If-Match on institute_managers.updated_at.

  • Target must belong to the caller's institute and not be the primary manager (is_primary = true → 409 CONFLICT_STATE, details.reason = "cannot_edit_primary", message points to support, M53).
  • While status = 'invited': fullName, phone (re-checked for uniqueness), designation, staffRole are all editable (correcting a typo before they join).
  • While status = 'active': only designation and staffRole are editable — fullName, phone and email are the person's own account fields, changed through M51 Account Settings, not here.
  • Promoting a counsellor to manager, or adding a second/third manager, is blocked at the 3-manager limit (409 CONFLICT_STATE, details.reason = "max_managers"); demoting a manager to counsellor is always allowed (never drops below one active manager because the primary is untouched here).
  • INSERT audit_logs app.institute_staff_role_changed when staffRole changes; the affected staff member is notified (BR-24.9).

BR-24.5 Disable — DELETE /institute/staff/:id { reason }.

  • Target must belong to the caller's institute; the primary manager can never be disabled from the app (409 CONFLICT_STATE, details.reason = "cannot_disable_primary"). A manager can disable themselves (e.g. leaving the institute) — the call succeeds and immediately signs the caller out.
  • reason 10–500 chars (shown only to admins and the disabled person, never to other staff).
  • One transaction: UPDATE institute_managers SET status = 'disabled', disabled_at = now(), disabled_reason = reason; if user_id IS NOT NULL, revoke every app_sessions row for that user_id (same effect as sign-out-everywhere, M04) so any signed-in device is logged out on its next call with FORBIDDEN (conventions §5 "Wrong role or not the owner" — the app then shows "Your access to this institute was removed." and returns to Login, matching M23's error table). INSERT audit_logs app.institute_staff_disabled.
  • A disabled row can be re-enabled only by GuruConnect support (Admin M25); the app has no "enable" endpoint (re-inviting the same phone after disabling creates a fresh invite instead, since the old row's status <> 'invited'... actually a disabled phone still blocks a new invite at step 2 of BR-24.3 — support removes/re-enables the old row first).

BR-24.6 Institute profile — GET/PATCH /institute/profile, If-Match on institutes.updated_at.

  • GET is open to any active staff (managers and counsellors); PATCH requires an active manager.
  • Allowed only while institutes.verification_status = 'approved' (regardless of account_status, except BR-24.8). Before approval: 409 CONFLICT_STATE, details.reason = "use_registration_basics" — the app routes to M21 InstituteBasicsEdit instead, which owns edits during draft/docs_requested/recently-rejected. While pending, under_review, visit_scheduled or evaluation_done: 409 CONFLICT_STATE, details.reason = "in_review" (same family of errors M21 and M22 already use).
  • Fields, two groups:
    • Starred (needs reason 10–500 chars; logged as profile_changed_after_approval): name, instituteType, establishedYear, registrationNumber, gstin (same isValidGstin rule as M21), addressLine, cityId, areaId, pincode, latitude/longitude (same 40 km rule as M21 BR-21.5).
    • Unstarred (no reason): email, website, about (≤ 3,000 chars), logoFileId, coverFileId, facilities[] (from the fixed list: ac_classrooms, cctv, library, science_lab, computer_lab, test_centre, parking, wheelchair_access, drinking_water, separate_washrooms, sound_proof_rooms, instrument_library, sports_ground, other), classrooms, seatingCapacity, studentCount, feeMinPaise/feeMaxPaise (min ≤ max).
    • The owner's mobile (institutes.phone) is never editable here (BR-21.2 — support only).
  • Changing cityId or facilities also sets the institute's current institute_ratings row's next_review_due = today (bringing the next GuruConnect evaluation forward, matching Admin FR-24.3), inside the same transaction as the profile update.
  • Changing name regenerates the slug (BR-21.7 algorithm); changing cityId clears areaId and requires new coordinates, exactly as M21 BR-21.9.
  • INSERT audit_logs app.institute_profile_updated (changed field names; starred changes include the reason; GSTIN stored masked to last 4).

BR-24.7 Photos. logoFileId/coverFileId point at confirmed institute_logo/institute_cover uploads (M00, gc-public, ≤ 5 MB). The public campus-photo gallery stays owned by M22 (approved campus_photo documents, published by Admin M24 FR-24.7) — this module can only set which uploaded file is the logo and which is the cover, not reorder the gallery.

BR-24.8 Suspension. While institutes.account_status = 'suspended', PATCH /institute/profile and every batch write return 409 CONFLICT_STATE, details.reason = "suspended"; GETs still work so staff can see the paused banner and current data.

BR-24.9 Batches — GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /institute/batches(/:id). Writes need an active manager; reads are open to counsellors (they see which batch a lead is asking about, M39). Allowed at any verification_status (a new institute can add batches before approval, per M23's task list) as long as the institute isn't deleted and not suspended (BR-24.8). Fields: name 3–80 chars, subjectIds 1–6 active subjects, classId active classes, teachingModeId active teaching_modes, scheduleText ≤ 120 chars, seatsTotal 1–1,000, seatsAvailable 0…seatsTotal, feePaise 0…1,00,00,000, feePeriod (one_time|monthly|quarterly|yearly), startsOn ≥ today − 365 days, isActive. Max 50 active batches per institute (409 CONFLICT_STATE, details.reason = "max_batches"). Delete is a soft delete (deleted_at, is_active = false); deleted batches never come back. INSERT audit_logs app.institute_batch_created / _updated / _deleted.

BR-24.10 Phone masking. Counsellors see other staff's phones masked (+91 98XXX XX122) in GET /institute/staff; managers see full numbers (they may need to call a colleague). Nobody outside the institute's own staff ever sees these rows.

BR-24.11 Rate limits. POST /institute/staff/invite 10/hour per institute; PATCH /institute/staff/:id and DELETE 30/hour; PATCH /institute/profile 20/hour; batch writes 60/hour per institute.

6. Screen Wireframe Description

InstituteStaffList — header "Team", sticky "Invite staff" (managers only). Sections "Owner", "Managers", "Counsellors", "Invited", "Disabled" — each row: avatar/initials, name, designation ("Centre Head"), phone (masked for counsellors), role badge, status pill ("Invite expired" in amber with "Resend"). Owner row shows a crown icon and "Primary — contact support to change" instead of a chevron. Empty invited/disabled sections are hidden.

InstituteStaffInvite — title "Invite a team member". Fields: "Full name" (placeholder "e.g. Kavita Rao"), "Mobile" (PhoneField), segmented "Role" (Manager · Counsellor, with one-line hints: "Manager — can edit the profile, batches and teachers", "Counsellor — can view and reply to enquiries"), "Designation (optional)" (placeholder "e.g. Front desk"). Helper under Role when the limit is close: "2 of 3 manager seats used." Sticky "Send invite".

InstituteStaffDetail — header = the person's name. "Designation" text field, "Role" segmented (disabled and captioned "Contact support to change the primary manager" when isPrimary), status line ("Joined 12 Aug 2026" / "Invited 2 days ago — expires in 1 day" with "Resend invite"). Danger zone: "Disable this person" (red text button) → bottom sheet "Disable Kavita Rao?" with a reason field (placeholder "e.g. Left the institute in August") and confirm "Disable".

InstituteProfileEdit — grouped sections "Basics" (name, type, established year, registration number, GSTIN — each shows a small "Needs a reason" note once touched), "Contact" (email, website), "Address" (line, city, area, PIN, map preview, reused from M21), "About" (multiline, counter 0/3,000), "Facilities" (chip row → FacilitiesSheet), "Capacity & fees" (classrooms, seating capacity, student count, fee min/max), "Photos" (logo circle + cover 16:9, tap to replace via image picker). A reason field appears inline the moment a starred field changes, e.g. "Why is this changing? (Shown to GuruConnect's evaluator)". Locked state under docs_requested/pending/etc. shows a banner "This can't be edited right now — use Registration details instead." and a link to M21.

FacilitiesSheet — checklist of 14 items with icons (AC classrooms, CCTV, Library, Science lab, Computer lab, Test hall, Parking, Wheelchair access, Drinking water, Separate washrooms, Sound-proof rooms, Instrument library, Sports ground, Other), sticky "Done (5 selected)".

InstituteBatches — header "Batches", sticky "+ Add batch" (managers). Each card: name ("JEE 2027 · Class 12 weekend"), subjects chips, class, mode, schedule text, "6 seats left of 30", fee ("₹1,20,000 / yearly"), inactive batches greyed with an "Inactive" pill. Empty: "No batches yet", "Add courses and batches so parents know what you offer.", button "Add your first batch".

InstituteBatchForm — fields: Name, Subjects (multi-select chips, 1–6), Class (select), Mode (select), Schedule text, Seats total / Seats available (two number fields side by side), Fee + period (segmented one_time/monthly/quarterly/yearly), Start date (date picker), "Active" switch. Sticky "Save batch" / for a new batch "Add batch".

12. PostgreSQL Tables & Columns

Existing tables this module reads or writes (full definitions in the owning module)

Table Owner Purpose
institute_managers Admin M25 App accounts that act for an institute. Exactly one active primary manager; counsellors can only handle leads.
app_users Admin M00 Login identity for every mobile app account (parent, student, teacher, institute staff). Role profiles hang off this table.
institutes Admin M22 Coaching centres, tuition centres, schools and academies. Rated by GuruConnect after verification.
institute_batches Admin M24 Courses and batches an institute runs, shown on its public profile.
institute_ratings Admin M27 Evaluations by GuruConnect admins. The latest submitted version is current and drives the public rating.
classes Admin M11 Grades and levels learners study at, from Class 1 to competitive exam preparation.
subjects Admin M12 Subjects, exams and skills teachers can teach.
teaching_modes Admin M14 How classes are delivered, e.g. Online, Offline at teacher's place, Home tuition, Hybrid.
files Admin M00 Metadata for every uploaded object stored in S3 / Cloudflare R2. Binary content never touches PostgreSQL.
audit_logs Admin M00 Append-only record of every admin action and security event. Never updated or deleted by the application.
  • institute_managers: this module inserts (invite), updates (edit/resend/disable) and reads every row except the transition that creates the owner (M21) or accepts an invite (M21 join mode). is_primary is read-only here.
  • institutes: reads and writes every profile column except phone, verification_status, account_status, the rating cache columns and the M21-owned registration fields while unapproved.
  • institute_batches: fully owned in behaviour (CRUD) by this module, though the table itself lives in Admin M24's migration.
  • institute_ratings: only next_review_due on the current row is touched (BR-24.6), to bring re-evaluation forward after an address or facilities change.
  • classes, subjects, teaching_modes: read-only, to validate and label batch fields.
  • files: logo_file_id/cover_file_id point at confirmed uploads; ownership checked the same way as M22 documents.

14. State Management

  • Query keys: staffKeys.list, instituteKeys.profile (also read by M21), batchKeys.list. Persisted; staleTime 30 s.
  • After invite/edit/disable: invalidate staffKeys.list. After profile update: invalidate instituteKeys.profile, dashboardKeys.institute (M23 tasks), meKeys.me. After a batch write: invalidate batchKeys.list, dashboardKeys.institute (batch count).
  • Optimistic update only for the batch "Active" toggle (rolled back on error); everything else waits for the server response since it changes what's public.

15. Offline Handling

  • Staff list, profile and batches render from cache with "Updated …".
  • Invite, edit, disable, profile save and batch writes are class 2 (save draft, submit online): forms keep their values while offline; the sticky button is disabled with "Connect to the internet to continue."
  • No queued writes here — every action here is either sensitive (staff) or changes a public listing (profile/batches), so none are safe to replay blind.

16. Push Notification Requirements

Event Recipient Title / Body Deep link Category Urgent
Invited staff joined (M21 inserts the row; this module owns the template) Inviter and primary manager "Kavita Rao joined your team" / "They can now answer enquiries as Counsellor." /institute/staff account No
Your role changed The affected staff member "Your role changed" / "You're now a Manager at Apex JEE Academy." /institute/staff account No
Your access was removed The disabled staff member (best-effort, device may already be signed out) "Your access was removed" / "You no longer have access to Apex JEE Academy." — (in-app inbox only) account No
Profile change needs a reason review none — internal only, no push — — — —

17. Security Rules

  • Every endpoint scopes by iid from the token; :id params from other institutes return NOT_FOUND.
  • staff_role = 'manager' and status = 'active' are checked server-side on every write in this section (and reused by M25); counsellors get FORBIDDEN, never a silently-disabled button only.
  • is_primary cannot be set or cleared by any endpoint in this module.
  • Disabling revokes sessions immediately (BR-24.5); the disabled person's next authenticated call anywhere returns FORBIDDEN and signs them out app-wide (not just from this institute — v1 has one role per account).
  • Reasons for disabling and for starred profile changes are visible only to GuruConnect admins and, for disable, to the disabled person; never to other staff.
  • Phones are masked for counsellors in the staff list (BR-24.10); full PII is never sent to analytics.

18. Error Handling

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
Counsellor calls any manager-only endpoint FORBIDDEN 403 Toast "Only a manager can do this."
Phone already active on the team CONFLICT_DUPLICATE (already_on_team) 409 Inline "This number is already on the team."
Manager/counsellor limit reached CONFLICT_STATE (max_managers/max_counsellors) 409 Inline with the current count
Edit or disable the primary manager CONFLICT_STATE (cannot_edit_primary/cannot_disable_primary) 409 Sheet "Contact support to change the primary manager" (M53)
Resend within 15 minutes RATE_LIMITED 429 "Try again in a few minutes."
Profile edit before approval CONFLICT_STATE (use_registration_basics) 409 Route to M21 InstituteBasicsEdit
Profile edit while in review CONFLICT_STATE (in_review) 409 Read-only banner; refetch
Profile/batch edit while suspended CONFLICT_STATE (suspended) 409 Banner "Your listing is paused. Contact support."
Starred field changed without a reason VALIDATION_FAILED 422 Inline reason field required
Batch limit reached CONFLICT_STATE (max_batches) 409 "Deactivate an old batch first."
Seats available > total VALIDATION_FAILED 422 Inline under Seats available
Stale edit (staff, profile or batch) VERSION_CONFLICT 409 "Updated on another device. Review and save again."
Network / 5xx GATEWAY_ERROR / INTERNAL_ERROR 502 / 500 Retry; form values kept

19. Testing Scenarios

  • T24.1 Happy path (Maestro institute_staff_invite): manager invites a counsellor by phone; invitee signs in with that phone, sees the pending invite, joins (M21 BR-21.8); inviter and primary get the "joined your team" push.
  • T24.2 Invite a phone already active on the team → already_on_team; invite a 4th manager → max_managers.
  • T24.3 Resend within 15 minutes of the first invite → RATE_LIMITED; after 15 minutes → invited_at updated, one row still.
  • T24.4 Counsellor calls POST /institute/staff/invite, PATCH /institute/profile or POST /institute/batches → 403 on each.
  • T24.5 Attempt to PATCH/DELETE the primary manager's row → cannot_edit_primary / cannot_disable_primary.
  • T24.6 Manager disables a counsellor → the counsellor's active session gets FORBIDDEN on its next call and is signed out; institute_managers.status = 'disabled'.
  • T24.7 Manager disables themself → their own session is revoked and the app navigates to Login.
  • T24.8 PATCH /institute/profile on a draft institute → use_registration_basics; on pending → in_review; on approved → succeeds.
  • T24.9 Changing addressLine without reason → VALIDATION_FAILED; with a reason → succeeds and writes profile_changed_after_approval-style audit with the reason.
  • T24.10 Changing cityId also sets the current institute_ratings.next_review_due to today.
  • T24.11 Batch: seatsAvailable greater than seatsTotal → VALIDATION_FAILED; adding a 51st active batch → max_batches; soft-deleted batch never reappears.
  • T24.12 Suspended institute: PATCH /institute/profile and POST /institute/batches both → suspended; GETs still return 200.
  • T24.13 Stale If-Match on staff edit, profile edit and batch edit each → VERSION_CONFLICT.

21. Future Scalability Notes

  • Granular per-staff permissions (e.g. a counsellor who can also manage batches) instead of the fixed two roles.
  • Staff activity log visible to the manager (last enquiry handled, last sign-in).
  • A "meet our team" section on the public profile (photo, designation) sourced from this staff list.
  • Branches/chains sharing one staff directory across several institute records (tracked in M21's scalability notes too).
  • Bulk facilities/photos import when onboarding a chain of centres.
  • Admin portal additions: none; Admin M24 and M25 already cover the same data for support.

Module 25 · Institute Teacher Management

Phase 5 · Institute · Used by: Institute manager (add, edit, remove, assign, link), counsellor (view only), teacher (accept/decline a link invite from their own app) · Depends on: M00 (masters, uploads, bootstrap limits), M24 (manager role check), M16 (teacher verification status, for linking only approved teachers); Admin M26 · New tables: none · Uses: institute_teachers, institute_teacher_subjects, institute_teacher_classes, teachers, institute_managers, subjects, classes, files, audit_logs · Build estimate: 3–4 days

1. Module Purpose

Lets an institute manager build and maintain the faculty list shown on the institute's public profile: add a teacher by name and phone, assign their subjects and classes, edit or remove them, and — when a listed teacher already has their own approved GuruConnect profile — send them a link request that only the teacher can accept from their own app. It owns no new tables (institute_teachers and its subject/class join tables belong to Admin M26); this module is the only place the app writes to them, always through the manager-only check defined in M24. The 25-teacher limit, the id_pending display rule, and the teacher-side accept/decline flow are the trickiest parts.

2. User Stories

  • As an institute manager, I want to add our six faculty members with their subjects and classes so that parents can see who teaches what.
  • As a manager, I want to search for a teacher's GuruConnect code and link her listing to her verified profile so that her trust score shows on our page.
  • As a teacher who already has a GuruConnect profile, I want to see and approve (or decline) an institute's request to link me so that I control what appears under my name.
  • As a manager, I want to remove a teacher who left without deleting the historical record so that support can still see who taught what and when.
  • As an institute counsellor, I want to see the faculty list (read-only) so that I can answer a parent's question about who teaches Class 12 Chemistry.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-25.1 App rules. Add / edit / remove / assign / link require an active institute_managers row with staff_role = 'manager' (M24 BR-24.1); counsellors get FORBIDDEN on every write and can only call the GET endpoints. Teachers only ever see their own pending invites (BR-25.6) — they can't browse or search institute teacher lists.

BR-25.2 Add — POST /institute/teachers, one transaction.

  1. Caller is an active manager. InstituteTeacherSchema: fullName 2–100 chars, phone E.164, qualification ≤ 120 chars optional, experienceYears 0–60 optional, photoFileId optional (confirmed teacher_photo upload, gc-public), subjectIds 1–6 active subjects, classIds 1–10 active classes, scheduleText ≤ 120 chars, isVisible default true.
  2. Phone uniqueness among this institute's non-removed rows is enforced by uq_institute_teachers_phone; a duplicate returns 409 CONFLICT_DUPLICATE, details.reason = "already_listed".
  3. Soft abuse cap: at most 50 non-removed rows total (active + id_pending) per institute regardless of the teacher limit, so a manager can't spam invites — 409 CONFLICT_STATE, details.reason = "too_many_pending". This is separate from BR-25.7's 25-active-teacher limit, which is checked only when a row is about to become active.
  4. INSERT institute_teachers (institute_id, teacher_id = NULL, full_name, phone, qualification, experience_years, photo_file_id, schedule_text, status = 'id_pending', is_visible, added_by_manager_id = caller's staff id); INSERT institute_teacher_subjects / institute_teacher_classes for each id.
  5. Send an SMS to the phone: "Apex JEE Academy added you as faculty on GuruConnect. Verify your identity: <link>." (the identity check itself is outside this app — Admin M26 FR-26.4 — see BR-25.7).
  6. INSERT audit_logs app.institute_teacher_added.

BR-25.3 Edit — PATCH /institute/teachers/:id, If-Match on institute_teachers.updated_at.

  • Manager only; the row must belong to the caller's institute and not be removed (409 CONFLICT_STATE, details.reason = "removed").
  • Editable: fullName, qualification, experienceYears, photoFileId, scheduleText, isVisible, and — replacing the full set — subjectIds/classIds (same limits as BR-25.2; omitted means unchanged).
  • phone is not editable here (it's what the ID-check SMS and any pending link invite are keyed to); a wrong number is fixed by removing the row and adding a new one.
  • INSERT audit_logs app.institute_teacher_updated (changed fields).

BR-25.4 Remove — DELETE /institute/teachers/:id { reason? }.

  • Manager only; sets status = 'removed', removed_at = now(), removed_reason (optional, ≤ 200 chars — shorter and optional here, unlike M24's disable reason, since it's the manager's own team). The row is never deleted (kept for history, matching the DB comment) and the phone becomes free for a new add. Any pending link invite for the row (BR-25.5) is cancelled. If teacher_id was set, it is left in place for history; the teacher's own profile is untouched.
  • INSERT audit_logs app.institute_teacher_removed.

BR-25.5 Link to an existing GuruConnect teacher — POST /institute/teachers/link { instituteTeacherId, teacherCode }.

  1. Manager only; the row must be id_pending or active, not removed, and not already linked (teacher_id IS NULL).
  2. Look up teachers by public_code (case-insensitive, e.g. GC-T10252); it must be verification_status = 'approved' and account_status = 'active', else 409 CONFLICT_STATE, details.reason = "teacher_not_approved".
  3. Its phone must equal the institute teacher row's phone (normalised E.164); otherwise 409 CONFLICT_STATE, details.reason = "phone_mismatch", message "This code belongs to a different phone number." — a teacher can be listed under several institutes (Admin FR-26.5), so the check is about identity, not exclusivity.
  4. No DB write yet: a pending invite is written to Redis, inst-teacher-link:<instituteTeacherId> = { teacherId, teacherCode, requestedByManagerId, requestedAt } (TTL 7 days) and the id is added to a set teacher-link-invites:<teacherId> (same TTL) so the teacher's own list can find it. institute_teachers.teacher_id is only set on acceptance (BR-25.6).
  5. Push to the teacher if they have a registered device (BR-25.6's events); INSERT audit_logs app.institute_teacher_link_requested.
  6. A manager can re-send the same link request at any time (overwrites the Redis entry and its TTL); cancelling is implicit — removing the institute teacher row (BR-25.4) also deletes the Redis key.

BR-25.6 Teacher side — GET /teacher/institute-invites, POST /teacher/institute-invites/:instituteTeacherId/accept, .../decline.

  • GET lists every non-expired Redis invite in the caller teacher's set: institute name, logo, requested date, days left.
  • Accept, one transaction: verify the Redis key still names this teacherId; re-check the 25-active-teacher limit for that institute (BR-25.7) — over the limit, the accept fails with 409 LIMIT_REACHED, details.reason = "institute_max_teachers" and the invite stays pending (the manager is told to make room); otherwise UPDATE institute_teachers SET teacher_id, status = 'active', delete the Redis key and set entry, INSERT audit_logs app.institute_teacher_linked, notify the requesting manager.
  • Decline: deletes the Redis key and set entry only, no table write; notifies the requesting manager. A declined institute teacher row stays id_pending and unlinked; the manager may try again later (e.g. after confirming the right code with the teacher).
  • An invite left untouched for 7 days simply disappears from GET /teacher/institute-invites (Redis TTL); the manager re-sends it to renew.

BR-25.7 The 25-teacher limit and id_pending → active. limits.institute_max_teachers (read from GET /bootstrap, M01 — public setting, default 25) counts only rows with status = 'active' for the institute. A row becomes active in exactly two ways, both re-checking the limit at the moment of transition: (a) accepting a link invite (BR-25.6) or (b) completing GuruConnect's lightweight ID check outside this app (Admin M26 FR-26.4 — a phone-verified Aadhaar/PAN self-declaration, not a screen this module owns; support can also flip it manually). Adding a teacher (BR-25.2) never itself hits the limit, since new rows start id_pending. GET /institute/teachers returns meta.activeCount/meta.limit so the manager sees how much room is left before inviting more.

BR-25.8 Public display rule (read by M32, informational here). A row appears on the institute's public profile only when is_visible = true and status <> 'removed': active rows show the Verified tick (and the linked teacher's trust score, if any); id_pending rows show without the tick. removed rows never appear regardless of is_visible.

BR-25.9 Rate limits. POST /institute/teachers 20/day per institute; POST /institute/teachers/link 10/day per institute; PATCH/DELETE 60/day.

Chemistry"), "Experience (years)" (number pad), "Photo" (avatar picker), "Subjects" (chip multi-select, 1–6, opens a SubjectSheet), "Classes" (chip multi-select, 1–10), "Schedule" (placeholder "e.g. Weekdays 4–7 PM"), "Show on our public profile" switch. 12. PostgreSQL Tables & Columns

Existing tables this module reads or writes (full definitions in the owning module)

Table Owner Purpose
institute_teachers Admin M26 Teachers listed under an institute. Added, edited and removed only by an institute manager (or an admin).
institute_teacher_subjects Admin M26 Subjects assigned to an institute teacher.
institute_teacher_classes Admin M26 Classes assigned to an institute teacher.
teachers Admin M16 Teacher profile and verification state. One row per teacher app account.
institute_managers Admin M25 App accounts that act for an institute. Exactly one active primary manager; counsellors can only handle leads.
subjects Admin M12 Subjects, exams and skills teachers can teach.
classes Admin M11 Grades and levels learners study at, from Class 1 to competitive exam preparation.
files Admin M00 Metadata for every uploaded object stored in S3 / Cloudflare R2. Binary content never touches PostgreSQL.
audit_logs Admin M00 Append-only record of every admin action and security event. Never updated or deleted by the application.
  • institute_teachers: this module inserts (add), updates (edit, link accept, remove) and reads every row of the caller's institute; teacher_id is set only on link acceptance, never directly by PATCH.
  • institute_teacher_subjects / institute_teacher_classes: replaced wholesale on add/edit (delete-then-insert in the same transaction) inside packages/shared's InstituteTeacherSchema validated set.
  • teachers: read-only, to validate a link's target (public_code, verification_status, account_status, phone) and to show the linked trust score.
  • institute_managers: read-only, for the manager role check (M24) and added_by_manager_id.
  • The pending-link invite itself is not a database row — it lives in Redis (BR-25.5/25.6) with a 7-day TTL, so an invite that is never answered simply disappears without leaving a stale table row.

14. State Management

  • Query keys: instituteTeacherKeys.list, teacherInvitesKeys.mine (teacher side). Persisted; staleTime 30 s.
  • After add/edit/remove/link: invalidate instituteTeacherKeys.list, dashboardKeys.institute (M23 counts and tasks).
  • After accept/decline: invalidate teacherInvitesKeys.mine; accept also invalidates the teacher's own teacherKeys.dashboard (M18, now listed under one more institute) and, for the institute side, a push-triggered refetch of instituteTeacherKeys.list.
  • isVisible toggle is optimistic (reversible, idempotent); everything else waits for the server.

15. Offline Handling

  • Teacher list and detail render from cache with "Updated …".
  • Add, edit, remove and link are class 2 (save draft, submit online): the form keeps values while offline, submit disabled with a hint.
  • Teacher accept/decline are class 3 (online only, security-adjacent — they change what's shown under the teacher's name) — buttons disabled offline.

16. Push Notification Requirements

Event Recipient Title / Body Deep link Category Urgent
Link request sent Teacher (if a device is registered) "Apex JEE Academy wants to list you" / "Confirm or decline in 2 taps." /teacher/institute-invites account No
Link accepted Requesting manager and primary manager "Imran Qureshi confirmed" / "He's now listed as verified faculty." /institute/teachers account No
Link declined Requesting manager "Request declined" / "Imran Qureshi declined the link request." /institute/teachers account No
Teacher limit reached on accept Primary manager "Teacher limit reached" / "Remove a teacher or contact us to add more than 25." /institute/teachers account No

17. Security Rules

  • Every endpoint scopes writes by iid from the token; a :id from another institute returns NOT_FOUND.
  • Manager-only enforcement is the same check as M24 (institute_managers.staff_role = 'manager', status = 'active'); counsellors get FORBIDDEN, not a hidden button.
  • Teacher accept/decline check the Redis invite's teacherId against the caller's own pid; a teacher can never act on another teacher's invite even with a guessed instituteTeacherId.
  • Linking requires an exact phone match (BR-25.5.3) so a manager cannot attach an institute listing to an unrelated approved teacher just by knowing their code.
  • The full PAN/Aadhaar the ID-check flow may collect never touches this module or its logs; it is handled entirely by the process referenced in BR-25.7(b).

18. Error Handling

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
Counsellor calls a write endpoint FORBIDDEN 403 Toast "Only a manager can manage teachers."
Duplicate phone in this institute CONFLICT_DUPLICATE (already_listed) 409 Inline "This teacher is already listed."
Too many pending/active rows CONFLICT_STATE (too_many_pending) 409 "Remove someone before adding more."
Link: teacher not approved CONFLICT_STATE (teacher_not_approved) 409 "This teacher isn't verified yet."
Link: phone mismatch CONFLICT_STATE (phone_mismatch) 409 "This code belongs to a different phone number."
Accept over the 25-teacher limit LIMIT_REACHED (institute_max_teachers) 409 Teacher sees "This institute is full right now."; manager gets the reminder push
Invite expired (7 days) NOT_FOUND 404 Row simply absent from the invites list; manager can re-send
Edit/remove a removed row CONFLICT_STATE (removed) 409 Refetch, row shows Removed
Stale edit VERSION_CONFLICT 409 "Updated on another device. Review and save again."
Network / 5xx GATEWAY_ERROR / INTERNAL_ERROR 502 / 500 Retry; form values kept

19. Testing Scenarios

  • T25.1 Happy path (Maestro institute_teacher_add): manager adds a teacher with 2 subjects and 3 classes → id_pending row, subject/class rows inserted, SMS sent (test double).
  • T25.2 Duplicate phone in the same institute → already_listed; same phone at a different institute succeeds.
  • T25.3 Link flow: manager sends a link with a matching phone and approved code → Redis invite created; teacher's GET /teacher/institute-invites lists it; teacher accepts → teacher_id set, status = active, both notified.
  • T25.4 Link with a mismatched phone → phone_mismatch; with an unapproved teacher code → teacher_not_approved.
  • T25.5 Teacher declines → no institute_teachers change; manager gets the decline push; manager can re-send later.
  • T25.6 Accept when the institute already has 25 active teachers → institute_max_teachers; invite remains listed for the teacher.
  • T25.7 Invite left 8 days → gone from GET /teacher/institute-invites (TTL expired); manager re-sends successfully.
  • T25.8 Counsellor calls every write endpoint → 403 on each; GET /institute/teachers still works for them.
  • T25.9 Edit reassigns subjects/classes → old join rows replaced, not accumulated (count matches the new set exactly).
  • T25.10 Remove a linked teacher → status = removed, teacher_id left as-is for history; the phone can be reused for a new add.
  • T25.11 isVisible = false teacher with active status is fetched by GET /institute/teachers but is documented (BR-25.8) as excluded from M32's public profile query.
  • T25.12 Stale If-Match on edit → VERSION_CONFLICT.

21. Future Scalability Notes

  • An in-app identity check for directly-added (unlinked) institute teachers, instead of relying on the external lightweight flow (Admin M26 FR-26.4) to move them out of id_pending.
  • Per-batch teacher assignment (which teacher teaches which institute_batches row) once batches carry a teacher reference.
  • Bulk import (CSV) of a faculty list for onboarding a large institute.
  • Teacher-visible history of which institutes have listed them, with an option to unlink themselves.
  • Public faculty change history on the profile ("3 new teachers this term").
  • Admin portal additions: none; Admin M26 already covers support overrides and the cross-institute phone/teacher search.

Module 26 · Institute Rating Display

Phase 5 · Institute · Used by: Any signed-in user and limited public viewers (see the rating on a profile, search card or share link), institute staff (see the same numbers plus the next review date and history) · Depends on: M00, M22 (verification produces the first rating), M23 (embeds the rating card); Admin M27, Admin M34 · New tables: none · Uses: institutes, institute_ratings, institute_reviews · Build estimate: 2–3 days

1. Module Purpose

Displays GuruConnect's own evaluation of an institute — Infrastructure, Faculty and Overall ratings, sourced from the current row of institute_ratings (Admin M27) — next to, but never mixed with, the separate average of parent and student reviews (institutes.user_rating_avg/user_rating_count, Admin M34). It is the single place the mobile app reads a rating summary from, so M22's verification screen, M23's dashboard, M32's profile view and M35's institute reviews screen all call the same shape. Institute staff additionally see when the rating was last updated, when the next re-evaluation is due, and a short version history — information a parent never sees.

2. User Stories

  • As a parent comparing two coaching centres, I want to see GuruConnect's Infrastructure and Faculty scores, not just star reviews, so that I get an independent signal alongside what other parents said.
  • As a parent, I want the GuruConnect rating and the parent-review average kept clearly separate so that I don't mistake one for the other.
  • As an institute manager, I want to see exactly when we'll next be re-evaluated so that I can prepare the campus in time.
  • As a manager whose infrastructure score dropped, I want to read the public summary GuruConnect wrote so that I understand what to improve.
  • As any signed-in user browsing search results, I want a quick rating chip on each card so that I can shortlist without opening every profile.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-26.1 What's shown, and where.

Surface Fields Source
Search card / list row (M28) InstituteRatingChip — overall rating only (★ 4.5) or "Not yet rated" institutes.overall_rating
Profile header (M32) InstituteRatingChip + user rating badge, separately labelled institutes.overall_rating, user_rating_avg/user_rating_count
Verification status (M22) Same chip plus badge once approved this module's summary service
Dashboard rating card (M23) Chip + ScoreBars (Infrastructure, Faculty) this module's summary service
InstituteRatingDetail (public) Overall, Infrastructure, Faculty, evaluation method + date, public summary, badge, user review average with distribution link (M35), 3 latest published reviews preview GET /institutes/:id/rating
InstituteRatingDetail (institute staff, own institute) Everything above plus next review date, a short history of past overall ratings by date GET /institute/rating
Only these three numbers ever leave the server for a rating: overall (1–5, half steps), infrastructure (0–10) and faculty (0–10) — institute_ratings.student_feedback_score, trustworthiness_score, criteria, notes and rated_by are never returned to the app at any role, matching Admin M27 FR-27.5.

BR-26.2 Summary service (InstituteRatingService.summary(instituteId, { asStaff })), used by this module's two endpoints and read directly by M22 and M23.

  1. Load institutes (overall_rating, infrastructure_score, faculty_score, is_verified_badge, user_rating_avg, user_rating_count) and the current institute_ratings row (is_current = true) if one exists.
  2. No current row (institute not yet evaluated — always true before the first evaluation, and possible briefly right after evaluation_done if the draft hasn't been submitted): return hasRating: false with a friendly placeholder; every numeric field is null. This is a normal 200, not an error.
  3. With a current row: overall, infrastructure, faculty from the cached institutes columns (kept in lock-step with institute_ratings by Admin M27 FR-27.3, so this module never recomputes them); evaluationMethod, evaluatedAt (submitted_at), publicSummary from the current institute_ratings row itself (not cached on institutes).
  4. asStaff = true adds nextReviewDue (institute_ratings.next_review_due) and history — up to 5 rows, { version, overall, evaluatedAt }, newest first, from all institute_ratings rows of the institute regardless of status.
  5. Result is cached in Redis 5 minutes per (instituteId, asStaff); a webhook from Admin M27's submit step (FR-27.3) purges both cache entries for that institute.

BR-26.3 GET /institutes/:id/rating (Any user, limited for signed-out/shared-link viewers). Public summary (BR-26.2 step 3) plus userRating: { avg, count } and, when count ≥ 3, recentReviews: the 3 latest institute_reviews rows with status = 'published', newest first ({ id, rating, comment excerpt (≤ 140 chars), authorType, publishedAt } — no author name, matching M35's masking). Institute soft-deleted → 404 NOT_FOUND. A suspended institute (account_status = 'suspended') still returns its rating (rating and suspension are independent; M32 shows the suspension banner separately).

BR-26.4 GET /institute/rating (Institute staff, any role — managers and counsellors both just view). Same payload as BR-26.3 for the caller's own iid, plus nextReviewDue and history (BR-26.2 step 4). When nextReviewDue is within 30 days, the response adds reviewDueSoon: true so the app can show an informational line — never a task or a blocking banner, since re-evaluation scheduling is entirely Admin M27's process.

BR-26.5 Never mixing the two numbers. Every screen that shows both labels them separately — "4.5 GuruConnect rating" and "4.7 from 486 parent & student reviews" — and never averages or re-weights them client-side (BR-35.8 states the same rule from the reviews side; this module is where the rule is defined once and both screens follow it).

BR-26.6 Formatting. Overall rating: one decimal out of 5 ("4.5", never "4.50"). Infrastructure/Faculty: one decimal out of 10. evaluationMethod maps to copy: site_visit → "Evaluated by an in-person visit", video_walkthrough → "Evaluated by video walkthrough", document_only → "Evaluated from documents". publicSummary is shown verbatim (already validated ≤ 200 chars, no contact details, by Admin M27) inside a quote card; null hides the card entirely rather than showing an empty one.

BR-26.7 Badge. badge mirrors institutes.is_verified_badge, granted and revoked only by Admin M23 (never by this module); it is shown next to the rating chip whenever true, independent of the numeric scores (a badge can in principle be revoked — e.g. for a policy issue — while the last rating stays on file, or a fresh rating can exist a few hours before the badge is (re-)granted).

BR-26.8 Caching and freshness. Both endpoints are Redis-cached 5 minutes per institute (BR-26.2 step 5); the app additionally treats the response as a persisted query with a 5-minute staleTime, so opening the same profile twice in a session rarely refetches. Pull-to-refresh on InstituteRatingDetail bypasses both caches once per 30 seconds.

BR-26.9 Rate limits. Default limits (conventions §5) apply; no endpoint here writes anything, so there is nothing to rate-limit beyond abuse of the public GET.

How we rate institutes InstituteRatingMethodSheet (bottom sheet) Plain-language explainer of the four criteria and the 1–5 scale

Two ScoreBars rows: "Infrastructure 8.8/10", "Faculty 9.1/10" (each bar 0–10, filled proportionally, number at the end — colour never the only signal, a numeric label always shown). Quote card (when present): "Well-run NEET centre with a separate biology lab." Divider. "What parents & students say" section: "4.7 ★ · 486 reviews" with a link "See all reviews" (→ M35), and up to 3 short review snippets ("★★★★★ · Faculty for JEE Physics is excellent… — Parent"). Footer link "How we rate institutes" → InstituteRatingMethodSheet. 7. UI Components & Component Tree

InstituteRatingDetailScreen
├─ RatingHero (overall, stars, VerifiedBadge, evaluation line)
├─ ScoreBars (infrastructure, faculty)
├─ PublicSummaryCard (hidden when null)
├─ NextReviewCard (staff only)
├─ RatingHistoryList (staff only)
├─ UserReviewSummaryRow (avg, count) → M35 InstituteReviews
├─ RecentReviewSnippet × ≤3
└─ MethodologyLink → InstituteRatingMethodSheet
InstituteRatingChip (used inline in M22/M23/M28/M32) — not a screen of its own
  • InstituteRatingChip({ overall, hasRating, size: 'sm'|'md', showLabel }) — the small badge embedded elsewhere; M35's screens call the same component under the alias GuruConnectRatingBadge (same props, same file) so both names resolve to one implementation.
  • ScoreBars({ infrastructure, faculty }) — accessible summary label, e.g. "Infrastructure 8.8 out of 10, Faculty 9.1 out of 10".
  • RatingHistoryList({ items }) — staff only, read-only.
  • Hooks: useInstituteRatingQuery(instituteId?) — calls GET /institute/rating when instituteId is omitted and the caller is institute staff, otherwise GET /institutes/:id/rating; useInstituteRatingMethodCopy() (static content, no network).

8. Validation Rules

No user input — this module only reads. The single parameter, instituteId in the path, is validated as an existing, non-deleted institute; an unknown or malformed id returns 404 NOT_FOUND rather than 422, since it's a route parameter, not a form field.

9. API Endpoints

Method Path Auth Description
GET /institutes/:id/rating Any user (public, limited for signed-out) Public rating summary, user review average, up to 3 recent reviews
GET /institute/rating Institute staff Same summary for the caller's own institute, plus next review date and history

Uses: M35 GET /institutes/:id/reviews (full list, when the user taps "See all reviews"); read by M22 GET /institute/verification (rating field), M23 GET /institute/dashboard (kpis.rating), M32 GET /institutes/:idOrSlug (profile header) — all three embed this module's summary shape rather than calling it a second time from the client.

12. PostgreSQL Tables & Columns

Existing tables this module reads or writes (full definitions in the owning module)

Table Owner Purpose
institutes Admin M22 Coaching centres, tuition centres, schools and academies. Rated by GuruConnect after verification.
institute_ratings Admin M27 Evaluations by GuruConnect admins. The latest submitted version is current and drives the public rating.
institute_reviews Admin M34 Reviews of institutes by parents and students.
