14. State Management

  • Query keys: ratingKeys.public(instituteId), ratingKeys.mine. Persisted; staleTime 5 minutes, matching the server cache.
  • No mutations, so no invalidation rules of its own; other modules invalidate these keys when they know a rating changed — M23 already lists verification push category as a dashboard-refresh trigger, which covers a fresh rating too.

15. Offline Handling

  • Fully readable offline from cache with "Updated …"; a first-ever open with no cache shows the standard error state with Retry.
  • No writes exist in this module.

16. Push Notification Requirements

Event Recipient Title / Body Deep link Category Urgent
New GuruConnect rating submitted (Admin M27 FR-27.3) All active managers "Your GuruConnect rating is 4.5" / "Read what our evaluator noted about Apex JEE Academy." /institute/rating verification No
Re-evaluation due in 14 days (Admin M27 FR-27.6, informational) Primary manager "Your next evaluation is coming up" / "GuruConnect will re-evaluate Apex JEE Academy around 14 Aug 2027." /institute/rating verification No

17. Security Rules

  • The public endpoint never returns notes, criteria, sub-scores other than infrastructure/faculty, or rated_by; GET /institute/rating adds only nextReviewDue and history (both harmless to the institute's own staff) — the private fields stay withheld even for staff.
  • GET /institute/rating scopes strictly by the caller's iid; there is no way to pass another institute's id to this endpoint.
  • No PII is involved; recent-review snippets reuse M35's existing masking (no author name).

18. Error Handling

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
Institute not found or deleted NOT_FOUND 404 "This is no longer available." with back button
Institute exists, never evaluated — 200 hasRating: false placeholder, not an error
Institute staff without an active row calling /institute/rating FORBIDDEN 403 Sign out, same as other institute-staff endpoints
Network / 5xx GATEWAY_ERROR / INTERNAL_ERROR 502 / 500 Cached summary + toast; ErrorState with Retry when no cache

19. Testing Scenarios

  • T26.1 Happy path (Maestro institute_rating_view): open a search card's rating chip → InstituteRatingDetail shows overall/infrastructure/faculty, evaluation date, public summary, badge and 3 recent reviews.
  • T26.2 Institute with no current rating → hasRating: false; chip on the card and profile reads "Not yet rated" instead of a number.
  • T26.3 GuruConnect rating and user rating are rendered as two separately labelled numbers on the same screen (never combined into one value).
  • T26.4 Staff view of the caller's own institute includes nextReviewDue and history; the same institute viewed via the public endpoint by another user does not.
  • T26.5 reviewDueSoon: true when nextReviewDue is within 30 days; false otherwise.
  • T26.6 publicSummary: null hides the quote card entirely (no empty card rendered).
  • T26.7 Suspended institute still returns its rating; the suspension banner is drawn by M32/M23, not hidden by this module.
  • T26.8 Recent reviews only include status = 'published' rows; a flagged or hidden review of the same institute never appears.
  • T26.9 Cache: two GET /institutes/:id/rating calls inside 5 minutes hit Redis once; a rating resubmission (Admin M27) purges both public and mine cache entries for that institute before the next call.
  • T26.10 Unknown instituteId → 404 NOT_FOUND, not 422.
  • T26.11 Offline with a cached rating → renders with "Updated …"; no cache and offline → ErrorState with Retry.
  • T26.12 InstituteRatingChip and GuruConnectRatingBadge (M35) render identical output for the same props (shared component, verified by a snapshot test).

20. Audit Log Events

None. Every endpoint in this module is a read; nothing here changes data, so there is nothing to audit (Admin M27's own submission and M34's review moderation carry their own audit trails).

21. Future Scalability Notes

  • A public "rating history" timeline on the profile (currently staff-only) once ratings are frequent enough to be a positive signal rather than noise.
  • Featured/leaderboard rails ("Top-rated JEE coaching in Bengaluru") built on Admin M27's leaderboard endpoint.
  • Push a comparison ("your rating vs. similar institutes in your city") using anonymised medians.
  • Cache the summary in the CDN edge for the public endpoint once traffic justifies it (currently Redis only).
  • Admin portal additions: none; Admin M27 already owns rating creation, submission and the leaderboard.

Module 27 · Teacher Search

Phase 6 · Search & Discovery · Used by: Learner (parent or student, browse also Public-limited on shared links) · Depends on: M00 (masters, events), M07 (active child context), M08 (v0 rails this replaces for "see all"), M19 (availability shown on cards), M29 (Advanced Filters sheet), M31 (profile), M42 (trust score); Admin M16, M18, M19, M20, M36 · New tables: user_search_history · Uses: teachers, teacher_subjects, teacher_classes, teacher_locations, teacher_teaching_modes, trust_scores, areas, cities · Build estimate: 6–7 days

1. Module Purpose

Lets a parent or student find teachers by name, subject or structured filters (Subject, Class, City, Area, Experience, Rating, Trust Score, Online, Offline) and returns a ranked, paged list that blends text relevance, trust and rating with fair, capped placement for featured and premium teachers. It owns user_search_history, powering "Recent searches" and autocomplete suggestions, and is the base signal M30's Recommendation Engine reads from. Results only ever include teachers who are actually bookable: approved, active and not paused.

2. User Stories

  • As a parent in Bengaluru, I want to search "maths class 8" and see nearby, well-rated teachers first so that I don't scroll through irrelevant ones.
  • As a student prepping for JEE, I want to filter by Subject = Physics and Trust Score ≥ 80 so that I only see teachers I can rely on.
  • As a parent on 3G, I want my last search to load from cache instantly while fresh results come in behind it.
  • As a new teacher who just got approved, I want to appear in search the moment my profile is approved, not the next day.
  • As a parent comparing tutors, I want to tell Online from Offline (home tuition) teachers at a glance so that I filter to what actually works for us.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-27.1 Entry and default filters. TeacherSearch opens with subjectIds, classId and cityId pre-filled from the parent's active child (M07 useActiveChild()) or, for a student, from students.class_id/students.city_id; a signed-out or Public viewer gets no defaults. Filters live in useSearchFilters (Zustand, persisted per role), so returning to Search keeps the last filter set for the session; a fresh child selection resets subject/class only.

BR-27.2 Text query — trigram matching. q (2–60 chars) matches, using pg_trgm (extension CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm;, already required by M17 profile search — enabled once in the base migration):

  • similarity(teachers.full_name, q) >= 0.25 (name match), OR
  • similarity(subjects.name, q) >= 0.30 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(subjects.aliases) a WHERE similarity(a, q) >= 0.30) via the joined teacher_subjects. Matches are unioned and de-duplicated on teachers.id; textScore = GREATEST(name_sim, subject_sim). Empty q skips this branch entirely and ranks by structured relevance only. Required indexes (schema request, section below): idx_teachers_full_name_trgm ON teachers USING gin (full_name gin_trgm_ops), idx_subjects_name_trgm ON subjects USING gin (name gin_trgm_ops).

BR-27.3 Structured filters.

Filter Column(s) Behaviour
Subject teacher_subjects.subject_id IN (...) OR within the list, ANDed with other filters
Class teacher_classes.class_id = :classId exact match; board is a separate Advanced Filter (M29)
City teacher_locations.city_id = :cityId required for any location-bound result; Online-only teachers still need a primary city for display
Area teacher_locations.area_id = :areaId narrows within the city; ignored if not set
Experience teachers.experience_years >= :experienceMin steps 0, 1, 3, 5, 10 years
Rating teachers.rating_avg >= :ratingMin steps 3.0, 3.5, 4.0, 4.5
Trust Score trust_scores.score >= :trustScoreMin steps 60, 70, 80, 90
Mode see BR-27.5 online, offline, or both (default)
Multiple subjectIds and one classId at a time in v1 (matches how a parent's child is set up, M07); GET /search/filters (M29) supplies the option lists with facet counts.

BR-27.4 Eligibility (always applied, never a user-visible filter). A teacher appears in search only if: teachers.verification_status = 'approved', teachers.account_status = 'active', teachers.deleted_at IS NULL, and not currently paused — no teacher_time_off row with pause_leads = true and CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN starts_on AND ends_on. A teacher who pauses leads for an exam-season break disappears from search but their shared-link profile (M31) still resolves with an "Away until 12 Oct" banner.

BR-27.5 Online vs Offline. teaching_modes.code = 'online' is the only Online mode. Offline covers every mode where requires_location = true (home_tuition, offline_at_teachers_place, hybrid's in-person leg). mode = 'online' filters to teachers with a live teacher_teaching_modes row for the online mode (no location filter applied). mode = 'offline' requires a teacher_locations row for the search city whose travel_radius_km, from that location's lat/long, covers the search area's centroid (haversine, BR-27.6) — or, if no area is chosen, any location in the city. Default (mode unset) unions both, tagging each card Online / Offline / Online · Offline from the teacher's live teacher_teaching_modes.

BR-27.6 Distance and ranking — the query. One SQL statement (a CTE) per request:

  1. eligible — apply BR-27.4, then filters (subject/class/city/area/mode/experience/rating/trust), joining teacher_locations (nearest matching row per teacher when several), trust_scores, and the text branch (BR-27.2) when q is present.
  2. Distance (only when areaId or a device lat/long is given): distance_km = 2 * 6371 * asin(sqrt(sin(radians((lat2-lat1)/2))^2 + cos(radians(lat1))*cos(radians(lat2))*sin(radians((lon2-lon1)/2))^2)) between the teacher's location and the search area/city centroid; distanceScore = GREATEST(0, 1 - distance_km / GREATEST(travel_radius_km, 5)), else distanceScore = 0.5 (neutral) when no location signal.
  3. Normalise 0–1: trustNorm = trust_scores.score / 100, ratingNorm = teachers.rating_avg / 5, textNorm = textScore (already 0–1, 0 when no q).
  4. relevance = 0.30*textNorm + 0.25*trustNorm + 0.20*ratingNorm + 0.15*distanceScore + 0.10*availabilityBoost where availabilityBoost = 1 if the teacher has any teacher_availability row in the next 7 days else 0.4.
  5. Premium boost: +8 points (relevance is scaled ×100 first, so plain relevance*100, then +8 if teachers.is_premium AND premium_until > now()), capped so premium never overtakes a non-premium teacher more than 15 relevance points ahead — implemented as final = relevance*100 + LEAST(8, max(0, competitorGapAllowance)), in practice just the flat +8 since 8 < 15 always; documented here as the deliberate ceiling for future tuning.
  6. ORDER BY final DESC, teachers.rating_count DESC, teachers.id. Featured placement is layered on top, not part of final: on page 1 only, up to 3 teachers with is_featured AND featured_until > now() that also satisfy eligible are prepended, ranked among themselves by final, each carrying "featured": true and a "Featured" tag; they are removed from their natural position in the ranked list beneath so no teacher appears twice. Premium-boosted teachers are capped at 4 per page of 20 (the 5th-highest-scoring premium teacher on a page drops its +8 and is re-ranked on natural relevance) so premium can influence order but never fill a page.

BR-27.7 Suggestions / autocomplete — GET /search/suggestions?q=&target=. q ≥ 2 chars, debounced 250 ms client-side; target is teacher (default) or institute (M28 reuses this endpoint rather than owning a second one). For target=teacher, returns up to 8 items merged from: subject names/aliases (similarity >= 0.3, only subjects with is_active), teacher names (similarity >= 0.3, BR-27.4 eligibility, max 3), area/city names (similarity >= 0.3), and up to 2 "Popular searches" — the most frequent query_text values from user_search_history in the last 30 days for the same city, result_count > 0, grouped and capped. For target=institute, the teacher-name branch is replaced with an institute-name branch (similarity(institutes.name, q) >= 0.3, M28 BR-28.2 eligibility, max 3) and popular searches are filtered to user_search_history.target = 'institute'. Each item carries type (subject, teacher, institute, location, popular) so the app can route the tap directly (a teacher or institute suggestion opens its profile, not a filtered list).

BR-27.8 Recording a search. GET /search/teachers inserts one user_search_history row after the query executes (target = 'teacher', query_text, filters = the applied filter object as jsonb, child_id = the active child if a parent, result_count). To avoid bloat, the app only sends the "commit" signal (a logSearch: true flag on the request) when the user pauses typing for 800 ms, changes a filter, or taps Search — not on every keystroke; the server additionally de-duplicates: if the caller's last row (any time) has an identical filters hash within the last 5 minutes, it updates that row's result_count and created_at instead of inserting. Kept 180 days (nightly job hard-deletes older rows, per the table's purpose).

BR-27.9 Recent searches and clicks. GET /search/history returns the last 10 distinct rows (already de-duplicated by BR-27.8) newest first, each rendered as a chip ("Maths · Class 8 · Koramangala" or the raw query_text). DELETE /search/history clears all of the caller's rows; DELETE /search/history/:id removes one. When the user taps a result card from a search whose history row was just recorded, the app calls POST /search/history/:id/click { teacherId } (fire-and-forget, best-effort) which sets clicked_teacher_id; this is the strongest per-user relevance signal M30 reads. Only the caller's own row can be updated.

BR-27.10 Pagination. ?page=1&limit=20 (max limit 20). The single ranking query uses COUNT(*) OVER() so total and rows return in one round trip; meta.total is exact up to 1,000 — beyond that the query is capped with LIMIT 1000 inside the CTE before windowing and meta.total = 1000 with meta.totalIsFloor = true, and the app shows "1,000+ results — narrow your search" instead of a page count. meta.page, meta.totalPages (ceil(total/20), capped 50). Statement timeout 3 s; a timeout (rare, only pathological unfiltered nationwide queries) falls back to city-only + trust-sorted results and logs a Sentry warning.

BR-27.11 Zero results. When eligible returns 0 rows, the response includes meta.suggestions: the same query re-run once without the least-selective filter in this drop order — Area → Trust Score → Rating → Experience → Class — labelled "Try without {filter}", plus a count for each, computed in the same request (cheap, since eligibility is already narrow). The app renders these as one-tap "Try without Area (12 results)" chips above the empty state.

6. Screen Wireframe Description

SearchHome — header with segmented control "Teachers | Institutes" (Teachers active, green underline). Search bar "Search by subject, class or teacher name" with a leading search icon; typing 2+ chars opens the suggestions overlay: rows grouped "Subjects", "Teachers", "Locations", each with an icon and a highlighted matched substring; "Popular near you" chip row below the bar when the field is empty. Quick filter chips (horizontal scroll): "Subject", "Class", "Online", "Offline", "Near me" — tapping "Subject"/"Class" opens a single-select bottom sheet from masters; "Online"/"Offline" toggle directly. Section "Recent searches" — up to 5 chips with an "×" per chip and "See all" → RecentSearchesSheet. Section "Popular subjects near you" — chip grid from trending subjects.

TeacherSearchResults — sticky header: search bar (editable), row of active filter chips with counts ("Class 8", "Koramangala ×", "Trust 80+ ×") and a "Filters" button (badge = count) opening M29's sheet, "Sort" button opening SearchSortSheet. Result count line "128 teachers in Koramangala, Bengaluru". List of TeacherCards (FlashList): photo, name, "Featured" ribbon when applicable, subjects (max 3 + "+2"), experience "6 yrs experience", TrustScoreRing (small), RatingStars + count, mode chips "Online · Home tuition", PriceTag "From ₹500/hr", distance line "2.4 km away" when relevant, VerifiedBadge. Loading: 6 skeleton cards. Empty: illustration, "No teachers match these filters", suggestion chips (BR-27.11), button "Clear filters". Error: ErrorState with Retry. Offline: banner + last cached page, "Filters" disabled with hint.

SearchSortSheet — radio list: "Relevance (recommended)", "Highest rated", "Highest trust score", "Nearest first" (disabled with "Set your location or area" if no location signal), "Most experienced".

RecentSearchesSheet — list rows "Maths, Physics · Class 8 · Koramangala" with a timestamp ("2 hours ago") and a trailing ⋮ → "Delete"; header action "Clear all" (confirm sheet "Clear all recent searches?").

<details><summary>DDL</summary>

CREATE TABLE user_search_history (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES app_users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- Searcher
  target text NOT NULL CHECK (target IN ('teacher','institute')), -- What was searched
  query_text text, -- Free text, max 100 chars
  filters jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, -- Normalised filters, e.g. {"subjectIds":[…],"classId":"…","cityId":"…"}
  child_id uuid REFERENCES parent_children(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, -- Child the parent searched for, if chosen
  result_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Results returned
  clicked_teacher_id uuid REFERENCES teachers(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, -- First result opened
  clicked_institute_id uuid REFERENCES institutes(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, -- First result opened
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Searched
  deleted_at timestamptz -- Cleared by the user (soft delete)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_user_search_history_user ON user_search_history (user_id, created_at DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;

</details>

14. State Management

  • useSearchFilters (Zustand + MMKV, per role): { q, subjectIds, classId, cityId, areaId, experienceMin, ratingMin, trustScoreMin, mode, sort, setFilter(), reset() }.
  • Query keys: searchKeys.teachers(filters) (infinite, persisted only for page 1), searchKeys.suggestions(q) (not persisted, staleTime 0), searchKeys.history.
  • After useDeleteSearchHistoryMutation / clear-all: optimistic removal from searchKeys.history, rollback on error.
  • useLogSearchClick fires and forgets; no cache invalidation.

15. Offline Handling

  • Page 1 of the last few distinct filter sets is persisted (max 5 filter sets, LRU) so recent results open instantly; further pages are online-only.
  • Class 1 (queue offline): POST /search/history/:id/click queues and replays; harmless if the row was since deleted (server no-ops on NOT_FOUND).
  • Class 3 (online only): GET /search/teachers beyond page 1 and GET /search/suggestions need network; suggestions overlay shows nothing (no error) when offline.
  • Recent-search deletes are queued (class 1) and applied optimistically.

16. Push Notification Requirements

None. Search is a pull interaction; new-teacher and price-drop alerts for a saved filter set are M29's saved_searches alerts, not this module.

17. Security Rules

  • GET /search/teachers for a Public (signed-out) caller requires cityId (no nationwide scraping), omits trustScoreMin/ratingMin fine-grained filters, and returns only page 1 (page > 1 → 403 FORBIDDEN, details.reason = "signin_required").
  • Only eligible teachers (BR-27.4) are ever returned or suggested; a paused, rejected or suspended teacher's data never appears in search or suggestions even if q matches their name.
  • Rate limited per BR above; q is parameterised (no raw SQL interpolation) and length-capped to bound pg_trgm cost.
  • POST /search/history/:id/click checks user_search_history.user_id = sub before updating.
  • No PII in analytics; search_result_click events carry ids and position only.

18. Error Handling

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
Public caller, no cityId VALIDATION_FAILED 422 Prompt "Choose a city to see teachers near you."
Public caller, page > 1 FORBIDDEN (signin_required) 403 Sheet "Sign in to see more results"
Query timeout (BR-27.10) — (fallback response, no error) 200 Results still shown; no user-visible error
Invalid filter value VALIDATION_FAILED 422 Filter reset to default, toast "That filter was reset."
History item not caller's own NOT_FOUND 404 Row already removed from the list (idempotent)
Network / suggestions fails — — Overlay silently shows nothing; results screen shows ErrorState + Retry

19. Testing Scenarios

  • T27.1 Happy path (Maestro teacher_search_happy): open Search → type "maths" → suggestions appear → apply City + Trust Score 80+ → results ranked, Featured teachers pinned first 3 on page 1.
  • T27.2 q = "phyiscs" (typo) still matches "Physics" via trigram similarity ≥ 0.3.
  • T27.3 Teacher with pause_leads active today is absent from results and suggestions but resolves via a direct shared link (M31) with an Away banner.
  • T27.4 mode=offline, area 6 km from a teacher whose travel_radius_km = 5 → excluded; radius 10 → included with correct distanceKm.
  • T27.5 4 premium teachers already placed on page 1 → a 5th premium match is re-ranked on natural relevance only (no +8).
  • T27.6 Zero results for Area + Trust 90+ → suggestions list "Try without Area" and "Try without Trust Score 90+" with non-zero counts.
  • T27.7 Same filters searched twice within 5 minutes → one user_search_history row, result_count and created_at updated, not duplicated.
  • T27.8 Tap a result card → POST /search/history/:id/click sets clicked_teacher_id; offline tap queues and applies on reconnect.
  • T27.9 Public (signed-out) request without cityId → 422; with cityId and page=2 → 403 signin_required.
  • T27.10 Total capped at 1000 for an unfiltered citywide search; totalIsFloor = true and the app shows "1,000+ results".
  • T27.11 Offline: last searched filter set renders from cache instantly; scrolling to page 2 offline shows "Connect to the internet to see more."
  • T27.12 DELETE /search/history/:id for another user's row → 404, list unaffected.

20. Audit Log Events

None. Searches and suggestions are reads (BR-27.8 writes are an app-usage signal, not an auditable action) and are logged to user_search_history and analytics instead, per conventions §11.

21. Future Scalability Notes

  • Move ranking to OpenSearch/Elasticsearch once teachers passes ~200k rows and pg_trgm scan cost rises; keep the same scoring formula as the relevance function.
  • Personalise relevance weights per user from click-through (feeds into M30's model rather than duplicating logic here).
  • Location-aware suggestions using device GPS instead of area-name text once permission UX is validated.
  • Add subjectIds multi-select synonyms (e.g. "Maths" ↔ "Mathematics") as a small curated table instead of relying on aliases alone.
  • Schema requests: GIN trigram indexes on teachers.full_name and subjects.name (BR-27.2) — no new columns, index-only migration.

Module 28 · Institute Search

Phase 6 · Search & Discovery · Used by: Learner (parent or student, browse also Public-limited) · Depends on: M00 (masters, events), M27 (shared SearchHome toggle, suggestions pattern), M32 (profile), M35 (institute reviews for rating); Admin M22, M24, M27 · New tables: none · Uses: institutes, institute_batches, institute_ratings · Build estimate: 3–4 days

1. Module Purpose

The Institutes tab of Search: lets a parent or student find coaching centres, tuition centres, schools and academies filtered by Category (institute type), City and Rating, ranked by GuruConnect's independent rating rather than by a text-match score, since institutes compete on trust and infrastructure more than on keyword relevance. It shares SearchHome (M27) for the Teachers/Institutes toggle and reuses M27's suggestion and recent-search patterns without owning any tables of its own.

2. User Stories

  • As a parent choosing a coaching centre for JEE, I want to filter by Category = Coaching Centre and Rating ≥ 4 so that I only see well-evaluated ones.
  • As a student, I want to see which institutes run a batch for my class and subject so that I don't open ones that don't teach it.
  • As a parent new to a city, I want institutes near my area shown first so that daily commute is realistic.
  • As a parent on a slow connection, I want the last institute search to load instantly from cache.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-28.1 Entry and filters. Reached from SearchHome's "Institutes" toggle (M27) or the Institutes quick-access on the parent/student dashboard. Filters: institute_type (Category — one of coaching_centre, tuition_centre, school, music_school, coding_academy, language_institute, sports_academy, other), cityId (required), areaId (optional), ratingMin (steps 3.0, 3.5, 4.0, 4.5, matching institutes.overall_rating), plus an optional free-text q matched against institutes.name only (similarity(name, q) >= 0.3, same pg_trgm extension as M27; no separate index request since institutes.name is short and low-cardinality enough for a trigram scan at institute volumes — revisit if it passes 20k rows).

BR-28.2 Eligibility. Only verification_status = 'approved', account_status = 'active', deleted_at IS NULL. Unlike teachers, institutes have no per-day pause; a temporarily unavailable institute is handled by support suspending account_status (Admin M22), which already excludes it here.

BR-28.3 Ranking. No relevance blending — parents choose institutes on trust more than keyword match. ORDER BY (CASE WHEN :q IS NOT NULL THEN similarity(name, :q) ELSE 0 END) DESC, is_premium DESC, overall_rating DESC NULLS LAST, user_rating_count DESC, id. Institutes with is_premium AND premium_until > now() are boosted to sort immediately after any text match but are capped at 3 per page of 20 (same anti-domination rule as M27); beyond the cap, remaining premium institutes sort purely on rating. There is no "Featured" pinned strip for institutes in v1 (that placement type is teacher-only, tied to teachers.is_featured — institutes only have is_premium).

BR-28.4 Batch match (soft filter, not a hard exclude). When the search carries subjectIds/classId (passed through from a child's profile or the last teacher search, to keep the two tabs consistent), institutes with at least one live institute_batches row (is_active, deleted_at IS NULL) matching class_id and overlapping subject_ids are tagged hasMatchingBatch: true and shown a "Runs a Class 8 Physics batch" line on the card; they are not excluded when no batch matches, since many institutes list only current/enrolling batches and still take enquiries for others (M39 Contact Institute handles that).

BR-28.5 Card summary fields. Each result carries: name, logo, institute type label, area/city, overall_rating (x.x/5) with user_rating_count, infrastructure_score (x.x/10) when present, Verified badge, fee_min_paise–fee_max_paise range when set, and up to 2 matching batch names (BR-27.4-style tag). Institutes with no institute_ratings row yet (freshly approved, evaluation pending) show "Evaluation in progress" instead of a rating and sort after all rated institutes at any given premium tier.

BR-28.6 Pagination. Same shape as M27 BR-27.10: page-based, limit 20 (max), COUNT(*) OVER() in one query, meta.total exact up to 1,000 with the same totalIsFloor flag. Institute volumes are far lower than teacher volumes, so the 3 s statement timeout and fallback are unlikely to trigger but are implemented identically for consistency.

BR-28.7 Recording and suggestions. This module does not own user_search_history (M27 does) but writes to it identically: GET /search/institutes with logSearch: true inserts a row with target = 'institute', the same de-duplication window (5 minutes) and 180-day retention. Suggestions for the institute tab reuse M27's GET /search/suggestions?target=institute (M27 adds the target parameter to also match institutes.name and returns type: "institute" items) rather than a second endpoint — this module has no suggestions endpoint of its own.

  • Distance-based ranking (haversine, like M27) once institute density per city justifies it — today a city-level list is small enough that rating order reads better than distance order.
  • Batch-level search ("show only institutes with an open Class 10 CBSE batch starting this month") as a dedicated filter once institute_batches volume supports it.

Module 29 · Advanced Filters

Phase 6 · Search & Discovery · Used by: Learner · Depends on: M00 (masters, push), M27 (teacher search this filters), M28 (institute search this filters); Admin M16, M17, M18, M19, M20 · New tables: saved_searches · Uses: teacher_availability, teacher_fee_plans · Build estimate: 4–5 days

1. Module Purpose

The full filter sheet behind M27 and M28's "Filters" button: fee range (from teacher_fee_plans), availability days/time (from teacher_availability), gender, languages, verified-only, demo-available, board and teacher category for teacher search, plus facet counts next to every option so a parent can see before tapping whether a filter narrows to 40 teachers or 2. It owns saved_searches — a named filter set with an optional daily alert email/push when new matching teachers are approved or a new matching institute batch opens.

2. User Stories

  • As a parent with a ₹500–₹800/hr budget, I want to filter by fee range so that I don't browse tutors I can't afford.
  • As a parent who only wants a female tutor for her daughter, I want a gender filter so that results match her comfort.
  • As a parent who works late, I want to filter by evening availability so that only teachers who can actually take that slot show up.
  • As a parent who searches every week for a Hindi-speaking maths tutor in HSR Layout, I want to save that search and get notified the moment a new one is approved.
  • As a student wanting a free trial first, I want a "Demo available" filter so that I only see teachers offering one.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-29.1 Filter sheet contents (teacher target). In addition to M27's basic filters (Subject, Class, City, Area, Experience, Rating, Trust Score, Mode):

Filter Source Values
Fee range teacher_fee_plans.amount_paise (per matching fee_unit, subject_id/class range if set) Slider ₹100–₹5,000/hr in ₹50 steps (per-hour plans); per-month and per-course plans are converted to an implied hourly rate at 4 sessions/week × 4 weeks for filtering purposes only, never shown as the displayed price
Availability teacher_availability.day_of_week, start_time/end_time Day chips (Mon–Sun) + time-of-day chips (Morning 6–12, Afternoon 12–17, Evening 17–21, Night 21–23); a teacher matches if any row overlaps any selected day × time-of-day combination
Gender teachers.gender Female, Male, Other, Any (default)
Languages teachers.languages (text[]) Multi-select from the distinct values seeded (English, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Bengali, …); teacher matches if any selected language is in their array
Verified only teachers.is_verified_badge Toggle
Demo available teachers.demo_available Toggle
Board teacher_classes.board_id Single-select from /masters boards, only enabled once a Class is chosen
Teacher category teachers.category_id Single-select from /masters teacher categories (Home Tutor, Coaching Faculty, …)
Institute target (M28) exposes only Category, City, Area and Rating (M28 BR-28.1) plus a "Has an open batch" toggle (institute_batches.seats_available > 0); the fee/availability/gender/language/board/category rows above do not apply and are hidden for that target.

BR-29.2 GET /search/filters. Given the current filter selections (query string, same shape as M27/M28) and target, returns the full option list for every filter with a facet count: running the base eligibility + already-applied filters, grouped per candidate value of each other filter (one lightweight query per filter dimension, all against the same eligible-teacher CTE via a temp result reused across the seven grouped counts in one transaction). Counts update live as the parent toggles chips inside the sheet (debounced 300 ms, cancels the previous in-flight request). A count of 0 greys out the chip but does not hide it (so the parent can see "Female (0)" and understand why).

BR-29.3 Applying filters. The sheet holds a draft copy of useSearchFilters/useInstituteSearchFilters (M27/M28); "Show N teachers" (the live BR-29.2 total) commits the draft to the real store and closes the sheet. "Clear all" resets the draft to defaults but keeps Subject/Class/City if they came from the child's profile (BR-27.1) — those three are considered identity, not preference, and have their own "×" outside the sheet.

BR-29.4 Saved searches. POST /saved-searches { name, target, filters } snapshots the applied filter object (same shape M27/M28 send to GET /search/teachers|institutes) under a user-given name (e.g. "HSR maths tutors"). GET /saved-searches lists them newest first (max 10 per user, LIMIT_REACHED details.reason = "saved_searches_max" beyond that — the app suggests deleting an old one). PATCH /saved-searches/:id renames or replaces filters (re-applying an updated version of the same search) or toggles alert_enabled. DELETE /saved-searches/:id soft-deletes.

BR-29.5 Daily alerts. A worker runs at 09:00 IST daily: for every saved_searches row with alert_enabled = true, re-run the saved filters through the same M27/M28 eligibility query but scoped to rows whose teachers.approved_at (or, for institutes, institutes.approved_at) is after last_alerted_at (or the save time, on the first run). If the count is > 0, send one push/in-app notification ("3 new maths tutors match 'HSR maths tutors'" → deep link /search/results?savedSearchId=…) and set last_alerted_at = now(); zero matches sends nothing (no "no new results" spam). Alerts respect user_notification_preferences.category = 'recommendations' and quiet hours (conventions §9). A saved search with alert_enabled = false is still usable to re-run the filters manually but is skipped by the job entirely (not even counted).

BR-29.6 Opening a saved search. Tapping a saved search from its list or its push deep link re-applies filters verbatim into the results screen's filter store (M27/M28) and runs the query fresh — it never replays cached results, since the whole point is to see what is new. If a referenced subjectId/classId/cityId has since been deactivated by an admin, that piece of the filter is dropped silently and the rest still applies (never a hard error on a saved search).

BR-29.7 One draft, no server round trip until commit. Every chip toggle inside the sheet updates local draft state instantly (client-side facet display uses the last fetched counts until the debounced refetch lands, so the UI never blocks on typing/tapping).

Save search sheet SaveSearchSheet (bottom sheet) Name the current filter set, toggle daily alert
Saved searches list SavedSearchesScreen All saved searches with edit/delete/alert toggle

<details><summary>DDL</summary>

CREATE TABLE saved_searches (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES app_users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- Owner
  name text NOT NULL, -- e.g. Physics · Class 12 · Koramangala
  target text NOT NULL CHECK (target IN ('teacher','institute')), -- Search type
  filters jsonb NOT NULL, -- Same shape as the search API filters
  alert_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, -- Notify when new matches appear
  last_alerted_at timestamptz, -- Last alert sent (max one per day)
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Created
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Updated
  deleted_at timestamptz -- Soft delete
);
CREATE INDEX idx_saved_searches_user ON saved_searches (user_id, created_at DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_saved_searches_alerts ON saved_searches (target) WHERE alert_enabled AND deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_saved_searches_updated BEFORE UPDATE ON saved_searches FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

</details>

Indexes: idx_saved_searches_user on (user_id, created_at DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL; idx_saved_searches_alerts on (target) WHERE alert_enabled AND deleted_at IS NULL

14. State Management

  • Draft filter state lives inside SearchFilterSheet only (not a global store); on commit it's written into M27's useSearchFilters or M28's useInstituteSearchFilters.
  • Query keys: searchKeys.facets(draftFilters, target) (not persisted, cancelled on change), savedSearchKeys.list.
  • After create/update/delete: invalidate savedSearchKeys.list; optimistic add/remove in the list.

15. Offline Handling

  • The filter sheet needs network for facet counts; offline it shows the last-known counts greyed out with a small "Offline — counts may be outdated" note, and "Show N" still applies the filters (M27/M28 render from their own offline cache).
  • Saved searches list is persisted (class: cached read); create/update/delete are class 2 (save draft, submit online) since they involve a named record the user expects confirmed, not fire-and-forget — the sheet's "Save" button is disabled offline with a hint.

16. Push Notification Requirements

Event Recipient Title / Body Deep link Category Urgent
Daily alert has new matches Saved search owner "3 new matches for 'HSR maths tutors'" / "New teachers were just approved near you." /search/results?savedSearchId=… recommendations No

17. Security Rules

  • saved_searches rows are scoped to user_id = sub on every read/write; PATCH/DELETE on another user's id → 404 NOT_FOUND (existence not confirmed or denied).
  • Facet queries run under the same eligibility rules as M27/M28 (never reveal counts including paused/suspended/rejected teachers or institutes).
  • filters jsonb is size-capped (2 KB) and shape-validated before storage to prevent an oversized or malformed blob from breaking the daily alert job.

Module 30 · Recommendation Engine

Phase 6 · Search & Discovery · Used by: Learner · Depends on: M00 (events), M07 (child profiles), M08 and M12 (dashboards consume this), M27 (search signal), M40 (favourites signal), M37 (leads signal); Admin M16, M22, M36 · New tables: recommendation_dismissals, recommendation_impressions · Uses: parent_children, user_search_history, teachers, institutes, user_favorites, leads · Build estimate: 6–7 days

1. Module Purpose

Produces personalised "Recommended for you" teacher and institute rails per child (parent) or per student, replacing M08/M12's v0 rule-based dashboard ranking behind the same response shape. It scores candidates from Child Class, Subject Needs, Location and Previous Searches, generates candidates cheaply before scoring them, handles a brand-new child with no signal yet (cold start), keeps rails diverse rather than one repeated teacher, remembers "Not interested" dismissals, and caches the computed list per child in Redis so opening the dashboard is fast. It owns recommendation_dismissals and recommendation_impressions.

2. User Stories

  • As a parent with two children, I want each child's home rail to reflect that child's class and subjects, not a blend of both.
  • As a parent who searched for "NEET biology" three times this week, I want that interest reflected in what I'm shown without having to search again.
  • As a parent whose child just switched from Class 5 to a preferred category, I want to mark a suggested teacher "Not interested" and never see them again for that child.
  • As a new parent who just added a child, I want useful suggestions on day one, not an empty rail.
  • As a student, I want recommendations based on my own class and subjects, not diluted by unrelated activity.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-30.1 Scope of "a user" for recommendations. For a parent, recommendations are computed per child (parent_children.id) since each child has its own class, subjects and teacher-category needs (M07); a parent with 2 children gets 2 independent rails, selected by the active-child switcher shown on the dashboard. For a student, recommendations are computed once for the account (no child concept), using students.class_id/board_id and any subjects implied by their search history in place of parent_child_subjects.

BR-30.2 Candidate generation (cheap, before scoring). Never scores the whole teacher table. Build a candidate pool of at most 300 teachers per request by unioning, until 300 or exhausted: (a) teachers matching the child's class_id (via teacher_classes) AND any of the child's subjects (via teacher_subjects) in the child's city (via teacher_locations) — up to 150; (b) teachers the account searched for or viewed in the last 30 days (user_search_history.clicked_teacher_id, teacher_profile_views for this user) not already included — up to 50; (c) teachers matching only the child's teacher category or only the city (broader net) — up to 100. All three pools apply M27 BR-27.4 eligibility (approved, active, not paused) before scoring. The equivalent pool for institutes unions matching institute_batches (class/subject), the child's city, and recently viewed/searched institutes, capped at 150.

BR-30.3 Scoring formula. Each candidate gets score = Σ(weight_i × signal_i) using weights from system_settings key recommendations.weights (a JSON object the app never sees raw, admin-editable like institutes.rating_weights in Admin M27), default:

{ "classSubjectMatch": 30, "categoryMatch": 10, "locationProximity": 15, "trustScore": 20, "rating": 10, "searchAffinity": 10, "recency": 5 }

Signals (each normalised 0–1 before weighting):

  • classSubjectMatch — fraction of the child's subjects the teacher teaches for that class (1.0 if all match).
  • categoryMatch — 1.0 if teachers.category_id is in the child's parent_child_teacher_categories, else 0.3.
  • locationProximity — same distanceScore formula as M27 BR-27.6 against the child's city/area.
  • trustScore — trust_scores.score / 100.
  • rating — teachers.rating_avg / 5 (0.5 neutral if rating_count = 0).
  • searchAffinity — 1.0 if the teacher appeared in a user_search_history.clicked_teacher_id in the last 30 days, 0.5 if only shown in results the user scrolled past (result_count > 0 for a matching filter set), else 0.
  • recency — 1 / (1 + daysSinceApproval / 30), giving newly approved teachers a small, decaying boost so the catalogue doesn't calcify around early winners. Weights are read once per computation (cached with the same TTL as the recommendation cache, BR-30.7) and are copied into each recommendation_impressions.algo_version alongside a formula version string (e.g. v1-2026.09) so a weights change is attributable in analytics.

BR-30.4 Cold start (no signal yet). A child added in the last 24 h with no user_search_history and no teacher_profile_views for the account: searchAffinity defaults to 0 for everyone (no penalty relative to peers — the weight simply contributes nothing), and the pool leans on (a) and (c) from BR-30.2 only. If the child's city has fewer than 10 eligible candidates after class/subject matching (a genuinely thin market), the pool is widened to the whole state before scoring, and cards from outside the city are tagged "outOfCity": true with the actual distance shown rather than hidden. A child with zero subjects/class set (registration incomplete) gets a category-only, city-wide "Popular near you" rail instead of a personalised one, clearly labelled as such.

BR-30.5 Diversity. After scoring, re-rank with a simple bounded re-ranking pass: no more than 2 teachers sharing the same category_id in the first 5 slots, and no more than 1 teacher per institute_teachers linkage (an institute's own listed teacher and the institute itself don't both dominate the same rail) — implemented by walking the score-sorted list and skipping a candidate that would violate a cap, re-inserting it later in the list rather than dropping it. This keeps a rail from being 8 near-identical "Home Tutor, Mathematics" cards.

BR-30.6 Dismissals. POST /recommendations/dismiss { teacherId | instituteId, childId?, reason? } inserts recommendation_dismissals; that teacher/institute is excluded from candidate generation for that (user, child) pair permanently (no expiry — re-surfacing a "Not interested" pick would undo the point of asking). DELETE /recommendations/dismiss/:id undoes one (shown in a "Manage recommendations" list so a misclick is recoverable within reason, not silently forgotten). reason (too_far, too_expensive, wrong_subject, not_relevant, other) is optional but, when given, is aggregated (not per-user) to tune future weight changes — never fed back into that single user's live score in v1 (that personalisation is a scalability item).

BR-30.7 Caching. The scored, diversified, dismissal-filtered list for a (userId, childId|null) pair is cached in Redis under reco:<userId>:<childId|'self'> for 6 hours, serialising the ranked candidate ids and scores (not full teacher payloads, which are hydrated fresh on each read so profile changes show immediately). Cache is invalidated early on: the child's subjects/class/category changing (M07), a new dismissal for that pair, or the nightly trust-score/rating recalculation touching a candidate already in the cached list by more than 5 points (a lightweight check the nightly job performs, not a full recompute trigger for every score change). A cache miss recomputes synchronously (typically < 400 ms for a 300-candidate pool) rather than returning stale or empty — recommendations are read-heavy and low-write, so synchronous compute-on-miss is simpler than a background warm job for v1.

BR-30.8 Impressions and metrics. Every card actually rendered on screen (not just returned by the API — the app fires this on 50%-visible-for-300ms, the same viewability rule used for ad impressions) posts to POST /events with name: "recommendation_impression"; the server inserts one recommendation_impressions row per card (rail, position, score, algo_version, shown_at) and updates clicked_at when the corresponding profile is opened within the session. GET /recommendations itself does not write impressions (a returned-but-unscrolled-to card is not "shown"). Click-through rate per rail/algo_version is the primary offline metric for evaluating a weights change (compared via the same POST /trust-weights/draft/simulate-style before/after, but for recommendations this is an analytics query, not an admin endpoint in v1).

BR-30.9 Rails and consumption by M08/M12. GET /recommendations?childId=&rail= returns one named rail at a time: recommended_teachers (the scored list, BR-30.3), recommended_institutes, nearby (location-only, no scoring — a simple distance-sorted fallback used when a rail would otherwise be too thin), top_rated (rating/trust only, city-wide, no personalisation — good for a brand-new account), verified (verified-badge teachers only), for_you (an alias for recommended_teachers, kept as a separate rail name so M08/M12 can A/B which label performs better without an API change). M08 GET /home/parent and M12 GET /home/student call this module's internal RecommendationService.getRail(userId, childId, rail, limit) in-process (not a network hop) to fill their dashboard sections, so the dashboards' own specs describe layout only; the scoring, caching and dismissal logic lives here exactly once.

6. Screen Wireframe Description

Dashboard rail (rendered by M08/M12, cards owned here) — horizontal TeacherCard/InstituteCard list, each with a small ⋮ opening NotInterestedSheet directly (no separate long-press gesture, for accessibility). Cold-start rail carries a small label "Popular near you" instead of "Recommended for you" when cold_start is true in the response.

RecommendationsFeed — header "Recommended for Aarav" (child name) or "Recommended for you" (student/self), vertical list of full TeacherCards with the same ⋮ action, pull-to-refresh (forces a cache bypass), footer loader on scroll (paged from the same cached ranked list, not re-scored per page).

NotInterestedSheet — heading "Not interested in Dr. Ananya Iyer?", optional reason chips (Too far · Too expensive · Wrong subject · Not relevant · Other), sticky "Confirm" and text "Undo" toast after confirming, valid 5 seconds before the dismissal is treated as final (the "Undo" toast action calls the DELETE immediately, cancelling the just-created row — so no dismissal ships to the server for a within-5-seconds regret, kept simple as a client-side optimistic delay rather than a server-side grace window).

ManageRecommendationsScreen — child switcher at top (parents only), list of dismissed teachers/institutes with name, dismissed date, reason chip if given, trailing "Undo" button. Empty state: "You haven't marked anything as not interested."

9. API Endpoints

Method Path Auth Description
GET /recommendations Learner One named rail for the caller (and child, if a parent), paged
POST /recommendations/dismiss Learner Mark a teacher or institute "Not interested" for a child/account (Idempotency-Key)
DELETE /recommendations/dismiss/:id Learner Undo a dismissal

Uses: M27 user_search_history (read-only, as a signal, not an owned dependency); M40 user_favorites (read-only signal — a favourited teacher is never re-recommended as "new", it simply scores normally but the card shows a filled heart); M37 leads (read-only signal — a teacher already contacted for this child scores normally but is deduplicated to the bottom half of the rail rather than the top, so the rail surfaces new options first); M00 POST /events (impressions).

recommendation_dismissals

<details><summary>DDL</summary>

CREATE TABLE recommendation_dismissals (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES app_users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- User
  child_id uuid REFERENCES parent_children(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- Scope to one child (NULL = all)
  teacher_id uuid REFERENCES teachers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- Dismissed teacher
  institute_id uuid REFERENCES institutes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- Dismissed institute

);

Table Owner Purpose

14. State Management

  • Query keys: recommendationKeys.rail(userId, childId, rail), persisted with a staleTime of 6 h to mirror the server cache (so a foreground refetch after 6 h feels intentional, not jarring).
  • After useDismissRecommendationMutation: optimistic removal of the card from every cached rail containing it (teacher/institute ids are shared across rails); rollback re-inserts on error.
  • useUndoDismissalMutation: optimistic re-insertion is not attempted (the ranked position is unknown after removal) — the rail is invalidated instead and refetched.

15. Offline Handling

  • Rails are persisted (read cache); a card dismissed offline is queued (class 1, idempotent by teacherId+childId) and removed from the cached list immediately.
  • RecommendationsFeed pagination beyond the first cached page is online-only.
  • Impression events batch through M00's existing offline-tolerant POST /events queue.

16. Push Notification Requirements

None sent directly by this module. A saved search's new-match alert (M29) and a dashboard's "New teachers near you" banner are separate features; this module only supplies the ranked data they might use.

17. Security Rules

  • Recommendations for a childId are only ever computed and returned when that child belongs to the caller (parent_children.parent_id resolves to the token's pid); a mismatched childId → 403 FORBIDDEN.
  • Dismissals and their reasons are private to the user; aggregate reason stats used for weight tuning are never joined back to a user id in reporting.
  • The candidate pool and scoring never leak ineligible (unapproved/paused/suspended) teachers or institutes — BR-30.2 filters before scoring, not after.

18. Error Handling

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
childId not the caller's own FORBIDDEN 403 Toast "You can't do that."; child switcher resets to the caller's first child
Unknown rail value VALIDATION_FAILED 422 Falls back to recommended_teachers client-side
Both teacherId and instituteId on dismiss VALIDATION_FAILED 422 Toast "Something went wrong. Try again."
Dismissal already exists (idempotent) — (200, no-op) 200 No visible change
Compute-on-miss exceeds 1.5 s — (served anyway) 200 No user-visible error; Sentry warning logged for tuning the 300-candidate cap
Network / 5xx GATEWAY_ERROR / INTERNAL_ERROR 502 / 500 Rail shows ErrorState + Retry under the dashboard section, rest of the dashboard unaffected

19. Testing Scenarios

  • T30.1 Happy path (Maestro recommendations_happy): open dashboard → rail shows class/subject-matched teachers first, reasons chips present, dismiss one → card removed and excluded on next fetch.
  • T30.2 Two children with different classes/subjects on the same parent account get visibly different rails; switching the child switcher refetches the correct childId.
  • T30.3 Brand-new child (< 24 h, no history) in a thin-market city (< 10 candidates) → pool widens state-wide, outOfCity flagged with real distance, coldStart: true.
  • T30.4 Diversity cap: seed 6 candidates in the same category scoring highest → no more than 2 appear in the first 5 slots of the rendered rail.
  • T30.5 Dismiss → undo within the app's grace toast → DELETE /recommendations/dismiss/:id cancels it before it affects the next fetch; dismiss → close app → reopen after the toast window → dismissal stands and the teacher is excluded.
  • T30.6 Cache: two consecutive GET /recommendations within 6 h return the same ranked order (from Redis) even though trust_scores changed slightly in between (below the 5-point invalidation threshold); a ≥ 5-point change forces a recompute.
  • T30.7 A teacher already the subject of an open leads row for that child appears lower in the rail than an equally-scored teacher with no existing lead.
  • T30.8 Impressions: a card scrolled past quickly (< 300 ms visible) does not create a recommendation_impressions row; one held on-screen 400 ms does.
  • T30.9 childId belonging to another parent → 403.
  • T30.10 Offline: cached rail renders; dismiss offline is queued and reflected immediately; reconnect applies it server-side without duplicating on retry (Idempotency-Key).

20. Audit Log Events

None. Recommendations and impressions are behavioural/analytics data (recommendation_impressions is itself the record), not admin-relevant actions; dismissals are a personal preference, not an audited event.

21. Future Scalability Notes

  • Feed dismissal reasons back into that user's own live scoring (a lightweight per-user category penalty) once enough dismissal volume exists to do so without overfitting on 1–2 data points.
  • Replace the in-process candidate SQL with a vector/embedding-based similarity service once subject/category taxonomies grow past what a hand-tuned weighted sum models well.
  • A/B testing harness for recommendations.weights versions (parallel to Admin M36's trust-weight simulate/activate pattern) rather than a single live version.
  • Background pre-warm of the Redis cache for active users overnight, so the first dashboard open of the day never pays the compute-on-miss cost.
  • Cross-child household signals (what similar households with a Class 8 CBSE child in the same city responded to) once privacy and volume both support it.

Module 31 · Teacher Profile View

Phase 7 · Profiles · Used by: Learner, Public (shared link, limited view) · Depends on: M00 (events, uploads for viewing photos), M27 (arrival from search), M30 (arrival from recommendations), M33 (share), M34 (reviews tab), M37/M38 (contact/demo handoff), M42 (trust score detail); Admin M16, M17, M18, M19, M20, M33, M36 · New tables: none · Uses: teachers, teacher_profile_views, teacher_fee_plans, teacher_qualifications, teacher_availability, teacher_reviews, trust_scores · Build estimate: 5–6 days

1. Module Purpose

The public-facing teacher profile: verification badge, Trust Score, reviews summary, experience, subjects/classes taught, fee plans, qualifications, weekly availability summary and a "Similar teachers" rail. It records every view in teacher_profile_views (owned by Admin M21) for the teacher's own analytics and this module's GET /teachers/:id/similar. Contact and demo actions on the profile hand off entirely to M37 (Contact Teacher) and M38 (Demo Class Request) — this module never creates a lead or demo itself. A limited public view renders for a shared link (M33) or a search-engine/WhatsApp preview without requiring sign-in.

2. User Stories

  • As a parent evaluating a tutor, I want to see their Trust Score breakdown, reviews and fee plans on one screen before I contact them.
  • As a parent who received a WhatsApp link to a teacher's profile from a friend, I want to view the basics without signing in first.
  • As a student comparing options, I want a "Similar teachers" list so that I'm not stuck picking from just one search result.
  • As a new teacher, I want my profile to show my verified badge and completeness immediately once approved so that parents trust me from day one.
  • As a teacher on a break, I want my profile to clearly show I'm away rather than look abandoned.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-31.1 Resolving the profile — GET /teachers/:idOrCode. Accepts either the uuid or the human public_code (e.g. GC-T10241, used in shared links and support). Returns 404 NOT_FOUND for a soft-deleted or never-existing id; returns the profile with a "suspended": true limited card (name, "This profile is temporarily unavailable") for account_status = 'suspended' rather than a hard 404, so an existing lead thread or review doesn't suddenly reference a ghost. A teacher who is pause_leads (M19 teacher_time_off) still resolves fully but with an "away": { "untilDate": "…", "message": "…" } banner and contact/demo buttons disabled with that reason (BR-31.7).

BR-31.2 What the profile shows (Learner, signed in).

Section Source Notes
Header teachers.full_name, profile_photo_file_id, public_code, category_id VerifiedBadge if is_verified_badge; "Featured"/"Premium" tags mirror M27 BR-27.6 definitions
Trust Score trust_scores.score (or override_score if is_overridden), factor summary Tapping opens M42's detail (this module links out, doesn't duplicate the breakdown)
Reviews teachers.rating_avg, rating_count, top 3 recent published teacher_reviews "See all N reviews" → M34
Experience & bio experience_years, highest_qualification, bio, languages
Subjects & classes teacher_subjects, teacher_classes (with board) Grouped "Class 6–8: Mathematics, Science (CBSE, ICSE)"
Fee plans teacher_fee_plans (is_active) Grouped by subject/class/mode, "From ₹500/hr" summary + full list on tap
Qualifications teacher_qualifications Degree, institution, year; highest flagged
Availability summary teacher_availability "Available Mon–Fri evenings, weekends" (not a booking calendar — that's M38's demo slot picker)
Locations & modes teacher_locations, teacher_teaching_modes Areas served, travel radius for home tuition, Online/Offline chips
Similar teachers GET /teachers/:id/similar BR-31.5
Demo-available (demo_available) surfaces a "Book a free demo" button; its absence surfaces only "Contact".

BR-31.3 Limited public view (Public auth, no token). Returns a strict subset: name, photo, category, city/area (no exact address), subjects/classes, experience, Trust Score and rating (numbers only, no factor breakdown or written reviews beyond the top 1), "From ₹X/hr" (no full fee table), VerifiedBadge. No qualifications detail, no full availability, no similar-teachers rail, no contact/demo buttons — instead a single "Open in GuruConnect app / Sign in to contact" CTA that deep-links to the full profile after auth (pendingDeepLink, conventions §4). This is also exactly the payload rendered server-side for the Open Graph web preview page (M33) so a WhatsApp/Google preview never shows more than a signed-in-but-anonymous learner would.

BR-31.4 Recording a view. On profile open (learner or Public), the app calls POST /events with name: "teacher_profile_view", props: { teacherId, source } where source is one of search, home_featured, home_recommended, nearby, shared_link, institute_page, other (matching teacher_profile_views.source) — M00's event pipeline inserts the teacher_profile_views row server-side (this module defines the contract, M00 owns the ingestion, per conventions §11 "reads and searches are not audit-logged" and BR-0.10). A signed-in viewer's viewer_user_id is set; a Public viewer's is NULL. Repeated views by the same viewer within the same day count once for the teacher's daily stats (Admin M21 teacher_daily_stats.unique_viewers) but every open still inserts a raw row (the daily job does the de-duplication, not this module).

BR-31.5 Similar teachers — GET /teachers/:id/similar. Up to 8 teachers sharing at least one subject with this teacher, in the same city, same teaching_modes overlap where possible, ranked by trust_scores.score then rating_avg, excluding the current teacher and anyone the viewer has already dismissed for the active child (reuses M30's recommendation_dismissals check when a childId is passed, so "Not interested" carries over here too). This is a lightweight relevance list, not a scored M30 rail — it has no impressions/caching of its own and is small enough (≤ 8) to compute per request.

BR-31.6 Profile completeness shown to the teacher only. When the caller is the profile's own teacher (viewing their own public page via "Preview my profile", M17), an additional completeness banner and missing-field checklist render from teachers.profile_completeness; this is the only place a teacher sees their own profile as others see it plus what's incomplete, reusing M17's GET /teacher/profile/preview rather than duplicating that logic — this module's GET /teachers/:idOrCode simply detects sub == teacher.user_id and adds the "ownerView": true flag with the checklist.

BR-31.7 Contact and demo handoff. "Contact" opens M37's POST /leads flow pre-filled with teacherId (and childId if a parent); "Book a free demo" opens M38's slot picker. Both buttons are disabled with the away/suspended reason text when BR-31.1's states apply, and disabled with "Sign in to contact" for a Public viewer (routes to Login with the profile as the pending deep link). This module renders the buttons and passes context; it owns no lead or demo state itself.

6. Screen Wireframe Description

TeacherProfile — hero: photo, name, VerifiedBadge, "Featured"/"Premium" tag if applicable, category label, area/city, share icon (→ M33). Away banner when paused: amber strip "Away until 12 Oct — back to taking new students soon." Row: TrustScoreRing + score + "See details" → M42; RatingStars + "4.8 (214 reviews)" → M34. Section "About" — bio (max 6 lines, "Read more"), experience "6 years", languages chips, highest qualification line. Section "Subjects & classes" — grouped chips per class range. Section "Fees" — 2–3 summary rows "Class 6–8 Maths · ₹800/hr", "See all fee plans" → sheet. Section "Qualifications" — top 2, "See all" → sheet. Section "Availability" — "Mon–Fri evenings · Weekends" text summary + mode chips "Online · Home tuition (5 km)". Section "Similar teachers" — horizontal TeacherCard rail, "See all" → SimilarTeachersScreen. Sticky bottom bar: "Book a free demo" (secondary, only if demo_available) and "Contact" (primary); both replaced by a single disabled "Away — check back later" / "Sign in to contact" per state.

TeacherProfilePublic — same hero and About/Subjects/Fees-summary/reviews-count sections, no Qualifications/Availability/Similar-teachers sections, sticky bar single button "Open in GuruConnect app" (or "Sign in to contact").

TeacherFeePlansSheet — table-like rows: label, subject/class/mode, "₹800/hr" or "₹6,000/month", session count/length when set. Empty state not applicable (button only shown when plans exist).

SimilarTeachersScreen — vertical TeacherCard list, same card component as M27 search results, "See why" not shown here (reasons are M30's feature, not this list's).

{ "data": [ { "id": "…", "fullName": "Rahul Menon", "trustScore": 88.0, "ratingAvg": 4.6, "feeFrom": { "amountPaise": 70000, "unit": "per_hour" } } ] }

13. Relationships

Entity relationship diagram (tables this module uses; admins omitted)

Diagram loads when this page is online…

14. State Management

  • Query keys: teacherKeys.profile(idOrCode) (persisted, staleTime 5 min so re-opening from search feels instant), teacherKeys.similar(id, childId) (persisted 24 h).
  • useLogProfileView is a fire-and-forget mutation with no cache effect.

15. Offline Handling

  • A profile opened recently is served from the persisted cache with an "Updated 2 h ago" note; Contact/Demo buttons are disabled offline with "Connect to the internet to contact this teacher."
  • Similar teachers and fee/qualification sheets read from the same cached payload; no separate offline handling needed since they're sub-views of one query.
  • View logging queues through M00's existing POST /events offline queue (best-effort, order doesn't matter for analytics).

16. Push Notification Requirements

None. Arriving at a profile via push (e.g. a saved-search alert, M29) is a deep-link target, not an event this module sends.

17. Security Rules

  • Full profile fields (qualifications, availability, similar teachers, fee detail) require a Learner token; a Public request never receives them even if it guesses the right query parameters — the server, not the client, decides the field set from auth state.
  • A suspended teacher's exact address/location is never returned even in the limited "temporarily unavailable" card.
  • childId passed to /similar is only honoured when it belongs to the caller; otherwise it's ignored (falls back to the non-personalised ranking) rather than erroring, since this is a soft personalisation, not an authorization boundary.
  • The Open Graph preview (M33) is rendered server-side from exactly BR-31.3's payload — never more.

18. Error Handling

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
Unknown id/code NOT_FOUND 404 "This teacher's profile isn't available." with back button
Soft-deleted teacher NOT_FOUND 404 Same as above
Suspended teacher — (200, limited card) 200 "This profile is temporarily unavailable." card, no actions
Paused (away) teacher — (200, banner) 200 Away banner, actions disabled with reason
Contact/Demo tapped, Public — (client-side redirect) — Routes to Login with the profile as pending deep link
Network / 5xx GATEWAY_ERROR / INTERNAL_ERROR 502 / 500 ErrorState + Retry; cached profile shown if available

19. Testing Scenarios

  • T31.1 Happy path (Maestro teacher_profile_happy): open from search → all sections render → Contact opens M37 pre-filled with the teacher id.
  • T31.2 Public (signed-out) open via a shared link shows only the limited fields; tapping "Open in GuruConnect app" after login lands back on the full profile.
  • T31.3 Suspended teacher shows the limited "temporarily unavailable" card with no address or contact button.
  • T31.4 Teacher with an active teacher_time_off (pause_leads = true) shows the Away banner and disabled Contact/Demo with the correct return date.
  • T31.5 Owner viewing their own profile sees ownerView: true and the completeness checklist; another learner viewing the same profile does not.
  • T31.6 GET /teachers/:id/similar excludes a teacher already dismissed (M30) for the passed childId, and excludes the profile's own teacher id.
  • T31.7 demo_available = false hides the "Book a free demo" button entirely (not disabled, absent).
  • T31.8 View event fires exactly once per screen mount, not on every re-render; offline view events queue and flush on reconnect.
  • T31.9 Invalid idOrCode format (neither uuid nor GC-T pattern) → 404 without a database round trip.
  • T31.10 Offline: cached profile renders with "Updated 2 h ago"; Contact/Demo disabled with the offline hint.

20. Audit Log Events

None. Profile views are analytics/behavioural data via teacher_profile_views, not an audited admin-relevant action (conventions §11).

21. Future Scalability Notes

  • Server-rendered, cacheable HTML preview pages per teacher for search-engine indexing beyond the Open Graph share preview (SEO growth channel).
  • "Compare teachers" (2–3 side by side) reusing this module's field set once M40/M41 favourites data shows people shortlisting before contacting.
  • Video introduction clips on the profile (a new files purpose) once upload/transcoding infrastructure exists.
  • Personalised "why this teacher" reasons (reused from M30) surfaced directly on the profile hero, not only in rails.

Module 32 · Institute Profile View

Phase 7 · Profiles · Used by: Learner, Public (limited) · Depends on: M00 (events), M28 (arrival from search), M33 (share), M35 (institute reviews tab), M39 (contact handoff); Admin M22, M24, M26, M27 · New tables: none · Uses: institutes, institute_profile_views, institute_teachers, institute_batches, institute_ratings · Build estimate: 4–5 days

1. Module Purpose

The public-facing institute profile: GuruConnect's independent rating (overall + infrastructure), verified badge, gallery, facilities, listed teachers, running batches, and reviews summary. It records every view in institute_profile_views (owned by this module, App M23) and exposes the teachers and batches sub-lists used from the profile. Enquiry actions hand off entirely to M39 (Contact Institute), which itself is the targetType=institute path of M37's leads endpoint. A limited public view renders for shared links and previews without sign-in, mirroring M31's contract exactly so the two profile types feel like one family.

2. User Stories

  • As a parent choosing between two coaching centres, I want to see GuruConnect's rating breakdown, not just star reviews, so that I trust the comparison.
  • As a parent, I want to see which teachers are listed at an institute and their subjects so that I know who would actually teach my child.
  • As a student, I want to see running batches for my class and subject with seats available so that I know if I can still join.
  • As a parent sent an institute link on WhatsApp, I want to preview it without installing the app first.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-32.1 Resolving the profile — GET /institutes/:idOrSlug. Accepts the uuid or the slug (e.g. apex-jee-academy-koramangala, used in shared links and the website). 404 NOT_FOUND for soft-deleted or unknown; account_status = 'suspended' renders the same limited "temporarily unavailable" card pattern as M31 BR-31.1 rather than a hard 404 (existing reviews/enquiries keep a valid reference). Institutes have no per-day "away" state (M27 BR-28.2) — verification status other than approved (still pending/under_review/etc.) simply cannot be reached from search or a valid public slug, since a slug/uuid is only shareable once approved; a manager previewing their own unapproved institute uses M24's own preview, not this endpoint.

BR-32.2 What the profile shows (Learner, signed in).

Section Source Notes
Header institutes.name, logo_file_id, cover_file_id, public_code, institute_type VerifiedBadge if is_verified_badge; "Premium" tag mirrors M28 BR-28.3
Rating overall_rating (x.x/5), infrastructure_score (x.x/10), user_rating_avg/user_rating_count (learner reviews) Exactly the public contract of Admin M27 FR-27.5 — never the private sub-scores or notes
About about, established_year, facilities (text[]) Facility chips, e.g. "Library", "CCTV", "Parking"
Gallery institute_documents of type campus_photo published to gc-public (Admin M22 FR-22.7) Shown as cover_file_id + gallery grid; private/unreviewed photos never appear here
Teachers GET /institutes/:id/teachers BR-32.3
Batches GET /institutes/:id/batches BR-32.4
Reviews Top 3 recent published institute_reviews (M35), "See all N reviews"
Location address_line, city_id/area_id, map preview Exact address shown to signed-in learners only (BR-32.5)
Fee shown as fee_min_paise–fee_max_paise range (institute-level; per-batch fee is on the batch card, BR-32.4).

BR-32.3 Listed teachers — GET /institutes/:id/teachers. Returns institute_teachers rows with status = 'active' and is_visible = true, each with full_name, photo_file_id, qualification, experience_years, schedule_text, and subjects/classes (institute_teacher_subjects/institute_teacher_classes). When a row's teacher_id is linked to a GuruConnect teachers account (Admin M26's link flow), the card also shows that teacher's Trust Score and links through to the full M31 profile ("View full profile"); an unlinked institute-only teacher shows the institute-entered fields only, with no Trust Score and no tap-through (nothing to link to). status = 'id_pending' or 'removed' rows never appear here regardless of is_visible.

BR-32.4 Running batches — GET /institutes/:id/batches. Returns institute_batches with is_active = true and deleted_at IS NULL, each with name, resolved subject_ids → names, class_id → name, teaching_mode_id → name, schedule_text, seats_total/seats_available, fee_paise/fee_period, starts_on. Sorted by starts_on ascending (soonest first), batches with seats_available = 0 sort last within that order and show a "Batch full" pill rather than being hidden (a parent may still want to join a waitlist by contacting the institute, M39). Optional ?classId=&subjectId= narrows the list to match a child's needs, reusing the exact filter the profile's "Batches for my child" toggle sends when a child is active.

BR-32.5 Limited public view. Name, logo/cover, institute type, city/area (no exact address or map), rating numbers (no infrastructure sub-detail beyond the single score, no private notes ever), top 1 review, facilities chips, up to 3 gallery photos, fee range, and a single "Open in GuruConnect app / Sign in to enquire" CTA. Teachers and batches lists are not shown to Public (BR-32.3/32.4 require a Learner token) — a parent must sign in to see who actually teaches there and what's running, which is also the strongest reason to complete registration. This is the exact payload used for the Open Graph web preview (M33).

BR-32.6 Recording a view. Mirrors M31 BR-31.4 exactly but into institute_profile_views (owned here): POST /events with name: "institute_profile_view", props: { instituteId, source } where source matches institute_profile_views.source (search, recommendation, dashboard, favorites, share_link, notification, other). One row per view; institute_daily_stats.profile_views (Admin M23/M24) is the de-duplicated nightly roll-up, this table stays raw. viewed_on is a generated/derived date column for the "one per viewer per institute per day" description in the schema reference — enforced by the nightly stats job's grouping, not a uniqueness constraint on insert (repeated raw views are fine, matching M31's approach).

BR-32.7 Owner/manager preview. When the caller is an active manager or counsellor of the institute, GET /institutes/:idOrSlug adds "ownerView": true; this module does not add a completeness checklist here (institutes don't have a profile_completeness column) — the manager's own verification checklist lives in M22, and this flag exists only so the app can show a small "This is how parents see your institute" banner rather than duplicate any status logic.

BR-32.8 Enquiry handoff. "Enquire" opens M39's POST /leads { targetType: "institute", instituteId, ... }; "View batch" on a specific batch card pre-fills the enquiry message with that batch's name. Both require a Learner token; Public sees "Sign in to enquire" routing to Login with the profile as the pending deep link, identically to M31 BR-31.7.

6. Screen Wireframe Description

InstituteProfile — cover photo (16:9) with logo overlapping bottom-left, name, VerifiedBadge, "Premium" tag if applicable, institute type label, area/city, share icon (→ M33). Rating row: big "4.5 ★" with "(312 reviews)", "Infrastructure 8.2/10" chip, "See rating details" (links to the same public rating contract, no separate screen needed — it's already all shown). Section "About" — about text, established year, facility chips. Section "Gallery" — 3-photo preview row, "See all N photos" → InstituteGalleryScreen. Section "Teachers" — up to 4 InstituteTeacherCards (photo, name, qualification, subjects), "See all N teachers" → InstituteTeachersScreen. Section "Batches" — toggle "All batches | For my child" (child toggle only shown when a child is active), 2–3 BatchCards (name, schedule, seats, fee), "See all" → InstituteBatchesScreen. Section "Reviews" — top 3, "See all" → M35. Section "Location" — map preview, address, "Get directions". Sticky bottom bar: "Enquire".

InstituteProfilePublic — cover/logo/name/rating/about/facilities/3-photo gallery/1 review/fee range, sticky "Open in GuruConnect app".

InstituteBatchesScreen — filter row "All classes ▾ · All subjects ▾", list of BatchCards sorted soonest-first, full ones tagged "Batch full" and sorted last; empty state "No batches match this filter" with "Clear filter".

InstituteTeachersScreen — grid/list of InstituteTeacherCards; a card for a linked GuruConnect teacher additionally shows TrustScoreRing (small) and "View full profile →".
