6. Screen Wireframe Description

PaymentSheet (bottom sheet, 70 % height, FLAG_SECURE) — drag handle; title from caller, e.g. "Parent membership · Monthly"; description line in muted text "Unlimited teacher contacts and free demo bookings". Period line for subscriptions "Valid 30 days · 26 Sep – 25 Oct" or, when queued, "Starts after your current plan ends on 3 Oct". Breakdown card (KeyValueRows, right-aligned tabular numbers):

  • "Price" ₹299
  • "Wallet balance used" −₹100 (only when the wallet toggle is on)
  • divider; "You pay" ₹199 (20 sp bold)
  • small text "Includes ₹30.36 GST (18%)". Wallet row (only when wallet available and balance > 0): checkbox "Use wallet balance (₹100 available)" with helper "Up to 50% of the price can be paid from your wallet." Below: "By paying you agree to the Terms and Refund policy" with both links. Payment method icons row (UPI, RuPay, Visa, Mastercard, Net banking) and "Secured by Razorpay". Sticky button Pay ₹199 (loading spinner while the order is created; disabled offline with helper "Connect to the internet to pay"). Loading state: skeleton for the breakdown card. Error state: "Couldn't load the price" + Retry. Fee disabled: sheet closes with toast "This is free right now." and the caller continues.

Razorpay Checkout — Razorpay's native UI; shows GuruConnect name and logo, amount ₹199, prefilled phone; UPI apps (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm) on top on Android.

PaymentResult — full screen, no tab bar, FLAG_SECURE.

  • Success: green check animation (once, 600 ms), heading "Payment successful", amount "₹199 paid", line per purpose, e.g. "Your membership is active till 25 Oct 2026" / "Contact unlocked. You can now call Dr. Ananya Iyer." / "Registration fee received. We'll verify your documents within 48 hours."; reference "TXN-7702140 · UPI" (long-press copies); buttons Continue (primary) and "View receipt" (text, opens M45 PaymentDetail).
  • Processing: clock icon, heading "Payment processing", body "Your bank is confirming the payment. This usually takes a few seconds, sometimes up to 5 minutes. Don't pay again.", progress indicator; after 60 s text "We'll send you a notification when it's confirmed." and button Done; link "Money debited but not confirmed?" opens PaymentHelpSheet.
  • Failed: red cross, heading "Payment failed", reason from the gateway mapped to plain text (e.g. "Your bank declined the payment."), note "If money was debited, it will be refunded to your account within 5–7 working days."; buttons Try again and "Choose another method" (both reopen the sheet), link "Contact support".
  • Cancelled: heading "Payment cancelled", body "No money was taken."; buttons Try again and "Not now".
  • Expired: heading "Payment session expired", body "No money was taken. Start again to pay."; button Start again.

PriceChangedSheet — heading "The price was updated", rows "Earlier ₹1,999" (struck through) and "Now ₹1,799", buttons Continue with ₹1,799 and "Cancel".

PaymentHelpSheet — three short steps: "1. Wait 5 minutes — most payments confirm on their own. 2. Check your bank SMS for the UPI reference. 3. Still stuck? Contact support with reference TXN-7702140." Buttons Contact support (M53 new ticket with transactionId prefilled) and "Close".

8. Validation Rules

Shared schemas in packages/shared/payments.ts: PaymentQuoteQuerySchema, CreateOrderSchema, VerifyPaymentSchema.

Field Rule Message shown
feeCode one of the 9 fee codes "This item can't be bought here."
context.leadId uuid; required for CONTACT_UNLOCK, forbidden otherwise "Pick the request you want to unlock."
context.renewal boolean; only for registration fee codes —
useWallet boolean, default false —
paymentConfigurationId uuid of the quoted version "The price was updated. Please review."
expectedPayablePaise integer ≥ 100; must equal the server's computed C "The price was updated. Please review."
Idempotency-Key header uuid v4, required on orders "Something went wrong. Try again."
transactionId uuid owned by the caller "Payment not found."
razorpayOrderId ^order_[A-Za-z0-9]{14}$ "We couldn't confirm this payment."
razorpayPaymentId ^pay_[A-Za-z0-9]{14}$ "We couldn't confirm this payment."
razorpaySignature 64 hex chars "We couldn't confirm this payment."

9. API Endpoints

Method Path Auth Description
GET /payments/quote Any user Price, GST split, wallet redemption and period for a fee code (?feeCode=&useWallet=&leadId=&renewal=)
POST /payments/orders Any user Create transaction + Razorpay order and return checkout options (Idempotency-Key). 10/min, 30/hour
POST /payments/verify Any user Verify Checkout signature, fetch payment, apply capture if confirmed. 20/min
GET /payments/:id/status Any user (owner) Polling status with fulfilment state; triggers throttled gateway sync. 60/min

The Razorpay webhook receiver POST /webhooks/razorpay is owned by Admin M40; the pricing list for plan screens is M10 GET /plans.

{ "data": { "transactionId": "b3f1c2d4-…", "status": "processing", "fulfilment": { "type": "subscription", "state": "pending" }, "nextPollAfterMs": 2000 } }

// 200 GET /payments/:id/status
{ "data": { "transactionId": "b3f1c2d4-…", "publicCode": "TXN-7702140", "status": "failed", "rawStatus": "failed", "amountPaise": 19900, "method": "upi",
  "failure": { "code": "BAD_REQUEST_ERROR", "reason": "Payment was declined by the bank." }, "fulfilment": null, "invoiceAvailable": false,
  "canRetry": true, "nextPollAfterMs": null } }

// 409 POST /payments/orders   (admin published a new price)
{ "error": { "code": "CONFLICT_STATE", "message": "The price was updated. Please review.",
  "details": { "reason": "price_changed", "quote": { "paymentConfigurationId": "…", "listAmountPaise": 179900, "payablePaise": 179900 } }, "requestId": "…" } }

// 402 POST /payments/verify   (signature mismatch)
{ "error": { "code": "PAYMENT_FAILED", "message": "We couldn't confirm this payment.", "details": { "reason": "signature_mismatch" }, "requestId": "…" } }

12. PostgreSQL Tables & Columns

Existing tables this module reads or writes (full definitions in the owning module)

Table Owner Purpose
transactions Admin M40 Every payment attempt through Razorpay, plus refunds and reward payouts. Amounts in paise.
payment_configurations Admin M05 One row per version of each fee. The app charges whichever version is active at payment time.
payment_webhook_events Admin M40 Raw Razorpay webhooks, stored before processing so every event is processed exactly once.
wallet_ledger App M46 Append-only ledger of GuruConnect wallet credits and debits (referral rewards, use at checkout, reversals). Balance = sum(amount_paise).
subscriptions Admin M41 Paid access periods for parents, students, teachers and institutes, including trials.
teachers Admin M16 Teacher profile and verification state. One row per teacher app account.
institutes Admin M22 Coaching centres, tuition centres, schools and academies. Rated by GuruConnect after verification.
institute_managers Admin M25 App accounts that act for an institute. Exactly one active primary manager; counsellors can only handle leads.
leads Admin M38 Enquiries and call-back requests from parents/students to a teacher or institute.
app_users Admin M00 Login identity for every mobile app account (parent, student, teacher, institute staff). Role profiles hang off this table.
system_settings Admin M04 Typed key–value settings that change platform behaviour without a deploy.
audit_logs Admin M00 Append-only record of every admin action and security event. Never updated or deleted by the application.
user_notifications App M00 The in-app notification inbox for every user: transactional events and copies of admin campaigns.
  • payment_configurations: read only, through resolveFee (Admin M05 FR-5.9); never cached longer than 60 s (Redis pricing:v1, purged on publish).
  • transactions: this module inserts (created) and updates gateway_order_id, gateway_payment_id, status (authorized on verify); capture, failure, invoice number and cancellation are written by PaymentCaptureService / Admin M40 jobs. metadata keys written here: context, listAmountPaise, walletRedeemedPaise, pendingPeriod, payerFingerprint, platform, appVersion, installId.
  • wallet_ledger (M46): checkout_redemption (−W) on order, redemption_refund (+W) on cancel/expiry, a second checkout_redemption (key redeem_retry:<id>) on late capture. Balance = SUM(amount_paise) for the user.
  • payment_webhook_events: written by Admin M40; this module's status endpoint reads nothing from it (it syncs from Razorpay instead).
  • subscriptions, teachers, institutes, leads: written only by the fulfilment step (BR-43.11).

13. Relationships

Entity relationship diagram (tables this module uses; admins omitted)

Diagram loads when this page is online…

Every paid object points back to its payment: teachers.registration_transaction_id, institutes.registration_transaction_id, subscriptions.last_transaction_id, leads.unlock_transaction_id, wallet_ledger.transaction_id. transactions.payment_configuration_id fixes the price version charged.

14. State Management

  • usePendingPayment (Zustand + encrypted MMKV): { current: { transactionId, feeCode, returnTo, startedAt } | null, set(), clear() }.
  • Query keys (paymentKeys): paymentKeys.quote(feeCode, contextHash, useWallet) (not persisted, staleTime 30 s), paymentKeys.status(id) (not persisted, meta.persist = false, polling via refetchInterval per BR-43.10).
  • Mutations: useCreateOrderMutation (not auto-retried; uses the same Idempotency-Key for a manual retry of the same attempt), useVerifyPaymentMutation (retried twice on network error — verify is idempotent).
  • Invalidation on success, by purpose: subscription → subscriptionKeys.all, planKeys.all, meKeys.me; teacher_registration → teacherRegKeys.all, teacherVerificationKeys.all, meKeys.me; institute_registration → instituteVerificationKeys.all, meKeys.me; premium_listing/featured_listing → boostKeys.all, teacherDashboardKeys.all; contact_unlock → leadKeys.detail(leadId), leadKeys.list; always paymentHistoryKeys.all and walletKeys.all.
  • No optimistic updates anywhere in this module.

15. Offline Handling

  • Everything here is online only (conventions §8 class 3). Offline, the Pay button is disabled with "Connect to the internet to pay"; the quote is never served from cache.
  • Connection lost after Checkout returned: POST /payments/verify is retried automatically when back online (idempotent); PaymentResult shows processing with the offline banner.
  • Connection lost while the UPI app is open: the payment continues in the UPI app; on return the watcher polls status once online.
  • usePendingPayment survives restarts so a result is never lost.

16. Push Notification Requirements

Event Recipient Title / Body Deep link Category Urgent
payment.captured Payer "Payment successful" / "₹199 received for Parent membership · Monthly. Receipt TXN-7702140." gc://payments/<id> payments yes (user just paid)
payment.failed Payer "Payment failed" / "Your ₹199 payment didn't go through. If money was debited, it will be refunded in 5–7 days." gc://payments/<id> payments yes
payment.late_captured Payer "Payment confirmed" / "Your bank confirmed ₹199. Your membership is now active." gc://payments/<id> payments no

In-app only: none. The push data.entityId is the transaction id; PaymentResult listens for it in the foreground and stops polling when it arrives.

17. Security Rules

  • Razorpay key secret and webhook secret live in the secrets manager; the app only receives the public key id.
  • Amounts are computed server-side only; expectedPayablePaise is a comparison, not an input.
  • Ownership: every lookup is WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :sub (institutes: institute_id = :iid and the caller is a manager); counsellors get FORBIDDEN.
  • Signature check with constant-time compare; mismatches are counted per user (3 in 24 h → account flagged for review in Admin M40).
  • Fulfilment only from gateway-confirmed state (webhook or server fetch), never from the client.
  • PaymentSheet and PaymentResult use useSecureScreen() (FLAG_SECURE / iOS snapshot blur). No card or UPI data touches the app code or our servers; payerFingerprint is a SHA-256 hash.
  • Checkout options, order ids and payment ids are never written to analytics or Sentry breadcrumbs (scrubbed by key name).
  • Wallet debits run under a per-user advisory lock so two devices cannot spend the same balance.

18. Error Handling

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
Fee switched off CONFLICT_STATE (fee_disabled) 409 Close sheet, toast "This is free right now.", caller continues
Price changed between quote and Pay CONFLICT_STATE (price_changed) 409 PriceChangedSheet with the new quote
Existing payment still processing CONFLICT_STATE (payment_in_progress) 409 Open PaymentResult for that transaction
Already subscribed (> 30 days left) CONFLICT_STATE (already_subscribed) 409 Toast "You already have an active plan till 3 Oct."
No featured slot in the city CONFLICT_STATE (featured_slots_full) 409 Inline "All featured spots in Bengaluru are taken. Try Premium."
Boost already bought 90 days ahead CONFLICT_STATE (boost_limit) 409 Inline "You can buy up to 90 days ahead."
Lead already unlocked CONFLICT_STATE (already_unlocked) 409 Close sheet, refetch lead
Wrong role for the fee / counsellor paying FORBIDDEN 403 Toast "You can't do that."
Too many open orders or requests RATE_LIMITED 429 Disable Pay until Retry-After
Idempotency key reused with another body VALIDATION_FAILED (idempotency_key_reused) 422 New key, toast "Please try again."
Razorpay order API down GATEWAY_ERROR 502 Inline "Payments are temporarily unavailable. Try again in a minute." + Retry
Signature mismatch PAYMENT_FAILED (signature_mismatch) 402 PaymentResult failed with "We couldn't confirm this payment." + support link
Gateway declined status failed 200 PaymentResult failed with mapped reason, Try again
User closed Checkout client cancelled — Status check, then PaymentResult cancelled
Transaction of another user NOT_FOUND 404 "This is no longer available."

19. Testing Scenarios

  • T43.1 Happy path (Maestro payments_upi_success): parent opens plans → PaymentSheet shows ₹299 incl. ₹45.61 GST → Pay → test-mode UPI success → verify → PaymentResult success → Continue returns to plans with "Active till …".
  • T43.2 GST maths unit tests for all 9 seeded prices, inclusive and exclusive, with and without wallet; base + gst = amount always.
  • T43.3 Wallet: balance ₹100, price ₹299 → pay ₹199, ledger has −10000; order expires after 30 min → +10000 redemption_refund; balance back to ₹100.
  • T43.4 Two taps on Pay within 1 s send the same Idempotency-Key → one transaction, one Razorpay order.
  • T43.5 Admin publishes ₹1,799 while the sheet shows ₹1,999 → price_changed → PriceChangedSheet → pay ₹1,799.
  • T43.6 Forged signature → 402 signature_mismatch, transaction stays created, audit/security log written, no access granted.
  • T43.7 Verify arrives before webhook: server fetch says authorized → processing; webhook payment.captured 20 s later → status poll returns success; fulfilment ran exactly once.
  • T43.8 Kill the app while PhonePe is open, pay, relaunch → Splash → PaymentResult for the pending transaction → success.
  • T43.9 Cancel in Checkout → status check → cancelled screen; Try again within 25 min reuses the same order id.
  • T43.10 First attempt fails (card declined), second attempt on the same order captures → final status success, failed → captured.
  • T43.11 Late capture after the 30-min cancel → transaction captured, wallet re-debited, subscription activated, payment.late_captured push.
  • T43.12 Institute counsellor calls POST /payments/orders for INSTITUTE_REGISTRATION → 403.
  • T43.13 Offline: Pay disabled; go offline right after Checkout success → verify retried on reconnect → success.
  • T43.14 Featured purchase when 12 teachers in Bengaluru are featured → featured_slots_full.
  • T43.15 Contact unlock for a lead owned by another parent → 404; for an already unlocked lead → already_unlocked.

21. Future Scalability Notes

  • Razorpay Turbo UPI (in-app UPI without app switch) once available for the account, cutting drop-off on UPI intent.
  • Second gateway (Cashfree / PhonePe PG) behind the PaymentGateway interface with automatic failover when Razorpay's order API errors.
  • Promo codes as a second discount line in PriceBreakdownCard (Admin M05 future coupons), stored in discount_paise with metadata.promoCode.
  • Play Integrity / App Attest token on POST /payments/orders to block scripted order creation.
  • Saved UPI IDs / tokenised cards via Razorpay Customer and Tokens APIs for one-tap renewals.

Module 44 · Subscriptions

Phase 12 · Payments · Used by: Parents and students (membership), teachers (registration renewal, premium and featured boosts), institute managers (registration renewal) · Depends on: M10, M13 (plans, current subscription), M43 (PaymentSheet, orders), M45 (refund request), M47 (events); Admin M05, Admin M40, Admin M41 · New tables: none · Uses: subscriptions, payment_configurations, transactions, teachers, institutes, institute_managers, teacher_locations, teacher_daily_stats, system_settings, audit_logs · Build estimate: 4–5 days

1. Module Purpose

One "My plan" place for every role to see and manage what they pay for. Parents and students see their membership (trial, active, grace, cancelled, expired, free access), turn AutoPay (Razorpay subscription mandate over UPI Autopay or card) on or off, cancel or resume, and see past periods. Teachers and institute managers see their annual registration period and renew it before it lapses; teachers also buy and track Premium (search boost) and Featured (home-screen rail) listing boosts. All purchases go through the M43 PaymentSheet; plan lists and the summary chip come from M10 GET /plans and GET /subscriptions/current. State rules follow Admin M41 exactly; this module adds the user-side actions, the mandate flow, renewal/boost reminders and the listing-eligibility rule for lapsed registrations.

2. User Stories

  • As a parent, I want to see that my membership renews on 3 Oct for ₹299 by UPI AutoPay so that I'm not surprised by the debit.
  • As a student, I want to cancel my membership and keep access till the end of the month so that I don't lose what I paid for.
  • As a teacher, I want a reminder 30 days before my registration expires and a one-tap renew so that my profile never disappears from search.
  • As a new teacher in Pune, I want to buy Featured for 30 days and see how many featured spots are left in my city so that I know it's worth it.
  • As an institute manager, I want to renew our registration from the app so that our rating and listing stay live.
  • As a parent whose AutoPay failed, I want a clear banner with "Pay now" during the 3-day grace period so that my access doesn't stop.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-44.1 What each role sees.

Role Cards on "My plan" Actions
Parent Membership (PARENT_SUBSCRIPTION_MONTHLY/_YEARLY) Buy/change plan (M10), AutoPay on/off, cancel, resume, pay now in grace
Student Membership (STUDENT_SUBSCRIPTION_*) Same as parent (M13 trial rules)
Teacher Registration (TEACHER_REGISTRATION) + Boosts entry Renew registration, buy Premium / Featured
Institute staff, staff_role = manager Registration (INSTITUTE_REGISTRATION) Renew registration
Institute counsellor Menu item hidden; API returns FORBIDDEN —

Rows are selected by user_id = sub (institutes: subscriber_type = institute AND institute_id = iid, any manager of that institute).

BR-44.2 Display status. From subscriptions.status plus dates (Admin M41 FR-41.1):

Row state Pill text Colour + icon Access
trial "Free trial · 5 days left" blue, clock Full
active "Active" green, check Full
active + auto_renew "Active · AutoPay on" green, repeat Full
grace "Payment due" amber, alert Full for 3 days after ends_at
cancelled by user, ends_at > now "Cancelled · access till 25 Oct" grey Full until ends_at (trial_ends_at for a cancelled trial)
cancelled by admin/system "Cancelled" grey None
expired "Expired" grey None
free_access "Free for now" green Full, no end date; buy/cancel/AutoPay hidden
queued paid period (from transactions.metadata.pendingPeriod) "Starts 3 Oct" blue outline From its start

daysLeft = ceil((ends_at − now) / 1 day) in IST; the progress bar runs from starts_at to ends_at.

BR-44.3 AutoPay availability. Shown only when: fee code is a parent/student subscription; status trial or active; the fee is enabled; price_paise > 0 or it is a trial; granted_by is null (not complimentary); no queued period exists. Renewal price = list total of the version in force at renewal time (wallet is never used for AutoPay). Maximum mandate: 12 cycles for monthly, 5 for yearly.

BR-44.4 Turn AutoPay on (POST /subscriptions/:id/auto-renew { enabled: true }).

  1. Lock the row (FOR UPDATE), check BR-44.3; if gateway_subscription_id is set and Razorpay reports it authenticated/active → return on (idempotent).
  2. Get the Razorpay plan for the active payment_configurations version of the fee (Redis rzp:plan:<paymentConfigurationId>; created with period = monthly|yearly, interval = 1, item.amount = list total if missing).
  3. Create a Razorpay subscription { plan_id, total_count, start_at = unix(trial_ends_at or ends_at), customer_notify: 0, notes: { subscriptionId, userId } }; store gateway_subscription_id (auto_renew stays false).
  4. Return checkout options { key, subscription_id, name, description: "AutoPay for Parent membership · Monthly", prefill, theme, method: { upi: true, card: true, netbanking: false } }.
  5. App opens RazorpayCheckout.open(options); the user approves the mandate in their UPI app or with card OTP. Razorpay takes a small authorisation charge (₹1–₹5) that it refunds itself; it is not recorded in transactions (Admin M40's handler ignores payments whose order has no transaction and that carry a subscription_id in the authenticated phase).
  6. App calls POST /subscriptions/:id/auto-renew/confirm { razorpayPaymentId, razorpaySubscriptionId, razorpaySignature }. Server verifies HMAC_SHA256(payment_id + "|" + subscription_id, key_secret) (constant time), fetches the Razorpay subscription and, if authenticated/active, sets auto_renew = true; otherwise returns pending. Webhooks subscription.authenticated / subscription.activated set auto_renew = true if the confirm call never arrived.

BR-44.5 Turn AutoPay off ({ enabled: false }). Razorpay POST /v1/subscriptions/:sid/cancel { cancel_at_cycle_end: 0 } first (no future debits; current period untouched), then auto_renew = false. On Razorpay error → GATEWAY_ERROR, row unchanged, toggle reverts. Webhook subscription.cancelled (mandate revoked from the user's UPI app or bank) also sets auto_renew = false and sends subscription.autopay_off.

BR-44.6 AutoPay renewal charge. Banks send the RBI-mandated pre-debit notice 24 h before. Webhook subscription.charged → RenewalService.onCharged in one transaction: insert transactions (purpose = subscription, status = captured, fee_code, payment_configuration_id of the charged plan's version, amounts split as M43 BR-43.3 with W = 0, gateway_payment_id, metadata = { renewal: true, subscriptionId, gatewaySubscriptionId }); set the old row expired; insert the next period (active, starts_at = old ends_at, ends_at = starts_at + validity_days, auto_renew = true, same gateway_subscription_id, last_transaction_id); invoice via Admin M40; push subscription.renewed. Idempotent on gateway_payment_id (unique index). subscription.pending (charge failed, Razorpay will retry) → row grace from ends_at for 3 days, push subscription.renewal_failed. subscription.halted (retries exhausted) → auto_renew = false; the M41 job expires the row after grace.

BR-44.7 Pay now in grace. "Pay now" opens M43 PaymentSheet with the same fee code; on capture M43 starts the new period (Admin M41 FR-41.2) and this module cancels the Razorpay subscription so the pending retry can't charge twice, then shows "Turn AutoPay on again?".

BR-44.8 Price change with AutoPay. When Admin M05 activates a new version of a subscription fee, a pricing.changed handler updates each live Razorpay subscription's plan with schedule_change_at = cycle_end. If the new amount exceeds the UPI mandate's maximum, the mandate is cancelled, auto_renew = false and the user gets subscription.autopay_reauth. The 7-day renewal reminder (Admin M41 FR-41.3) always states the new price.

BR-44.9 Cancel (POST /subscriptions/:id/cancel). Allowed for parent/student rows in trial, active or grace. One transaction: cancel the Razorpay mandate if any (BR-44.5, failure aborts), set status = cancelled, cancelled_at = now(), cancelled_by_type = user, cancel_reason = "<reasonCode>: <text>", auto_renew = false. Access continues per BR-44.2. Registration rows, free_access and complimentary rows → CONFLICT_STATE details.reason = "not_cancellable". Cancelling never refunds automatically; if the last payment was captured within 7 days the sheet links to M45 "Request refund". A queued paid period is not affected (the sheet says so).

BR-44.10 Resume (POST /subscriptions/:id/resume). Allowed when status = cancelled, cancelled_by_type = user, the access end is in the future and no other live row exists for (user_id, subscriber_type). Sets status back to trial (if trial_ends_at > now) or active, clears cancelled_at, cancel_reason, cancelled_by_type. AutoPay stays off (the user can turn it on again).

BR-44.11 Registration renewal (teachers and institutes). The registration card shows "Renew" when ends_at is within 30 days or has passed. Renew opens PaymentSheet with { feeCode: TEACHER_REGISTRATION | INSTITUTE_REGISTRATION, context: { renewal: true } }; the new 365-day period starts at the current ends_at (or at capture if already ended) — M43 BR-43.11. Reminders (job registration-reminders, daily 10:00 IST): 30, 7 and 1 day before ends_at, and on the day it ends. If the registration fee is disabled, the card shows "Free for now" and no renew button.

BR-44.12 Listing eligibility after a lapsed registration. TeacherListingEligibility.isListed(teacherId) (and the institute equivalent) — used by M27/M28 search, M30 recommendations and M37/M39 new leads — returns true when the registration fee is disabled, or a live registration row exists, or the last registration row ended less than 7 days ago. Otherwise the profile is hidden from search and new leads are refused with SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED details.reason = "teacher_registration_lapsed"; existing leads, demos and messages keep working. Teachers see a red banner on the dashboard "Your registration ended on 12 Sep. Renew to appear in search again."

BR-44.13 Boosts (GET /teacher/boosts). Premium: active = is_premium AND premium_until > now(). Featured: same with featured_until; slotsLeft = limits.featured_slots_per_city − count(teachers featured now whose primary teacher_locations.city_id = teacher's primary city). Buying while active extends by validity_days (30) from the current end (M43 BR-43.11); the end may not pass today + 90 days. Performance block: profile views in the last 30 days vs the 30 days before (from teacher_daily_stats), leads in the last 30 days. Job boost-expiry (hourly) sets is_premium = false / is_featured = false when the end has passed and sends reminders 3 days before and on expiry. Admin-granted boosts (Admin M17) show "Added by GuruConnect" and no price.

BR-44.14 History. GET /subscriptions returns live and queued items plus a cursor-paginated history of ended rows (expired, cancelled), newest first, 20 per page, each with the last payment's public code and amount.

8. Validation Rules

14. State Management

  • Query keys (subscriptionKeys): subscriptionKeys.all, subscriptionKeys.list() (persisted), subscriptionKeys.history(cursor) (infinite, persisted first page), boostKeys.all / boostKeys.teacher() (persisted, staleTime 60 s). M10's subscriptionKeys.current shares the prefix.
  • After cancel / resume / auto-renew: invalidate subscriptionKeys.all and meKeys.me. After a boost or renewal payment M43 invalidates boostKeys.all, subscriptionKeys.all, teacherDashboardKeys.all.
  • AutoPay switch is not optimistic (money and a gateway call); it shows a spinner in place until the server answers.
  • useAutoPayFlow keeps the pending mandate { subscriptionId, razorpaySubscriptionId, startedAt } in encrypted MMKV so a killed app re-checks the state (GET /subscriptions) on next launch.

15. Offline Handling

  • MyPlan and TeacherBoosts render from the persisted cache offline with "Updated 2 h ago"; the status pill still counts days from the cached endsAt.
  • All actions (AutoPay, cancel, resume, renew, buy boost) are online only; buttons are disabled offline with "Connect to the internet to change your plan."

17. Security Rules

  • Ownership: rows by user_id = sub; institute rows by institute_id = iid and staff_role = manager; :id of another user → NOT_FOUND.
  • Only parent/student rows accept AutoPay, cancel and resume; teachers/institutes → FORBIDDEN.
  • Mandate signature verified server-side; gateway_subscription_id must match the row. Mandate checkout screen uses FLAG_SECURE.
  • UPI handles are masked (lak…@okaxis); card mandates show "Card •••• 4821" only.
  • Cancel/resume/auto-renew require If-Match; 10 AutoPay toggles per hour per user (prevents mandate spam).

18. Error Handling

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
Cancel a registration, free or complimentary row CONFLICT_STATE (not_cancellable) 409 Toast with message
Resume when another plan is live or access ended CONFLICT_STATE (cannot_resume) 409 Toast, refetch
AutoPay not available for this row CONFLICT_STATE (autopay_unavailable) 409 Hide switch, refetch
Mandate signature mismatch PAYMENT_FAILED (signature_mismatch) 402 AutoPayResult failed
Razorpay down on AutoPay on/off GATEWAY_ERROR 502 Switch reverts, toast "Couldn't reach the bank. Try again."
Changed on another device VERSION_CONFLICT 409 Refetch, "Updated on another device. Review and try again."
Counsellor opens My plan / teacher calls cancel FORBIDDEN 403 Toast "You can't do that."
New lead to a lapsed teacher (M37) SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED (teacher_registration_lapsed) 402 Learner sees "This teacher isn't taking new requests right now."
Too many AutoPay toggles RATE_LIMITED 429 Disable switch until Retry-After

  • T44.1 Happy path (Maestro subscriptions_autopay_on): active parent → AutoPay on → test mandate approved → confirm → pill "Active · AutoPay on", next charge date shown.
  • T44.2 Webhook subscription.charged → old row expired, new active row, transactions row with metadata.renewal = true; replayed webhook creates nothing new.
  • T44.3 subscription.pending → row grace, amber banner; Pay now via PaymentSheet → new period, Razorpay subscription cancelled.
  • T44.4 Cancel active monthly with reason → status cancelled, access till ends_at, AutoPay off; Resume → active again.

  • T44.7 Registration ended 8 days ago → isListed false → teacher missing from M27 search; new lead → teacher_registration_lapsed.

  • T44.9 Premium active till +85 days → Extend disabled (would pass 90 days).

  • T44.11 Admin publishes ₹349 monthly → Razorpay plan updated at cycle end; reminder shows ₹349.
  • T44.12 Offline: MyPlan renders from cache, all buttons disabled.
  • T44.13 Institute counsellor → GET /subscriptions 403; manager sees the institute registration paid by another manager.

Module 45 · Payment History

Phase 12 · Payments · Used by: Parents, students, teachers and institute managers (anyone who has paid GuruConnect) · Depends on: M00, M43 (transactions, PaymentResult "View receipt" link), M44 (subscription refund hint); Admin M40 (refunds, invoices, webhook-driven decisions) · New tables: none · Uses: transactions, refunds · Build estimate: 2–3 days

1. Module Purpose

One place, "Payment history" (opened from Profile and from M43's PaymentResult), where anyone who has paid GuruConnect sees every payment they made, opens the GST invoice for each, and — within a 7-day window — asks for a refund. The module owns nothing about how money moves: it lists transactions rows scoped to the signed-in user, serves the invoice Admin M40 generated on capture, and creates a refunds row that Admin M40's maker-checker flow (FR-40.2) then approves, denies or fails. Refund status the user sees always comes from that same row, so support and the app never disagree about where a refund stands.

2. User Stories

  • As a parent, I want to see every payment I've made — memberships, contact unlocks — with dates and amounts so that I can track what I've spent.
  • As a teacher, I want to download the GST invoice for my ₹499 registration fee so that I can claim it as a business expense.
  • As a student who was charged twice by mistake, I want to request a refund for the extra charge so that I get my money back without calling support.
  • As an institute manager, I want to see the institute's registration payment and its invoice for our accounts team.
  • As a parent whose AutoPay renewal failed, I want to see the failed attempt in my history so that I understand why my membership lapsed.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-45.1 Scope and ownership. GET /payments and GET /payments/:id return only rows where transactions.user_id = sub — the person who actually paid, never every payment linked to their institute. An institute manager sees the registration and boost payments they personally made; a counsellor, who never pays, sees an empty list (the menu item still shows so they can find the invoice link if a manager forwards it, but :id lookups for another user's transaction return NOT_FOUND, never FORBIDDEN, so the id space isn't enumerable).

BR-45.2 List (GET /payments). Cursor-paginated, newest first, 20 per page (limit 1–50). Each row: purpose (mapped to a plain label — "Parent membership · Monthly", "Teacher registration", "Contact unlock", "Premium listing", "Featured listing"), amountPaise, status mapped to the same five states as M43 BR-43.10 (pending, processing, success, failed, expired, refunded) plus partially_refunded shown as "Partially refunded", capturedAt or createdAt when never captured, publicCode, and invoiceAvailable. Optional filters ?status= and ?purpose= narrow the list; both accept the same enums as transactions.status/purpose.

BR-45.3 Detail (GET /payments/:id). Full breakdown (basePaise, gstPaise, discountPaise, amountPaise, refundedAmountPaise, refundableAmountPaise = amountPaise − refundedAmountPaise − sum of open refund requests' amountPaise), masked method (upi, card, netbanking — never an account or card number, Razorpay never returns one), gateway reference (gatewayPaymentId, shown truncated with copy-on-long-press, matching M43's PaymentResult), the fulfilment summary reused verbatim from Admin M40 GET /transactions/:id ({ type, state, … } — e.g. { type: "subscription", state: "done", endsAt }), and the full refunds history for that transaction (id, amountPaise, reasonCode, status, decidedAt, denialReason, processedAt) oldest first.

BR-45.4 Invoice (GET /payments/:id/invoice). Returns a 60-second presigned GET to the PDF Admin M40 generated at capture (FR-40.5), only when invoice_number IS NOT NULL. Before capture, or for a failed/cancelled transaction, → CONFLICT_STATE details.reason = "invoice_not_ready" and the button is hidden client-side. A refund produces a credit note (Admin M40); when any refunds row is processed, the response also carries creditNoteUrl for that refund.

BR-45.5 Refund request (POST /payments/:id/refund-request, Idempotency-Key). In one transaction, holding a row lock on the transaction:

  1. Transaction must belong to the caller, status in captured, partially_refunded and refundableAmountPaise > 0 — otherwise CONFLICT_STATE details.reason = "not_refundable".
  2. No existing refunds row for this transaction in requested, approved, processing — otherwise CONFLICT_STATE details.reason = "refund_already_requested" with that row's id.
  3. captured_at must be within the last 7 days (refund_hold_window_days, matches the hint shown in M44's CancelSubscriptionSheet) — otherwise CONFLICT_STATE details.reason = "refund_window_expired"; the sheet closes and offers "Contact support" (M53, ticket pre-filled with the transaction).
  4. Insert refunds (amount_paise = refundableAmountPaise — v1 only supports requesting the full refundable amount, no partial amount field from the user — reason_code one of duplicate_charge, service_not_started, user_request, other (never teacher_rejected, institute_rejected or goodwill, which are system/admin-only per Admin M40 FR-40.2), reason_note, status = requested, requested_by_type = app_user, requested_by_id = sub).
  5. Audit app.refund_requested. From here the row is entirely Admin M40's maker-checker: an admin with refunds.approve who isn't the requester (always true here, since the app user can never hold that permission) approves or denies; Razorpay processes the approved refund; refund.processed / refund.failed webhooks finish it.

BR-45.6 Status shown to the user, per refunds.status.

refunds.status Shown as Detail screen copy
requested "Refund requested" "We're reviewing your request. This usually takes 1–2 business days."
approved, processing "Refund in progress" "Your refund of ₹199 was approved and is being processed by the bank."
processed "Refunded" "₹199 refunded on 3 Oct 2026. It can take 5–7 working days to reflect in your account." + "Download credit note"
denied "Refund declined" denial_reason verbatim, plus "Contact support" link
failed "Refund failed" "Something went wrong processing this refund. Our team has been notified and will retry."

A partially_refunded transaction with a further open request is blocked by BR-45.5 step 2 until that request resolves.

BR-45.7 Reused, not redefined. Invoice generation, the refund approval/denial/processing pipeline, credit notes, and the nightly reconciliation all belong to Admin M40 (FR-40.2, FR-40.5); this module never calls Razorpay directly and never changes transactions.status. M43's PaymentResult "View receipt" link and M44's CancelSubscriptionSheet "Request a refund" link both open PaymentDetail for a given transactionId — no separate deep link is needed beyond gc://payments/:id.

6. Screen Wireframe Description

PaymentHistory — header "Payment history". Rows (FlashList): purpose icon (card for subscription, key for contact unlock, badge for registration, star for boosts), title "Parent membership · Monthly", date "26 Sep 2026", right-aligned amount "₹199" with StatusPill beneath ("Success" green, "Failed" red, "Refunded" grey, "Partially refunded" amber, "Processing" blue). Pull-to-refresh. Infinite scroll with ListFooterLoader. Empty: illustration, "No payments yet", body "Your membership and other purchases will show up here."; Loading: 6 skeleton rows; Error: ErrorState + Retry.

PaymentDetail — header shows publicCode "TXN-7702140" with a copy icon. Purpose title and date. Breakdown card (same KeyValueRow layout as M43's PaymentSheet): "Amount paid" ₹199, "Base" ₹168.64, "GST (18%)" ₹30.36, "Wallet used" −₹100 (if any), divider, "Refunded" ₹0 (hidden when zero). Method row "UPI · lak…@okaxis" or "Card •••• 4821". Reference row "pay_OZ4lA1bC2dE3fG" (long-press to copy). Fulfilment line, one of: "Membership active till 25 Oct 2026", "Registration fee received. Verification in progress.", "Contact unlocked. You can now call Dr. Ananya Iyer.", "Premium listing active till 20 Oct 2026". Buttons: Download invoice (spinner while presigning, then opens the OS share sheet / PDF viewer) — hidden with no message when invoiceAvailable is false. Below: Request refund (visible only when refundableAmountPaise > 0 and within 7 days of capture) or, once one exists, a Refund status card per BR-45.6 with a "Download credit note" link when processed; after the 7-day window and with no existing request: muted text "It's been more than 7 days since this payment. Contact support if something's wrong." with a Contact support link. Loading: skeleton breakdown card. Error: ErrorState + Retry.

RefundRequestSheet — heading "Request a refund", subheading "You're eligible to refund ₹199 from this payment.", reason radio list: "I was charged twice" (duplicate_charge), "The service hasn't started yet" (service_not_started), "I don't need this anymore" (user_request), "Other" (other, reveals a text field), note field "Tell us more" (10–500 chars, required for all reasons), info line "Refund requests are reviewed within 1–2 business days.", buttons Submit request and "Cancel".

12. PostgreSQL Tables & Columns

Existing tables this module reads or writes (full definitions in the owning module)

Table Owner Purpose
transactions Admin M40 Every payment attempt through Razorpay, plus refunds and reward payouts. Amounts in paise.
refunds Admin M40 Refund requests and their gateway processing.
  • transactions: read only; this module never updates a transaction — status, refunded_amount_paise and invoice_number all change through Admin M40's capture, webhook and refund pipeline (M43 BR-43.11, Admin M40 FR-40.2).
  • refunds: this module inserts one row per user-initiated request (requested_by_type = 'app_user', requested_by_id = sub); every later transition (approved → processing → processed/failed, or denied) is written by Admin M40. Reads join back to transactions.id for the history list in BR-45.3.

13. Relationships

Entity relationship diagram (tables this module uses; admins omitted)

Diagram loads when this page is online…

14. State Management

  • Query keys (paymentHistoryKeys): paymentHistoryKeys.list(filters) (infinite, persisted first page), paymentHistoryKeys.detail(id) (persisted, staleTime 30 s). M43 invalidates paymentHistoryKeys.all after every successful purchase (BR-43 @state).
  • useRequestRefundMutation is not optimistic (creates a real request); on success it invalidates paymentHistoryKeys.detail(id).
  • No client-side state beyond the query cache and the open bottom sheet.

15. Offline Handling

  • PaymentHistory and PaymentDetail render from the persisted cache offline ("Updated 2 h ago"); refund history and invoice availability reflect the last successful fetch.
  • Invoice download and refund request are online only (conventions §8 class 3); both buttons disabled offline with "Connect to the internet to do this."

16. Push Notification Requirements

Event Recipient Title / Body Deep link Category Urgent
payment.refund_processed Payer "Refund completed" / "₹199 refunded to your original payment method for TXN-7702140." gc://payments/<id> payments no
payment.refund_denied Payer "Refund request declined" / "<denialReason>" gc://payments/<id> payments no
payment.refund_failed Payer "Refund couldn't be processed" / "We're retrying your ₹199 refund for TXN-7702140." gc://payments/<id> payments no

In-app only: the "Refund requested" confirmation toast right after submit. payment.captured/payment.failed/payment.late_captured are M43's events, not repeated here.

17. Security Rules

  • Ownership: every lookup is WHERE id = :id AND user_id = :sub; a valid id belonging to another user returns NOT_FOUND, never FORBIDDEN (no confirmation that the id exists).
  • Invoice and credit-note URLs are 60-second presigned GETs, never cached, never logged.
  • reason_code is restricted server-side to the four user-selectable values regardless of what the client sends; the other three (teacher_rejected, institute_rejected, goodwill) are rejected with VALIDATION_FAILED even if a modified client sends them.
  • PaymentDetail uses useSecureScreen() (FLAG_SECURE / iOS snapshot blur), matching M43.
  • Rate limit 5 refund requests per hour per user (abuse/spam protection); gateway ids and masked handles are scrubbed from analytics and Sentry breadcrumbs.

18. Error Handling

Scenario Code HTTP App behaviour
Transaction not captured/partially refunded CONFLICT_STATE (not_refundable) 409 Toast "Only completed payments can be refunded."
Refund already requested and open CONFLICT_STATE (refund_already_requested) 409 Sheet closes, RefundStatusCard shown instead
Fully refunded already CONFLICT_STATE (already_refunded) 409 Sheet closes, refetch
Older than 7 days CONFLICT_STATE (refund_window_expired) 409 Sheet closes, "Contact support" link shown
Invoice not generated yet CONFLICT_STATE (invoice_not_ready) 409 Button hidden; if tapped via stale cache, toast "Invoice isn't ready yet."
Transaction of another user NOT_FOUND 404 "This payment isn't available." + back
Too many refund requests RATE_LIMITED 429 Disable button until Retry-After
Idempotency key reused with another body VALIDATION_FAILED (idempotency_key_reused) 422 Toast "Please try again."

19. Testing Scenarios

  • T45.1 Happy path (Maestro payment_history_view): parent opens Payment history from Profile → list shows a captured and a failed row → tap the captured one → breakdown, method and fulfilment shown → Download invoice opens the PDF.
  • T45.2 Refund request within 7 days on a captured contact-unlock payment → refunds row inserted requested; detail shows "Refund requested".
  • T45.3 Refund request 8 days after capture → refund_window_expired; sheet closes, "Contact support" link opens M53 with the transaction pre-filled.
  • T45.4 Second refund request while one is already requested → refund_already_requested, existing status shown instead.
  • T45.5 Refund request on a failed transaction → not_refundable.
  • T45.6 Invoice tapped on a transaction still created/authorized → button not shown; direct call → invoice_not_ready.
  • T45.7 GET /payments/:id for a transaction owned by another user → 404.
  • T45.8 Offline: history and a previously-opened detail render from cache; Download invoice and Request refund disabled with the offline hint.
  • T45.9 Two rapid taps on Submit request with the same Idempotency-Key → exactly one refunds row.
  • T45.10 Admin approves and Razorpay processes the refund (Admin M40) → refund.processed → app polls/refetches on next open → "Refunded ₹199 on 3 Oct" with a credit note link; push payment.refund_processed received.
  • T45.11 Admin denies with a reason → detail shows "Refund declined: <reason>"; push payment.refund_denied received.
  • T45.12 45 payments on the account → first page returns 20 with nextCursor set; scrolling loads the rest with no duplicates or gaps.

Event When Details
app.refund_requested Refund request submitted transaction id, refund id, amount, reason code
Invoice downloads and history views are reads and are not audit-logged (conventions §11); approvals, denials and processing are logged by Admin M40 as admin/system actor.

21. Future Scalability Notes

  • Partial-amount refund requests (currently full refundable amount only) once support needs finer control from the app side.
  • Bulk export (CSV/PDF) of a date range for a teacher's or institute's annual tax filing.
  • In-app support chat pre-filled from a payment instead of a plain ticket link.
  • Push the refund decision the moment Admin M40's webhook lands, instead of relying on the next GET /payments/:id (already covered by BR-45's push table; today the app also refetches on foreground).
  • A combined annual GST statement (all invoices for a financial year in one PDF) once teachers ask for it at tax time.

Module 46 · Referral System

Phase 13 · Referrals · Used by: Parents, students (Learner Referral), teachers (Teacher Referral) and institute managers (Institute Referral) — any signed-in user who can invite or be invited · Depends on: M00, M05 (referral code field at registration), M33 (share sheet component reused for invites); Admin M06 (referral_settings — program rules and terms), Admin M42 (referral_codes, referrals — attribution, fraud scoring, qualification, payout and admin review) · New tables: wallet_ledger · Uses: referral_codes, referrals, referral_settings, transactions · Build estimate: 4–5 days

1. Module Purpose

The Refer & Earn experience: a personal code every user can share, a screen that shows who they've invited and what they've earned, and the "I have a code" flow for someone who signs up without one. GuruConnect runs three programs — LEARNER_REFERRAL for parents and students, TEACHER_REFERRAL for teachers, INSTITUTE_REFERRAL for institute managers — configured in Admin M06 and each user sees only the one program that matches their role. This module owns wallet_ledger, GuruConnect's spendable-credit balance: referral rewards land here, M43 spends from here at checkout, and every entry is visible to the user as a plain-English line. All of the fraud scoring, code attribution, qualification and admin review that decide whether a referral earns anything live in Admin M42; this module only shows the resulting status — and never the fraud signals behind it.

2. User Stories

  • As a parent, I want to share my code on WhatsApp so my friend gets ₹100 off and I get ₹100 in my wallet once she subscribes.
  • As a teacher, I want to see that my invited friend is verified and my ₹200 reward is on its way so I know the invite worked.
  • As a student who installed the app from a friend's link but signed up without entering the code, I want to add it within a few days so we both still get the reward.
  • As a parent with ₹100 in her wallet, I want to see exactly where that credit came from before I use it at checkout.
  • As an institute manager, I want to invite another institute owner I know so that we both get a discount on registration.
  • As anyone whose reward was reversed, I want a simple "reversed" line in my wallet, not a scary fraud notice.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-46.1 One code per user per program. RC.getOrCreate(userId) is called the first time GET /referrals/me or InviteFriends is opened: it maps the caller's role to a program (parent/student → LEARNER_REFERRAL, teacher → TEACHER_REFERRAL, institute staff with staff_role = manager → INSTITUTE_REFERRAL) and creates a referral_codes row (code = upper(first name, transliterated to ASCII) + 2–3 digits until unique, e.g. LAKSHMI50, Admin M42 FR-42.1) if none exists for that (user_id, program_code). Institute counsellors have no program and no code; InviteFriends/ReferralCode are hidden from their menu and the endpoints return FORBIDDEN.

BR-46.2 Program rules are read live. GET /referrals/me reads the active referral_settings row for the caller's program (Admin M06) and returns isEnabled, referrerRewardPaise, refereeRewardPaise, rewardHoldDays, qualifyingEvent mapped to plain copy (first_payment → "after your friend's first payment", teacher_approved → "after your friend is verified", institute_approved → "after your friend's institute is verified"), and termsText (rendered as Markdown). When isEnabled is false the screen still shows the user's code and past earnings but hides the invite call-to-action behind "Referrals are paused right now — check back soon."; a code shared while paused still opens the app (deep link resolves) but Admin M42 records the referral rejected with reason program_disabled (Admin M06 FR-6.3.6), which this module shows as "Not eligible" without further explanation.

BR-46.3 Applying a code after signup (POST /referrals/apply, Idempotency-Key). The same underlying ReferralService.attribute(refereeUserId, code) is called from two places: M05's registration step (when the user enters a code inline while signing up) and this endpoint (when they didn't, or weren't sure, and add one afterwards). In one transaction:

  1. app_users.created_at must be within the last 7 days — otherwise CONFLICT_STATE details.reason = "referral_window_expired".
  2. The account must not already have a referrals row as referee (uq_referrals_referee) — otherwise CONFLICT_STATE details.reason = "already_referred".
  3. The code must resolve to an active, unexpired referral_codes row under its usage limit — otherwise VALIDATION_FAILED "That code isn't valid or has expired."; the code's program_code must match the caller's own program (a parent can't apply a TEACHER_REFERRAL code) — otherwise the same message.
  4. The code must not belong to the caller — otherwise VALIDATION_FAILED "You can't use your own code."
  5. Insert referrals (status = pending, referral_setting_id = the program's active version, referrer_user_id from the code, referee_user_id = sub) — Admin M42 FR-42.2 then takes over fraud scoring, qualification and payout exactly as it would for a code entered at registration. Success always returns 200 even when the program is disabled or the code was a now-expired campaign code that still resolves (Admin M06 FR-6.3.6): the copy adapts ("Code applied — rewards aren't available right now" vs "Code applied! You'll both be rewarded once <event>.").

BR-46.4 Deep link capture. https://guruconnect.in/r/<code> and gc://r/<code> (conventions §4) opened before install are stored by the install-attribution SDK and read once after first sign-in; opened after sign-in they pre-fill ApplyCodeSheet directly. Either way BR-46.3 is what actually attributes the referral — a stored link by itself does nothing.

BR-46.5 Status shown to the referrer, mapped from referrals.status (Admin M42 FR-42.3/42.4 — fraud detail is never exposed).

referrals.status Shown as Reward line
pending, on_hold "Invited" "Waiting for <event>"
qualified "Qualified" "₹100 unlocks on 3 Oct" (reward_release_at)
rewarded "Rewarded" "₹100 credited to your wallet"
rejected, expired, reversed "Not eligible" — (no reason shown; on_hold's fraud review and a later rejected look identical to the user)

GET /referrals lists every invite the caller has sent, newest first, with the referee shown as first name + last initial ("Priya S.") and joinedAt; a campaign code has no referrer view (not applicable here — those are Admin-only, Admin M42 §14).

BR-46.6 Payout, mirrored into the wallet this module owns. At reward_release_at, Admin M42's job (FR-42.5) marks qualified → rewarded and, for the currently-seeded programs (reward_type = wallet_credit), the same job inserts, alongside its transactions row (purpose = referral_payout, direction = debit, gateway = wallet):

  1. wallet_ledger for the referrer: entry_type = referral_reward, amount_paise = +reward_amount_paise, referral_id, transaction_id (the payout transaction), idempotency_key = referral_reward:<referralId>, description = "Referral reward · <referee first name>".
  2. When referee_reward_paise > 0: wallet_ledger for the referee: entry_type = referee_bonus, amount_paise = +referee_reward_paise, referral_id, idempotency_key = referee_bonus:<referralId>, description = "Welcome bonus for joining with a referral code". (A future reward_type = discount program instead applies refereeRewardPaise as transactions.discount_paise at the referee's first purchase — M43's future scalability note — and writes no wallet row.) Both entries' expires_at is left null (referral credit does not expire at launch).

BR-46.7 Reversal. Admin M42's POST /referrals/:id/reverse (FR-42.6) posts a matching wallet_ledger row (entry_type = reversal, negative amount equal to the entry(ies) it undoes, idempotency_key = reversal:<referralId>) for whichever of the referrer/referee still hold the credit. The balance may go negative (M43 BR-43.11 already documents this for the checkout side); this module never blocks a negative balance, it only stops "Use wallet balance" from offering more than the (floor-zero) positive amount.

BR-46.8 Wallet (GET /wallet). balancePaise = SUM(wallet_ledger.amount_paise) WHERE user_id = sub (Redis-cached 30 s, invalidated on any write to the user's rows). Cursor-paginated ledger (newest first, 20 per page) with each entry mapped to plain copy by entry_type: referral_reward → "Referral reward · <description>", referee_bonus → "Welcome bonus", checkout_redemption → "Used at checkout · <transaction public code>", redemption_refund → "Refund · <transaction public code>", reversal → "Reward reversed", expiry → "Credit expired", admin_adjustment → "Adjustment by GuruConnect" (with reason_note if the admin set one). Sign and colour follow amount_paise (green +, muted red −). A negative running balance (rare, post-reversal) shows a one-line note: "A previous reward was reversed. Future credits will apply here first."

BR-46.9 Sharing. InviteFriends's share text is built server-side per program and returned by GET /referrals/me as shareText (so copy changes don't need an app release): e.g. "Join GuruConnect with my code LAKSHMI50 and get ₹100 off your first month! https://guruconnect.in/r/LAKSHMI50". Sharing reuses M33's react-native-share WhatsApp-first sheet and expo-clipboard for "Copy link"; a share does not by itself create a referrals row (BR-46.3/4 do).

BR-46.10 Stats on GET /referrals/me. invitedCount (all non-rejected rows), qualifiedCount, rewardedCount, totalEarnedPaise (sum of rewarded rows' reward_amount_paise), pendingPaise (sum of qualified rows' reward_amount_paise not yet released). These come from the caller's own referrals rows as referrer only; a user is never shown their own referee-side reward inline here (it appears in their wallet once credited, per BR-46.6).

6. Screen Wireframe Description

ReferralCode — header "Refer & earn". Code card: big monospace "LAKSHMI50" with a copy icon, subtitle "Share this code — you both get ₹100" (from shareText's first line). Sticky button Invite friends. Stats row: "3 invited · 1 qualified · ₹100 earned" (tap → ReferralEarnings). Wallet card: "Wallet balance ₹100" with chevron → Wallet. Below: link "Have a code? Enter it" (hidden after 7 days from signup or once a code is already attached — shows "Referred by LAKSHMI50" instead, greyed, no action). Paused state: banner "Referrals are paused right now — check back soon." replaces the Invite button. Loading: skeleton card. Error: ErrorState + Retry.

InviteFriends — header "Invite friends". Big code repeated, buttons Share on WhatsApp, Copy link, "More options" (native share sheet). "How it works" 3 steps with icons: "1. Share your code", "2. Your friend signs up and pays for membership", "3. You both get ₹100 — released after 7 days." Terms link opens a full-screen Markdown viewer with termsText.

ReferralEarnings — header "Your invites". Rows: avatar-initial circle, "Priya S.", "Joined 20 Sep 2026", right side StatusPill ("Invited" grey, "Qualified" blue, "Rewarded" green, "Not eligible" muted) and reward line ("₹100 unlocks on 3 Oct" / "₹100 credited" / blank). Empty: illustration, "No invites yet", body "Share your code to start earning.", button Invite friends.

Wallet — header "Wallet", big balance "₹100" top of screen. List of entries (FlashList): icon by sign, description, date, amount ("+₹100" green / "−₹100" muted), e.g. "Referral reward · Priya S. · 3 Oct 2026 · +₹100", "Used at checkout · TXN-7702140 · 26 Sep 2026 · −₹100". Negative-balance note banner when relevant. Empty: "No wallet activity yet", body "Refer a friend to start earning credit."

ApplyCodeSheet — heading "Have a referral code?", field "Enter code" (auto-uppercase, e.g. "PRIYA22"), helper "You can only add a code within 7 days of signing up." (only shown when relevant), button Apply code; success state replaces the sheet content with a check icon and the copy from BR-46.3.

12. PostgreSQL Tables & Columns

New tables owned by this module (migration sql/migrations/146_app_m46_referral_system_wallet.sql)

wallet_ledger

Append-only ledger of GuruConnect wallet credits and debits (referral rewards, use at checkout, reversals). Balance = sum(amount_paise).

Column Type Null Default Constraints / References Description
id uuid no gen_random_uuid() PK Primary key
user_id uuid no — FK → app_users.id (on delete restrict) Wallet owner
amount_paise bigint no — CHECK amount_paise <> 0 Positive = credit, negative = debit
entry_type text no — CHECK entry_type IN ('referral_reward','referee_bonus','checkout_redemption','redemption_refund','reversal','expiry','admin_adjustment') Why
referral_id uuid yes — FK → referrals.id (on delete restrict) Source referral
transaction_id uuid yes — FK → transactions.id (on delete restrict) Related payment / payout record
description text no — — Shown in the app, e.g. Reward: Priya joined with your code
expires_at timestamptz yes — — Credits expire 365 days after issue
idempotency_key text no — — e.g. referral_reward:<referralId>
created_at timestamptz no now() — Posted

<details><summary>DDL</summary>

CREATE TABLE wallet_ledger (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES app_users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Wallet owner
  amount_paise bigint NOT NULL CHECK (amount_paise <> 0), -- Positive = credit, negative = debit
  entry_type text NOT NULL CHECK (entry_type IN ('referral_reward','referee_bonus','checkout_redemption','redemption_refund','reversal','expiry','admin_adjustment')), -- Why
  referral_id uuid REFERENCES referrals(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Source referral
  transaction_id uuid REFERENCES transactions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Related payment / payout record
  description text NOT NULL, -- Shown in the app, e.g. Reward: Priya joined with your code
  expires_at timestamptz, -- Credits expire 365 days after issue
  idempotency_key text NOT NULL, -- e.g. referral_reward:<referralId>
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now() -- Posted
);

14. State Management

  • Query keys (referralKeys): referralKeys.me() (persisted, staleTime 60 s), referralKeys.list(cursor) (infinite, persisted first page). walletKeys: walletKeys.balance() (persisted, staleTime 30 s — same key M43 reads for "Use wallet balance"), walletKeys.ledger(cursor) (infinite).
  • After a successful POST /referrals/apply: invalidate referralKeys.me(), meKeys.me (subscription/trial state may change once qualified later, not immediately).
  • Push events (BR below) invalidate referralKeys.me(), referralKeys.list, walletKeys.balance, walletKeys.ledger for whichever user they target.
  • No optimistic updates: applying a code and sharing are not reversible client actions worth faking.

15. Offline Handling

  • ReferralCode, ReferralEarnings and Wallet render from the persisted cache offline ("Updated 2 h ago").
  • POST /referrals/apply is online only (conventions §8 class 3, it changes account-level attribution); the button is disabled offline with "Connect to the internet to apply a code."
  • Sharing works offline for "Copy link" (clipboard) but the WhatsApp/native share sheet needs the app installed on the receiving side regardless of the sharer's connectivity — no special handling needed.

Event Recipient Title / Body Deep link Category Urgent

17. Security Rules

  • Ownership: GET /referrals and GET /wallet always scope to user_id = sub; there is no way to view another user's code stats, invites or wallet.
  • Fraud signals (fraud_score, fraud_flags, on_hold distinct from pending) are computed and stored by Admin M42 and never serialised into any app response — the DTO for GET /referrals maps both to the same "Invited" status.
  • POST /referrals/apply is rate-limited 5/hour per user and 20/hour per install id (code-guessing / brute-force protection); repeated invalid codes from one account are flagged for Admin M42's fraud review the same as at registration.
  • The referee's masked name in GET /referrals is first name + last initial only, matching how names are shown elsewhere pre-contact-unlock (conventions §13).
  • Wallet balance and ledger never reveal another user's data; admin_adjustment entries show only the admin's note, never the admin's name.

  • T46.7 Admin reverses a paid reward → referrer's wallet shows a reversal entry and balance decreases (may go negative); referral status shows "Not eligible" with no reason text.

  • T46.10 Wallet balance used at checkout (M43) then refunded (expiry/cancel) → redemption_refund entry appears in GET /wallet and the balance is restored.

21. Future Scalability Notes

  • Wallet credit expiry after a configurable number of days (no expiry at launch; wallet_ledger.expires_at is already in the schema for this).
  • Tiered rewards (a bigger reward after 5 successful referrals) once Admin M42 ships tiered rules.
  • A referral leaderboard visible to users themselves (today GET /referrals/top-referrers is admin-only), as a light gamification layer.
  • Share-link attribution with per-channel tracking (WhatsApp vs SMS vs copy-link conversion) beyond the existing profile_shares table (M33).
  • reward_type = discount programs applying the referee's reward automatically at their first PaymentSheet checkout instead of (or in addition to) a wallet credit.

Module 47 · Push Notifications

Phase 14 · Notifications · Used by: Any user (infrastructure and reference used by every other module) · Depends on: M00 (delivery pipeline, device registration, NotificationService — this module documents its contract rather than rebuilding it), M20 (preference switches UI); Admin M46 (campaigns share this pipeline); every module listed in the event catalogue below · New tables: none · Uses: user_devices, user_notifications, user_notification_preferences, notifications, notification_recipients · Build estimate: 3–4 days

1. Module Purpose

This module doesn't send a single event of its own beyond open-tracking — it is the contract every other module's push follows. It restates the delivery pipeline M00 built (so it isn't re-explained 40 times), owns the one thing genuinely missing from M00's plumbing (POST /notifications/:id/opened, which closes the loop for both the in-app inbox and Admin M46's campaign analytics), defines the permission-request UX and Android/iOS channel mapping every screen with a push relies on, and — its main deliverable — gathers the full event catalogue: every push event any module defines, in one table, so a developer adding module 52 doesn't invent a fourth way to spell "your registration expired" or push a category the user turned off. Business rules that decide when an event fires stay in the module that owns the trigger (M37 decides when a lead is new, M44 decides when a subscription renews); this module only decides how any of them gets to a phone.

2. User Stories

  • As a developer adding a new feature, I want one table of every existing push event so that I reuse a category and tone instead of inventing new copy.
  • As a parent, I want to be asked for notification permission right after I send my first request, not on first launch, so the ask makes sense.
  • As a teacher, I want lead notifications to sound different from a "your profile is verified" notification so I never miss a paying opportunity.
  • As product, I want admin campaigns (Admin M46) to go through the exact same pipeline as a lead alert so delivery, quiet hours and counting are consistent everywhere.
  • As a user who tapped a notification while the app was closed, I want it marked read and to land on the right screen without a second tap.

3. Business Rules & Logic

BR-47.1 The pipeline (built in M00, restated as the contract every module's server code calls). NotificationService.notify(userId, { category, eventType, title, body, deepLink, data, dedupeKey, urgent }): insert user_notifications (ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) DO NOTHING — a retried job or a duplicate trigger never double-sends) → read user_notification_preferences for category (missing row = push on, email off) → disabled → push_status = skipped_pref, stop (the inbox row still exists — M48 shows it even with push off) → outside 08:00–21:30 IST and not urgent → delivery delayed to 08:00, not dropped → enqueue BullMQ push:send → worker loads the user's active user_devices (revoked_at IS NULL), sends one FCM v1 request per token (batched 500), sets push_status = sent if at least one token succeeded, no_device if there were none, and revokes any device whose token comes back UNREGISTERED/INVALID_ARGUMENT.

BR-47.2 What every event needs. A unique eventType (<domain>.<verb>, e.g. payment.captured), one of the 11 categories from conventions §16, a dedupeKey template unique per occurrence (e.g. payment:<transactionId>:captured, lead:<leadId>:new), and an urgent flag reserved for something the user must act on within minutes or that they caused seconds ago (a payment they just made, a demo starting in an hour, a renewal that just failed) — never for routine good news, which can wait for quiet hours to end.

BR-47.3 Naming is inconsistent across a few early modules; this table is the point where it gets reconciled rather than silently duplicated. subscription.grace_started (M10, an early build of the parent plan screen) and subscription.renewal_failed (M44, the full subscriptions module that supersedes it) describe the same underlying event — the client treats them as aliases and a later cleanup should retire the M10 name. Likewise subscription.moved_to_free_access/.moved_to_trial (M10) and subscription.free_access (M44) are the same event under two names. Several early modules (lead_new, demo_requested, review_published, …) used snake_case before this module fixed the domain.verb convention (BR-47.2) — they are not renamed retroactively (that would break stored dedupeKeys already in production), but every event added after this module ships uses the dotted form.

BR-47.4 Admin campaigns share the pipeline, not the rules. Admin M46 composes its own title/body/deepLink, resolves its audience, and inserts one user_notifications row per recipient with campaign_id set and category fixed to announcements — never a transactional category, so muting announcements never silences a lead or a payment. The same quiet-hours and urgent logic applies (urgent only for a Super Admin's campaign, Admin M46 FR-46.3); the 2-per-day cap (notifications.daily_cap) applies only to announcements campaigns, never to transactional events, which are uncapped by design.

BR-47.5 Open tracking (POST /notifications/:id/opened). Called once, the first time a user_notifications row is opened — cold start (getInitialNotification), background tap (onNotificationOpenedApp) or a foreground banner tap (BR-47.9) — for any row, transactional or a copied campaign. In one transaction: set read_at = now() if still null (this is the tap path; M48 additionally lets a user mark an item read from the inbox list without opening it, which is a separate, already-existing write this module doesn't duplicate); when campaign_id IS NOT NULL, also set notification_recipients.status = 'opened', opened_at = now() for (campaign_id, sub) and increment notifications.opened_count (Admin M46's funnel). Idempotent: opening an already-opened notification again is a no-op 200.

BR-47.6 Permission timing. Never asked on first launch. One PushPermissionExplainer per meaningful moment, shown at most once every 14 days if dismissed or denied: parent/student — right after their first lead or first favourite, whichever happens first; teacher — at the end of registration ("Get notified the moment you're verified", M14/M20); institute — right after registration submission (M21). Android 13+ asks POST_NOTIFICATIONS directly after the explainer; iOS offers provisional authorisation (quiet delivery, no OS prompt) for the period before the first meaningful moment, so early transactional pushes (e.g. "Application submitted") still reach Notification Center silently without asking.

BR-47.7 Android channels. Created at first launch (M00 BR-0.1): leads (importance HIGH, sound + vibration — categories leads, demos), payments (DEFAULT — payments, subscription, referral), account (DEFAULT — account, verification, complaints), reviews (DEFAULT — reviews), general (LOW — recommendations, announcements). A category not in this list defaults to general. A user who mutes a channel in Android system settings still gets push_status = sent server-side — the OS silently drops it, which this module calls out for support scripts ("delivered but not received" is often a muted channel, not a bug).

BR-47.8 iOS categories and threading. One UNNotificationCategory per Android-channel group (same five, for consistent grouping in iOS Settings); thread-id = the deep link's entity id, so repeated pushes about one lead/demo/payment stack instead of scattering; interruption-level = time-sensitive when urgent, active otherwise (never passive — quiet hours already gate timing server-side, so nothing needs to be silently deprioritised on-device).

BR-47.9 Foreground display. @notifee/react-native renders an in-app banner for any FCM message that arrives while the app is foregrounded (onMessage), styled by category (icon + accent colour matching its channel group), auto-dismissing after 5 s, tappable to the same deep link a real notification tap would use — a tap here also calls POST /notifications/:id/opened.

BR-47.10 Multiple devices. A user signed in on two phones (M00 BR-0.6) receives the push on every active user_devices row; opening it on either marks the row read for both (M48 re-fetches the unread count on foreground, so the badge clears everywhere within one app-open).

14. State Management

15. Offline Handling

  • POST /notifications/:id/opened is a queue-offline write (conventions §8 class 1 — idempotent, keyed by notification id, explicitly listed there as "notification read"): a tap while offline is stored and replayed FIFO on reconnect: the read state is visually applied immediately in the UI regardless.
  • The permission explainer and OS prompts work fully offline (no network call until the resulting PUT /devices/me, which is itself queued per M00 BR-0.5, latest-wins).
